    [void](Assert-Contains 'post associative-cross-filter.spec.ts' $specPost 'toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2)' 'LAW 10 the two-dependent-mutation threshold is unchanged')
    [void](Assert-Contains 'post associative-cross-filter.spec.ts' $specPost 'expect(notRestored, "clearing the selection did not restore baseline").toEqual([]);' 'LAW 10 clear restoration is still exact')
    [void](Assert-Contains 'post associative-cross-filter.spec.ts' $specPost 'BLOCKED BY NON-DETERMINISTIC WIDGET RESULT' 'LAW 10 baseline stability is still reported, not excluded')
    [void](Assert-Contains 'post associative-cross-filter.spec.ts' $specPost 'the gate is not measuring executed propagation' 'LAW 10 the falsification assertion is unchanged')
    [void](Assert-Contains 'post associative-cross-filter.spec.ts' $specPost 'const REQUIRED = ["bar", "line", "table", "scatter", "heatmap", "kpi"]' 'LAW 10 all six renderer families are still required')
    [void](Assert-NotContains 'post associative-cross-filter.spec.ts' $specPost 'test.skip' 'LAW 10 nothing is skipped')
    [void](Assert-NotContains 'post associative-cross-filter.spec.ts' $specPost 'test.fixme' 'LAW 10 nothing is deferred')

    # ---- law 11: evidence schema untouched, falsification forceable --------
    if ($PostImages.ContainsKey('Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\e2e\release-truth\associativeSelectionEvidence.ts')) {
        Write-Bad 'LAW 11 the evidence module must not be rewritten by this pack'
    } else {
        Write-Ok 'LAW 11 associativeSelectionEvidence.ts, release-truth.globalSetup.ts and playwright.release-truth.config.ts are preserved untouched'
    }
    [void](Assert-Contains 'post associative-cross-filter.spec.ts' $specPost 'PPIQ_T204_FALSIFY' 'LAW 11 the gate can be forced RED on demand')

    if ($script:Failures.Count -eq 0) { Write-Ok 'Every closure law holds.'; return $true }
    return $false
}

# ============================================================ STEP 3 + 4 ======
function Invoke-Apply {
    Write-Head 'STEP 3 - BACKUP (outside the repository) AND APPLY'

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupDir -Force | Out-Null
    foreach ($rel in $OwnedRelative) {
        $dst = Join-Path $BackupDir $rel
        $dstDir = Split-Path -Parent $dst
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dstDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dstDir -Force | Out-Null }
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepoRootFull $rel) -Destination $dst -Force
    }
    Write-Ok "All six files backed up to $BackupDir"

    foreach ($rel in $ChangedRelative) {
        Write-NoBom (Join-Path $RepoRootFull $rel) $PostImages[$rel]
        Write-Ok "written  $rel"
    }

    Write-Head 'STEP 4 - POST-IMAGE HASHES ON DISK'
    $ok = $true
    foreach ($rel in $ChangedRelative) {
        $full = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $rel
        $onDisk = Get-FileSha256 $full
        if ($onDisk -ne $ExpectedHash[$rel]) { Write-Bad "hash mismatch after write: $rel"; $ok = $false }
        else { Write-Ok ('hash ' + $onDisk.Substring(0, 16) + "  $rel") }
        $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($full)
        if ($bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and $bytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and $bytes[2] -eq 0xBF) {
            Write-Bad "BOM written into $rel"; $ok = $false
        }
    }
    return $ok
}

function Restore-Backup {
    foreach ($rel in $OwnedRelative) {
        $src = Join-Path $BackupDir $rel
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $src) { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination (Join-Path $RepoRootFull $rel) -Force }
    }
    Write-Warn "Reverted from $BackupDir. The working tree is exactly as it was."
}

# ============================================================ STEP 5 ==========
function Invoke-TargetedTypecheck {
    Write-Head 'STEP 5 - TARGETED T-204 TYPE GATE'

    $fwd = { param([string]$p) return $p.Replace('\', '/') }

    $files = @()
    foreach ($rel in $OwnedRelative) { $files += (& $fwd (Join-Path $RepoRootFull $rel)) }

    $baseConfig = & $fwd (Join-Path $WebRoot 'e2e\tsconfig.json')
    $typeRoots = & $fwd (Join-Path $WebRoot 'node_modules\@types')

    $lines = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
    [void]$lines.Add('{')
    [void]$lines.Add('  "extends": "' + $baseConfig + '",')
    [void]$lines.Add('  "compilerOptions": {')
    [void]$lines.Add('    "noEmit": true,')
    [void]$lines.Add('    "typeRoots": ["' + $typeRoots + '"]')
    [void]$lines.Add('  },')
    [void]$lines.Add('  "include": [],')
    [void]$lines.Add('  "exclude": [],')
    [void]$lines.Add('  "files": [')
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $files.Count; $i++) {
        $comma = ','
        if ($i -eq ($files.Count - 1)) { $comma = '' }
        [void]$lines.Add('    "' + $files[$i] + '"' + $comma)
    }
    [void]$lines.Add('  ]')
    [void]$lines.Add('}')

    $configPath = Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'tsconfig.t204.json'
    Write-NoBom $configPath (($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
    Write-Ok "temporary tsconfig (outside the repo): $configPath"
    Write-Inf 'files list: the six T-204-owned files only. Their imports are checked through the module graph.'

    Push-Location -LiteralPath $WebRoot
    try { $targeted = Invoke-LocalBin 'tsc' @('-p', $configPath) } finally { Pop-Location }
    $targeted.Output | Out-String | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'typecheck_t204.log') -Encoding ASCII

    if ($targeted.Exit -ne 0) {
        Write-Bad 'the T-204 type gate failed. These errors are inside the six owned files or their imports:'
        $targeted.Output | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor Red }
        return $false
    }
    Write-Ok 'T-204 type gate clean'

    # Reported, never a blocker. Unrelated broken specs are not modified.
    Push-Location -LiteralPath $WebRoot
    try { $tscB = Invoke-LocalBin 'tsc' @('-b') } finally { Pop-Location }
    if ($tscB.Exit -eq 0) { Write-Ok 'tsc -b clean (reported; it covers none of the six T-204 files)' }
    else { Write-Warn 'tsc -b reported errors. NOT a T-204 blocker; see typecheck_tscb.log' }
    $tscB.Output | Out-String | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'typecheck_tscb.log') -Encoding ASCII

    Push-Location -LiteralPath $WebRoot
    try { $whole = Invoke-LocalBin 'tsc' @('-p', 'e2e/tsconfig.json', '--noEmit') } finally { Pop-Location }
    $whole.Output | Out-String | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'typecheck_whole_e2e.log') -Encoding ASCII
    if ($whole.Exit -eq 0) { Write-Ok 'the whole e2e project also type-checks clean (reported)' }
    else {
        Write-Warn 'the whole e2e project does NOT type-check. Pre-existing and unrelated to T-204:'
        $offenders = @($whole.Output | ForEach-Object { "$_" } | Where-Object { $_ -match '^e2e/' } |
                       ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '\(')[0] } | Sort-Object -Unique)
        foreach ($o in $offenders) { Write-Host "         $o" -ForegroundColor DarkGray }
        Write-Warn 'These files are NOT owned by T-204, are NOT modified, and do NOT block this closure.'
    }
    return $true
}

# ============================================================ RUNTIME =========
$script:ApiProcess = $null
$ApiBase = "http://localhost:$ApiPort"

function Test-ApiHealthy {
    try {
        $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$ApiBase/health" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5
        return ($r.StatusCode -ge 200 -and $r.StatusCode -lt 400)
    } catch { return $false }
}

function Get-PortOwner([int]$Port) {
    try {
        $conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $Port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
        if ($null -eq $conn) { return $null }
        return (Get-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
    } catch { return $null }
}

function Get-ApiEnvironment {
    # Mirrors playwright.config.ts webServer env. A different auth configuration
    # here would leave the e2e admin unable to log in, and that failure would
    # read as a product defect.
    $conn = $env:ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb
    if (-not $conn) { $conn = $env:PPIQ_TEST_CONNECTION_STRING }
    if (-not $conn) { $conn = 'Host=localhost;Port=5432;Database=ppiq_app;Username=ppiq_dev;Password=ppiq_dev_local_only' }
    $signing = $env:PlantProcess__Auth__SigningKey
    if (-not $signing) { $signing = 'ppiq-local-signing-key-not-for-production-0a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6' }
    $pass = $env:PPIQ_SMOKE_PASSWORD
    if (-not $pass) { $pass = 'E2eAdmin_Local123!' }

    return @{
        ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT = 'Development'
        ASPNETCORE_URLS = $ApiBase
        ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb = $conn
        PLANTPROCESS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = 'http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:3000'
        PlantProcess__AllowedOrigins__0 = 'http://localhost:5173'
        PlantProcess__AllowedOrigins__1 = 'http://localhost:3000'
        PlantProcess__RequireDatabaseConnectionString = 'true'
        PlantProcess__PlantTimeZoneId = 'Europe/Berlin'
        PlantProcess__PlantUtcOffsetMinutes = '60'
        PlantProcess__Auth__Issuer = 'PlantProcessIQ'
        PlantProcess__Auth__Audience = 'PlantProcessIQ.Client'
        PlantProcess__Auth__SigningKey = $signing
        PlantProcess__Auth__AccessTokenMinutes = '120'
        PlantProcess__Auth__BootstrapAdminUser = 'bootstrap-admin'
        PlantProcess__Auth__BootstrapAdminPassword = 'BootstrapAdmin_DoNotUse123!'
        PlantProcess__Auth__BootstrapAdminForcePasswordChange = 'true'
        PlantProcess__Auth__Users__0__UserName = 'e2eadmin'
        PlantProcess__Auth__Users__0__Password = $pass
        PlantProcess__Auth__Users__0__Role = 'Admin'
        PlantProcess__Auth__Users__0__DisplayName = 'Playwright E2E Admin'
        PlantProcess__Auth__Users__0__IsBootstrapAdmin = 'false'
        PlantProcess__Auth__Users__0__ForcePasswordChangeOnFirstLogin = 'false'
        PPIQ_SMOKE_USERNAME = 'e2eadmin'
        PPIQ_SMOKE_PASSWORD = $pass
        VITE_API_BASE_URL = $ApiBase
        PLAYWRIGHT_API_URL = $ApiBase
    }
}

function Start-Api {
    Write-Head 'STEP 6 - API RUNTIME'

    $envMap = Get-ApiEnvironment
    foreach ($key in $envMap.Keys) { [System.Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($key, $envMap[$key], 'Process') }

    for ($attempt = 1; $attempt -le 2; $attempt++) {
        if (Test-ApiHealthy) { Write-Ok "API healthy on $ApiBase - reusing it"; return $true }

        $owner = Get-PortOwner $ApiPort
        if ($null -ne $owner) {
            Write-Warn "Port $ApiPort is held by $($owner.ProcessName) (pid $($owner.Id)) but /health does not answer."
            Write-Warn 'Stopping it so the certification runs against a known runtime.'
            try { Stop-Process -Id $owner.Id -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Warn "could not stop pid $($owner.Id): $_" }
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
        }

        $csproj = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\PlantProcess.Api.csproj'
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $csproj)) { Write-Bad "API project not found: $csproj"; return $false }

        $log = Join-Path $EvidenceDir "api_attempt$attempt.log"
        $errLog = Join-Path $EvidenceDir "api_attempt$attempt.err.log"
        Write-Inf "Starting API (attempt $attempt): dotnet run --project $csproj --urls $ApiBase"
        $script:ApiProcess = Start-Process -FilePath 'dotnet' `
            -ArgumentList @('run', '--project', $csproj, '--urls', $ApiBase) `
            -WorkingDirectory $RepoRootFull -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden `
            -RedirectStandardOutput $log -RedirectStandardError $errLog

        for ($i = 0; $i -lt 60; $i++) {
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
            if (Test-ApiHealthy) { Write-Ok "API healthy after $((($i + 1) * 3)) s"; return $true }
            if ($script:ApiProcess.HasExited) {
                Write-Warn "the API exited with code $($script:ApiProcess.ExitCode) on attempt $attempt. See $log"
                break
            }
        }
        Write-Warn "attempt $attempt did not reach a healthy API."
    }

    Write-Bad "API did not become healthy on $ApiBase after two attempts. See the api_attempt logs in the evidence directory."
    return $false
}

function Stop-Api {
    if ($null -eq $script:ApiProcess) { return }
    if ($script:ApiProcess.HasExited) { return }
    Write-Inf "Stopping the API this pack started (pid $($script:ApiProcess.Id))"
    try { Stop-Process -Id $script:ApiProcess.Id -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Warn "could not stop the API cleanly: $_" }
}

function Get-Bearer {
    $pass = $env:PPIQ_SMOKE_PASSWORD
    if (-not $pass) { $pass = 'E2eAdmin_Local123!' }
    $body = @{ UserName = 'e2eadmin'; Password = $pass } | ConvertTo-Json
    $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$ApiBase/auth/login" -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json' -TimeoutSec 30
    $token = Get-Prop $r 'accessToken'
    if (-not $token) { $token = Get-Prop $r 'token' }
    if (-not $token) { throw 'login returned no bearer token' }
    return [string]$token
}

function Invoke-Gate([string]$Label, [bool]$Falsify) {
    Write-Head "GATE RUN: $Label"

    if ($Falsify) { [System.Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('PPIQ_T204_FALSIFY', '1', 'Process') }
    else { [System.Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('PPIQ_T204_FALSIFY', $null, 'Process') }

    Push-Location -LiteralPath $WebRoot
    try {
        $run = Invoke-LocalBin 'playwright' @('test', '--config=playwright.release-truth.config.ts', 'e2e/release-truth/associative-cross-filter.spec.ts')
    } finally { Pop-Location }

    $out = Join-Path $EvidenceDir ("gate_" + $Label + ".log")
    $run.Output | Out-String | Set-Content -LiteralPath $out -Encoding ASCII
    Write-Inf "gate output: $out"
    $run.Output | Select-Object -Last 30 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkGray }

    # Snapshot this run's evidence before the next run's globalSetup clears it.
    $evSrc = Join-Path $WebRoot 'reports\release-truth\associative'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $evSrc) {
        $evDst = Join-Path $EvidenceDir ("associative_" + $Label)
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $evSrc -Destination $evDst -Recurse -Force
        Write-Inf "evidence snapshot: $evDst"
    }
    return @{ Exit = $run.Exit }
}

function Read-Phases([string]$Label) {
    $root = Join-Path $EvidenceDir ("associative_" + $Label)
    $marker = Join-Path $root 'run-id.txt'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $marker)) { return @() }
    $runId = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $marker -Raw).Trim()
    $dir = Join-Path $root $runId
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { return @() }
    $phases = @()
    foreach ($f in (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Filter '*.json' -File)) {
        $phases += (Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
    }
    return $phases
}

function Get-FiltersJson($Row) {
    $f = Get-Prop $Row 'executedRequestFilters'
    if ($null -eq $f) { return '{}' }
    return ($f | ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 8)
}

# ============================================================ STEPS 7-15 ======
function Invoke-Certify {
    if (-not (Test-PostImageOnDisk)) {
        Write-Bad 'REFUSING TO CERTIFY: the T-204 post-image hashes are not on disk. Certifying here would certify a different implementation than the one this pack builds.'
        return $false
    }
    Write-Ok 'post-image hashes confirmed on disk - certification is against the proposed T-204 implementation'

    if (-not (Start-Api)) { return $false }

    try {
        Write-Head 'STEP 7 - FALSIFICATION FIRST (MUST BE RED)'
        Write-Inf 'Every filter is severed at the request boundary. A gate that cannot be made to fail is not evidence.'
        $red = Invoke-Gate 'falsified' $true
        if ($red.Exit -eq 0) {
            Write-Bad 'THE FALSIFIED RUN PASSED. The gate is not measuring executed propagation. Certification refused.'
            return $false
        }
        Write-Ok "falsified run exited $($red.Exit) - RED as required"

        Write-Head 'STEP 8 - NORMAL RUN (MUST BE GREEN)'
        $normal = Invoke-Gate 'normal' $false
        if ($normal.Exit -ne 0) {
            Write-Bad "the normal run exited $($normal.Exit) - the gate is RED. Certification refused. See gate_normal.log."
            return $false
        }
        Write-Ok 'normal run exited 0 - GREEN'

        Write-Head 'STEPS 9-13 - EVIDENCE ASSERTIONS'
        $phases = @(Read-Phases 'normal')
        if ($phases.Count -eq 0) { Write-Bad 'the normal run produced no phase artifacts'; return $false }
        Write-Ok "$($phases.Count) phase artifact(s) read from the normal run"

        $dep = @($phases | Where-Object { -not ((Get-Prop $_ 'widgetCode').StartsWith('POSSIBLE_SET|') -or (Get-Prop $_ 'widgetCode').StartsWith('UNMATCHED|')) })
        $possible = @($phases | Where-Object { (Get-Prop $_ 'widgetCode').StartsWith('POSSIBLE_SET|') })
        Write-Inf "$($dep.Count) dependent observation(s), $($possible.Count) possible-set observation(s) retained in evidence"
        if ($possible.Count -eq 0) { Write-Warn 'no possible-set traffic was observed; the exclusion predicate is untested by this run.' }
        else { Write-Ok 'possible-set traffic was captured AND kept out of the dependent comparison' }

        foreach ($family in @('bar', 'line', 'table', 'scatter', 'heatmap', 'kpi')) {
            $scenario = "renderer-$family"
            $rows = @($dep | Where-Object { (Get-Prop $_ 'scenario') -eq $scenario -and ('' + (Get-Prop $_ 'chartType')).ToLower() -eq $family })
            $b = @($rows | Where-Object { (Get-Prop $_ 'phase') -eq 'BASELINE_A' })
            $s = @($rows | Where-Object { (Get-Prop $_ 'phase') -eq 'SELECTED' })
            $c = @($rows | Where-Object { (Get-Prop $_ 'phase') -eq 'CLEARED' })
            if ($b.Count -eq 0 -or $s.Count -eq 0 -or $c.Count -eq 0) {
                Write-Bad "$family FAIL  incomplete four-phase case (baseline $($b.Count), selected $($s.Count), cleared $($c.Count))"
                continue
            }
            $bf = Get-FiltersJson $b[0]; $sf = Get-FiltersJson $s[0]; $cf = Get-FiltersJson $c[0]
            $requestChanged = ($bf -ne $sf)
            $resultChanged = ((Get-Prop $b[0] 'population') -ne (Get-Prop $s[0] 'population')) -or ((Get-Prop $b[0] 'semanticResultSignature') -ne (Get-Prop $s[0] 'semanticResultSignature'))
            $restored = ($bf -eq $cf) -and ((Get-Prop $b[0] 'population') -eq (Get-Prop $c[0] 'population')) -and ((Get-Prop $b[0] 'semanticResultSignature') -eq (Get-Prop $c[0] 'semanticResultSignature'))
            if ($requestChanged -and $resultChanged -and $restored) { Write-Ok "$family PASS  baseline / request changed / result changed / clear restored" }
            else { Write-Bad "$family FAIL  requestChanged=$requestChanged resultChanged=$resultChanged clearRestored=$restored" }
        }

        $sa = @($dep | Where-Object { (Get-Prop $_ 'scenario') -eq 'stability' -and (Get-Prop $_ 'phase') -eq 'BASELINE_A' })
        $sb = @($dep | Where-Object { (Get-Prop $_ 'scenario') -eq 'stability' -and (Get-Prop $_ 'phase') -eq 'BASELINE_B' })
        if ($sa.Count -gt 0 -and $sa.Count -eq $sb.Count) { Write-Ok "baseline stability PASS ($($sa.Count) dependent widgets observed twice)" }
        else { Write-Bad "baseline stability FAIL (A $($sa.Count), B $($sb.Count))" }

        $ab = @($dep | Where-Object { (Get-Prop $_ 'scenario') -eq 'associative' -and (Get-Prop $_ 'phase') -eq 'BASELINE_A' })
        $asel = @($dep | Where-Object { (Get-Prop $_ 'scenario') -eq 'associative' -and (Get-Prop $_ 'phase') -eq 'SELECTED' })
        $acl = @($dep | Where-Object { (Get-Prop $_ 'scenario') -eq 'associative' -and (Get-Prop $_ 'phase') -eq 'CLEARED' })

        $carried = @($asel | Where-Object { (Get-FiltersJson $_) -ne '{}' })
        if ($carried.Count -gt 0) { Write-Ok "X propagation PASS ($($carried.Count) dependent request(s) carried the selection)" }
        else { Write-Bad 'X propagation FAIL - no dependent request carried a filter' }

        $mutations = 0
        foreach ($sel in $asel) {
            $bas = $ab | Where-Object { (Get-Prop $_ 'widgetCode') -eq (Get-Prop $sel 'widgetCode') } | Select-Object -First 1
            if ($null -eq $bas) { continue }
            $q = ((Get-FiltersJson $bas) -ne (Get-FiltersJson $sel))
            $a = ((Get-Prop $bas 'population') -ne (Get-Prop $sel 'population')) -or ((Get-Prop $bas 'semanticResultSignature') -ne (Get-Prop $sel 'semanticResultSignature'))
            if ($q -and $a) { $mutations++ }
        }
        if ($mutations -ge 2) { Write-Ok "two dependent result mutations PASS ($mutations dependents changed query AND result)" }
        else { Write-Bad "two dependent result mutations FAIL - only $mutations dependent(s) changed both" }

        $notRestored = 0
        foreach ($bas in $ab) {
            $cl = $acl | Where-Object { (Get-Prop $_ 'widgetCode') -eq (Get-Prop $bas 'widgetCode') } | Select-Object -First 1
            if ($null -eq $cl) { continue }
            $same = ((Get-FiltersJson $bas) -eq (Get-FiltersJson $cl)) -and
                    ((Get-Prop $bas 'population') -eq (Get-Prop $cl 'population')) -and
                    ((Get-Prop $bas 'semanticResultSignature') -eq (Get-Prop $cl 'semanticResultSignature'))
            if (-not $same) { $notRestored++ }
        }
        if ($acl.Count -gt 0 -and $notRestored -eq 0) { Write-Ok 'clear restoration PASS' }
        else { Write-Bad "clear restoration FAIL - $notRestored dependent(s) did not return to baseline" }

        $mSel = @($dep | Where-Object { (Get-Prop $_ 'scenario') -eq 'multi' -and (Get-Prop $_ 'phase') -eq 'SELECTED' })
        $mCl = @($dep | Where-Object { (Get-Prop $_ 'scenario') -eq 'multi' -and (Get-Prop $_ 'phase') -eq 'CLEARED' })
        $composed = @($mSel | Where-Object { ((Get-FiltersJson $_) -split ':').Count -ge 3 })
        if ($mSel.Count -gt 0 -and $mCl.Count -gt 0 -and $composed.Count -gt 0) {
            Write-Ok "X/Y/remove-Y/remove-X PASS (a dependent executed a two-field filter, and clear returned it to baseline)"
        } else {
            Write-Bad "X/Y/remove-Y/remove-X FAIL (selected $($mSel.Count), two-field $($composed.Count), cleared $($mCl.Count))"
        }

        Write-Ok 'falsification RED then normal GREEN PASS'

        Write-Head 'STEPS 14-15 - INVENTORY'
        $token = Get-Bearer
        $headers = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $token"; 'X-PPIQ-MFA-Verified' = 'true'; Accept = 'application/json' }
        $defs = @(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$ApiBase/analytics/dashboard/definitions" -Headers $headers -TimeoutSec 90)

        $activeDefs = @($defs | Where-Object { (Get-Prop $_ 'isActive') -ne $false })
        $acceptanceDefs = @($activeDefs | Where-Object { [string](Get-Prop $_ 'dashboardCode') -like 'ACCEPTANCE_ASSOCIATIVE_*' })
        $acceptanceWidgets = 0
        foreach ($d in $acceptanceDefs) {
            $ws = Get-Prop $d 'widgets'
            if ($null -ne $ws) { $acceptanceWidgets += @($ws | Where-Object { (Get-Prop $_ 'isActive') -ne $false }).Count }
        }
        $systemDefs = @($activeDefs | Where-Object { [string](Get-Prop $_ 'dashboardCode') -like 'SYSTEM_*' })
        $systemWidgets = 0
        $systemCodes = @()
        foreach ($d in $systemDefs) {
            $systemCodes += [string](Get-Prop $d 'dashboardCode')
            $ws = Get-Prop $d 'widgets'
            if ($null -ne $ws) { $systemWidgets += @($ws | Where-Object { (Get-Prop $_ 'isActive') -ne $false }).Count }
        }

        if ($acceptanceDefs.Count -eq 0) { Write-Ok 'active acceptance dashboards 0' }
        else { Write-Bad ("active acceptance dashboards $($acceptanceDefs.Count) - the ephemeral fixture leaked: " + (($acceptanceDefs | ForEach-Object { [string](Get-Prop $_ 'dashboardCode') }) -join ', ')) }

        if ($acceptanceWidgets -eq 0) { Write-Ok 'active acceptance widgets 0' }
        else { Write-Bad "active acceptance widgets $acceptanceWidgets - the ephemeral fixture leaked" }

        if ($systemDefs.Count -eq 5) { Write-Ok "canonical system dashboards 5 ($(($systemCodes | Sort-Object) -join ', '))" }
        else { Write-Bad "canonical system dashboards $($systemDefs.Count), expected 5" }

        if ($systemWidgets -eq 13) { Write-Ok 'canonical system widgets 13' }
        else { Write-Bad "canonical system widgets $systemWidgets, expected 13" }

        $summary = [ordered]@{
            task = 'T-204'; version = 'V2'; head = $head
            certifiedAtUtc = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')
            falsifiedRunExit = $red.Exit; normalRunExit = $normal.Exit
            dependentObservations = $dep.Count; possibleSetObservations = $possible.Count
            dependentMutations = $mutations
            acceptanceDashboards = $acceptanceDefs.Count; acceptanceWidgets = $acceptanceWidgets
            systemDashboards = $systemDefs.Count; systemWidgets = $systemWidgets
            postImageHashes = $ExpectedHash
            failures = @($script:Failures)
        }
        Write-NoBom (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'certification.json') (($summary | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8) + "`r`n")
        Write-Ok "certification summary: $(Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'certification.json')"
    }
    finally { Stop-Api }

    if ($script:Failures.Count -eq 0) { return $true }
    return $false
}

# ============================================================ STEPS 16-17 =====
function Invoke-Commit {
    Write-Head 'STEP 16 - STAGE EXACTLY THE SIX T-204 FILES'
    Push-Location -LiteralPath $RepoRootFull
    try {
        $alreadyStaged = @(& git diff --cached --name-only)
        if ($alreadyStaged.Count -gt 0) {
            Write-Bad ('the index is not empty before staging. Refusing to commit alongside foreign staged files: ' + ($alreadyStaged -join ', '))
            return $false
        }

        foreach ($rel in $OwnedRelative) {
            & git add -- ($rel.Replace('\', '/'))
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Bad "git add failed for $rel"; return $false }
        }

        $staged = @(& git diff --cached --name-only)
        $expectedSet = @($OwnedRelative | ForEach-Object { $_.Replace('\', '/') })
        $foreign = @($staged | Where-Object { $expectedSet -notcontains $_ })
        if ($foreign.Count -gt 0) {
            Write-Bad ('foreign staged files present, refusing to commit: ' + ($foreign -join ', '))
            & git reset -- $foreign 2>&1 | Out-Null
            return $false
        }
        if ($staged.Count -eq 0) {
            Write-Warn 'nothing to commit - the six files are already identical to HEAD.'
            return $true
        }
        Write-Ok ('staged: ' + ($staged -join ', '))

        Write-Head 'STEP 17 - COMMIT'
        & git commit -m 'Certify associative cross-filter behavior'
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Bad 'git commit failed'; return $false }
        Write-Ok ('committed at ' + (& git rev-parse --short HEAD))

        $dirty = @(& git status --porcelain)
        if ($dirty.Count -gt 0) {
            Write-Inf 'the working tree still carries unrelated changes (evidence artifacts under reports/ are expected):'
            $dirty | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkGray }
        }
    } finally { Pop-Location }
    return $true
}

        Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepoRootFull $rel) -Destination $dst -Force
    }
    Write-Ok "All six files backed up to $BackupDir"
} else {
    if (-not (Invoke-Apply)) {
        Restore-Backup
        Write-Head 'RESULT'
        foreach ($f in $script:Failures) { Write-Host "  - $f" -ForegroundColor Red }
        Write-Bad 'CLOSE FAILED writing the post-image. Reverted.'

PPIQ APPLY PACK - Associative Phase Identity Correction
================================================================================
Backlog origin : T-204   Release: M2   Owner: Worker 2 (Release Truth)

THE DEFECT, MEASURED
  Duplicate phase artifact: stability/BASELINE_A/dataQualityIssueCount|materialUnitType
  Three artifacts were written, then a fourth observation collided.

ROOT CAUSE - MINE, NOT THE PRODUCT'S
  The artifact identity is measureCode|dimensionCode, which identifies a QUERY,
  not a widget instance. A widget legitimately executes the same query more than
  once inside one phase: initial load, then a refresh. The duplicate guard was
  correct to fire; the identity model was wrong.

  Within a phase, keep the LAST observation per query identity. It is the
  settled one; earlier observations are superseded, not duplicates. This is a
  semantic correction, not a relaxation:
    - the duplicate guard in the evidence module is untouched
    - two artifacts for the same query in the same phase would still fail
    - nothing is deduplicated across phases
    - no threshold is weakened anywhere

// ============================================================================

import type { APIRequestContext } from "@playwright/test";

export const ACCEPTANCE_PREFIX = "ACCEPTANCE_ASSOCIATIVE_";

/** Scatter is measure-constrained by DashboardWidgetQuerySafetyRegistry
 *  .IsChartCompatibleWithMeasure. These are the only measures it admits. */
export const SCATTER_COMPATIBLE_MEASURES = [
  "avgParameterValue", "riskScore", "defectRate", "parameterRelationship",
];

export type WidgetIdentity = { dashboardCode: string; widgetCode: string; id: string };
export type Inventory = { dashboards: string[]; widgets: WidgetIdentity[] };

function auth(token: string) {
  return { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, "X-PPIQ-MFA-Verified": "true", Accept: "application/json" };
}

export async function bearer(api: APIRequestContext, base: string, user: string, pass: string): Promise<string> {
  const r = await api.post(`${base}/auth/login`, { data: { UserName: user, Password: pass } });
  if (!r.ok()) throw new Error(`fixture login failed: http ${r.status()}`);
  const j = (await r.json()) as Record<string, string>;
  const t = j.accessToken ?? j.token;
  if (!t) throw new Error("fixture login returned no bearer token");
  return t;
}

export async function readInventory(api: APIRequestContext, base: string, token: string): Promise<Inventory> {
  const r = await api.get(`${base}/analytics/dashboard/definitions`, { headers: auth(token) });
  if (!r.ok()) throw new Error(`cannot enumerate definitions: http ${r.status()}`);
  const defs = (await r.json()) as Record<string, unknown>[];
  const dashboards: string[] = [];
  const widgets: WidgetIdentity[] = [];
  for (const d of defs) {
    const code = String(d.dashboardCode ?? "");
    if (d.isActive === false) continue;
    dashboards.push(code);
    for (const w of ((d.widgets as Record<string, unknown>[]) ?? [])) {
      if (w.isActive === false) continue;
      widgets.push({ dashboardCode: code, widgetCode: String(w.widgetCode ?? ""), id: String(w.id ?? "") });
    }
  }
  dashboards.sort();
  widgets.sort((a, b) => (a.dashboardCode + a.widgetCode).localeCompare(b.dashboardCode + b.widgetCode));
  return { dashboards, widgets };
}

/** A lawful dimension/measure pair taken from a definition the product already
 *  persisted. Never a literal chosen by this test. */
export type CodePair = { dimensionCode: string; measureCode: string };

export async function resolveLawfulPairs(
  api: APIRequestContext, base: string, token: string
): Promise<{ any: CodePair; scatter: CodePair | null }> {
  const r = await api.get(`${base}/analytics/dashboard/definitions`, { headers: auth(token) });
  const defs = (await r.json()) as Record<string, unknown>[];
  const pairs: CodePair[] = [];
  for (const d of defs) {
    for (const w of ((d.widgets as Record<string, unknown>[]) ?? [])) {
      const dim = String(w.dimensionCode ?? "");
      const mea = String(w.measureCode ?? "");
      if (dim && mea) pairs.push({ dimensionCode: dim, measureCode: mea });
    }
  }
  if (pairs.length === 0) throw new Error("no persisted widget offers a lawful dimension/measure pair");
  const scatter = pairs.find((p) =>
    SCATTER_COMPATIBLE_MEASURES.some((m) => m.toLowerCase() === p.measureCode.toLowerCase())) ?? null;
  return { any: pairs[0], scatter };
}

export type Created = { definitionId: string; dashboardCode: string; widgetIds: string[] };

export async function createAcceptanceDashboard(
  api: APIRequestContext, base: string, token: string,
  pairs: { any: CodePair; scatter: CodePair | null }
): Promise<Created> {
  const dashboardCode = `${ACCEPTANCE_PREFIX}${Date.now()}`;
  const created = await api.post(`${base}/analytics/dashboard/definitions`, {
    headers: auth(token),
    data: {
      dashboardCode, name: "Associative acceptance fixture (ephemeral)",
      description: "Created through the public authoring contract by the associative certification. Removed after the run.",
      layoutJson: "{}", isDefault: false, isSystemTemplate: false, isSynthetic: true,
    },
  });
  if (!created.ok()) throw new Error(`cannot author acceptance dashboard: http ${created.status()}`);
  const definitionId = String(((await created.json()) as Record<string, unknown>).id ?? "");
  if (!definitionId) throw new Error("authoring returned no definition id");

  const wanted: { chartType: string; widgetType: string; pair: CodePair }[] = [
    { chartType: "kpi",     widgetType: "kpi",   pair: pairs.any },
    { chartType: "heatmap", widgetType: "chart", pair: pairs.any },
  ];
  if (pairs.scatter) wanted.push({ chartType: "scatter", widgetType: "chart", pair: pairs.scatter });

  const widgetIds: string[] = [];
  for (const w of wanted) {
    const res = await api.post(`${base}/analytics/dashboard/definitions/${definitionId}/widgets`, {
      headers: auth(token),
      data: {
        widgetCode: `${ACCEPTANCE_PREFIX}${w.chartType.toUpperCase()}`,
        widgetTitle: `Acceptance ${w.chartType}`,
        widgetType: w.widgetType, chartType: w.chartType,
        dimensionCode: w.pair.dimensionCode, measureCode: w.pair.measureCode,
        filterJson: "{}", layoutJson: "{}", displayOptionsJson: "{}", sortOrder: 0, isSynthetic: true,
      },
    });
    if (!res.ok()) {
      throw new Error(
        `BLOCKED BY AUTHORING CONTRACT: ${w.chartType} - renderer supports it but the public ` +
        `authoring contract refused it with http ${res.status()}: ${(await res.text()).slice(0, 300)}`
      );
    }
    widgetIds.push(String(((await res.json()) as Record<string, unknown>).id ?? ""));
  }
  return { definitionId, dashboardCode, widgetIds };
}

/** Public-API cleanup. Never SQL. Safe to call on a partially created fixture. */
export async function removeAcceptanceArtifacts(
  api: APIRequestContext, base: string, token: string
): Promise<string[]> {
  const removed: string[] = [];
  const r = await api.get(`${base}/analytics/dashboard/definitions`, { headers: auth(token) });
  if (!r.ok()) return removed;
  const defs = (await r.json()) as Record<string, unknown>[];
  for (const d of defs) {
    const code = String(d.dashboardCode ?? "");
    if (!code.startsWith(ACCEPTANCE_PREFIX)) continue;
    const id = String(d.id ?? "");
    for (const w of ((d.widgets as Record<string, unknown>[]) ?? [])) {
      await api.delete(`${base}/analytics/dashboard/definitions/${id}/widgets/${String(w.id)}`, { headers: auth(token) });
    }
    await api.delete(`${base}/analytics/dashboard/definitions/${id}`, { headers: auth(token) });
    removed.push(code);
  }
  return removed;
}

export function inventoryDelta(before: Inventory, after: Inventory): string[] {
  const problems: string[] = [];
  const bd = before.dashboards.join("|"), ad = after.dashboards.join("|");
  if (bd !== ad) problems.push(`dashboard identity set changed:\n  before ${bd}\n  after  ${ad}`);
  const bw = before.widgets.map((w) => `${w.dashboardCode}/${w.widgetCode}#${w.id}`).join("|");
  const aw = after.widgets.map((w) => `${w.dashboardCode}/${w.widgetCode}#${w.id}`).join("|");
  if (bw !== aw) problems.push("widget identity set changed");
  const stale = after.dashboards.filter((c) => c.startsWith(ACCEPTANCE_PREFIX));
  if (stale.length > 0) problems.push(`acceptance definitions remain: ${stale.join(", ")}`);
  return problems;
}

async function settle(page: Page): Promise<boolean> {
  try { await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle", { timeout: 25_000 }); return true; }
  catch { return false; }
}

async function capturePhase(
  page: Page, cap: CaptureHandle, scenario: string, phase: Phase
): Promise<WidgetPhase[]> {
  const settled = await settle(page);
  const intended = await readIntendedSelections(page);
  const written: WidgetPhase[] = [];
  for (const o of cap.observed()) {
    const p: WidgetPhase = {
      scenario, phase, widgetCode: o.widgetCode, chartType: o.chartType,
      intendedFilters: intended, executedRequestFilters: o.executedRequestFilters,
      population: o.population, semanticResultSignature: o.semanticResultSignature,
      settled, writtenAtUtc: new Date().toISOString(), runId: runId(),
    };
    writePhase(p);
    written.push(p);
  }
  return written;
}

async function selectRenderedValue(page: Page): Promise<boolean> {
  const before = await page.locator('[data-testid="selection-chip"]').count();
  const candidates = page.locator(
    "svg .recharts-bar-rectangle, svg .recharts-rectangle, svg .recharts-dot, " +
    "svg .recharts-symbols, tbody tr[role='button'], tbody tr"
  );
  const n = Math.min(await candidates.count(), 14);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 1) {
    try { await candidates.nth(i).click({ timeout: 2_000 }); } catch { continue; }
    await page.waitForTimeout(700);
    if ((await page.locator('[data-testid="selection-chip"]').count()) > before) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** A shipped system dashboard with enough widgets for a source plus two dependents. */
function scenarioDashboard(): string {
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const w of baseline.widgets) counts.set(w.dashboardCode, (counts.get(w.dashboardCode) ?? 0) + 1);
  let best = ""; let most = 0;
  for (const [code, n] of counts) { if (n > most) { most = n; best = code; } }
  return best;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------- stability first ----
test("BASELINE_A equals BASELINE_B before any selection", async ({ page, context }) => {
  await login(context.request);
  const cap = await installWidgetCapture(page);
  const target = `/workspace/${scenarioDashboard()}`;

  cap.reset();
  await page.goto(target, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
  const a = await capturePhase(page, cap, "stability", "BASELINE_A");

  cap.reset();
  await page.reload({ waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
  const b = await capturePhase(page, cap, "stability", "BASELINE_B");

  expect(a.length, `no widget query traffic on ${target}`).toBeGreaterThan(0);

  const byWidget = new Map(b.map((p) => [p.widgetCode, p]));
  const unstable: string[] = [];
  for (const first of a) {
    const second = byWidget.get(first.widgetCode);
    if (second && first.semanticResultSignature !== second.semanticResultSignature) {
      unstable.push(`${first.widgetCode} (${first.chartType})`);
    }
  }
  expect(
    unstable,
    "BLOCKED BY NON-DETERMINISTIC WIDGET RESULT: the same query returned a different " +
      "semantic answer twice with no selection applied. Reported, not excluded."
  ).toEqual([]);
});

// --------------------------------------------- associative state machine ----
test("selection propagates to dependent widgets and clears back to baseline", async ({ page, context }) => {
  await login(context.request);
  const cap = await installWidgetCapture(page);

  cap.reset();
  await page.goto(`/workspace/${scenarioDashboard()}`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
  const before = await capturePhase(page, cap, "associative", "BASELINE_A");
  expect(before.length, "no baseline widget traffic").toBeGreaterThan(0);

  cap.reset();
  expect(await selectRenderedValue(page), "no widget exposed a governed clickable value").toBe(true);
  const after = await capturePhase(page, cap, "associative", "SELECTED");

  const baseByWidget = new Map(before.map((p) => [p.widgetCode, p]));
  const changed = after.filter((p) => {
    const b = baseByWidget.get(p.widgetCode);
    if (!b) return false;
    const queryChanged = JSON.stringify(b.executedRequestFilters) !== JSON.stringify(p.executedRequestFilters);
    const answerChanged = b.population !== p.population || b.semanticResultSignature !== p.semanticResultSignature;
    return queryChanged && answerChanged;
  });
  expect(
    changed.length,
    "fewer than two dependent widgets changed BOTH their executed query and their result. " +
      "A selection that only emits an event is not associative."
  ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);

  cap.reset();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Clear all" }).click();
  const cleared = await capturePhase(page, cap, "associative", "CLEARED");

  const clearByWidget = new Map(cleared.map((p) => [p.widgetCode, p]));
  const notRestored: string[] = [];
  for (const b of before) {
    const c = clearByWidget.get(b.widgetCode);
    if (!c) continue;
    if (JSON.stringify(b.executedRequestFilters) !== JSON.stringify(c.executedRequestFilters)) {
      notRestored.push(`${b.widgetCode}: executed query not restored`);
    } else if (b.population !== c.population || b.semanticResultSignature !== c.semanticResultSignature) {
      notRestored.push(`${b.widgetCode}: analytical result not restored`);
    }
  }
  expect(notRestored, "clearing the selection did not restore baseline").toEqual([]);
});

// ------------------------------------- multi-selection known answer case ----
test("removing one selection leaves an unrelated selection effective", async ({ page, context }) => {
  await login(context.request);
  const cap = await installWidgetCapture(page);

  cap.reset();
  await page.goto(`/workspace/${scenarioDashboard()}`, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
  await capturePhase(page, cap, "multi", "BASELINE_A");

  expect(await selectRenderedValue(page), "first selection unavailable").toBe(true);
  const firstChip = (await page.locator('[data-testid="selection-chip"]').first().innerText()).trim();

  expect(await selectRenderedValue(page), "second selection unavailable").toBe(true);
  expect(await page.locator('[data-testid="selection-chip"]').count(),
    "second selection did not produce a distinct chip").toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);

  await page.locator('[data-testid="selection-chip"]').last().locator("button").last().click();
  await page.waitForTimeout(800);
  const remaining = (await page.locator('[data-testid="selection-chip"]').allInnerTexts()).map((t) => t.trim());
  expect(remaining, "removing one selection erased an unrelated one").toContain(firstChip);

  cap.reset();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Clear all" }).click();
  await capturePhase(page, cap, "multi", "CLEARED");
  expect(await page.locator('[data-testid="selection-chip"]').count(), "clear all left selections behind").toBe(0);
});

PlantProcess IQ - CANONICAL MIGRATION ORDER

Backlog task : T-088 (metadata only; no task id in any permanent artifact)
Owner        : Worker 1

WHAT THIS PRODUCES
  One canonical ordered path that builds a database from zero, every SQL file
  classified into exactly one disposition, a duplicate-DDL truth gate, and a
  fresh throwaway build proving the path needs no manual step.

DISPOSITIONS - exactly one per file, no other value is emitted
  Canonical         schema-defining, on the fresh-build path
  HistoricalRepair  corrective, still required to reach the current shape,
                    on the path, labelled so its role is not mistaken
  Superseded        retired or no-op, off the path
  FixtureOnly       data, demonstration or test content, never on the path
  DeferredWithReason off the path with a written reason

ORDERING
  Primary key is the numeric ordinal. Ties - and there are several - break by
  dependency: a script creating a table precedes one referencing it. Filename
  age never decides. A file with no numeric ordinal is positioned by dependency
  and the reason is recorded; no ordinal is invented or hardcoded.

DUPLICATE DDL
  Governed duplicate: every occurrence after the first uses IF NOT EXISTS, so
  replay is idempotent. Recorded, allowed.
  Ungoverned duplicate: a later unguarded CREATE TABLE for a table an earlier
  path script already creates. That fails the build and fails the gate.

FRESH BUILD
  Mandatory. Creates a throwaway database, replays the canonical path in order,
  records the final schema, and drops it. NOT EXECUTED cannot close this task.

CREDENTIALS
  None embedded. Resolved from env\profiles. The pack stops rather than invent.

FILES

  A  Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\CanonicalMigrationOrderTests.cs
