<#
================================================================================
PlantProcess IQ - CANONICAL MIGRATION ORDER
================================================================================
Backlog task : T-088 (metadata only; no task id in any permanent artifact)
Owner        : Worker 1
Depends      : T-086   Precedes : T-087, T-089, T-112, T-128

ACCEPTANCE BEING MET
  "Define one canonical ordered migration path, archive superseded scripts, and
   add a truth gate that no two scripts create the same table."
  "A fresh database builds from the canonical path with no manual step. The truth
   gate fails if a duplicate CREATE TABLE is introduced."

WHAT THIS PACK DOES
  1. Parses every .sql under Backend\database, with single-quoted literals and
     comments stripped first, so a script's own documentation prose can never be
     mistaken for a statement.
  2. Extracts every CREATE TABLE target and builds a table -> scripts map.
  3. Writes one canonical ordered migration manifest that classifies every script
     as canonical, demo-only, or needs-ruling.
  4. Records pre-existing duplicate CREATE TABLE targets as a shrink-only
     baseline. The gate fails on anything INTRODUCED, which is the acceptance
     wording, and fails if the total grows.
  5. Adds the truth gate as an architecture test.

WHAT THIS PACK DELIBERATELY DOES NOT DO
  It moves and deletes nothing. Choosing which of two colliding scripts is
  superseded is a product judgment that can silently break replay. Every
  collision is classified needs-ruling and reported. Physical archival happens
  after a ruling, not before.

FRESH-DATABASE PROOF
  -FreshBuild replays the canonical path into a throwaway database and drops it.
  It reads connection settings from env\profiles only, embeds no credentials, and
  invokes psql with -f against a written file, never -c. Without the switch the
  closure report states plainly that the fresh build was not executed.

PERMANENT ARTIFACTS  (descriptive names)
  A  Backend\database\canonical-migration-order.json
  A  Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\CanonicalMigrationOrderTests.cs
  A  Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\duplicate-table-baseline.txt   (only if duplicates exist)

EXIT  0 = applied, gate green, staged   2 = verification failed, no mutation
      3 = failed after mutation, auto-revert completed
================================================================================
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot     = 'C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ',
    [string]$EvidenceRoot = 'C:\Workspace\_ppiq_evidence',
    [switch]$StrictZero,
    [switch]$FreshBuild,
    [string]$FreshBuildDatabase = 'ppiq_migration_order_probe',
    [switch]$SkipTests
)

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Write-Head([string]$t) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan; Write-Host $t -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan }
function Write-Ok  ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [OK]   $t" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Warn([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [WARN] $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Write-Bad ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] $t" -ForegroundColor Red }
function Write-Inf ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [INFO] $t" -ForegroundColor Gray }

function Invoke-Git {
    param([string[]]$GitArgs)
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try { $raw = & git @GitArgs 2>&1; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $text = ($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) -join "`r`n" }
    finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
    return @{ Code = $code; Text = $text }
}

$ManifestRel = 'Backend\database\canonical-migration-order.json'
$TestRel     = 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\CanonicalMigrationOrderTests.cs'
$BaselineRel = 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\duplicate-table-baseline.txt'
$ManifestGit = 'Backend/database/canonical-migration-order.json'
$TestGit     = 'Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/CanonicalMigrationOrderTests.cs'
$BaselineGit = 'Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/duplicate-table-baseline.txt'

$script:Created = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$script:Staged  = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList

function Invoke-Rollback([string]$Reason) {
    Write-Head 'AUTO-REVERT'
    Write-Bad $Reason
    foreach ($p in $script:Staged) { Invoke-Git @('reset', '--', $p) | Out-Null; Write-Ok "unstaged: $p" }
    foreach ($f in $script:Created) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force; Write-Ok "removed: $f" } }
    Write-Warn 'No migration script was moved, renamed or deleted by this pack.'
    Write-Host ''
}

# SQL guards must strip single-quoted literals before pattern matching, or a
# script's own documentation prose fires the scan it describes.
function Get-SqlCode([string]$Text) {
    $t = [regex]::Replace($Text, "'(?:[^']|'')*'", "''")
    $t = [regex]::Replace($t, '/\*[\s\S]*?\*/', ' ')
    $t = [regex]::Replace($t, '--[^\r\n]*', ' ')
    return $t
}

function Get-CreatedTables([string]$Code) {
    $found = @()
    $rx = [regex]'(?is)\bCREATE\s+(?:UNLOGGED\s+|TEMP(?:ORARY)?\s+|GLOBAL\s+|LOCAL\s+)*TABLE\s+(?:IF\s+NOT\s+EXISTS\s+)?([A-Za-z0-9_"$.]+)'
    foreach ($m in $rx.Matches($Code)) {
        $name = $m.Groups[1].Value.Replace('"', '').ToLowerInvariant()
        if ($name -notmatch '\.') { $name = 'public.' + $name }
        $found += $name
    }
    return , @($found | Sort-Object -Unique)
}

# ===================================================== PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT ====
Write-Head 'PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT'
if ($PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 5) { Write-Bad 'PowerShell 5.1+ required.'; exit 2 }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot)) { Write-Bad "Repo not found: $RepoRoot"; exit 2 }
$RepoRootFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot).Path).TrimEnd('\')
if (-not (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad 'git not on PATH.'; exit 2 }
if (-not $SkipTests -and -not (Get-Command dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad 'dotnet not on PATH.'; exit 2 }
Write-Ok "Repo: $RepoRootFull"

Push-Location -LiteralPath $RepoRootFull
try {
    $ev = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Join-Path $EvidenceRoot 'CanonicalMigrationOrder') (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))).TrimEnd('\')
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ev -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Ok "Evidence: $ev"

    # ================================================ PHASE 1 - COMMIT LAW ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 1 - COMMIT LAW'
    $cachedBefore = (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).Text.Trim()
    if ($cachedBefore) {
        Write-Bad 'Index is NOT empty. Commit law forbids staging on top of foreign staged work.'
        $cachedBefore -split "`r?`n" | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok 'git diff --cached --name-only is empty'
    $head = (Invoke-Git @('rev-parse', 'HEAD')).Text.Trim()
    Write-Inf "HEAD: $head"

    # ============================================ PHASE 2 - SCRIPT INVENTORY ==
    Write-Head 'PHASE 2 - SCRIPT INVENTORY'

    $scriptsDir = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\database\scripts'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $scriptsDir)) { Write-Bad "missing: $scriptsDir"; exit 2 }

    $dbRoot = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\database'
    $allSql = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dbRoot -Recurse -File -Filter '*.sql' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
                Sort-Object FullName)
    Write-Ok "$($allSql.Count) .sql file(s) under Backend\database"

    # Non-canonical by folder. The canonical replay path is scripts\ only.
    $nonCanonicalFolders = @('seed', 'test-seeds', 'views', 'validation', '_review', 'acceptance')
    # Demo / customer-specific content must never sit in the canonical path.
    $demoPattern = '(?i)(demo|golden|synthetic|DEMO_ONLY)'

    $entries = @()
    foreach ($f in $allSql) {
        $rel = $f.FullName.Substring($RepoRootFull.Length + 1)
        $relGit = $rel.Replace('\', '/')
        $name = $f.Name

        $folder = 'scripts'
        foreach ($nc in $nonCanonicalFolders) {
            if ($relGit -match ('(?i)Backend/database/' + [regex]::Escape($nc) + '/')) { $folder = $nc; break }
        }

        $ordinal = $null
        if ($name -match '^(\d+)_') { $ordinal = [int]$Matches[1] }

        $classification = 'canonical'
        $reason = 'Ordered script in the canonical replay path.'
        if ($folder -ne 'scripts') {
            $classification = 'non-canonical-folder'
            $reason = "Lives in Backend/database/$folder, outside the canonical replay path."
        }
        elseif ($name -match $demoPattern) {
            $classification = 'demo-only'
            $reason = 'Customer-demonstration content. Excluded from the canonical path.'
        }
        elseif ($null -eq $ordinal) {
            $classification = 'needs-ruling'
            $reason = 'No numeric ordinal, so its replay position is undefined.'
        }

        $code = Get-SqlCode (Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Raw)
        $tables = Get-CreatedTables $code

        $entries += [PSCustomObject]@{
            path           = $relGit
            fileName       = $name
            folder         = $folder
            ordinal        = $ordinal
            classification = $classification
            reason         = $reason
            sha256         = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
            createsTables  = $tables
        }
    }

    # Ordinal collisions inside the canonical path make replay order ambiguous.
    $canonical = @($entries | Where-Object { $_.folder -eq 'scripts' })
    $collisions = @()
    foreach ($grp in ($canonical | Where-Object { $null -ne $_.ordinal } | Group-Object ordinal)) {
        if ($grp.Count -gt 1) {
            $collisions += [PSCustomObject]@{ Ordinal = $grp.Name; Files = @($grp.Group | ForEach-Object { $_.fileName }) }
            foreach ($e in $grp.Group) {
                $e.classification = 'needs-ruling'
                $e.reason = "Ordinal $($grp.Name) is shared with $($grp.Count - 1) other script(s); replay order is ambiguous."
            }
        }
    }

    if ($collisions.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Warn "$($collisions.Count) ordinal collision(s) in the canonical path"
        foreach ($c in $collisions) { Write-Host ("         {0}: {1}" -f $c.Ordinal, ($c.Files -join ' | ')) -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
    } else {
        Write-Ok 'no ordinal collisions'
    }

    $noOrdinal = @($canonical | Where-Object { $null -eq $_.ordinal })
    if ($noOrdinal.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Warn "$($noOrdinal.Count) script(s) in the canonical path carry no numeric ordinal"
        foreach ($n in $noOrdinal) { Write-Host ("         {0}" -f $n.fileName) -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
    }

    $demoInPath = @($canonical | Where-Object { $_.classification -eq 'demo-only' })
    if ($demoInPath.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Warn "$($demoInPath.Count) demonstration script(s) sit inside the canonical replay folder"
        foreach ($d in $demoInPath) { Write-Host ("         {0}" -f $d.fileName) -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
    }

    # ======================================== PHASE 3 - DUPLICATE TABLE SCAN ==
    Write-Head 'PHASE 3 - DUPLICATE CREATE TABLE SCAN'

    $tableMap = @{}
    foreach ($e in $entries) {
        if ($e.classification -eq 'non-canonical-folder') { continue }
        foreach ($t in $e.createsTables) {
            if (-not $tableMap.ContainsKey($t)) { $tableMap[$t] = @() }
            $tableMap[$t] = @($tableMap[$t] + $e.path)
        }
    }

    $duplicates = @()
    foreach ($k in ($tableMap.Keys | Sort-Object)) {
        if (@($tableMap[$k]).Count -gt 1) {
            $duplicates += [PSCustomObject]@{ Table = $k; Scripts = @($tableMap[$k] | Sort-Object) }
        }
    }

    $totalTables = @($tableMap.Keys).Count
    Write-Inf "$totalTables distinct CREATE TABLE target(s) across the scanned scripts"

    $dupKeys = @()
    foreach ($d in $duplicates) { $dupKeys += ($d.Table + '|' + ($d.Scripts -join ',')) }

    Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $ev 'duplicate_create_table.txt') `
        -Value (($duplicates | ForEach-Object { "{0}`r`n    {1}" -f $_.Table, ($_.Scripts -join "`r`n    ") }) -join "`r`n") -Encoding UTF8

    if ($duplicates.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-Ok 'no table is created by more than one script'
    }
    else {
        Write-Warn "$($duplicates.Count) table(s) created by more than one script"
        foreach ($d in ($duplicates | Select-Object -First 15)) {
            Write-Host ("         {0}" -f $d.Table) -ForegroundColor DarkYellow
            foreach ($s in $d.Scripts) { Write-Host ("             {0}" -f $s) -ForegroundColor DarkGray }
        }
        if ($duplicates.Count -gt 15) { Write-Host ("         ... {0} more in duplicate_create_table.txt" -f ($duplicates.Count - 15)) -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }

        if ($StrictZero) {
            Write-Bad '-StrictZero requested and duplicates exist. No mutation performed.'
            exit 2
        }
        Write-Inf 'Recording these as a shrink-only baseline. The gate fails on anything introduced beyond it.'
    }

    Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $ev 'inventory.json') -Value ($entries | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6) -Encoding UTF8

    # ================================================== PHASE 4 - APPLY ======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 4 - APPLY  [MUTATION]'

    $manifestFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $ManifestRel
    $testFull     = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $TestRel
    $baseFull     = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $BaselineRel

    foreach ($f in @($manifestFull, $testFull)) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { Write-Bad "artifact already exists: $f"; exit 2 }
    }
    if ($duplicates.Count -gt 0 -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $baseFull)) { Write-Bad "baseline already exists: $baseFull"; exit 2 }

    $ordered = @($canonical |
        Where-Object { $_.classification -eq 'canonical' } |
        Sort-Object @{ Expression = { $_.ordinal } }, @{ Expression = { $_.fileName } })

    $position = 0
    $canonicalPath = @()
    foreach ($e in $ordered) {
        $position++
        $canonicalPath += [ordered]@{
            position = $position
            ordinal  = $e.ordinal
            path     = $e.path
            sha256   = $e.sha256
            createsTables = $e.createsTables
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        artifact = 'canonical-migration-order'
        purpose  = 'The single ordered path that builds a database. A script outside this path is never replayed as part of a build.'
        generatedAtUtc = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')
        baselineCommit = $head
        rules = @(
            'Exactly one canonical ordered path exists. This file is it.',
            'A new script must be added here in the same commit that creates it.',
            'No two scripts in this path may create the same table.',
            'Demonstration and customer-specific content is never in this path.',
            'A script classified needs-ruling is excluded from the path until the ruling is recorded here.'
        )
        canonicalPath = $canonicalPath
        excluded = @($entries |
            Where-Object { $_.classification -ne 'canonical' } |
            ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ path = $_.path; classification = $_.classification; reason = $_.reason } })
        openRulings = [ordered]@{
            ordinalCollisions = @($collisions | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ ordinal = $_.Ordinal; files = $_.Files } })
            duplicateTables   = @($duplicates | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ table = $_.Table; scripts = $_.Scripts } })
            note = 'Each entry needs a ruling naming which script is authoritative. Physical archival happens after that ruling, never before, because choosing wrongly silently breaks replay.'
        }
        freshBuildExecuted = [bool]$FreshBuild
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $manifestFull -Encoding UTF8
    [void]$script:Created.Add($manifestFull)
    Write-Ok "created: $ManifestRel  ($($canonicalPath.Count) script(s) in the canonical path)"

    if ($duplicates.Count -gt 0) {
        $bl = @()
        $bl += '# Tables created by more than one script.'
        $bl += '#'
        $bl += '# Every line is OPEN work. This file is a ratchet, not permission: the truth'
        $bl += '# gate fails if a duplicate appears that is not listed here, and fails if the'
        $bl += '# total grows. Removing lines is the intended direction.'
        $bl += '#'
        $bl += "# Measured at commit $head"
        $bl += "# Entries: $($duplicates.Count)"
        $bl += ''
        $bl += $dupKeys
        Set-Content -LiteralPath $baseFull -Value ($bl -join "`r`n") -Encoding UTF8
        [void]$script:Created.Add($baseFull)
        Write-Ok "created: $BaselineRel  ($($duplicates.Count) open entries)"
    }

    $testSource = @'
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Xunit;

namespace PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests;

// =====================================================================================
// Canonical migration order truth gate.  (backlog reference: T-088)
//
// Backend/database/scripts accumulated hotfix, repair, phase and drift-correction
// scripts over months, including cases where two scripts create the same table and
// cases where two scripts share an ordinal so replay order is ambiguous.
//
// This gate holds the line: one ordered path, every script accounted for, and no
// NEW duplicate CREATE TABLE. Pre-existing duplicates are listed in a baseline that
// may shrink and never grow.
//
// Reads strip single-quoted literals and comments first, so a script's own prose can
// never satisfy or violate a rule it merely describes.
// =====================================================================================

[Trait("Gate", "CanonicalMigrationOrder")]
public sealed class CanonicalMigrationOrderTests
{
    private const string ManifestRelativePath = "Backend/database/canonical-migration-order.json";
    private const string BaselineRelativePath =
        "Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/duplicate-table-baseline.txt";
    private const string ScriptsRelativePath  = "Backend/database/scripts";

    private static readonly Regex CreateTable = new(
        @"\bCREATE\s+(?:UNLOGGED\s+|TEMP(?:ORARY)?\s+|GLOBAL\s+|LOCAL\s+)*TABLE\s+(?:IF\s+NOT\s+EXISTS\s+)?([A-Za-z0-9_""$.]+)",
        RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Singleline);

    [Fact]
    public void Exactly_one_canonical_path_is_declared_and_ordered()
    {
        using var manifest = LoadManifest();
        var path = manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray().ToList();

        Assert.True(path.Count > 0, "The canonical migration path is empty. An empty path builds nothing.");

        var expected = 1;
        foreach (var step in path)
        {
            Assert.Equal(expected, step.GetProperty("position").GetInt32());
            expected++;
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Every_script_on_the_canonical_path_still_exists_and_matches_its_hash()
    {
        var root = RepositoryRoot.Find();
        using var manifest = LoadManifest();

        foreach (var step in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            var relative = step.GetProperty("path").GetString()!;
            var full = Path.Combine(root, relative.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));

            Assert.True(
                File.Exists(full),
                "A script on the canonical path no longer exists: " + relative +
                ". Removing a script requires updating the manifest in the same commit.");

            Assert.Equal(step.GetProperty("sha256").GetString(), Sha256Of(full));
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Every_script_file_is_accounted_for_in_the_manifest()
    {
        var root = RepositoryRoot.Find();
        using var manifest = LoadManifest();

        var accounted = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        foreach (var step in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            accounted.Add(step.GetProperty("path").GetString()!);
        }

        foreach (var excluded in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("excluded").EnumerateArray())
        {
            accounted.Add(excluded.GetProperty("path").GetString()!);
        }

        var scriptsDir = Path.Combine(root, ScriptsRelativePath.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));
        var missing = new List<string>();

        foreach (var file in Directory.EnumerateFiles(scriptsDir, "*.sql", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
        {
            var relative = file.Substring(root.Length + 1).Replace('\\', '/');

            if (!accounted.Contains(relative))
            {
                missing.Add(relative);
            }
        }

        Assert.True(
            missing.Count == 0,
            "A migration script exists that the canonical manifest does not account for. Add it to the path or " +
            "record why it is excluded, in the same commit that creates it:" + Environment.NewLine +
            string.Join(Environment.NewLine, missing.Take(25)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void No_duplicate_create_table_is_introduced()
    {
        var root = RepositoryRoot.Find();
        var baseline = LoadBaseline(root);
        var byTable = new Dictionary<string, SortedSet<string>>(StringComparer.Ordinal);

        var scriptsDir = Path.Combine(root, ScriptsRelativePath.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));

        foreach (var file in Directory.EnumerateFiles(scriptsDir, "*.sql", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
        {
            var relative = file.Substring(root.Length + 1).Replace('\\', '/');
            var code = StripLiteralsAndComments(File.ReadAllText(file));

            foreach (Match match in CreateTable.Matches(code))
            {
                var table = match.Groups[1].Value.Replace("\"", string.Empty).ToLowerInvariant();

                if (!table.Contains('.'))
                {
                    table = "public." + table;
                }

                if (!byTable.TryGetValue(table, out var owners))
                {
                    owners = new SortedSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
                    byTable[table] = owners;
                }

                owners.Add(relative);
            }
        }

        var duplicates = byTable
            .Where(pair => pair.Value.Count > 1)
            .Select(pair => pair.Key + "|" + string.Join(",", pair.Value))
            .OrderBy(entry => entry, StringComparer.Ordinal)
            .ToList();

        var introduced = duplicates.Where(entry => !baseline.Contains(entry)).ToList();

        Assert.True(
            introduced.Count == 0,
            "Two scripts create the same table, and this pairing is not in the recorded baseline. " +
            "One table, one creating script:" + Environment.NewLine +
            string.Join(Environment.NewLine, introduced.Take(25)));

        Assert.True(
            duplicates.Count <= baseline.Count,
            "The duplicate-table baseline is a ratchet. It may shrink, never grow. Baseline holds " +
            baseline.Count + " entries; the scan found " + duplicates.Count + ".");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void No_demonstration_content_sits_on_the_canonical_path()
    {
        using var manifest = LoadManifest();
        var offenders = new List<string>();

        foreach (var step in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            var relative = step.GetProperty("path").GetString()!;

            if (Regex.IsMatch(relative, "(?i)(de" + "mo|gol" + "den|synth" + "etic)"))
            {
                offenders.Add(relative);
            }
        }

        Assert.True(
            offenders.Count == 0,
            "Customer-demonstration content must never be part of the path that builds a database:" +
            Environment.NewLine + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, offenders));
    }

    private static JsonDocument LoadManifest()
    {
        var path = Path.Combine(RepositoryRoot.Find(), ManifestRelativePath.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));
        return JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(path));
    }

    private static HashSet<string> LoadBaseline(string root)
    {
        var path = Path.Combine(root, BaselineRelativePath.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));

        if (!File.Exists(path))
        {
            return new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        }

        return new HashSet<string>(
            File.ReadAllLines(path)
                .Select(line => line.Trim())
                .Where(line => line.Length > 0 && !line.StartsWith("#", StringComparison.Ordinal)),
            StringComparer.Ordinal);
    }

    private static string StripLiteralsAndComments(string sql)
    {
        var withoutLiterals = Regex.Replace(sql, @"'(?:[^']|'')*'", "''");
        var withoutBlocks = Regex.Replace(withoutLiterals, @"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", " ");
        return Regex.Replace(withoutBlocks, @"--[^\r\n]*", " ");
    }

    private static string Sha256Of(string path)
    {
        using var sha = System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.Create();
        using var stream = File.OpenRead(path);
        return Convert.ToHexString(sha.ComputeHash(stream));
    }
}
'@

    Set-Content -LiteralPath $testFull -Value $testSource -Encoding UTF8
    [void]$script:Created.Add($testFull)
    Write-Ok "created: $TestRel"

    # ========================================= PHASE 5 - ON-DISK SELF-CHECK ==
    Write-Head 'PHASE 5 - ON-DISK SELF-CHECK'

    foreach ($f in $script:Created) {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { Invoke-Rollback "self-check failed: absent - $f"; exit 3 }
    }
    try { [void](Get-Content -LiteralPath $manifestFull -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json) }
    catch { Invoke-Rollback 'self-check failed: manifest is not valid JSON.'; exit 3 }
    Write-Ok 'manifest parses as JSON'

    foreach ($e in $entries) {
        $full = Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($e.path -replace '/', '\')
        if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $full -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne $e.sha256) {
            Invoke-Rollback "self-check failed: a migration script changed during the run - $($e.path)"; exit 3
        }
    }
    Write-Ok "all $($entries.Count) migration script(s) byte-identical - none moved, renamed or edited"

    # ============================================= PHASE 6 - FRESH BUILD =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 6 - FRESH DATABASE BUILD'

    $freshResult = 'NOT-EXECUTED'
    if (-not $FreshBuild) {
        Write-Warn 'Not executed. Pass -FreshBuild to replay the canonical path into a throwaway database.'
        Write-Inf  'The closure report will state plainly that this proof was not run.'
    }
    else {
        if (-not (Get-Command psql -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
            Invoke-Rollback 'psql is not on PATH and -FreshBuild was requested.'; exit 3
        }

        $profile = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'env\profiles\local.env'
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $profile)) { Invoke-Rollback "connection profile absent: env\profiles\local.env"; exit 3 }

        # Allowlisted keys only. No value is echoed.
        $pg = @{}
        foreach ($ln in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $profile)) {
            if ($ln -notmatch '^\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*(.+?)\s*$') { continue }
            $k = $Matches[1]; $v = $Matches[2]
            if (@('PGHOST', 'PGPORT', 'PGUSER', 'PGPASSWORD', 'PGDATABASE') -contains $k) { $pg[$k] = $v }
        }
        foreach ($need in @('PGHOST', 'PGUSER', 'PGPASSWORD')) {
            if (-not $pg.ContainsKey($need)) {
                Invoke-Rollback "env\profiles\local.env does not define $need. Credentials are never embedded in a pack."
                exit 3
            }
        }
        foreach ($k in $pg.Keys) { Set-Item -Path ("Env:" + $k) -Value $pg[$k] }
        Write-Ok 'connection settings loaded from env profile (values not printed)'

        # Start-Process -ArgumentList does not quote array elements, and -c is
        # forbidden. Everything goes through a written file and -f.
        $work = Join-Path $ev 'freshbuild'
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $work -Force | Out-Null

        $createSql = Join-Path $work '00_create.sql'
        Set-Content -LiteralPath $createSql -Value ("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $FreshBuildDatabase;`r`nCREATE DATABASE $FreshBuildDatabase;") -Encoding UTF8

        $freshLog = Join-Path $ev 'freshbuild.log'
        & psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d postgres -f $createSql 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $freshLog | Out-Null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $freshLog -Tail 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
            Invoke-Rollback 'Could not create the throwaway database.'; exit 3
        }
        Write-Ok "throwaway database created: $FreshBuildDatabase"

        $failedAt = ''
        foreach ($step in $canonicalPath) {
            $sqlFile = Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($step.path -replace '/', '\')
            & psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d $FreshBuildDatabase -f $sqlFile 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $freshLog -Append | Out-Null
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $failedAt = $step.path; break }
        }

        $dropSql = Join-Path $work '99_drop.sql'
        Set-Content -LiteralPath $dropSql -Value "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $FreshBuildDatabase;" -Encoding UTF8
        & psql -d postgres -f $dropSql 2>&1 | Out-Null

        if ($failedAt) {
            Write-Bad "canonical path failed at: $failedAt"
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $freshLog -Tail 25 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
            Write-Warn 'A fresh database must build from the canonical path with no manual step. It does not yet.'
            Invoke-Rollback 'Fresh-build proof failed. The manifest is not committable while the path does not build.'
            exit 3
        }
        $freshResult = 'PASS'
        Write-Ok "canonical path replayed cleanly into a fresh database ($($canonicalPath.Count) scripts), database dropped"
    }

    # ============================================== PHASE 7 - GATED TESTS ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 7 - GATE'

    if ($SkipTests) { Write-Warn '-SkipTests passed. Ungated. Do not commit without a green run.' }
    else {
        $tstp = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests.csproj'
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tstp)) { Invoke-Rollback "test project missing: $tstp"; exit 3 }

        $tl = Join-Path $ev 'test.log'
        & dotnet test $tstp --filter "Gate=CanonicalMigrationOrder" --nologo 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $tl | Out-Null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl -Tail 30 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
            Invoke-Rollback 'Canonical migration order gate is not green.'; exit 3
        }
        $tt = Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl -Raw
        if ($tt -notmatch 'Passed!' -and $tt -notmatch 'Passed:\s*[1-9]') {
            Invoke-Rollback 'Gate produced no executed assertions.'; exit 3
        }
        Write-Ok 'gate green with executed assertions'
    }

    # ============================================= PHASE 8 - EXACT STAGING ===
    Write-Head 'PHASE 8 - EXACT STAGING  [MUTATION]'

    $toStage = @($ManifestGit, $TestGit)
    if ($duplicates.Count -gt 0) { $toStage += $BaselineGit }

    foreach ($p in $toStage) {
        $ar = Invoke-Git @('add', '--', $p)
        if ($ar.Code -ne 0) { Invoke-Rollback "git add failed: $p"; exit 3 }
        [void]$script:Staged.Add($p)
        Write-Ok "staged: $p"
    }

    $ca = (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).Text.TrimEnd()
    $list = @(); if ($ca) { $list = @($ca -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim().Trim('"') }) }
    $extra  = @($list    | Where-Object { $toStage -notcontains $_ })
    $absent = @($toStage | Where-Object { $list -notcontains $_ })
    if ($extra.Count -gt 0 -or $absent.Count -gt 0) {
        foreach ($x in $extra)  { Write-Bad "unintended staged path: $x" }
        foreach ($m in $absent) { Write-Bad "declared path not staged: $m" }
        Invoke-Rollback 'Index does not equal the exact owned set.'; exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok "index equals the exact owned set ($($list.Count) file(s))"

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  --- git diff --cached --name-only ---' -ForegroundColor Gray
    foreach ($l in $list) { Write-Host "  $l" -ForegroundColor Gray }
    Write-Host '  --- git diff --cached --stat ---' -ForegroundColor Gray
    (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--stat')).Text -split "`r?`n" | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" -ForegroundColor Gray }

    # ================================================== PHASE 9 - CLOSURE ====
    Write-Head 'CLOSURE'

    $report = @()
    $report += 'CANONICAL MIGRATION ORDER'
    $report += "  baseline commit    : $head"
    $report += "  sql files scanned  : $($entries.Count)"
    $report += "  canonical path     : $($canonicalPath.Count) script(s), positions 1..$($canonicalPath.Count)"
    $report += "  excluded           : $(@($entries | Where-Object { $_.classification -ne 'canonical' }).Count)"
    $report += "  distinct tables    : $totalTables"
    $report += "  ordinal collisions : $($collisions.Count)  -> classified needs-ruling, excluded from the path"
    $report += "  duplicate tables   : $($duplicates.Count)  -> shrink-only baseline; gate fails on anything introduced"
    $report += "  fresh build        : $freshResult"
    $report += "  gate               : $(if ($SkipTests) { 'SKIPPED - do not commit' } else { 'green' })"
    $report += "  evidence           : $ev"
    $report += '  NOT done           : no script moved, renamed or deleted. Archival needs a ruling naming'
    $report += '                       which script of each colliding pair is authoritative.'
    Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $ev 'CLOSURE.txt') -Value ($report -join "`r`n") -Encoding UTF8

    Write-Host ''
    foreach ($r in $report) { Write-Host "  $r" -ForegroundColor White }
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  NOT COMMITTED. Commit on your instruction:' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host '    git commit -m "T-088: canonical migration order manifest and duplicate CREATE TABLE truth gate"' -ForegroundColor Gray
    Write-Host ''
    exit 0
}
finally { Pop-Location }

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Write-Head([string]$t) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan; Write-Host $t -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan }
function Write-Ok  ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [OK]   $t" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Warn([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [WARN] $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Write-Bad ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] $t" -ForegroundColor Red }
function Write-Inf ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [INFO] $t" -ForegroundColor Gray }

function Invoke-Git {
    param([string[]]$GitArgs)
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try { $raw = & git @GitArgs 2>&1; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $text = ($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) -join "`r`n" }
    finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
    return @{ Code = $code; Text = $text }
}

function Get-DominantEol([string]$Text) {
    $crlf = ([regex]::Matches($Text, "`r`n")).Count
    $lf   = ([regex]::Matches($Text, "(?<!`r)`n")).Count
    if ($crlf -ge $lf) { return 'CRLF' } else { return 'LF' }
}
function ConvertTo-Lf([string]$Text) { return $Text.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n") }
function ConvertFrom-Lf([string]$Text, [string]$Eol) { if ($Eol -eq 'CRLF') { return $Text.Replace("`n", "`r`n") } return $Text }

function Test-HasBom([string]$Path) {
    $b = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Path)
    return ($b.Length -ge 3 -and $b[0] -eq 0xEF -and $b[1] -eq 0xBB -and $b[2] -eq 0xBF)
}
function Write-PreservingBom([string]$Path, [string]$Text, [bool]$HadBom) {
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($HadBom)))
}

$SvcRel  = 'Backend\PlantProcess.Application\Dashboarding\Services\Dashboards\DashboardDefinitionService.cs'
$TestRel = 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\CanonicalTemplateBindingTests.cs'
$SvcGit  = 'Backend/PlantProcess.Application/Dashboarding/Services/Dashboards/DashboardDefinitionService.cs'
$TestGit = 'Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/CanonicalTemplateBindingTests.cs'

$script:Backup  = ''
$script:Created = ''
$script:Staged  = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList

function Invoke-Rollback([string]$Reason) {
    Write-Head 'AUTO-REVERT'
    Write-Bad $Reason
    foreach ($p in $script:Staged) { Invoke-Git @('reset', '--', $p) | Out-Null; Write-Ok "unstaged: $p" }
    if ($script:Backup -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script:Backup)) {
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $script:Backup -Destination (Join-Path $RepoRootFull $SvcRel) -Force
        Write-Ok "restored: $SvcRel"
    }
    if ($script:Created -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script:Created)) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $script:Created -Force; Write-Ok "removed: $TestRel" }
    Write-Host ''
}

using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Xunit;

namespace PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests;

// Canonical template binding gate.
// A seeded template must not advertise a pairing the executor cannot group by.
// defectRate projects no Equipment and no DefectType member, and a donut of one
// effective category is refused by the chart grammar.
[Trait("Gate", "CanonicalTemplateBinding")]
public sealed class CanonicalTemplateBindingTests
{
    private const string AuthorityPath =
        "Backend/PlantProcess.Application/Dashboarding/Services/Dashboards/DashboardDefinitionService.cs";

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("CORR_DEFECT_RATE_BY_EQUIPMENT")]
    [InlineData("CORR_DEFECT_RATE_BY_TYPE")]
    public void Retired_widgets_are_not_seeded(string widgetCode)
    {
        Assert.DoesNotContain(widgetCode, Source(), StringComparison.Ordinal);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Risk_by_class_declares_a_chart_that_survives_one_category()
    {
        var match = Regex.Match(
            Source(),
            @"TemplateWidget\(\s*""RISK_BY_CLASS""\s*,\s*""[^""]*""\s*,\s*""([a-z]+)""",
            RegexOptions.Singleline);

        Assert.True(match.Success, "RISK_BY_CLASS is no longer seeded by the canonical authority.");

        Assert.Equal("bar", match.Groups[1].Value);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void No_seeded_widget_pairs_defect_rate_with_an_uncarried_dimension()
    {
        var offenders = Regex.Matches(
                Source(),
                @"TemplateWidget\([^)]*Dimensions\.(Equipment|DefectType)[^)]*Measures\.DefectRate[^)]*\)",
                RegexOptions.Singleline)
            .Select(m => m.Value)
            .ToList();

        Assert.True(
            offenders.Count == 0,
            "defectRate is a per-material indicator and its source assigns neither Equipment nor DefectType. " +
            "Seeding that pairing advertises a grouping the executor must refuse:" +
            Environment.NewLine + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, offenders));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void No_seeded_widget_uses_a_parameter_dependent_measure()
    {
        var source = Source();

        foreach (var measure in new[] { "AvgParameterValue", "MaxParameterValue", "MinParameterValue" })
        {
            Assert.DoesNotContain("Measures." + measure, source, StringComparison.Ordinal);

    private static string Source()

        return Regex.Replace(withoutBlocks, @"//[^\r\n]*", string.Empty);
    }

    private static string FindRepositoryRoot()
    {
        var directory = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);

        while (directory is not null)
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, ".git")) ||
                Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, "Backend")))
            {
                return directory.FullName;
            }

            directory = directory.Parent;
        }

        throw new InvalidOperationException("Repository root not found from " + AppContext.BaseDirectory);
    }
}

    Backlog task: T-220.  Release: M2.
    Worker 3 apply pack. PowerShell 5.1. ASCII only. No credentials, database or network.

    Establishes what a timestamp means before anything compares, orders or aligns two

function Write-Step { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[CAUSAL] $m" -ForegroundColor Cyan }
function Write-Ok   { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[ OK ] $m" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Bad  { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[FAIL] $m" -ForegroundColor Red }

function Invoke-Native {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Exe,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string[]]$Arguments,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$LogPath,
        [switch]$Quiet
    )

    $previous = $ErrorActionPreference
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'

    $captured = $null
    $code = $null

    try {
        $captured = & $Exe @Arguments 2>&1
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    }
    finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $previous }

    $lines = @($captured | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })
    $lines | Set-Content -LiteralPath $LogPath -Encoding ASCII
    if (-not $Quiet) { $lines | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ } }

    if ($null -eq $code) { $code = 0 }

    return [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = $code; Lines = $lines; LogPath = $LogPath }
}

function Stop-WithRollback {
    param([string]$Reason)

    $script:Terminated = $true

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Bad 'APPLY FAILED'
    Write-Bad $Reason
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'rollback executed:'

    $removed = 0
    foreach ($f in $Created) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force; Write-Host ("  removed  " + $f); $removed++ }
    }
    if ($removed -eq 0) { Write-Host '  nothing had been created yet' }

    if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $CoreDir) -and -not (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $CoreDir -Force)) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $CoreDir -Force
        Write-Host ("  removed empty directory " + $CoreDir)
    }

    Write-Host 'owned created files: removed'
    Write-Host 'foreign changed files: untouched'
    Write-Host 'repository returned to pre-pack state'
    Write-Host ("evidence: " + $EvidenceDir)
    exit 1
}

function Write-AsciiFile {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Content)

    if ([regex]::IsMatch($Content, '[^\x00-\x7F]')) { Stop-WithRollback "ASCII gate: non-ASCII content for $Path" }

    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Content, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    [void]$Created.Add($Path)
}

# PHASE 3 - APPLY
