$epochCs = @'
// Frozen epoch for the generic validation fixture.
//
// Backlog origin: T-208.
//
// Nothing in the fixture reads the wall clock. Every instant is an offset from this
// constant, so two runs a month apart produce byte-identical inputs.
using System;

namespace PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Tests.GenericValidation;

public static class FrozenTestEpoch
{
    public static readonly DateTimeOffset Origin = new DateTimeOffset(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);

    public static DateTimeOffset AtMinute(double minutes) => Origin.AddMinutes(minutes);
}
'@
Write-AsciiFile -Path (Join-Path $FixtureDir 'FrozenTestEpoch.cs') -Content $epochCs
Write-Ok 'wrote FrozenTestEpoch.cs'

$fixtureCs = @'
// The generic controlled process fixture.
//
// Backlog origin: T-208.
//
// Vocabulary law: every identifier here is opaque. AnalysisSubject, ProcessUnit,
// Parameter, CategoryValue. No industry, no material identity, no plant story. An
// oracle flavoured by one customer would hand that customer's grain back to the
// product through the test suite.
//
// This file is the DATA SURFACE ONLY. Expected answers live in
// ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers and are not reachable from here: a kernel under test
// consumes this and cannot read the answer it is supposed to compute.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Tests.GenericValidation;

public enum ObservationSourceKind { Machine, Manual }

public enum ProcessRegime { Stable, Transition, Stabilising }

public sealed record ProcessObservation(
    string SubjectId,
    string UnitId,
    string ParameterId,
    DateTimeOffset At,
    double? NumericValue,
    string? CategoryValue,
    ObservationSourceKind Source,
    TimeSpan ClockUncertainty,
    ProcessRegime Regime);

public sealed record RegimeInterval(string SubjectId, DateTimeOffset Start, DateTimeOffset End, ProcessRegime Regime);

public sealed record PerformanceReference(
    string ParameterId,
    string Kind,               // EngineeringStandard | ManagementTarget | OperatingEnvelope
    int Precedence,            // lower number wins
    double? Value,
    bool LowerIsBetter,
    DateTimeOffset EffectiveFrom,
    DateTimeOffset EffectiveTo);

public static class GenericProcessFixture
{
    public const string UnitA = "UNIT-A";
    public const string UnitB = "UNIT-B";

    public const string ContinuousParameter = "PARAM-C1";   // irregular step signal
    public const string RateParameter       = "PARAM-C2";   // rate; must integrate, never sum
    public const string StateParameter      = "PARAM-S1";   // categorical; Average undefined

    // One signal, three defensible means.
    public static IReadOnlyList<ProcessObservation> ContinuousSignal { get; } = new[]
    {
        Continuous(0, 100), Continuous(10, 100), Continuous(15, 130),
        Continuous(45, 130), Continuous(50, 110), Continuous(60, 110)
    };

    // A rate. Naive SUM answers 180; the true integral is 60.
    public static IReadOnlyList<ProcessObservation> RateSignal { get; } = new[]
    {
        Rate(0, 60), Rate(30, 120), Rate(45, 0), Rate(60, 0)
    };

    // Mean-of-ratios is not ratio-of-sums.
    public static IReadOnlyList<(string SubjectId, double Numerator, double Denominator)> RatioSubjects { get; } = new[]
    {
        ("SUBJ-001", 9d, 10d), ("SUBJ-002", 80d, 100d), ("SUBJ-003", 1d, 2d)
    };

    // Grain conversion needs the weight, not the count.
    public static IReadOnlyList<(string SubjectId, double DurationMinutes, double Mean)> WeightedSubjects { get; } = new[]
    {
        ("SUBJ-001", 10d, 100d), ("SUBJ-002", 40d, 130d), ("SUBJ-003", 10d, 110d)
    };

    // Transition confounding.
    public static IReadOnlyList<double> StableRegimeValues { get; } = new[] { 100d, 102d, 98d, 100d };
    public static IReadOnlyList<double> TransitionRegimeValues { get; } = new[] { 60d, 70d, 85d };

    public static IReadOnlyList<RegimeInterval> Regimes { get; } = new[]
    {
        new RegimeInterval("SUBJ-010", FrozenTestEpoch.AtMinute(0),  FrozenTestEpoch.AtMinute(30), ProcessRegime.Stable),
        new RegimeInterval("SUBJ-010", FrozenTestEpoch.AtMinute(30), FrozenTestEpoch.AtMinute(45), ProcessRegime.Transition),
        new RegimeInterval("SUBJ-010", FrozenTestEpoch.AtMinute(45), FrozenTestEpoch.AtMinute(60), ProcessRegime.Stabilising)
    };

    // Overlapping uncertainty is TemporalUncertain; disjoint is ConflictingEvidence.
    // Both live here, so a kernel cannot pass by always returning the cautious verdict.
    public static IReadOnlyList<ProcessObservation> TemporalPairOverlapping { get; } = new[]
    {
        Machine("SUBJ-020", 100, 1.0), Manual("SUBJ-020", 108, 15.0)
    };

    public static IReadOnlyList<ProcessObservation> TemporalPairDisjoint { get; } = new[]
    {
        Machine("SUBJ-021", 100, 1.0), Manual("SUBJ-021", 140, 15.0)
    };

    // Authority is fact-specific. Never "machine wins".
    public static IReadOnlyList<ProcessObservation> EvidencePairs { get; } = new[]
    {
        Machine("SUBJ-030", 200, 1.0), Manual("SUBJ-030", 200, 5.0),   // Aligned
        Machine("SUBJ-031", 200, 1.0), Manual("SUBJ-031", 205, 5.0),   // PartiallyAligned
        Machine("SUBJ-032", 200, 1.0),                                  // MissingEvidence
        Machine("SUBJ-033", 200, 1.0), Manual("SUBJ-033", 900, 5.0)    // ConflictingEvidence
    };

    // References, with one parameter deliberately uncovered.
    public static IReadOnlyList<PerformanceReference> References { get; } = new[]
    {
        new PerformanceReference(ContinuousParameter, "EngineeringStandard", 1, 100d, true,
            FrozenTestEpoch.AtMinute(0), FrozenTestEpoch.AtMinute(10_000)),
        new PerformanceReference(ContinuousParameter, "ManagementTarget", 2, 95d, true,
            FrozenTestEpoch.AtMinute(0), FrozenTestEpoch.AtMinute(10_000)),
        new PerformanceReference(RateParameter, "OperatingEnvelope", 3, null, false,
            FrozenTestEpoch.AtMinute(0), FrozenTestEpoch.AtMinute(0))   // expired: InsufficientReference
    };

    // Categorical. Average is undefined here.
    public static IReadOnlyList<ProcessObservation> StateSignal { get; } = new[]
    {
        Categorical(0, "CAT-1"), Categorical(20, "CAT-2"), Categorical(35, "CAT-1"), Categorical(60, "CAT-1")
    };

    // An empty window, immediately beside a populated one, so "the test passed because
    // zero rows existed" is detectable rather than invisible.
    public static IReadOnlyList<ProcessObservation> EmptyWindow { get; } = Array.Empty<ProcessObservation>();

    public static IReadOnlyList<ProcessObservation> AllObservations { get; } =
        ContinuousSignal
            .Concat(RateSignal)
            .Concat(StateSignal)
            .Concat(TemporalPairOverlapping)
            .Concat(TemporalPairDisjoint)
            .Concat(EvidencePairs)
            .ToArray();

    private static ProcessObservation Continuous(double minute, double value) => new(
        "SUBJ-010", UnitA, ContinuousParameter, FrozenTestEpoch.AtMinute(minute), value, null,
        ObservationSourceKind.Machine, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1), ProcessRegime.Stable);

    private static ProcessObservation Rate(double minute, double value) => new(
        "SUBJ-011", UnitA, RateParameter, FrozenTestEpoch.AtMinute(minute), value, null,
        ObservationSourceKind.Machine, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1), ProcessRegime.Stable);

    private static ProcessObservation Categorical(double minute, string category) => new(
        "SUBJ-012", UnitB, StateParameter, FrozenTestEpoch.AtMinute(minute), null, category,
        ObservationSourceKind.Machine, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1), ProcessRegime.Stable);

    private static ProcessObservation Machine(string subject, double minute, double uncertaintySeconds) => new(
        subject, UnitA, ContinuousParameter, FrozenTestEpoch.AtMinute(minute), 200d, null,
        ObservationSourceKind.Machine, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(uncertaintySeconds), ProcessRegime.Stable);

    private static ProcessObservation Manual(string subject, double minute, double uncertaintyMinutes) => new(
        subject, UnitA, ContinuousParameter, FrozenTestEpoch.AtMinute(minute), 200d, null,
        ObservationSourceKind.Manual, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(uncertaintyMinutes), ProcessRegime.Stable);
}
'@
Write-AsciiFile -Path (Join-Path $FixtureDir 'GenericProcessFixture.cs') -Content $fixtureCs
Write-Ok 'wrote GenericProcessFixture.cs'

$knownCs = @'
// Known answers for the generic controlled fixture.
//
// Backlog origin: T-208.
//
// Exact rationals, not decimals, so a kernel cannot pass by rounding luck. These
// constants were derived by hand from the fixture; the integrity tests recompute each
// one from the data with an independent reference implementation, so an accidental
// edit to the fixture is caught rather than silently absorbed.
namespace PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Tests.GenericValidation;

public readonly struct ExactRational
{
    public ExactRational(long numerator, long denominator)
    {
        Numerator = numerator;
        Denominator = denominator;
    }

    public long Numerator { get; }
    public long Denominator { get; }

    public double AsDouble => (double)Numerator / Denominator;
}

public static class ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers
{
    // One signal, three defensible means.
    public static ExactRational ArithmeticMeanOfSamples => new(340, 3);       // 113.333... wrong for a continuous signal
    public static ExactRational TimeWeightedMeanLastValueHeld => new(715, 6); // 119.166...
    public static ExactRational TimeWeightedMeanLinear => new(1435, 12);      // 119.583...

    // A rate integrates; it does not sum.
    public const double NaiveSumOfRateSamples = 180d;                          // wrong
    public static ExactRational RateIntegralOverWindow => new(60, 1);

    // Mean-of-ratios is not ratio-of-sums.
    public static ExactRational MeanOfRatios => new(11, 15);   // 0.7333... wrong for a population question
    public static ExactRational RatioOfSums => new(45, 56);    // 0.8036...

    // Grain conversion needs the weight.
    public static ExactRational UnweightedSubjectMean => new(340, 3);   // wrong
    public static ExactRational DurationWeightedMean => new(365, 3);

    // Transition confounding.
    public static ExactRational PooledAcrossRegimes => new(615, 7);  // 87.857... must not be returned silently
    public static ExactRational StableRegimeOnly => new(100, 1);
    public const string RequiredRegimeRefusalCode = "RG01 mixed_process_regime";

    // Clock uncertainty is not conflict.
    public const string OverlappingVerdict = "TemporalUncertain";
    public const string DisjointVerdict = "ConflictingEvidence";

    // Fact-specific authority; never "machine wins".
    public static string[] RequiredEvidenceStates => new[]
    {
        "Aligned", "PartiallyAligned", "MissingEvidence", "ConflictingEvidence"
    };

    // Directionality is declared, never inferred.
    public static ExactRational AttainmentLowerIsBetter => new(10, 11);  // standard 100, actual 110
    public const double GapLowerIsBetter = 10d;

    // Required refusals.
    public const string InsufficientReference = "InsufficientReference";
    public const string CategoricalAverageUndefined = "AggregationUndefinedForCategorical";
    public const string InsufficientData = "InsufficientData";
}
'@
Write-AsciiFile -Path (Join-Path $FixtureDir 'ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.cs') -Content $knownCs
Write-Ok 'wrote ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.cs'

$integrityCs = @'
// Fixture integrity. This is what the task owns, and it must be GREEN.
//
// Backlog origin: T-208.
//
// These tests do not measure the product engine. They prove the oracle is sound:
// deterministic, populated, vocabulary-neutral, and that its stated answers actually
// follow from its data. Whether the engine can reproduce them is a separate,
// non-blocking probe - see CurrentEngineCompatibilityTests.
using System;
using System.Linq;
using Xunit;

namespace PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Tests.GenericValidation;

[Trait("BacklogTask", "T-208")]
public sealed class GenericProcessFixtureIntegrityTests
{
    private static double TimeWeightedLastValueHeld()
    {
        var s = GenericProcessFixture.ContinuousSignal;
        double area = 0, span = 0;

        for (var i = 0; i < s.Count - 1; i++)
        {
            var dt = (s[i + 1].At - s[i].At).TotalMinutes;
            area += s[i].NumericValue!.Value * dt;
            span += dt;
        }

        return area / span;
    }

    private static double TimeWeightedLinear()
    {
        var s = GenericProcessFixture.ContinuousSignal;
        double area = 0, span = 0;

        for (var i = 0; i < s.Count - 1; i++)
        {
            var dt = (s[i + 1].At - s[i].At).TotalMinutes;
            area += (s[i].NumericValue!.Value + s[i + 1].NumericValue!.Value) / 2 * dt;
            span += dt;
        }

        return area / span;
    }

    [Fact]
    public void One_signal_yields_three_defensible_and_different_means()
    {
        var samples = GenericProcessFixture.ContinuousSignal.Select(o => o.NumericValue!.Value).ToArray();

        Assert.Equal(ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.ArithmeticMeanOfSamples.AsDouble, samples.Average(), 10);
        Assert.Equal(ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.TimeWeightedMeanLastValueHeld.AsDouble, TimeWeightedLastValueHeld(), 10);
        Assert.Equal(ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.TimeWeightedMeanLinear.AsDouble, TimeWeightedLinear(), 10);

        // The point: a kernel that does not carry the declared interpolation rule must
        // refuse, not quietly pick one of these.
        Assert.NotEqual(
            ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.TimeWeightedMeanLastValueHeld.AsDouble,
            ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.TimeWeightedMeanLinear.AsDouble,
            10);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_rate_integrates_and_does_not_sum()
    {
        var r = GenericProcessFixture.RateSignal;
        double integral = 0;

        for (var i = 0; i < r.Count - 1; i++)
        {
            integral += r[i].NumericValue!.Value * (r[i + 1].At - r[i].At).TotalHours;
        }

        Assert.Equal(ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.RateIntegralOverWindow.AsDouble, integral, 10);
        Assert.Equal(ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.NaiveSumOfRateSamples, r.Sum(x => x.NumericValue!.Value), 10);
        Assert.NotEqual(ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.NaiveSumOfRateSamples, integral, 10);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Mean_of_ratios_is_not_ratio_of_sums()
    {
        var subjects = GenericProcessFixture.RatioSubjects;

        Assert.Equal(ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.MeanOfRatios.AsDouble,
            subjects.Average(s => s.Numerator / s.Denominator), 10);

        Assert.Equal(ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.RatioOfSums.AsDouble,
            subjects.Sum(s => s.Numerator) / subjects.Sum(s => s.Denominator), 10);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Grain_conversion_needs_the_weight()
    {
        var subjects = GenericProcessFixture.WeightedSubjects;

        Assert.Equal(ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.UnweightedSubjectMean.AsDouble,
            subjects.Average(s => s.Mean), 10);

        Assert.Equal(ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.DurationWeightedMean.AsDouble,
            subjects.Sum(s => s.DurationMinutes * s.Mean) / subjects.Sum(s => s.DurationMinutes), 10);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Transition_confounding_changes_the_answer()
    {
        var stable = GenericProcessFixture.StableRegimeValues;
        var pooled = stable.Concat(GenericProcessFixture.TransitionRegimeValues).Average();

        Assert.Equal(ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.StableRegimeOnly.AsDouble, stable.Average(), 10);
        Assert.Equal(ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.PooledAcrossRegimes.AsDouble, pooled, 10);
        Assert.Contains(ProcessRegime.Transition, GenericProcessFixture.Regimes.Select(r => r.Regime));
        Assert.Contains(ProcessRegime.Stabilising, GenericProcessFixture.Regimes.Select(r => r.Regime));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_fixture_carries_both_an_overlapping_and_a_disjoint_temporal_case()
    {
        static bool Overlaps(ProcessObservation a, ProcessObservation b) =>
            a.At - a.ClockUncertainty <= b.At + b.ClockUncertainty &&
            b.At - b.ClockUncertainty <= a.At + a.ClockUncertainty;

        var over = GenericProcessFixture.TemporalPairOverlapping;
        var dis = GenericProcessFixture.TemporalPairDisjoint;

        Assert.True(Overlaps(over[0], over[1]), "the overlapping pair must actually overlap");
        Assert.False(Overlaps(dis[0], dis[1]), "the disjoint pair must actually be disjoint");
        Assert.NotEqual(ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.OverlappingVerdict, ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.DisjointVerdict);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Evidence_pairs_cover_every_required_state()
    {
        var bySubject = GenericProcessFixture.EvidencePairs.GroupBy(o => o.SubjectId).ToArray();

        Assert.Equal(4, bySubject.Length);
        Assert.Single(bySubject.Where(g => g.Count() == 1));               // MissingEvidence
        Assert.Contains(bySubject, g => g.Any(o => o.Source == ObservationSourceKind.Manual));
        Assert.Equal(4, ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.RequiredEvidenceStates.Length);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Reference_precedence_holds_and_one_parameter_is_deliberately_uncovered()
    {
        var applicable = GenericProcessFixture.References
            .Where(r => r.ParameterId == GenericProcessFixture.ContinuousParameter)
            .OrderBy(r => r.Precedence)
            .ToArray();

        Assert.Equal("EngineeringStandard", applicable[0].Kind);
        Assert.True(applicable[0].LowerIsBetter);

        Assert.Equal(ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.AttainmentLowerIsBetter.AsDouble,
            applicable[0].Value!.Value / 110d, 10);

        Assert.Equal(ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.GapLowerIsBetter, 110d - applicable[0].Value!.Value, 10);

        // Insufficient, not zero.
        var rate = GenericProcessFixture.References.Single(r => r.ParameterId == GenericProcessFixture.RateParameter);
        Assert.True(rate.EffectiveTo <= rate.EffectiveFrom || rate.Value is null);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_categorical_parameter_carries_no_numeric_value()
    {
        Assert.All(GenericProcessFixture.StateSignal, o =>
        {
            Assert.Null(o.NumericValue);
            Assert.False(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(o.CategoryValue));
        });
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_empty_window_sits_beside_a_populated_one()
    {
        Assert.Empty(GenericProcessFixture.EmptyWindow);
        Assert.NotEmpty(GenericProcessFixture.ContinuousSignal);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Every_known_answer_rests_on_a_non_empty_population()
    {
        Assert.NotEmpty(GenericProcessFixture.ContinuousSignal);
        Assert.NotEmpty(GenericProcessFixture.RateSignal);
        Assert.NotEmpty(GenericProcessFixture.RatioSubjects);
        Assert.NotEmpty(GenericProcessFixture.WeightedSubjects);
        Assert.NotEmpty(GenericProcessFixture.StableRegimeValues);
        Assert.NotEmpty(GenericProcessFixture.TransitionRegimeValues);
        Assert.NotEmpty(GenericProcessFixture.EvidencePairs);
        Assert.NotEmpty(GenericProcessFixture.References);
        Assert.NotEmpty(GenericProcessFixture.StateSignal);

        // A known answer that runs on an empty population is a failed one, not a passed one.
        Assert.True(GenericProcessFixture.AllObservations.Count >= 20);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_fixture_is_deterministic_and_never_reads_the_wall_clock()
    {
        static string Signature() => string.Join("|", GenericProcessFixture.AllObservations.Select(o =>
            o.SubjectId + o.ParameterId + o.At.ToUnixTimeSeconds() + o.NumericValue + o.CategoryValue));

        Assert.Equal(Signature(), Signature());
        Assert.Equal(new DateTimeOffset(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero), FrozenTestEpoch.Origin);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_fixture_vocabulary_is_industry_neutral()
    {
        var text = string.Join(" ", GenericProcessFixture.AllObservations
            .Select(o => o.SubjectId + " " + o.UnitId + " " + o.ParameterId + " " + o.CategoryValue))
            .ToLowerInvariant();

        foreach (var forbidden in new[] { "coil", "heat", "slab", "caster", "mill", "furnace", "steel", "grade", "fleet" })
        {
            Assert.DoesNotContain(forbidden, text, StringComparison.Ordinal);
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Expected_answers_are_not_reachable_from_the_data_surface()
    {
        // The oracle is not a lookup table. Nothing a kernel consumes may expose the
        // answer it is being asked to compute.
        var leaks = typeof(GenericProcessFixture)
            .GetProperties()
            .Where(p => p.PropertyType == typeof(ExactRational))
            .ToArray();

        Assert.Empty(leaks);
    }
}
'@
Write-AsciiFile -Path (Join-Path $FixtureDir 'GenericProcessFixtureIntegrityTests.cs') -Content $integrityCs
Write-Ok 'wrote GenericProcessFixtureIntegrityTests.cs'

$probeCs = @'
// Current-engine compatibility probe. DIAGNOSTIC, NEVER BLOCKING.
//
// Backlog origin: T-208. Findings route to T-211.
//
// This asks one question: does an aggregation kernel capable of these continuous-process
// semantics exist in the loaded product assemblies today? It reports. It does not fail.
//
// A known-answer oracle can prove the engine is incomplete without becoming incomplete
// itself, and fixture acceptance is not held hostage to the engine's current state.
using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using Xunit;
using Xunit.Abstractions;

namespace PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Tests.GenericValidation;

[Trait("BacklogTask", "T-208-Probe")]
public sealed class CurrentEngineCompatibilityTests
{
    private readonly ITestOutputHelper _out;

    public CurrentEngineCompatibilityTests(ITestOutputHelper output) => _out = output;

    private static bool SurfaceExists(params string[] anyOfTheseNames)
    {
        var assemblies = AppDomain.CurrentDomain
            .GetAssemblies()
            .Where(a => a.FullName is not null && a.FullName.StartsWith("PlantProcess.", StringComparison.Ordinal));

        foreach (var assembly in assemblies)
        {
            Type[] types;
            try { types = assembly.GetTypes(); }
            catch (ReflectionTypeLoadException ex) { types = ex.Types.Where(t => t is not null).ToArray()!; }

            foreach (var type in types)
            {
                if (anyOfTheseNames.Any(n => type.Name.IndexOf(n, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)) return true;

                var members = type.GetMembers(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic |
                                              BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static);

                if (members.Any(m => anyOfTheseNames.Any(n => m.Name.IndexOf(n, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0))) return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Probe_the_current_engine_for_continuous_process_aggregation_semantics()
    {
        var probes = new (string What, bool Supported)[]
        {
            ("time-weighted mean",                SurfaceExists("TimeWeighted", "TimeWeightedMean")),
            ("declared interpolation rule",       SurfaceExists("Interpolation", "LastValueHeld", "StepHold")),
            ("rate integration over a window",    SurfaceExists("Integrate", "TimeIntegral", "AreaUnder")),
            ("duration-weighted grain conversion", SurfaceExists("WeightedMean", "GrainConversion", "DurationWeighted")),
            ("categorical aggregation refusal",   SurfaceExists("AggregationUndefined", "CategoricalAggregation"))
        };

        _out.WriteLine("ENGINE COMPATIBILITY PROBE (diagnostic only; fixture acceptance does not depend on it)");
        _out.WriteLine("");

        foreach (var p in probes)
        {
            _out.WriteLine(p.Supported
                ? "  SUPPORTED        " + p.What
                : "  ROUTE TO T-211   " + p.What + " - not present in the loaded product assemblies");
        }

        var gaps = probes.Count(p => !p.Supported);
        _out.WriteLine("");
        _out.WriteLine("EXPECTED DOWNSTREAM GAPS: " + gaps + " -> T-211 aggregation semantics execution kernel");

        // Deliberately unconditional. This probe records the engine's state; it does not
        // hold the fixture hostage to it.
        Assert.True(true);
    }
}
'@
Write-AsciiFile -Path (Join-Path $FixtureDir 'CurrentEngineCompatibilityTests.cs') -Content $probeCs
Write-Ok 'wrote CurrentEngineCompatibilityTests.cs'

# ===========================================================================
# PHASE 4 - FIXTURE INTEGRITY (BLOCKING - this is task acceptance)
# ===========================================================================
Write-Step 'Phase 4 - fixture integrity tests (blocking)'

$intRun = Invoke-Native -Exe 'dotnet' `
    -Arguments @('test', $Proj, '--filter', 'BacklogTask=T-208', '--nologo') `
    -LogPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'fixture-integrity.log')

if ($intRun.ExitCode -ne 0) { Stop-WithRollback ("fixture integrity failed (exit " + $intRun.ExitCode + "). The oracle is not sound; nothing is kept.") }
if ($intRun.Lines.Count -eq 0) { Stop-WithRollback 'empty test output is not a pass' }
Write-Ok 'fixture integrity GREEN - task acceptance satisfied'

# ===========================================================================
# PHASE 5 - ENGINE COMPATIBILITY PROBE (non-blocking diagnostic)
# ===========================================================================
Write-Step 'Phase 5 - current-engine compatibility probe (non-blocking)'

$probeRun = Invoke-Native -Exe 'dotnet' `
    -Arguments @('test', $Proj, '--filter', 'BacklogTask=T-208-Probe', '--logger', 'console;verbosity=detailed', '--nologo') `
    -LogPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'engine-compatibility-probe.log') -Quiet

Write-Host ''
Write-Host '--- PROBE FINDINGS -------------------------------------------------' -ForegroundColor Yellow
$probeRun.Lines |
    Where-Object { $_ -match 'ROUTE TO T-211|SUPPORTED|EXPECTED DOWNSTREAM GAPS' } |
    ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('    ' + $_.Trim()) -ForegroundColor Yellow }
Write-Host '--------------------------------------------------------------------' -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host ''

if ($probeRun.ExitCode -ne 0) {
    Write-Host '[NOTE] the probe harness returned non-zero. That is a harness fault, not a fixture failure.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
}
Write-Ok 'probe complete; unsupported semantics routed to T-211, not counted against this task'

# ===========================================================================
# PHASE 6 - FOREIGN-FILE DELTA GUARD
# ===========================================================================
Write-Step 'Phase 6 - foreign-file delta guard'

Push-Location $RepoRoot
try {
    $post = Invoke-Native -Exe 'git' -Arguments @('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all') `
        -LogPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'git-status-after.txt') -Quiet

    $foreignAfter = @($post.Lines | ForEach-Object { ($_ -replace '^..\s+', '') } | Where-Object { $Owned -notcontains $_ })
    $newForeign = @($foreignAfter | Where-Object { $ForeignDirtyBefore -notcontains $_ })
}
finally { Pop-Location }

if ($newForeign.Count -gt 0) { Stop-WithRollback ("this pack changed files it does not own: " + ($newForeign -join ', ')) }
Write-Ok 'foreign changed files: untouched (delta against the phase-1 baseline)'

# ===========================================================================
# EVIDENCE MANIFEST
# ===========================================================================
$gapLines = @($probeRun.Lines | Where-Object { $_ -match 'ROUTE TO T-211' } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() })

$manifest = @(
    'Task: T-208',
    'Release: M2',
    'Artifact: generic controlled validation fixture and continuous-process known answers',
    ('Timestamp: ' + $Stamp),
    ('Branch/head: ' + ($branch.Lines -join '') + ' ' + ($head.Lines -join '')),
    'Fixture integrity tests: GREEN',
    ('Engine compatibility gaps routed to T-211: ' + $gapLines.Count),
    'Foreign files: untouched',
    'Staged: no',
    'Committed: no'
) + $gapLines

$manifest | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'manifest.txt') -Encoding ASCII

Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'APPLY PASS' -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host 'fixture integrity tests: GREEN'
Write-Host ("engine compatibility gaps routed to T-211: " + $gapLines.Count)
Write-Host 'owned files present: FrozenTestEpoch.cs, GenericProcessFixture.cs, ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.cs, GenericProcessFixtureIntegrityTests.cs, CurrentEngineCompatibilityTests.cs'
Write-Host 'foreign changed files: untouched'
Write-Host 'not staged'
Write-Host ("evidence: " + $EvidenceDir)
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'Exact staging command:'
Write-Host '  git add Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Tests/GenericValidation/FrozenTestEpoch.cs Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Tests/GenericValidation/GenericProcessFixture.cs Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Tests/GenericValidation/ContinuousProcessKnownAnswers.cs Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Tests/GenericValidation/GenericProcessFixtureIntegrityTests.cs Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Tests/GenericValidation/CurrentEngineCompatibilityTests.cs'
Write-Host '  git status'
Write-Host '  git diff --cached --stat'

$Terminated = $true
exit 0

}
catch {
    if (-not $Terminated) {
        Write-Host ''
        Write-Bad 'APPLY FAILED'
        Write-Bad ("unhandled error: " + $_.Exception.Message)
        Write-Host ''
        Write-Host 'rollback executed:'

        $removed = 0
        foreach ($f in $Created) {
            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force; Write-Host ("  removed  " + $f); $removed++ }
        }
        if ($removed -eq 0) { Write-Host '  nothing had been created yet' }

        if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $FixtureDir) -and -not (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $FixtureDir -Force)) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $FixtureDir -Force
        }

        Write-Host 'owned created files: removed'
        Write-Host 'foreign changed files: untouched'
        Write-Host 'repository returned to pre-pack state'
        Write-Host ("evidence: " + $EvidenceDir)
    }
    exit 1
}

[FILE_START]
[METADATA: Path='tools\packs\Apply-PPIQ-LegacyOracleCertification.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='Tooling Script', Lines=282, SizeKB=13, SHA256='D734E18C44E979EF0C1BDE37231758F098CC795B0A1EE19C19015A2E0A281965', Modified='2026-08-25 16:46:34']

<#
================================================================================
PlantProcess IQ - LEGACY REGRESSION ORACLE CERTIFICATION
================================================================================
Owner : Worker 1
Type  : READ-ONLY. No repository mutation. No database mutation. No commit.

WHAT THIS CERTIFIES
  The frozen oracle still produces its declared answers. The freeze pinned the
  generator, the runner and the manifest by hash; this executes the declared
  phenomena and compares each verdict against the manifest band.

WHY A RUNNER IS EMBEDDED HERE
  phenomenon_harness.py does no database work by design: it reads one CSV per
  phenomenon and judges it. Its docstring names Invoke-PpiqPhenomenonHarness.ps1
  as the half that runs the queries, and that script is not in the repository.
  This pack performs that half - it runs each population_query through psql,
  writes <phenomenon_id>.csv, and hands the folder to the harness.

  It writes nothing into the repository. The CSVs go to evidence.

DATABASE
  Reads the FROZEN HISTORICAL database only, and only with SELECT. The pack
  refuses any database whose name is not the historical one, refuses a non-local
  host, and aborts if the manifest contains anything but a single SELECT.

CREDENTIALS
  None embedded. Resolved from env\profiles. If the profile does not resolve,
  the pack stops rather than inventing a value.

VERDICTS
  PASS         expectation met
  FAIL         expectation contradicted
  INSUFFICIENT population below the declared minimum - a refusal, not a pass
  ERROR        query failed or result shape wrong

  Only PASS on every declared phenomenon certifies. INSUFFICIENT does not.

EXIT  0 = certified   2 = could not execute (one concrete reason)   3 = not certified
================================================================================
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot     = 'C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ',
    [string]$EvidenceRoot = 'C:\Workspace\_ppiq_evidence',
    [string]$ProfileFile  = 'env\profiles\presentation.env',
    [string]$HistoricalDatabase = 'ppiq_presentation'
)

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Write-Head([string]$t) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan; Write-Host $t -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan }
function Write-Ok  ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [OK]   $t" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Warn([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [WARN] $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Write-Bad ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] $t" -ForegroundColor Red }
function Write-Inf ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [INFO] $t" -ForegroundColor Gray }

function Write-NoBom([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}

Write-Head 'PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT'
if ($PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 5) { Write-Bad 'PowerShell 5.1+ required.'; exit 2 }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot)) { Write-Bad "Repo not found: $RepoRoot"; exit 2 }
$RepoRootFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot).Path).TrimEnd('\')
foreach ($c in @('psql', 'python')) {
    if (-not (Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad "$c is not on PATH."; exit 2 }
}
Write-Ok "Repo: $RepoRootFull"

Push-Location -LiteralPath $RepoRootFull
try {
    $ev = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Join-Path $EvidenceRoot 'LegacyRegressionOracleCertification') (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))).TrimEnd('\')
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ev -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Ok "Evidence: $ev"

    # ================================== PHASE 1 - LOCK FILE STILL HOLDS =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 1 - PINNED ORACLE ASSETS'

    $lockPath = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\tools\legacy-regression-oracle.lock.json'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $lockPath)) { Write-Bad 'the freeze lock is missing; T-086 implementation is not present.'; exit 2 }

    $lock = Get-Content -LiteralPath $lockPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $checked = 0
    foreach ($asset in $lock.assets) {
        if (-not $asset.present) { continue }
        $full = Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($asset.path -replace '/', '\')
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full)) { Write-Bad "pinned asset missing: $($asset.path)"; exit 3 }
        $actual = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $full -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
        if ($actual -ne $asset.sha256) {
            Write-Bad "pinned asset changed: $($asset.path)"
            Write-Inf "  expected $($asset.sha256)"
            Write-Inf "  actual   $actual"
            exit 3
        }
        $checked++
    }
    Write-Ok "$checked pinned asset(s) byte-identical"

    $harness  = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\tools\phenomenon_harness.py'
    $manifest = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'docs\m1\phenomena\manifest.csv'
    foreach ($f in @($harness, $manifest)) { if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { Write-Bad "missing: $f"; exit 2 } }

    # ================================ PHASE 2 - HARNESS SELF-TEST ===========
    Write-Head 'PHASE 2 - HARNESS SELF-TEST'
    Write-Inf 'A judge that cannot fail proves nothing, so the harness judges its own fixtures first.'

    $selfLog = Join-Path $ev 'harness_selftest.log'
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    $selfOut = & python $harness --selftest 2>&1
    $selfCode = $LASTEXITCODE
    $ErrorActionPreference = $prev
    Write-NoBom -Path $selfLog -Text (($selfOut | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) -join "`r`n")
    $selfOut | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkGray }
    if ($selfCode -ne 0) { Write-Bad "harness self-test exited $selfCode"; exit 2 }
    Write-Ok 'harness self-test passed'

    # ================================= PHASE 3 - CONNECTION (READ ONLY) =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 3 - CONNECTION TO THE FROZEN HISTORICAL DATABASE'

    $profileFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $ProfileFile
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $profileFull)) { Write-Bad "profile not found: $ProfileFile"; exit 2 }

    $kv = @{}
    foreach ($ln in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $profileFull)) {
        if ($ln -match '^\s*#') { continue }
        if ($ln -match '^\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$') { $kv[$Matches[1]] = $Matches[2] }
    }

    $pg = @{ Host = ''; Port = '5432'; Database = ''; User = ''; Password = '' }
    foreach ($key in @('ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb', 'ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection')) {
        if (-not $kv.ContainsKey($key)) { continue }
        foreach ($part in ($kv[$key] -split ';')) {
            if ($part -notmatch '^\s*([A-Za-z ]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$') { continue }
            $n = $Matches[1].Trim().ToLowerInvariant(); $v = $Matches[2]
            switch ($n) {
                'host'     { if (-not $pg.Host)     { $pg.Host = $v } }
                'server'   { if (-not $pg.Host)     { $pg.Host = $v } }
                'port'     { $pg.Port = $v }
                'database' { if (-not $pg.Database) { $pg.Database = $v } }
                'username' { if (-not $pg.User)     { $pg.User = $v } }
                'user id'  { if (-not $pg.User)     { $pg.User = $v } }
                'password' { if (-not $pg.Password) { $pg.Password = $v } }
            }
        }
    }
    foreach ($pair in @(@{K='PGHOST';F='Host'}, @{K='PGPORT';F='Port'}, @{K='PGDATABASE';F='Database'}, @{K='PGUSER';F='User'}, @{K='PGPASSWORD';F='Password'})) {
        if ($kv.ContainsKey($pair.K) -and -not $pg[$pair.F]) { $pg[$pair.F] = $kv[$pair.K] }
    }

    $missing = @()
    foreach ($f in @('Host', 'Database', 'User', 'Password')) { if (-not $pg[$f]) { $missing += $f } }
    if ($missing.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Bad ("the profile does not resolve: " + ($missing -join ', '))
        Write-Warn 'No credential is embedded in this pack and none will be invented.'
        exit 2
    }

    if (@('localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1') -notcontains $pg.Host.ToLowerInvariant()) { Write-Bad "refusing a non-local host: $($pg.Host)"; exit 2 }
    if ($pg.Database -ne $HistoricalDatabase) {
        Write-Bad "the profile resolves to '$($pg.Database)', not the frozen historical database '$HistoricalDatabase'."
        Write-Warn 'The oracle is certified against the frozen historical database only. Refusing.'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok ("resolved: {0}@{1}:{2}/{3}  (read-only)" -f $pg.User, $pg.Host, $pg.Port, $pg.Database)
    $env:PGPASSWORD = $pg.Password

    # ============================ PHASE 4 - RUN THE DECLARED POPULATIONS ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 4 - EXECUTE THE DECLARED POPULATIONS'

    $rows = @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $manifest)
    if ($rows.Count -eq 0) { Write-Bad 'the manifest declares no phenomena.'; exit 2 }
    Write-Ok "$($rows.Count) declared phenomenon/phenomena"

    $dataDir = Join-Path $ev 'data'
    $sqlDir  = Join-Path $ev 'sql'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dataDir -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $sqlDir  -Force | Out-Null

    foreach ($row in $rows) {
        $pid = $row.phenomenon_id
        $q   = $row.population_query

        # Read-only by construction: one SELECT, nothing else.
        $probe = ($q -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
        if ($probe -notmatch '^(?i)SELECT\s') { Write-Bad "$pid : population_query does not begin with SELECT."; exit 2 }
        if ($probe -match '(?i)\b(INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|DROP|ALTER|CREATE|TRUNCATE|GRANT|REVOKE)\b') {
            Write-Bad "$pid : population_query contains a write statement. Refusing."
            exit 2
        }

        $sqlFile = Join-Path $sqlDir ($pid + '.sql')
        Write-NoBom -Path $sqlFile -Text $q

        $csvFile = Join-Path $dataDir ($pid + '.csv')
        $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
        $out = & psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --csv -q `
            -h $pg.Host -p $pg.Port -U $pg.User -d $pg.Database `
            -f $sqlFile 2>&1
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
        $ErrorActionPreference = $prev

        if ($code -ne 0) {
            Write-Bad "$pid : psql exited $code"
            $out | Select-Object -Last 8 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
            Write-Warn 'The historical oracle could not execute. This is the one concrete reason.'
            exit 2
        }

        Write-NoBom -Path $csvFile -Text ((($out | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
        $lineCount = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $csvFile | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' }).Count
        Write-Ok ("{0,-46} {1} row(s) incl. header" -f $pid, $lineCount)
    }

    $env:PGPASSWORD = ''

    # ==================================== PHASE 5 - JUDGE THE POPULATIONS ===
    Write-Head 'PHASE 5 - VERDICTS'

    $jsonOut = Join-Path $ev 'verdicts.json'
    $judgeLog = Join-Path $ev 'verdicts.log'
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    $judge = & python $harness --manifest $manifest --datadir $dataDir --json-out $jsonOut 2>&1
    $judgeCode = $LASTEXITCODE
    $ErrorActionPreference = $prev

    Write-NoBom -Path $judgeLog -Text (($judge | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) -join "`r`n")
    $judge | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkGray }

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $jsonOut)) {
        Write-Bad "the harness produced no verdict file (exit $judgeCode)."
        exit 3
    }

    $verdicts = Get-Content -LiteralPath $jsonOut -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json

    $results = @()
    foreach ($r in $rows) { $results += $r.phenomenon_id }

    $pass = 0; $bad = @()
    foreach ($v in $verdicts.results) {
        $line = "{0,-46} {1}" -f $v.phenomenon_id, $v.verdict
        if ($v.verdict -eq 'PASS') { Write-Ok $line; $pass++ }
        else { Write-Bad $line; $bad += ("$($v.phenomenon_id) = $($v.verdict)") }
    }

    if ($pass -ne $rows.Count -or $bad.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Head 'NOT CERTIFIED'
        foreach ($b in $bad) { Write-Bad $b }
        Write-Warn 'INSUFFICIENT is a refusal, not a pass. The oracle is not certified.'
        Write-Inf  "evidence: $ev"
        exit 3
    }

    Write-Head 'T-086 CERTIFICATION'
    $report = @()
    $report += 'LEGACY REGRESSION ORACLE CERTIFIED'
    $report += "  implementation commit : $($lock.baselineCommit)"
    $report += "  pinned assets         : $checked / $checked byte-identical"
    $report += "  declared phenomena    : $($rows.Count)"
    $report += "  executed              : $($rows.Count)"
    $report += "  PASS                  : $pass"
    $report += '  harness self-test     : passed (the judge can fail)'
    $report += "  database              : $($pg.Database) (read-only, SELECT only)"
    $report += '  repository mutation   : none'
    $report += '  database mutation     : none'
    $report += "  evidence              : $ev"
    Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'CERTIFICATION.txt') -Text (($report -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")

    Write-Host ''
    foreach ($r in $report) { Write-Host "  $r" -ForegroundColor White }
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  Nothing to commit. Certification changes no file.' -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host ''
    exit 0
}
finally {
    if (Test-Path Env:PGPASSWORD) { $env:PGPASSWORD = '' }
    Pop-Location
}

PlantProcess IQ - LEGACY REGRESSION ORACLE FREEZE

Backlog task : T-086 (metadata only; no task id appears in any permanent artifact)
Owner        : Worker 1

PURPOSE
  The legacy discrete-manufacturing dataset stays available as a controlled
  regression oracle with predeclared expected effects and negative controls. It
  is NOT canonical product vocabulary, NOT the generic fixture authority and NOT
  a source of customer schema semantics. The generic fixture authority is owned
  elsewhere and must be able to run without this dataset.

  This pack makes two things true and keeps them true:

  1. IMMUTABILITY. Every oracle asset is pinned by SHA256 in a tracked lock file.
     Editing an asset without deliberately re-locking it fails the build.

  2. NO DERIVATION. An architecture gate proves that generic runtime, analytics,
     domain, registry and ML contracts do not derive vocabulary or a universal
     grain from the legacy dataset.

  Where the no-derivation gate finds existing violations it records them in a
  tracked baseline as OPEN work owned by the plant-vocabulary sweep. The baseline
  is a ratchet: it may shrink, never grow. This is not a weakened threshold - the
  rule stays zero-tolerance for anything new, and every existing violation is
  named in a file rather than tolerated silently.

PERMANENT ARTIFACTS  (descriptive names, no backlog identifiers)
  A  Backend\tools\legacy-regression-oracle.lock.json
  A  Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\LegacyRegressionOracleFreezeTests.cs

DATABASE

  law. That execution is a separate run; this pack never claims it happened.

EXIT  0 = frozen, gate green, staged   2 = verification failed, no mutation
      3 = failed after mutation, auto-revert completed

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot     = 'C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ',
    [string]$EvidenceRoot = 'C:\Workspace\_ppiq_evidence',
    [switch]$StrictZero,
    [switch]$SkipTests
)

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Write-Head([string]$t) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan; Write-Host $t -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan }
function Write-Ok  ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [OK]   $t" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Warn([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [WARN] $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Write-Bad ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] $t" -ForegroundColor Red }
function Write-Inf ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [INFO] $t" -ForegroundColor Gray }

function Invoke-Git {
    param([string[]]$GitArgs)
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try { $raw = & git @GitArgs 2>&1; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $text = ($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) -join "`r`n" }
    finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
    return @{ Code = $code; Text = $text }
}

$LockRel     = 'Backend\tools\legacy-regression-oracle.lock.json'
$TestRel     = 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\LegacyRegressionOracleFreezeTests.cs'
$BaselineRel = 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\legacy-vocabulary-baseline.txt'
$LockGit     = 'Backend/tools/legacy-regression-oracle.lock.json'
$TestGit     = 'Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/LegacyRegressionOracleFreezeTests.cs'
$BaselineGit = 'Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/legacy-vocabulary-baseline.txt'

# Oracle assets. Absence of an optional asset is recorded, never invented.
$OracleAssets = @(
    @{ Path = 'Backend\tools\generate_fleet_v2_donor.py';    Role = 'oracle-generator';        Required = $true  },
    @{ Path = 'Backend\tools\phenomenon_harness.py';         Role = 'phenomena-runner';        Required = $true  },
    @{ Path = 'docs\m1\phenomena\manifest.csv';              Role = 'declared-phenomena';      Required = $true  },
    @{ Path = 'docs\m1\phenomena\T-027_coverage_ledger.csv'; Role = 'coverage-ledger';         Required = $false },
    @{ Path = 'scripts\demo\Reemit-Fleetv2Donor.ps1';        Role = 'oracle-reemit-command';   Required = $false }

# Generic product surfaces that must not derive vocabulary from the oracle.
$GenericScanRoots = @(

    'Backend\PlantProcess.Domain',

$LegacyVocabulary = @('coil', 'heat', 'caster', 'tundish', 'meltshop', 'fleet')

$script:Created = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$script:Staged  = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList

function Invoke-Rollback([string]$Reason) {
    Write-Head 'AUTO-REVERT'
    Write-Bad $Reason
    foreach ($p in $script:Staged) { Invoke-Git @('reset', '--', $p) | Out-Null; Write-Ok "unstaged: $p" }
    foreach ($f in $script:Created) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force; Write-Ok "removed: $f" }
    }
    Write-Warn 'No oracle asset was modified by this pack, before or during revert.'
    Write-Host ''
}

# ===================================================== PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT ====
Write-Head 'PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT'
if ($PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 5) { Write-Bad 'PowerShell 5.1+ required.'; exit 2 }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot)) { Write-Bad "Repo not found: $RepoRoot"; exit 2 }
$RepoRootFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot).Path).TrimEnd('\')
if (-not (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad 'git not on PATH.'; exit 2 }
if (-not $SkipTests -and -not (Get-Command dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad 'dotnet not on PATH.'; exit 2 }
Write-Ok "Repo: $RepoRootFull"

try {
    $ev = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Join-Path $EvidenceRoot 'LegacyRegressionOracleFreeze') (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))).TrimEnd('\')
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ev -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Ok "Evidence: $ev"

    # ================================ PHASE 1 - COMMIT LAW: INDEX MUST BE CLEAN
    Write-Head 'PHASE 1 - COMMIT LAW'

    $cachedBefore = (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).Text.Trim()
    if ($cachedBefore) {
        Write-Bad 'Index is NOT empty. Commit law forbids staging on top of foreign staged work.'
        $cachedBefore -split "`r?`n" | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Write-Warn 'This is the condition that produced the mixed commit. Stopping.'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok 'git diff --cached --name-only is empty'

    $head = (Invoke-Git @('rev-parse', 'HEAD')).Text.Trim()
    Write-Inf "HEAD: $head"

    # ============================================ PHASE 2 - ORACLE INVENTORY ==
    Write-Head 'PHASE 2 - ORACLE INVENTORY'

    $assets = @()
    foreach ($a in $OracleAssets) {
        $full = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $a.Path
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full) {
            $fi = Get-Item -LiteralPath $full
            $assets += [PSCustomObject]@{
                path   = $a.Path.Replace('\', '/')
                role   = $a.Role
                sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $full -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
                bytes  = $fi.Length
                present= $true
            }
            Write-Ok ("{0,-46} {1}" -f (Split-Path -Leaf $a.Path), (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $full -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.Substring(0, 16))
        }
        elseif ($a.Required) {
            Write-Bad "required oracle asset missing: $($a.Path)"
            Write-Warn 'The oracle cannot be frozen while a required asset is absent. No mutation performed.'
            exit 2
        }
        else {
            $assets += [PSCustomObject]@{ path = $a.Path.Replace('\', '/'); role = $a.Role; sha256 = ''; bytes = 0; present = $false }
            Write-Warn "optional asset absent (recorded, not invented): $($a.Path)"
        }
    }

    # Declared phenomena, read from the manifest rather than restated by hand.
    $manifestFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'docs\m1\phenomena\manifest.csv'
    $phenomena = @()
    $rows = @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $manifestFull)
    foreach ($r in $rows) {
        $phenomena += [PSCustomObject]@{
            id                 = $r.phenomenon_id
            expectedDirection  = $r.expected_direction
            minimumPopulation  = $r.minimum_population
            expectedEffectBand = $r.expected_effect_band
            conditioningVariable = $r.conditioning_variable
            expectedAfterConditioning = $r.expected_after_conditioning
            isNegativeControl  = $r.negative_control
        }
    }
    Write-Ok "$($phenomena.Count) declared phenomena read from the manifest"
    foreach ($p in $phenomena) { Write-Inf ("  {0,-46} {1} {2}" -f $p.id, $p.expectedDirection, $p.expectedEffectBand) }

    if ($phenomena.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-Bad 'The phenomena manifest declares nothing. An oracle with no predeclared answers is not an oracle.'
        exit 2
    }

    # ========================================= PHASE 3 - NO-DERIVATION SCAN ===
    Write-Head 'PHASE 3 - NO-DERIVATION SCAN'
    Write-Inf 'Scanning generic product surfaces for legacy vocabulary and oracle references.'

    $violations = @()
    foreach ($root in $GenericScanRoots) {
        $rootFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $root
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $rootFull)) { Write-Warn "scan root absent: $root"; continue }

        $files = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $rootFull -Recurse -File -Include '*.cs' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
                   Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\(bin|obj)\\' })

        foreach ($f in $files) {
            $raw = Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Raw
            # Comment-stripped: prose explaining a rule must never satisfy the rule.
            $code = [regex]::Replace($raw, '/\*[\s\S]*?\*/', '')
            $code = [regex]::Replace($code, '//[^\r\n]*', '')

            $rel = $f.FullName.Substring($RepoRootFull.Length + 1).Replace('\', '/')
            $lineNo = 0
            foreach ($line in ($code -split "`r?`n")) {
                $lineNo++
                foreach ($term in $LegacyVocabulary) {
                    if ($line -match ('(?i)\b' + $term + 's?\b')) {
                        $violations += [PSCustomObject]@{ Path = $rel; Line = $lineNo; Term = $term; Text = $line.Trim() }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    $violations = @($violations | Sort-Object Path, Line, Term)
    $keys = @($violations | ForEach-Object { "{0}|{1}|{2}" -f $_.Path, $_.Line, $_.Term })

    Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $ev 'no_derivation_scan.txt') `
        -Value (($violations | ForEach-Object { "{0}:{1}  [{2}]  {3}" -f $_.Path, $_.Line, $_.Term, $_.Text }) -join "`r`n") -Encoding UTF8

    if ($violations.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-Ok 'zero legacy-vocabulary references in generic product surfaces'
    }
    else {
        Write-Warn "$($violations.Count) legacy-vocabulary reference(s) found in generic product surfaces"
        foreach ($v in ($violations | Select-Object -First 20)) {
            Write-Host ("         {0}:{1}  [{2}]  {3}" -f $v.Path, $v.Line, $v.Term, $v.Text.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(70, $v.Text.Length))) -ForegroundColor DarkYellow
        }
        if ($violations.Count -gt 20) { Write-Host ("         ... {0} more in no_derivation_scan.txt" -f ($violations.Count - 20)) -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }

        if ($StrictZero) {
            Write-Bad '-StrictZero was requested and the surface is not clean.'
            Write-Warn 'No mutation performed. The plant-vocabulary sweep owns removing these.'
            exit 2
        }
        Write-Inf 'Recording these as an OPEN, shrink-only baseline owned by the plant-vocabulary sweep.'
    }

    # ================================================== PHASE 4 - APPLY =======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 4 - APPLY  [MUTATION]'

    $lockFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $LockRel
    $testFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $TestRel
    $baseFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $BaselineRel

    foreach ($f in @($lockFull, $testFull)) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { Write-Bad "artifact already exists: $f"; exit 2 }
    }
    if ($violations.Count -gt 0 -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $baseFull)) { Write-Bad "baseline already exists: $baseFull"; exit 2 }

    $lock = [ordered]@{
        artifact    = 'legacy-regression-oracle-freeze'
        purpose     = 'Pins the legacy discrete-manufacturing regression oracle. This dataset is historical regression input only. It is not canonical product vocabulary, not the generic fixture authority and not a source of customer schema semantics.'
        frozenAtUtc = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')
        baselineCommit = $head
        assets      = $assets
        declaredPhenomena = $phenomena
        reproducibility = 'The generator and the phenomena runner are pinned by hash, so a rerun of the same generator against the frozen historical database reproduces the declared effects. Executing the runner is a separate step and is not asserted by this lock.'
        relockProcedure = 'Deliberate change to an oracle asset requires regenerating this lock in the same commit as the change, with a written reason. A silent asset edit fails the freeze gate.'
    }
    $lock | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $lockFull -Encoding UTF8
    [void]$script:Created.Add($lockFull)
    Write-Ok "created: $LockRel"

    if ($violations.Count -gt 0) {
        $baseLines = @()
        $baseLines += '# Legacy vocabulary present in generic product surfaces.'
        $baseLines += '#'
        $baseLines += '# Every line is OPEN work owned by the plant-vocabulary sweep. This file is a'
        $baseLines += '# ratchet, not permission: the freeze gate fails if any entry appears that is not'
        $baseLines += '# listed here, and fails if the total grows. Removing lines is the intended'
        $baseLines += '# direction and requires no approval.'
        $baseLines += '#'
        $baseLines += "# Measured at commit $head"
        $baseLines += "# Entries: $($violations.Count)"
        $baseLines += ''
        $baseLines += $keys
        Set-Content -LiteralPath $baseFull -Value ($baseLines -join "`r`n") -Encoding UTF8
        [void]$script:Created.Add($baseFull)
        Write-Ok "created: $BaselineRel  ($($violations.Count) open entries)"
    }

    $testSource = @'
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Xunit;

namespace PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests;

// =====================================================================================
// Legacy regression oracle freeze gate.  (backlog reference: T-086)
//
// The legacy discrete-manufacturing dataset is retained as a controlled regression
// oracle with predeclared expected effects and negative controls. It is not canonical
// product vocabulary and no generic contract may derive vocabulary or a universal
// grain from it.
//
// This gate enforces two properties:
//   1. Oracle assets are immutable unless the lock file is deliberately regenerated.
//   2. Generic product surfaces gain no new legacy vocabulary, and the recorded
//      baseline of existing occurrences may shrink but never grow.
//
// Every scanned term is assembled from fragments so this file can never satisfy the
// rules it enforces, and every read strips comments first.
// =====================================================================================

[Trait("Gate", "LegacyRegressionOracleFreeze")]
public sealed class LegacyRegressionOracleFreezeTests
{
    private const string LockRelativePath =
        "Backend/tools/legacy-regression-oracle.lock.json";

    private const string BaselineRelativePath =
        "Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/legacy-vocabulary-baseline.txt";

    private static readonly string[] GenericScanRoots =
    {
        "Backend/PlantProcess.Analytics.Core",
        "Backend/PlantProcess.Domain",
        "Backend/PlantProcess.Application",
        "Backend/PlantProcess.ML.Runtime",
        "Backend/PlantProcess.Infrastructure"
    };

    private static readonly string[] LegacyVocabulary =
    {
        "co" + "il",
        "he" + "at",
        "cas" + "ter",
        "tun" + "dish",
        "melt" + "shop",
        "fl" + "eet"
    };

    [Fact]
    public void Every_pinned_oracle_asset_still_matches_its_recorded_hash()
    {
        var root = FindRepositoryRoot();
        using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(root, LockRelativePath)));

        var checkedCount = 0;

        foreach (var asset in document.RootElement.GetProperty("assets").EnumerateArray())
        {
            if (!asset.GetProperty("present").GetBoolean())
            {
                continue;
            }

            var relative = asset.GetProperty("path").GetString()!;
            var expected = asset.GetProperty("sha256").GetString()!;
            var full = Path.Combine(root, relative.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));

            Assert.True(
                File.Exists(full),
                "A pinned oracle asset has been deleted: " + relative +
                ". The oracle is frozen; removing an asset requires regenerating the lock in the same commit.");

            Assert.Equal(expected, Sha256Of(full));
            checkedCount++;
        }

        Assert.True(
            checkedCount > 0,
            "The lock pins no present asset. An empty freeze proves nothing.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Declared_phenomena_carry_predeclared_expectations()
    {
        var root = FindRepositoryRoot();
        using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(root, LockRelativePath)));

        var phenomena = document.RootElement.GetProperty("declaredPhenomena").EnumerateArray().ToList();

        Assert.True(
            phenomena.Count > 0,
            "An oracle with no predeclared answers cannot falsify anything.");

        foreach (var phenomenon in phenomena)
        {
            var id = phenomenon.GetProperty("id").GetString();

            Assert.False(
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(id),
                "Every declared phenomenon needs an identifier.");

            Assert.False(
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(phenomenon.GetProperty("expectedDirection").GetString()),
                "Phenomenon '" + id + "' declares no expected direction, so no run of it can fail.");
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Generic_surfaces_gain_no_new_legacy_vocabulary()
    {
        var root = FindRepositoryRoot();
        var baseline = LoadBaseline(root);
        var found = ScanGenericSurfaces(root);

        var added = found.Where(entry => !baseline.Contains(entry)).OrderBy(entry => entry).ToList();

        Assert.True(
            added.Count == 0,
            "Generic product surfaces must not derive vocabulary from the legacy regression oracle. " +
            "New occurrences, not present in the recorded baseline:" + Environment.NewLine +
            string.Join(Environment.NewLine, added.Take(25)));

        Assert.True(
            found.Count <= baseline.Count,
            "The legacy-vocabulary baseline is a ratchet. It may shrink, never grow. Baseline holds " +
            baseline.Count + " entries; the scan found " + found.Count + ".");
    }

    private static HashSet<string> LoadBaseline(string root)
    {
        var path = Path.Combine(root, BaselineRelativePath.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));

        if (!File.Exists(path))
        {
            return new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        }

        var entries = File.ReadAllLines(path)
            .Select(line => line.Trim())
            .Where(line => line.Length > 0 && !line.StartsWith("#", StringComparison.Ordinal));

        return new HashSet<string>(entries, StringComparer.Ordinal);
    }

    private static HashSet<string> ScanGenericSurfaces(string root)
    {
        var found = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);

        foreach (var scanRoot in GenericScanRoots)
        {
            var full = Path.Combine(root, scanRoot.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));

            if (!Directory.Exists(full))
            {
                continue;
            }

            foreach (var file in Directory.EnumerateFiles(full, "*.cs", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
            {
                if (file.Contains(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "bin" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
                    file.Contains(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "obj" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                var relative = file.Substring(root.Length + 1).Replace('\\', '/');
                var lines = StripComments(File.ReadAllText(file)).Replace("\r\n", "\n").Split('\n');

                for (var index = 0; index < lines.Length; index++)
                {
                    foreach (var term in LegacyVocabulary)
                    {
                        if (Regex.IsMatch(lines[index], @"\b" + term + @"s?\b", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase))
                        {
                            found.Add(relative + "|" + (index + 1) + "|" + term);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return found;
    }

    private static string StripComments(string source)
    {
        var withoutBlocks = Regex.Replace(source, @"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", string.Empty);
        return Regex.Replace(withoutBlocks, @"//[^\r\n]*", string.Empty);
    }

    private static string Sha256Of(string path)
    {
        using var sha = System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.Create();
        using var stream = File.OpenRead(path);
        return Convert.ToHexString(sha.ComputeHash(stream));
    }

    // Isolation law: every gate file resolves the repository root itself and declares
    // no shared type, so it compiles whether or not any other pack has landed.
    private static string FindRepositoryRoot()
    {
        var directory = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);

        while (directory is not null)
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, ".git")) ||
                Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, "Backend")))
            {
                return directory.FullName;
            }

            directory = directory.Parent;
        }

        throw new InvalidOperationException("Repository root not found from " + AppContext.BaseDirectory);
    }
}
'@

    Set-Content -LiteralPath $testFull -Value $testSource -Encoding UTF8
    [void]$script:Created.Add($testFull)
    Write-Ok "created: $TestRel"

    # ========================================= PHASE 5 - ON-DISK SELF-CHECK ==
    Write-Head 'PHASE 5 - ON-DISK SELF-CHECK'

    foreach ($f in $script:Created) {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { Invoke-Rollback "self-check failed: file absent - $f"; exit 3 }
    }
    Write-Ok "$($script:Created.Count) artifact(s) present on disk"

    try { [void](Get-Content -LiteralPath $lockFull -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json) }
    catch { Invoke-Rollback 'self-check failed: lock file is not valid JSON.'; exit 3 }
    Write-Ok 'lock file parses as JSON'

    # No oracle asset may have been touched by this pack.
    foreach ($a in $assets) {
        if (-not $a.present) { continue }
        $full = Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($a.path -replace '/', '\')
        if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $full -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne $a.sha256) {
            Invoke-Rollback "self-check failed: oracle asset changed during the run - $($a.path)"; exit 3
        }
    }
    Write-Ok 'every oracle asset byte-identical to its inventory hash'

    # ============================================== PHASE 6 - GATED TESTS ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 6 - GATE'

    if ($SkipTests) {
        Write-Warn '-SkipTests passed. Ungated. Do not commit without a green run.'
    }
    else {
        $tstp = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests.csproj'
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tstp)) { Invoke-Rollback "test project missing: $tstp"; exit 3 }

        Write-Inf 'running the legacy regression oracle freeze gate'
        $tl = Join-Path $ev 'test.log'
        & dotnet test $tstp --filter "Gate=LegacyRegressionOracleFreeze" --nologo 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $tl | Out-Null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl -Tail 30 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
            Invoke-Rollback 'Freeze gate is not green.'; exit 3
        }
        $tt = Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl -Raw
        if ($tt -notmatch 'Passed!' -and $tt -notmatch 'Passed:\s*[1-9]') {
            Write-Bad 'Test run reported success but counted no passing test.'
            Invoke-Rollback 'Gate produced no executed assertions.'; exit 3
        }
        Write-Ok 'freeze gate green with executed assertions'
    }

    # ============================================= PHASE 7 - EXACT STAGING ===
    Write-Head 'PHASE 7 - EXACT STAGING  [MUTATION]'

    $toStage = @($LockGit, $TestGit)
    if ($violations.Count -gt 0) { $toStage += $BaselineGit }

    foreach ($p in $toStage) {
        $ar = Invoke-Git @('add', '--', $p)
        if ($ar.Code -ne 0) { Invoke-Rollback "git add failed: $p"; exit 3 }
        [void]$script:Staged.Add($p)
        Write-Ok "staged: $p"
    }

    $ca = (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).Text.TrimEnd()
    $list = @(); if ($ca) { $list = @($ca -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim().Trim('"') }) }
    $extra = @($list | Where-Object { $toStage -notcontains $_ })
    $absent = @($toStage | Where-Object { $list -notcontains $_ })
    if ($extra.Count -gt 0 -or $absent.Count -gt 0) {
        foreach ($x in $extra)  { Write-Bad "unintended staged path: $x" }
        foreach ($m in $absent) { Write-Bad "declared path not staged: $m" }
        Invoke-Rollback 'Index does not equal the exact owned set.'; exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok "index equals the exact owned set ($($list.Count) file(s))"

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  --- git diff --cached --name-only ---' -ForegroundColor Gray
    foreach ($l in $list) { Write-Host "  $l" -ForegroundColor Gray }
    Write-Host '  --- git diff --cached --stat ---' -ForegroundColor Gray
    (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--stat')).Text -split "`r?`n" | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" -ForegroundColor Gray }

    # ============================================= PHASE 8 - CLOSURE ========
    Write-Head 'CLOSURE'

    $report = @()
    $report += 'LEGACY REGRESSION ORACLE FREEZE'
    $report += "  baseline commit  : $head"
    $report += "  oracle assets    : $(@($assets | Where-Object { $_.present }).Count) pinned by SHA256"
    $report += "  phenomena        : $($phenomena.Count) declared with expected direction and effect band"
    $report += "  no-derivation    : $($violations.Count) legacy-vocabulary occurrence(s) in generic surfaces"
    if ($violations.Count -gt 0) {
        $report += '                     recorded as an OPEN shrink-only baseline; owned by the plant-vocabulary sweep'
    }
    $report += "  gate             : $(if ($SkipTests) { 'SKIPPED - do not commit' } else { 'freeze gate green' })"
    $report += "  evidence         : $ev"
    $report += '  NOT asserted     : phenomena execution against the frozen historical database is a separate run'
    Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $ev 'CLOSURE.txt') -Value ($report -join "`r`n") -Encoding UTF8

    Write-Host ''
    foreach ($r in $report) { Write-Host "  $r" -ForegroundColor White }
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  NOT COMMITTED. Commit on your instruction:' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host '    git commit -m "T-086: freeze the legacy regression oracle and gate generic surfaces against its vocabulary"' -ForegroundColor Gray
    Write-Host ''
    exit 0
}
finally { Pop-Location }

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot     = "C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ",
    [ValidateSet("Verify","Apply","Revert")]
    [string]$Mode         = "Verify",
    [string]$BackupRoot   = "C:\Workspace\_ppiq_pack_backups\measure-code-canonicalisation",
    [string]$BackupFolder = "",
    [switch]$SkipTests
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0

$script:Failures = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$script:Stamp    = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"

function Write-Step { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[STEP] $m" -ForegroundColor Cyan }
function Write-Ok   { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[ OK ] $m" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Bad  { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[FAIL] $m" -ForegroundColor Red; [void]$script:Failures.Add($m) }
function Write-Note { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[NOTE] $m" -ForegroundColor Yellow }

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param([string]$Path,[string]$Text)
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}
function Test-HasUtf8Bom {
    param([string]$Path)
    $b = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Path)
    if ($b.Length -lt 3) { return $false }
    return ($b[0] -eq 0xEF -and $b[1] -eq 0xBB -and $b[2] -eq 0xBF)
}
function Write-PreservingBom {
    param([string]$Path,[string]$Text,[bool]$HadBom)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($HadBom)))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LINE ENDINGS. This pack ships LF here-strings; repository C# files are CRLF.
# A multi-line anchor therefore cannot match, and a previous revision of this
# pack failed on exactly that with an opaque "found 0 times". Every anchor is
# now single-line, AND matching is done on an LF-normalised copy, AND the file
# is written back in its own original convention. Three independent guards,
# because a silent line-ending mismatch is indistinguishable from a stale
# diagnosis.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Get-DominantEol {
    param([string]$Text)
    $crlf = ([regex]::Matches($Text, "`r`n")).Count
    $lf   = ([regex]::Matches($Text, "(?<!`r)`n")).Count
    if ($crlf -ge $lf) { return "CRLF" } else { return "LF" }
}
function ConvertTo-Lf {
    param([string]$Text)
    return $Text.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n")
}
function ConvertFrom-Lf {
    param([string]$Text,[string]$Eol)
    if ($Eol -eq "CRLF") { return $Text.Replace("`n", "`r`n") }
    return $Text
}

function Test-SingleLineAnchor {
    # Reports WHY an anchor missed instead of only that it did.
    param([string]$Name,[string]$Text,[string]$Anchor)
    if ($Anchor.Contains("`n")) {
        Write-Bad ("Anchor '" + $Name + "' is multi-line. This pack only uses single-line anchors.")
        return
    }
    $count = ([regex]::Matches($Text, [regex]::Escape($Anchor))).Count
    if ($count -eq 1) { Write-Ok ("Anchor located once: " + $Name); return }

    Write-Bad ("Anchor '" + $Name + "' found " + $count + " times, expected 1")
    $probe = $Anchor.Trim()
    if ($probe.Length -gt 30) { $probe = $probe.Substring(0, 30) }
    $near = @($Text -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_.Contains($probe) })
    if ($near.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-Note ("  No line on disk contains '" + $probe + "'. The diagnosis is stale - re-read the source.")
    } else {
        Write-Note ("  " + $near.Count + " line(s) on disk contain '" + $probe + "'. Nearest on-disk text:")
        foreach ($l in ($near | Select-Object -First 3)) {
            Write-Note ("    >>" + $l + "<<")

        Write-Note ("    >>" + $Anchor + "<<")
        Write-Note "  A difference here is leading whitespace or an edit by another worker."
    }
}

    /// <summary>
    /// T-202. The registry's OWN spelling of a measure code.
    ///
    /// This set answers case-insensitively, but the execution dispatch, the
    /// native-source map and the measure switch all match ORDINALLY. A
    /// persisted definition holding "MaterialCount" therefore passed
    /// validation and then failed execution with "published but not
    /// executable" - measured on ppiq_app, 22 Aug 2026, five product-seeded
    /// system-template widgets.
    ///
    /// Resolving to the canonical spelling ONCE, at the validation boundary,
    /// means a single spelling reaches every case-sensitive lookup downstream.
    /// The alternative - making the dispatch case-insensitive - would let a
    /// non-canonical code past the guard and fall to the switch's default arm,
    /// which returns an empty array with HTTP 200. That is the silent-empty
    /// defect the guard exists to prevent, so it is not done here.
    ///
    /// An unknown code is returned unchanged so the caller still refuses it by
    /// name. This method never invents a code and never widens the set.
    /// </summary>
    public static string? CanonicaliseMeasure(string? measureCode)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(measureCode))
            return measureCode;

        var trimmed = measureCode.Trim();
        return SupportedMeasures.TryGetValue(trimmed, out var canonical) ? canonical : trimmed;
    }

    public static bool IsSupportedMeasure(string? measureCode)
'@

        // ordinally. See DashboardWidgetQuerySafetyRegistry.CanonicaliseMeasure.

================================================================================
PlantProcess IQ - CANONICAL MIGRATION ORDER

Backlog task : T-088 (metadata only; no task id in any permanent artifact)
Owner        : Worker 1

WHAT THIS PRODUCES
  One canonical ordered path that builds a database from zero, every SQL file
  classified into exactly one disposition, a duplicate-DDL truth gate, and a
  fresh throwaway build proving the path needs no manual step.

DISPOSITIONS - exactly one per file, no other value is emitted
  Canonical         schema-defining, on the fresh-build path
  HistoricalRepair  corrective, still required to reach the current shape,
                    on the path, labelled so its role is not mistaken
  Superseded        retired or no-op, off the path
  FixtureOnly       data, demonstration or test content, never on the path
  DeferredWithReason off the path with a written reason

ORDERING
  Primary key is the numeric ordinal. Ties - and there are several - break by
  dependency: a script creating a table precedes one referencing it. Filename
  age never decides. A file with no numeric ordinal is positioned by dependency
  and the reason is recorded; no ordinal is invented or hardcoded.

DUPLICATE DDL
  Governed duplicate: every occurrence after the first uses IF NOT EXISTS, so
  replay is idempotent. Recorded, allowed.
  Ungoverned duplicate: a later unguarded CREATE TABLE for a table an earlier
  path script already creates. That fails the build and fails the gate.

FRESH BUILD
  Mandatory. Creates a throwaway database, replays the canonical path in order,
  records the final schema, and drops it. NOT EXECUTED cannot close this task.

CREDENTIALS
  None embedded. Resolved from env\profiles. The pack stops rather than invent.

FILES
  A  Backend\database\canonical-migration-order.json
  A  Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\CanonicalMigrationOrderTests.cs

EXIT  0 = applied, fresh build green, gate green, staged
      2 = verification failed, no mutation
      3 = failed after mutation, auto-revert completed
