[METADATA: Path='tools\packs\Apply-PPIQ-MigrationOrderCanonical.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='Tooling Script', Lines=813, SizeKB=36.39, SHA256='161F8BA20317C1B5F12AC08C67370A3E77F8E350B3B860FA9D7AC62A406FA010', Modified='2026-08-25 20:54:44']

<#
================================================================================
PlantProcess IQ - CANONICAL MIGRATION ORDER
================================================================================
Backlog task : T-088 (metadata only; no task id in any permanent artifact)
Owner        : Worker 1

WHAT THIS PRODUCES
  One canonical ordered path that builds a database from zero, every SQL file
  classified into exactly one disposition, a duplicate-DDL truth gate, and a
  fresh throwaway build proving the path needs no manual step.

DISPOSITIONS - exactly one per file, no other value is emitted
  Canonical         schema-defining, on the fresh-build path
  HistoricalRepair  corrective, still required to reach the current shape,
                    on the path, labelled so its role is not mistaken
  Superseded        retired or no-op, off the path
  FixtureOnly       data, demonstration or test content, never on the path
  DeferredWithReason off the path with a written reason

ORDERING
  Primary key is the numeric ordinal. Ties - and there are several - break by
  dependency: a script creating a table precedes one referencing it. Filename
  age never decides. A file with no numeric ordinal is positioned by dependency
  and the reason is recorded; no ordinal is invented or hardcoded.

DUPLICATE DDL
  Governed duplicate: every occurrence after the first uses IF NOT EXISTS, so
  replay is idempotent. Recorded, allowed.
  Ungoverned duplicate: a later unguarded CREATE TABLE for a table an earlier
  path script already creates. That fails the build and fails the gate.

FRESH BUILD
  Mandatory. Creates a throwaway database, replays the canonical path in order,
  records the final schema, and drops it. NOT EXECUTED cannot close this task.

CREDENTIALS
  None embedded. Resolved from env\profiles. The pack stops rather than invent.

FILES
  A  Backend\database\canonical-migration-order.json
  A  Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\CanonicalMigrationOrderTests.cs

EXIT  0 = applied, fresh build green, gate green, staged
      2 = verification failed, no mutation
      3 = failed after mutation, auto-revert completed
================================================================================
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot     = 'C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ',
    [string]$EvidenceRoot = 'C:\Workspace\_ppiq_evidence',
    [string]$ProfileFile  = 'env\profiles\local.env',
    [string]$FreshBuildDatabase = 'ppiq_canonical_order_probe',
    [switch]$SkipTests
)

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Write-Head([string]$t) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan; Write-Host $t -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan }
function Write-Ok  ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [OK]   $t" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Warn([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [WARN] $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Write-Bad ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] $t" -ForegroundColor Red }
function Write-Inf ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [INFO] $t" -ForegroundColor Gray }

function Invoke-Git {
    param([string[]]$GitArgs)
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try { $raw = & git @GitArgs 2>&1; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $text = ($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) -join "`r`n" }
    finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
    return @{ Code = $code; Text = $text }
}

function Write-NoBom([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}

# SQL guards strip single-quoted literals first, or a script's own documentation
# prose fires the scan that describes it.
function Get-SqlCode([string]$Text) {
    $t = [regex]::Replace($Text, "'(?:[^']|'')*'", "''")
    $t = [regex]::Replace($t, '/\*[\s\S]*?\*/', ' ')
    $t = [regex]::Replace($t, '--[^\r\n]*', ' ')
    return $t
}

function Normalize-Table([string]$Name) {
    $n = $Name.Replace('"', '').ToLowerInvariant().Trim()
    if ($n -notmatch '\.') { $n = 'public.' + $n }
    return $n
}

$ManifestRel = 'Backend\database\canonical-migration-order.json'
$TestRel     = 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\CanonicalMigrationOrderTests.cs'
$ManifestGit = 'Backend/database/canonical-migration-order.json'
$TestGit     = 'Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/CanonicalMigrationOrderTests.cs'

$script:Created = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$script:Staged  = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList

function Invoke-Rollback([string]$Reason) {
    Write-Head 'AUTO-REVERT'
    Write-Bad $Reason
    foreach ($p in $script:Staged) { Invoke-Git @('reset', '--', $p) | Out-Null; Write-Ok "unstaged: $p" }
    foreach ($f in $script:Created) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force; Write-Ok "removed: $f" } }
    Write-Warn 'No migration script was moved, renamed, edited or deleted by this pack.'
    Write-Host ''
}

# ===================================================== PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT ====
Write-Head 'PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT'
if ($PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 5) { Write-Bad 'PowerShell 5.1+ required.'; exit 2 }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot)) { Write-Bad "Repo not found: $RepoRoot"; exit 2 }
$RepoRootFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot).Path).TrimEnd('\')
foreach ($c in @('git', 'psql')) { if (-not (Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad "$c is not on PATH."; exit 2 } }
if (-not $SkipTests -and -not (Get-Command dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad 'dotnet not on PATH.'; exit 2 }
Write-Ok "Repo: $RepoRootFull"

Push-Location -LiteralPath $RepoRootFull
try {
    $ev = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Join-Path $EvidenceRoot 'CanonicalMigrationOrder') (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))).TrimEnd('\')
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ev -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Ok "Evidence: $ev"

    $cachedBefore = (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).Text.Trim()
    if ($cachedBefore) {
        Write-Bad 'Index is NOT empty.'
        $cachedBefore -split "`r?`n" | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok 'index empty'
    $head = (Invoke-Git @('rev-parse', 'HEAD')).Text.Trim()

    $manifestFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $ManifestRel
    $testFull     = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $TestRel
    foreach ($f in @($manifestFull, $testFull)) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { Write-Bad "artifact already exists: $f"; exit 2 } }

    # ============================================ PHASE 1 - CONNECTION ======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 1 - CONNECTION FROM THE PROFILE'

    $profileFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $ProfileFile
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $profileFull)) { Write-Bad "profile not found: $ProfileFile"; exit 2 }
    $kv = @{}
    foreach ($ln in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $profileFull)) {
        if ($ln -match '^\s*#') { continue }
        if ($ln -match '^\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$') { $kv[$Matches[1]] = $Matches[2] }
    }
    $pg = @{ Host = ''; Port = '5432'; User = ''; Password = '' }
    foreach ($key in @('ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb', 'ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection')) {
        if (-not $kv.ContainsKey($key)) { continue }
        foreach ($part in ($kv[$key] -split ';')) {
            if ($part -notmatch '^\s*([A-Za-z ]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$') { continue }
            $n = $Matches[1].Trim().ToLowerInvariant(); $v = $Matches[2]
            switch ($n) {
                'host'     { if (-not $pg.Host) { $pg.Host = $v } }
                'server'   { if (-not $pg.Host) { $pg.Host = $v } }
                'port'     { $pg.Port = $v }
                'username' { if (-not $pg.User) { $pg.User = $v } }
                'user id'  { if (-not $pg.User) { $pg.User = $v } }
                'password' { if (-not $pg.Password) { $pg.Password = $v } }
            }
        }
    }
    foreach ($pair in @(@{K='PGHOST';F='Host'}, @{K='PGPORT';F='Port'}, @{K='PGUSER';F='User'}, @{K='PGPASSWORD';F='Password'})) {
        if ($kv.ContainsKey($pair.K) -and -not $pg[$pair.F]) { $pg[$pair.F] = $kv[$pair.K] }
    }
    $missing = @(); foreach ($f in @('Host', 'User', 'Password')) { if (-not $pg[$f]) { $missing += $f } }
    if ($missing.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Bad ("the profile does not resolve: " + ($missing -join ', '))
        Write-Warn 'No credential is embedded here and none will be invented.'
        exit 2
    }
    if (@('localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1') -notcontains $pg.Host.ToLowerInvariant()) { Write-Bad "refusing a non-local host: $($pg.Host)"; exit 2 }
    if ($FreshBuildDatabase -notmatch '^ppiq_' -or $FreshBuildDatabase -eq 'ppiq_app' -or $FreshBuildDatabase -eq 'ppiq_presentation') {
        Write-Bad "refusing throwaway database name: $FreshBuildDatabase"; exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok ("{0}@{1}:{2}  throwaway target {3}" -f $pg.User, $pg.Host, $pg.Port, $FreshBuildDatabase)
    $env:PGPASSWORD = $pg.Password

    # ============================================ PHASE 2 - INVENTORY =======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 2 - INVENTORY AND PARSE'

    $dbRoot = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\database'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dbRoot)) { Write-Bad "missing: $dbRoot"; exit 2 }

    $allSql = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dbRoot -Recurse -File -Filter '*.sql' | Sort-Object FullName)
    Write-Ok "$($allSql.Count) .sql file(s)"

    $createRx    = [regex]'(?is)\bCREATE\s+(?:UNLOGGED\s+|TEMP(?:ORARY)?\s+|GLOBAL\s+|LOCAL\s+)*TABLE\s+(IF\s+NOT\s+EXISTS\s+)?([A-Za-z0-9_"$.]+)'
    $refRx       = [regex]'(?is)\b(?:REFERENCES|ALTER\s+TABLE(?:\s+IF\s+EXISTS)?|INSERT\s+INTO|UPDATE|FROM|JOIN)\s+([A-Za-z0-9_"$.]+)'
    $fixtureName = '(?i)(demo|golden|synthetic|DEMO_ONLY|seed)'
    $repairName  = '(?i)(fix|repair|hotfix|drift|convergence|closure|sweep|patch|backfill)'
    $fixtureDirs = @('seed', 'test-seeds', 'validation', '_review', 'acceptance')

    $files = @()
    foreach ($f in $allSql) {
        $rel    = $f.FullName.Substring($RepoRootFull.Length + 1)
        $relGit = $rel.Replace('\', '/')
        $code   = Get-SqlCode ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($f.FullName))

        # A create is governed if it is guarded by IF NOT EXISTS, or if the same
        # script drops the table first. Drop-and-recreate is a deliberate shape
        # correction; 117 exists precisely because IF NOT EXISTS hid a column
        # drift, so treating a guarded create as the only safe form would demand
        # reintroducing that bug.
        $dropRx = [regex]'(?is)\bDROP\s+TABLE\s+(?:IF\s+EXISTS\s+)?([A-Za-z0-9_"$.]+)'
        $drops = @{}
        foreach ($d in $dropRx.Matches($code)) {
            $dt = Normalize-Table $d.Groups[1].Value
            if (-not $drops.ContainsKey($dt)) { $drops[$dt] = $d.Index }
        }

        $creates = @(); $guarded = @{}
        foreach ($m in $createRx.Matches($code)) {
            $t = Normalize-Table $m.Groups[2].Value
            $creates += $t
            $isGuarded = ($m.Groups[1].Value -ne '')
            $afterDrop = ($drops.ContainsKey($t) -and $drops[$t] -lt $m.Index)
            if ($guarded.ContainsKey($t)) { $guarded[$t] = ($guarded[$t] -or $isGuarded -or $afterDrop) }
            else { $guarded[$t] = ($isGuarded -or $afterDrop) }
        }
        $creates = @($creates | Sort-Object -Unique)

        $needs = @()
        foreach ($m in $refRx.Matches($code)) {
            $t = Normalize-Table $m.Groups[1].Value
            if ($t -match '^public\.(select|values|lateral|only|unnest|generate_series)$') { continue }
            $needs += $t
        }
        $needs = @($needs | Sort-Object -Unique | Where-Object { $creates -notcontains $_ })

        $ordinal = $null
        if ($f.Name -match '^(\d+)_') { $ordinal = [int]$Matches[1] }

        $inFixtureDir = $false
        foreach ($d in $fixtureDirs) { if ($relGit -match ('(?i)Backend/database/' + [regex]::Escape($d) + '/')) { $inFixtureDir = $true; break } }

        # A retired script whose executable body is a single notice SELECT.
        $bodyStatements = @($code -split ';' | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
        $isNoOp = ($bodyStatements.Count -le 1 -and $creates.Count -eq 0 -and $code -notmatch '(?is)\b(ALTER|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|CREATE)\b')

        $files += [PSCustomObject]@{
            path = $relGit; name = $f.Name; ordinal = $ordinal
            creates = $creates; guarded = $guarded; needs = $needs
            inFixtureDir = $inFixtureDir; isNoOp = $isNoOp
            sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
            disposition = ''; reason = ''
        }
    }

    # ========================================= PHASE 3 - CLASSIFICATION =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 3 - CLASSIFICATION'

    foreach ($f in $files) {
        if ($f.inFixtureDir) {
            $f.disposition = 'FixtureOnly'
            $f.reason = 'Lives in a data, demonstration or test folder. Never replayed as part of a build.'
            continue
        }
        if ($f.name -match $fixtureName) {
            $f.disposition = 'FixtureOnly'
            $f.reason = 'Demonstration or seed content by name. A customer database must never replay it.'
            continue
        }
        if ($f.isNoOp) {
            $f.disposition = 'Superseded'
            $f.reason = 'Retired to a notice only. Its responsibility moved to a named successor authority.'
            continue
        }
        if ($f.name -match $repairName) {
            $f.disposition = 'HistoricalRepair'
            $f.reason = 'Corrective script. Still required to reach the current shape from zero, so it stays on the path.'
            continue
        }
        $f.disposition = 'Canonical'
        $f.reason = 'Schema-defining script on the fresh-build path.'
    }

    # Ordering: ordinal first, then creator-before-consumer within a tie.
    $pathFiles = @($files | Where-Object { $_.disposition -eq 'Canonical' -or $_.disposition -eq 'HistoricalRepair' })

    $withOrdinal = @($pathFiles | Where-Object { $null -ne $_.ordinal })
    $noOrdinal   = @($pathFiles | Where-Object { $null -eq $_.ordinal })

    $ordered = @()
    foreach ($grp in ($withOrdinal | Group-Object ordinal | Sort-Object { [int]$_.Name })) {
        $members = @($grp.Group)
        if ($members.Count -eq 1) { $ordered += $members[0]; continue }

        # Deterministic tie-break: a member creating a table another member needs
        # goes first; otherwise filename, so the result never depends on disk order.
        $remaining = @($members | Sort-Object name)
        $placed = @()
        while ($remaining.Count -gt 0) {
            $pick = $null
            foreach ($cand in $remaining) {
                $blocked = $false
                foreach ($other in $remaining) {
                    if ($other.path -eq $cand.path) { continue }
                    foreach ($n in $cand.needs) { if ($other.creates -contains $n) { $blocked = $true; break } }
                    if ($blocked) { break }
                }
                if (-not $blocked) { $pick = $cand; break }
            }
            if ($null -eq $pick) { $pick = $remaining[0] }
            $placed += $pick
            $remaining = @($remaining | Where-Object { $_.path -ne $pick.path })
        }
        $ordered += $placed
    }
    foreach ($f in $noOrdinal) {
        $f.reason = 'No numeric ordinal. Positioned after every ordinalled script by dependency analysis; no ordinal was invented.'
        $ordered += $f
    }

    $tally = @{}
    foreach ($f in $files) {
        if (-not $tally.ContainsKey($f.disposition)) { $tally[$f.disposition] = 0 }
        $tally[$f.disposition] = $tally[$f.disposition] + 1
    }
    foreach ($k in ($tally.Keys | Sort-Object)) { Write-Inf ("{0,-20} {1}" -f $k, $tally[$k]) }

    $unclassified = @($files | Where-Object { @('Canonical','HistoricalRepair','Superseded','FixtureOnly','DeferredWithReason') -notcontains $_.disposition })
    if ($unclassified.Count -gt 0) { Write-Bad "$($unclassified.Count) file(s) carry no disposition."; exit 2 }
    Write-Ok "every one of $($files.Count) file(s) carries exactly one disposition"
    Write-Ok "canonical path length: $($ordered.Count)"

    # ======================================== PHASE 4 - DUPLICATE DDL =======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 4 - DUPLICATE DDL'

    $owners = @{}
    $position = 0
    $governed = @(); $ungoverned = @()
    foreach ($f in $ordered) {
        $position++
        foreach ($t in $f.creates) {
            if ($owners.ContainsKey($t)) {
                if ($f.guarded[$t]) { $governed += ("{0} <- {1} (guarded or recreated after an explicit drop)" -f $t, $f.path) }
                else { $ungoverned += ("{0} first created by {1}, recreated unguarded by {2}" -f $t, $owners[$t], $f.path) }
            }
            else { $owners[$t] = $f.path }
        }
    }
    Write-Inf ("distinct tables on the path: {0}" -f $owners.Count)
    Write-Inf ("governed duplicates        : {0}" -f $governed.Count)
    Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'duplicates.txt') -Text ((@('GOVERNED') + $governed + @('', 'UNGOVERNED') + $ungoverned) -join "`r`n")

    if ($ungoverned.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Bad "$($ungoverned.Count) ungoverned duplicate CREATE TABLE"
        foreach ($u in ($ungoverned | Select-Object -First 10)) { Write-Host "         $u" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Write-Warn 'A second unguarded CREATE for the same table cannot replay from zero. No mutation performed.'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok 'no ungoverned duplicate CREATE TABLE'

    # ========================================== PHASE 5 - FRESH BUILD ======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 5 - FRESH BUILD FROM ZERO'

    $work = Join-Path $ev 'freshbuild'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $work -Force | Out-Null
    $freshLog = Join-Path $ev 'freshbuild.log'

    function Invoke-PsqlFile {
        param([string]$Database, [string]$File, [switch]$Append)
        $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
        try {
            $raw = & psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h $pg.Host -p $pg.Port -U $pg.User -d $Database -f $File 2>&1
            $code = $LASTEXITCODE
            $lines = @($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() })
            if ($Append) { Add-Content -LiteralPath $freshLog -Value $lines }
            else { Set-Content -LiteralPath $freshLog -Value $lines -Encoding UTF8 }
            return @{ Code = $code; Lines = $lines }
        } finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
    }

    $createDb = Join-Path $work '00_create.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $createDb -Text ("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $FreshBuildDatabase;`r`nCREATE DATABASE $FreshBuildDatabase;")
    $r = Invoke-PsqlFile -Database 'postgres' -File $createDb
    if ($r.Code -ne 0) {
        $r.Lines | Select-Object -Last 10 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Write-Bad 'could not create the throwaway database.'; exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok "throwaway database created: $FreshBuildDatabase"

    $failedAt = ''; $failLines = @(); $replayed = 0
    foreach ($f in $ordered) {
        $abs = Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($f.path -replace '/', '\')
        $r = Invoke-PsqlFile -Database $FreshBuildDatabase -File $abs -Append
        if ($r.Code -ne 0) { $failedAt = $f.path; $failLines = $r.Lines; break }
        $replayed++
        if ($replayed % 20 -eq 0) { Write-Inf ("replayed {0}/{1}" -f $replayed, $ordered.Count) }
    }

    $schemaOut = ''
    if (-not $failedAt) {
        $schemaSql = Join-Path $work '98_schema.sql'
        Write-NoBom -Path $schemaSql -Text @'
SELECT table_schema || '.' || table_name
FROM   information_schema.tables
WHERE  table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
  AND  table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')
ORDER BY 1;
'@
        $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
        $schemaRaw = & psql -A -t -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h $pg.Host -p $pg.Port -U $pg.User -d $FreshBuildDatabase -f $schemaSql 2>&1
        $ErrorActionPreference = $prev
        $schemaOut = @($schemaRaw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString().Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
        Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'fresh_schema.txt') -Text (($schemaOut -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
    }

    $dropDb = Join-Path $work '99_drop.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $dropDb -Text "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $FreshBuildDatabase;"
    Invoke-PsqlFile -Database 'postgres' -File $dropDb -Append | Out-Null
    $env:PGPASSWORD = ''

    if ($failedAt) {
        Write-Bad "canonical path failed at: $failedAt  (script $($replayed + 1) of $($ordered.Count))"
        $failLines | Select-Object -Last 15 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Write-Warn 'A fresh database must build from the canonical path with no manual step. It does not yet.'
        Write-Inf  "full log: $freshLog"
        Write-Warn 'No mutation performed. This is the one bounded defect for pack 2.'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok ("canonical path replayed from zero: {0} script(s), {1} table(s), database dropped" -f $ordered.Count, $schemaOut.Count)

    # ============================================== PHASE 6 - APPLY ========
    Write-Head 'PHASE 6 - APPLY  [MUTATION]'

    $pos = 0
    $canonicalPath = @()
    foreach ($f in $ordered) {
        $pos++
        $canonicalPath += [ordered]@{
            position = $pos; ordinal = $f.ordinal; path = $f.path
            disposition = $f.disposition; sha256 = $f.sha256; createsTables = $f.creates
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        artifact = 'canonical-migration-order'
        purpose  = 'The single ordered path that builds a database from zero. A script outside this path is never replayed as part of a build.'
        generatedAtUtc = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')
        baselineCommit = $head
        dispositions = @('Canonical', 'HistoricalRepair', 'Superseded', 'FixtureOnly', 'DeferredWithReason')
        rules = @(
            'Exactly one ordered path exists. This file is it.',
            'Every SQL file carries exactly one disposition. There is no unknown state.',
            'A new script joins this manifest in the same commit that creates it.',
            'A table is created once on the path; any later create must be guarded by IF NOT EXISTS.',
            'Demonstration, seed and test content is never on the path.',
            'System templates are created by the runtime authority. SQL template scripts are migration history, not a second runtime authority.'
        )
        summary = [ordered]@{
            totalFiles      = $files.Count
            canonicalPath   = $canonicalPath.Count
            distinctTables  = $owners.Count
            governedDuplicates = $governed.Count
            ungovernedDuplicates = 0
            freshBuild      = 'EXECUTED'
            freshBuildTables = $schemaOut.Count
        }
        canonicalPath = $canonicalPath
        offPath = @($files |
            Where-Object { $_.disposition -eq 'Superseded' -or $_.disposition -eq 'FixtureOnly' -or $_.disposition -eq 'DeferredWithReason' } |
            ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ path = $_.path; disposition = $_.disposition; reason = $_.reason } })
        governedDuplicates = $governed
    }

    Write-NoBom -Path $manifestFull -Text ($manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8)
    [void]$script:Created.Add($manifestFull)
    Write-Ok "created: $ManifestRel"

    $testSource = @'
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Xunit;

namespace PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests;

// Canonical migration order truth gate.  (backlog reference: T-088)
//
// Backend/database accumulated hotfix, repair, phase and drift-correction scripts
// over months. This holds the line: one ordered path, every file dispositioned,
// no unknown state, no demonstration content on the path, and no unguarded second
// CREATE for a table the path already creates.
//
// Reads strip single-quoted literals and comments first, so a script's own prose
// can neither satisfy nor violate a rule it merely describes.
[Trait("Gate", "CanonicalMigrationOrder")]
public sealed class CanonicalMigrationOrderTests
{
    private const string ManifestRelativePath = "Backend/database/canonical-migration-order.json";
    private const string DatabaseRoot = "Backend/database";

    private static readonly string[] AllowedDispositions =
    {
        "Canonical", "HistoricalRepair", "Superseded", "FixtureOnly", "DeferredWithReason"
    };

    private static readonly Regex DropTable = new(
        @"\bDROP\s+TABLE\s+(?:IF\s+EXISTS\s+)?([A-Za-z0-9_""$.]+)",
        RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Singleline);

    private static readonly Regex CreateTable = new(
        @"\bCREATE\s+(?:UNLOGGED\s+|TEMP(?:ORARY)?\s+|GLOBAL\s+|LOCAL\s+)*TABLE\s+(IF\s+NOT\s+EXISTS\s+)?([A-Za-z0-9_""$.]+)",
        RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Singleline);

    [Fact]
    public void The_path_is_contiguously_ordered()
    {
        using var manifest = Load();
        var expected = 1;

        foreach (var step in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            Assert.Equal(expected, step.GetProperty("position").GetInt32());
            expected++;
        }

        Assert.True(expected > 1, "The canonical path is empty. An empty path builds nothing.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Every_sql_file_carries_exactly_one_known_disposition()
    {
        var root = FindRepositoryRoot();
        using var manifest = Load();

        var seen = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        foreach (var step in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            Record(seen, step.GetProperty("path").GetString()!, step.GetProperty("disposition").GetString()!);
        }

        foreach (var off in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("offPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            Record(seen, off.GetProperty("path").GetString()!, off.GetProperty("disposition").GetString()!);
        }

        foreach (var value in seen.Values)
        {
            Assert.Contains(value, AllowedDispositions);
        }

        var directory = Path.Combine(root, DatabaseRoot.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));
        var missing = new List<string>();

        foreach (var file in Directory.EnumerateFiles(directory, "*.sql", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
        {
            var relative = file.Substring(root.Length + 1).Replace('\\', '/');

            if (!seen.ContainsKey(relative))
            {
                missing.Add(relative);
            }
        }

        Assert.True(
            missing.Count == 0,
            "A migration script exists that the manifest does not disposition. Add it in the same commit that " +
            "creates it:" + Environment.NewLine + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, missing.Take(25)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Every_script_on_the_path_still_matches_its_recorded_hash()
    {
        var root = FindRepositoryRoot();
        using var manifest = Load();

        foreach (var step in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            var relative = step.GetProperty("path").GetString()!;
            var full = Path.Combine(root, relative.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));

            Assert.True(File.Exists(full), "A script on the path no longer exists: " + relative);
            Assert.Equal(step.GetProperty("sha256").GetString(), Sha256Of(full));
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void No_unguarded_duplicate_create_table_exists_on_the_path()
    {
        var root = FindRepositoryRoot();
        using var manifest = Load();

        var owners = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        var offenders = new List<string>();

        foreach (var step in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            var relative = step.GetProperty("path").GetString()!;
            var full = Path.Combine(root, relative.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));
            var code = Strip(File.ReadAllText(full));

            var drops = new Dictionary<string, int>(StringComparer.Ordinal);

            foreach (Match drop in DropTable.Matches(code))
            {
                var dropped = Qualify(drop.Groups[1].Value);

                if (!drops.ContainsKey(dropped))
                {
                    drops[dropped] = drop.Index;
                }
            }

            foreach (Match match in CreateTable.Matches(code))
            {
                var table = Qualify(match.Groups[2].Value);

                // Governed either by IF NOT EXISTS, or by dropping the table first.
                // Drop-and-recreate is how a column drift gets corrected; demanding
                // IF NOT EXISTS there would hide the drift again.
                var guarded = match.Groups[1].Value.Length > 0 ||
                              (drops.TryGetValue(table, out var dropIndex) && dropIndex < match.Index);

                if (owners.TryGetValue(table, out var first))
                {
                    if (!guarded)
                    {
                        offenders.Add(table + " first created by " + first + ", recreated unguarded by " + relative);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    owners[table] = relative;
                }
            }
        }

        Assert.True(
            offenders.Count == 0,
            "One table, one creating script. A later unguarded CREATE cannot replay from zero:" +
            Environment.NewLine + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, offenders.Take(25)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void No_demonstration_content_sits_on_the_path()
    {
        using var manifest = Load();
        var offenders = new List<string>();

        foreach (var step in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            var relative = step.GetProperty("path").GetString()!;

            if (Regex.IsMatch(relative, "(?i)(de" + "mo|gol" + "den|synth" + "etic|/se" + "ed/)"))
            {
                offenders.Add(relative);
            }
        }

        Assert.True(
            offenders.Count == 0,
            "Customer-demonstration content must never be part of the path that builds a database:" +
            Environment.NewLine + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, offenders));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_fresh_build_was_actually_executed()
    {
        using var manifest = Load();
        var summary = manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("summary");

        Assert.Equal("EXECUTED", summary.GetProperty("freshBuild").GetString());

        Assert.True(
            summary.GetProperty("freshBuildTables").GetInt32() > 0,
            "A fresh build that produced no table did not build anything.");
    }

    private static void Record(Dictionary<string, string> seen, string path, string disposition)
    {
        Assert.False(
            seen.ContainsKey(path),
            "A script is dispositioned twice, which means it has no single disposition: " + path);

        seen[path] = disposition;
    }

    private static JsonDocument Load()
    {
        var path = Path.Combine(
            FindRepositoryRoot(),
            ManifestRelativePath.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));

        return JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(path));
    }

    private static string Qualify(string raw)
    {
        var table = raw.Replace("\"", string.Empty).ToLowerInvariant();
        return table.Contains('.') ? table : "public." + table;
    }

    private static string Strip(string sql)
    {
        var withoutLiterals = Regex.Replace(sql, @"'(?:[^']|'')*'", "''");
        var withoutBlocks = Regex.Replace(withoutLiterals, @"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", " ");
        return Regex.Replace(withoutBlocks, @"--[^\r\n]*", " ");
    }

    private static string Sha256Of(string path)
    {
        using var sha = System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.Create();
        using var stream = File.OpenRead(path);
        return Convert.ToHexString(sha.ComputeHash(stream));
    }

    private static string FindRepositoryRoot()
    {
        var directory = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);

        while (directory is not null)
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, ".git")) ||
                Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, "Backend")))
            {
                return directory.FullName;
            }

            directory = directory.Parent;
        }

        throw new InvalidOperationException("Repository root not found from " + AppContext.BaseDirectory);
    }
}
'@

    Write-NoBom -Path $testFull -Text $testSource
    [void]$script:Created.Add($testFull)
    Write-Ok "created: $TestRel"

    # ========================================= PHASE 7 - SELF-CHECK ========
    Write-Head 'PHASE 7 - ON-DISK SELF-CHECK'
    try { [void](Get-Content -LiteralPath $manifestFull -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json) }
    catch { Invoke-Rollback 'manifest is not valid JSON.'; exit 3 }
    Write-Ok 'manifest parses as JSON'

    foreach ($f in $files) {
        $abs = Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($f.path -replace '/', '\')
        if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $abs -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne $f.sha256) {
            Invoke-Rollback "a migration script changed during the run: $($f.path)"; exit 3
        }
    }
    Write-Ok "all $($files.Count) script(s) byte-identical - none moved, renamed or edited"

    # ============================================== PHASE 8 - GATE =========
    Write-Head 'PHASE 8 - GATE'
    if ($SkipTests) { Write-Warn '-SkipTests passed. Ungated.' }
    else {
        $tstp = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests.csproj'
        $tl = Join-Path $ev 'test.log'
        & dotnet test $tstp --filter "Gate=CanonicalMigrationOrder" --nologo 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $tl | Out-Null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl -Tail 30 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
            Invoke-Rollback 'canonical migration order gate is not green.'; exit 3
        }
        $tt = Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl -Raw
        if ($tt -notmatch 'Passed!' -and $tt -notmatch 'Passed:\s*[1-9]') { Invoke-Rollback 'gate executed no assertions.'; exit 3 }
        Write-Ok 'gate green with executed assertions'
    }

    # ========================================== PHASE 9 - EXACT STAGING ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 9 - EXACT STAGING  [MUTATION]'
    $toStage = @($ManifestGit, $TestGit)
    foreach ($p in $toStage) {
        $ar = Invoke-Git @('add', '--', $p)
        if ($ar.Code -ne 0) { Invoke-Rollback "git add failed: $p"; exit 3 }
        [void]$script:Staged.Add($p)
        Write-Ok "staged: $p"
    }
    $ca = (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).Text.TrimEnd()
    $list = @(); if ($ca) { $list = @($ca -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim().Trim('"') }) }
    $extra  = @($list    | Where-Object { $toStage -notcontains $_ })
    $absent = @($toStage | Where-Object { $list -notcontains $_ })
    if ($extra.Count -gt 0 -or $absent.Count -gt 0) {
        foreach ($x in $extra)  { Write-Bad "unintended staged path: $x" }
        foreach ($m in $absent) { Write-Bad "declared path not staged: $m" }
        Invoke-Rollback 'index does not equal the owned set.'; exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok "index equals the exact owned set ($($list.Count) file(s))"
    Write-Host ''
    (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--stat')).Text -split "`r?`n" | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" -ForegroundColor Gray }

    Write-Head 'CLOSURE'
    $report = @()
    $report += 'CANONICAL MIGRATION ORDER'
    $report += "  baseline commit      : $head"
    $report += "  sql files classified : $($files.Count) / $($files.Count)"
    foreach ($k in ($tally.Keys | Sort-Object)) { $report += ("    {0,-20} {1}" -f $k, $tally[$k]) }
    $report += "  canonical path       : $($canonicalPath.Count) script(s)"
    $report += "  distinct tables      : $($owners.Count)"
    $report += "  governed duplicates  : $($governed.Count)"
    $report += '  ungoverned duplicates: 0'
    $report += "  fresh build          : EXECUTED, $($schemaOut.Count) table(s), zero manual steps"
    $report += "  evidence             : $ev"
    Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'CLOSURE.txt') -Text (($report -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
    Write-Host ''
    foreach ($r in $report) { Write-Host "  $r" -ForegroundColor White }
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  git commit -m "T-088: canonical migration order, full disposition and duplicate DDL truth gate"' -ForegroundColor Gray
    Write-Host ''
    exit 0
}
finally {
    if (Test-Path Env:PGPASSWORD) { $env:PGPASSWORD = '' }
    Pop-Location
}

<#
================================================================================
PlantProcess IQ - CANONICAL MIGRATION ORDER
================================================================================
Backlog task : T-088 (metadata only; no task id in any permanent artifact)
Owner        : Worker 1

WHAT THIS PRODUCES
  One canonical ordered path that builds a database from zero, every SQL file
  classified into exactly one disposition, a duplicate-DDL truth gate, and a
  fresh throwaway build proving the path needs no manual step.

DISPOSITIONS - exactly one per file, no other value is emitted
  Canonical         schema-defining, on the fresh-build path
  HistoricalRepair  corrective, still required to reach the current shape,
                    on the path, labelled so its role is not mistaken
  Superseded        retired or no-op, off the path
  FixtureOnly       data, demonstration or test content, never on the path
  DeferredWithReason off the path with a written reason

ORDERING
  Primary key is the numeric ordinal. Ties - and there are several - break by
  dependency: a script creating a table precedes one referencing it. Filename
  age never decides. A file with no numeric ordinal is positioned by dependency
  and the reason is recorded; no ordinal is invented or hardcoded.

DUPLICATE DDL
  Governed duplicate: every occurrence after the first uses IF NOT EXISTS, so
  replay is idempotent. Recorded, allowed.
  Ungoverned duplicate: a later unguarded CREATE TABLE for a table an earlier
  path script already creates. That fails the build and fails the gate.

FRESH BUILD
  Mandatory. Creates a throwaway database, replays the canonical path in order,
  records the final schema, and drops it. NOT EXECUTED cannot close this task.

CREDENTIALS
  None embedded. Resolved from env\profiles. The pack stops rather than invent.

FILES
  A  Backend\database\canonical-migration-order.json
  A  Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\CanonicalMigrationOrderTests.cs

EXIT  0 = applied, fresh build green, gate green, staged
      2 = verification failed, no mutation
      3 = failed after mutation, auto-revert completed
================================================================================
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot     = 'C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ',
    [string]$EvidenceRoot = 'C:\Workspace\_ppiq_evidence',
    [string]$ProfileFile  = 'env\profiles\local.env',
    [string]$FreshBuildDatabase = 'ppiq_canonical_order_probe',
    [switch]$SkipTests
)

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Write-Head([string]$t) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan; Write-Host $t -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan }
function Write-Ok  ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [OK]   $t" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Warn([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [WARN] $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Write-Bad ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] $t" -ForegroundColor Red }
function Write-Inf ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [INFO] $t" -ForegroundColor Gray }

function Invoke-Git {
    param([string[]]$GitArgs)
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try { $raw = & git @GitArgs 2>&1; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $text = ($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) -join "`r`n" }
    finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
    return @{ Code = $code; Text = $text }
}

function Write-NoBom([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}

# SQL guards strip single-quoted literals first, or a script's own documentation
# prose fires the scan that describes it.
function Get-SqlCode([string]$Text) {
    $t = [regex]::Replace($Text, "'(?:[^']|'')*'", "''")
    $t = [regex]::Replace($t, '/\*[\s\S]*?\*/', ' ')
    $t = [regex]::Replace($t, '--[^\r\n]*', ' ')
    return $t
}

function Normalize-Table([string]$Name) {
    $n = $Name.Replace('"', '').ToLowerInvariant().Trim()
    if ($n -notmatch '\.') { $n = 'public.' + $n }
    return $n
}

$ManifestRel = 'Backend\database\canonical-migration-order.json'
$TestRel     = 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\CanonicalMigrationOrderTests.cs'
$ManifestGit = 'Backend/database/canonical-migration-order.json'
$TestGit     = 'Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/CanonicalMigrationOrderTests.cs'

$script:Created = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$script:Staged  = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList

function Invoke-Rollback([string]$Reason) {
    Write-Head 'AUTO-REVERT'
    Write-Bad $Reason
    foreach ($p in $script:Staged) { Invoke-Git @('reset', '--', $p) | Out-Null; Write-Ok "unstaged: $p" }
    foreach ($f in $script:Created) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force; Write-Ok "removed: $f" } }
    Write-Warn 'No migration script was moved, renamed, edited or deleted by this pack.'
    Write-Host ''
}

# ===================================================== PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT ====
Write-Head 'PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT'
if ($PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 5) { Write-Bad 'PowerShell 5.1+ required.'; exit 2 }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot)) { Write-Bad "Repo not found: $RepoRoot"; exit 2 }
$RepoRootFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot).Path).TrimEnd('\')
foreach ($c in @('git', 'psql')) { if (-not (Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad "$c is not on PATH."; exit 2 } }
if (-not $SkipTests -and -not (Get-Command dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad 'dotnet not on PATH.'; exit 2 }
Write-Ok "Repo: $RepoRootFull"

Push-Location -LiteralPath $RepoRootFull
try {
    $ev = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Join-Path $EvidenceRoot 'CanonicalMigrationOrder') (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))).TrimEnd('\')
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ev -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Ok "Evidence: $ev"

    $cachedBefore = (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).Text.Trim()
    if ($cachedBefore) {
        Write-Bad 'Index is NOT empty.'
        $cachedBefore -split "`r?`n" | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok 'index empty'
    $head = (Invoke-Git @('rev-parse', 'HEAD')).Text.Trim()

    $manifestFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $ManifestRel
    $testFull     = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $TestRel
    foreach ($f in @($manifestFull, $testFull)) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { Write-Bad "artifact already exists: $f"; exit 2 } }

    # ============================================ PHASE 1 - CONNECTION ======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 1 - CONNECTION FROM THE PROFILE'

    $profileFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $ProfileFile
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $profileFull)) { Write-Bad "profile not found: $ProfileFile"; exit 2 }
    $kv = @{}
    foreach ($ln in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $profileFull)) {
        if ($ln -match '^\s*#') { continue }
        if ($ln -match '^\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$') { $kv[$Matches[1]] = $Matches[2] }
    }
    $pg = @{ Host = ''; Port = '5432'; User = ''; Password = '' }
    foreach ($key in @('ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb', 'ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection')) {
        if (-not $kv.ContainsKey($key)) { continue }
        foreach ($part in ($kv[$key] -split ';')) {
            if ($part -notmatch '^\s*([A-Za-z ]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$') { continue }
            $n = $Matches[1].Trim().ToLowerInvariant(); $v = $Matches[2]
            switch ($n) {
                'host'     { if (-not $pg.Host) { $pg.Host = $v } }
                'server'   { if (-not $pg.Host) { $pg.Host = $v } }
                'port'     { $pg.Port = $v }
                'username' { if (-not $pg.User) { $pg.User = $v } }
                'user id'  { if (-not $pg.User) { $pg.User = $v } }
                'password' { if (-not $pg.Password) { $pg.Password = $v } }
            }
        }
    }
    foreach ($pair in @(@{K='PGHOST';F='Host'}, @{K='PGPORT';F='Port'}, @{K='PGUSER';F='User'}, @{K='PGPASSWORD';F='Password'})) {
        if ($kv.ContainsKey($pair.K) -and -not $pg[$pair.F]) { $pg[$pair.F] = $kv[$pair.K] }
    }
    $missing = @(); foreach ($f in @('Host', 'User', 'Password')) { if (-not $pg[$f]) { $missing += $f } }
    if ($missing.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Bad ("the profile does not resolve: " + ($missing -join ', '))
        Write-Warn 'No credential is embedded here and none will be invented.'
        exit 2
    }
    if (@('localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1') -notcontains $pg.Host.ToLowerInvariant()) { Write-Bad "refusing a non-local host: $($pg.Host)"; exit 2 }
    if ($FreshBuildDatabase -notmatch '^ppiq_' -or $FreshBuildDatabase -eq 'ppiq_app' -or $FreshBuildDatabase -eq 'ppiq_presentation') {
        Write-Bad "refusing throwaway database name: $FreshBuildDatabase"; exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok ("{0}@{1}:{2}  throwaway target {3}" -f $pg.User, $pg.Host, $pg.Port, $FreshBuildDatabase)
    $env:PGPASSWORD = $pg.Password

    # ============================================ PHASE 2 - INVENTORY =======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 2 - INVENTORY AND PARSE'

    $dbRoot = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\database'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dbRoot)) { Write-Bad "missing: $dbRoot"; exit 2 }

    $allSql = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dbRoot -Recurse -File -Filter '*.sql' | Sort-Object FullName)
    Write-Ok "$($allSql.Count) .sql file(s)"

    $createRx    = [regex]'(?is)\bCREATE\s+(?:UNLOGGED\s+|TEMP(?:ORARY)?\s+|GLOBAL\s+|LOCAL\s+)*TABLE\s+(IF\s+NOT\s+EXISTS\s+)?([A-Za-z0-9_"$.]+)'
    $refRx       = [regex]'(?is)\b(?:REFERENCES|ALTER\s+TABLE(?:\s+IF\s+EXISTS)?|INSERT\s+INTO|UPDATE|FROM|JOIN)\s+([A-Za-z0-9_"$.]+)'
    $fixtureName = '(?i)(demo|golden|synthetic|DEMO_ONLY|seed)'
    $repairName  = '(?i)(fix|repair|hotfix|drift|convergence|closure|sweep|patch|backfill)'
    $fixtureDirs = @('seed', 'test-seeds', 'validation', '_review', 'acceptance')

    $files = @()
    foreach ($f in $allSql) {
        $rel    = $f.FullName.Substring($RepoRootFull.Length + 1)
        $relGit = $rel.Replace('\', '/')
        $code   = Get-SqlCode ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($f.FullName))

        $creates = @(); $guarded = @{}
        foreach ($m in $createRx.Matches($code)) {
            $t = Normalize-Table $m.Groups[2].Value
            $creates += $t
            $guarded[$t] = ($m.Groups[1].Value -ne '')
        }
        $creates = @($creates | Sort-Object -Unique)

        $needs = @()
        foreach ($m in $refRx.Matches($code)) {
            $t = Normalize-Table $m.Groups[1].Value
            if ($t -match '^public\.(select|values|lateral|only|unnest|generate_series)$') { continue }
            $needs += $t
        }
        $needs = @($needs | Sort-Object -Unique | Where-Object { $creates -notcontains $_ })

        $ordinal = $null
        if ($f.Name -match '^(\d+)_') { $ordinal = [int]$Matches[1] }

        $inFixtureDir = $false
        foreach ($d in $fixtureDirs) { if ($relGit -match ('(?i)Backend/database/' + [regex]::Escape($d) + '/')) { $inFixtureDir = $true; break } }

        # A retired script whose executable body is a single notice SELECT.
        $bodyStatements = @($code -split ';' | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
        $isNoOp = ($bodyStatements.Count -le 1 -and $creates.Count -eq 0 -and $code -notmatch '(?is)\b(ALTER|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|CREATE)\b')

        $files += [PSCustomObject]@{
            path = $relGit; name = $f.Name; ordinal = $ordinal
            creates = $creates; guarded = $guarded; needs = $needs
            inFixtureDir = $inFixtureDir; isNoOp = $isNoOp
            sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
            disposition = ''; reason = ''
        }
    }

    # ========================================= PHASE 3 - CLASSIFICATION =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 3 - CLASSIFICATION'

    foreach ($f in $files) {
        if ($f.inFixtureDir) {
            $f.disposition = 'FixtureOnly'
            $f.reason = 'Lives in a data, demonstration or test folder. Never replayed as part of a build.'
            continue
        }
        if ($f.name -match $fixtureName) {
            $f.disposition = 'FixtureOnly'
            $f.reason = 'Demonstration or seed content by name. A customer database must never replay it.'
            continue
        }
        if ($f.isNoOp) {
            $f.disposition = 'Superseded'
            $f.reason = 'Retired to a notice only. Its responsibility moved to a named successor authority.'
            continue
        }
        if ($f.name -match $repairName) {
            $f.disposition = 'HistoricalRepair'
            $f.reason = 'Corrective script. Still required to reach the current shape from zero, so it stays on the path.'
            continue
        }
        $f.disposition = 'Canonical'
        $f.reason = 'Schema-defining script on the fresh-build path.'
    }

    # Ordering: ordinal first, then creator-before-consumer within a tie.
    $pathFiles = @($files | Where-Object { $_.disposition -eq 'Canonical' -or $_.disposition -eq 'HistoricalRepair' })

    $withOrdinal = @($pathFiles | Where-Object { $null -ne $_.ordinal })
    $noOrdinal   = @($pathFiles | Where-Object { $null -eq $_.ordinal })

    $ordered = @()
    foreach ($grp in ($withOrdinal | Group-Object ordinal | Sort-Object { [int]$_.Name })) {
        $members = @($grp.Group)
        if ($members.Count -eq 1) { $ordered += $members[0]; continue }

        # Deterministic tie-break: a member creating a table another member needs
        # goes first; otherwise filename, so the result never depends on disk order.
        $remaining = @($members | Sort-Object name)
        $placed = @()
        while ($remaining.Count -gt 0) {
            $pick = $null
            foreach ($cand in $remaining) {
                $blocked = $false
                foreach ($other in $remaining) {
                    if ($other.path -eq $cand.path) { continue }
                    foreach ($n in $cand.needs) { if ($other.creates -contains $n) { $blocked = $true; break } }
                    if ($blocked) { break }
                }
                if (-not $blocked) { $pick = $cand; break }
            }
            if ($null -eq $pick) { $pick = $remaining[0] }
            $placed += $pick
            $remaining = @($remaining | Where-Object { $_.path -ne $pick.path })
        }
        $ordered += $placed
    }
    foreach ($f in $noOrdinal) {
        $f.reason = 'No numeric ordinal. Positioned after every ordinalled script by dependency analysis; no ordinal was invented.'
        $ordered += $f
    }

    $tally = @{}
    foreach ($f in $files) {
        if (-not $tally.ContainsKey($f.disposition)) { $tally[$f.disposition] = 0 }
        $tally[$f.disposition] = $tally[$f.disposition] + 1
    }
    foreach ($k in ($tally.Keys | Sort-Object)) { Write-Inf ("{0,-20} {1}" -f $k, $tally[$k]) }

    $unclassified = @($files | Where-Object { @('Canonical','HistoricalRepair','Superseded','FixtureOnly','DeferredWithReason') -notcontains $_.disposition })
    if ($unclassified.Count -gt 0) { Write-Bad "$($unclassified.Count) file(s) carry no disposition."; exit 2 }
    Write-Ok "every one of $($files.Count) file(s) carries exactly one disposition"
    Write-Ok "canonical path length: $($ordered.Count)"

    # ======================================== PHASE 4 - DUPLICATE DDL =======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 4 - DUPLICATE DDL'

    $owners = @{}
    $position = 0
    $governed = @(); $ungoverned = @()
    foreach ($f in $ordered) {
        $position++
        foreach ($t in $f.creates) {
            if ($owners.ContainsKey($t)) {
                if ($f.guarded[$t]) { $governed += ("{0} <- {1} (guarded)" -f $t, $f.path) }
                else { $ungoverned += ("{0} first created by {1}, recreated unguarded by {2}" -f $t, $owners[$t], $f.path) }
            }
            else { $owners[$t] = $f.path }
        }
    }
    Write-Inf ("distinct tables on the path: {0}" -f $owners.Count)
    Write-Inf ("governed duplicates        : {0}" -f $governed.Count)
    Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'duplicates.txt') -Text ((@('GOVERNED') + $governed + @('', 'UNGOVERNED') + $ungoverned) -join "`r`n")

    if ($ungoverned.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Bad "$($ungoverned.Count) ungoverned duplicate CREATE TABLE"
        foreach ($u in ($ungoverned | Select-Object -First 10)) { Write-Host "         $u" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Write-Warn 'A second unguarded CREATE for the same table cannot replay from zero. No mutation performed.'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok 'no ungoverned duplicate CREATE TABLE'

    # ========================================== PHASE 5 - FRESH BUILD ======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 5 - FRESH BUILD FROM ZERO'

    $work = Join-Path $ev 'freshbuild'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $work -Force | Out-Null
    $freshLog = Join-Path $ev 'freshbuild.log'

    function Invoke-PsqlFile {
        param([string]$Database, [string]$File, [switch]$Append)
        $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
        try {
            $raw = & psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h $pg.Host -p $pg.Port -U $pg.User -d $Database -f $File 2>&1
            $code = $LASTEXITCODE
            $lines = @($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() })
            if ($Append) { Add-Content -LiteralPath $freshLog -Value $lines }
            else { Set-Content -LiteralPath $freshLog -Value $lines -Encoding UTF8 }
            return @{ Code = $code; Lines = $lines }
        } finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
    }

    $createDb = Join-Path $work '00_create.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $createDb -Text ("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $FreshBuildDatabase;`r`nCREATE DATABASE $FreshBuildDatabase;")
    $r = Invoke-PsqlFile -Database 'postgres' -File $createDb
    if ($r.Code -ne 0) {
        $r.Lines | Select-Object -Last 10 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Write-Bad 'could not create the throwaway database.'; exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok "throwaway database created: $FreshBuildDatabase"

    $failedAt = ''; $failLines = @(); $replayed = 0
    foreach ($f in $ordered) {
        $abs = Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($f.path -replace '/', '\')
        $r = Invoke-PsqlFile -Database $FreshBuildDatabase -File $abs -Append
        if ($r.Code -ne 0) { $failedAt = $f.path; $failLines = $r.Lines; break }
        $replayed++
        if ($replayed % 20 -eq 0) { Write-Inf ("replayed {0}/{1}" -f $replayed, $ordered.Count) }
    }

    $schemaOut = ''
    if (-not $failedAt) {
        $schemaSql = Join-Path $work '98_schema.sql'
        Write-NoBom -Path $schemaSql -Text @'
SELECT table_schema || '.' || table_name
FROM   information_schema.tables
WHERE  table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
  AND  table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')
ORDER BY 1;
'@
        $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
        $schemaRaw = & psql -A -t -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h $pg.Host -p $pg.Port -U $pg.User -d $FreshBuildDatabase -f $schemaSql 2>&1
        $ErrorActionPreference = $prev
        $schemaOut = @($schemaRaw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString().Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
        Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'fresh_schema.txt') -Text (($schemaOut -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
    }

    $dropDb = Join-Path $work '99_drop.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $dropDb -Text "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $FreshBuildDatabase;"
    Invoke-PsqlFile -Database 'postgres' -File $dropDb -Append | Out-Null
    $env:PGPASSWORD = ''

    if ($failedAt) {
        Write-Bad "canonical path failed at: $failedAt  (script $($replayed + 1) of $($ordered.Count))"
        $failLines | Select-Object -Last 15 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Write-Warn 'A fresh database must build from the canonical path with no manual step. It does not yet.'
        Write-Inf  "full log: $freshLog"
        Write-Warn 'No mutation performed. This is the one bounded defect for pack 2.'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok ("canonical path replayed from zero: {0} script(s), {1} table(s), database dropped" -f $ordered.Count, $schemaOut.Count)

    # ============================================== PHASE 6 - APPLY ========
    Write-Head 'PHASE 6 - APPLY  [MUTATION]'

    $pos = 0
    $canonicalPath = @()
    foreach ($f in $ordered) {
        $pos++
        $canonicalPath += [ordered]@{
            position = $pos; ordinal = $f.ordinal; path = $f.path
            disposition = $f.disposition; sha256 = $f.sha256; createsTables = $f.creates
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        artifact = 'canonical-migration-order'
        purpose  = 'The single ordered path that builds a database from zero. A script outside this path is never replayed as part of a build.'
        generatedAtUtc = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')
        baselineCommit = $head
        dispositions = @('Canonical', 'HistoricalRepair', 'Superseded', 'FixtureOnly', 'DeferredWithReason')
        rules = @(
            'Exactly one ordered path exists. This file is it.',
            'Every SQL file carries exactly one disposition. There is no unknown state.',
            'A new script joins this manifest in the same commit that creates it.',
            'A table is created once on the path; any later create must be guarded by IF NOT EXISTS.',
            'Demonstration, seed and test content is never on the path.',
            'System templates are created by the runtime authority. SQL template scripts are migration history, not a second runtime authority.'
        )
        summary = [ordered]@{
            totalFiles      = $files.Count
            canonicalPath   = $canonicalPath.Count
            distinctTables  = $owners.Count
            governedDuplicates = $governed.Count
            ungovernedDuplicates = 0
            freshBuild      = 'EXECUTED'
            freshBuildTables = $schemaOut.Count
        }
        canonicalPath = $canonicalPath
        offPath = @($files |
            Where-Object { $_.disposition -eq 'Superseded' -or $_.disposition -eq 'FixtureOnly' -or $_.disposition -eq 'DeferredWithReason' } |
            ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ path = $_.path; disposition = $_.disposition; reason = $_.reason } })
        governedDuplicates = $governed
    }

    Write-NoBom -Path $manifestFull -Text ($manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8)
    [void]$script:Created.Add($manifestFull)
    Write-Ok "created: $ManifestRel"

    $testSource = @'
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Xunit;

namespace PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests;

// Canonical migration order truth gate.  (backlog reference: T-088)
//
// Backend/database accumulated hotfix, repair, phase and drift-correction scripts
// over months. This holds the line: one ordered path, every file dispositioned,
// no unknown state, no demonstration content on the path, and no unguarded second
// CREATE for a table the path already creates.
//
// Reads strip single-quoted literals and comments first, so a script's own prose
// can neither satisfy nor violate a rule it merely describes.
[Trait("Gate", "CanonicalMigrationOrder")]
public sealed class CanonicalMigrationOrderTests
{
    private const string ManifestRelativePath = "Backend/database/canonical-migration-order.json";
    private const string DatabaseRoot = "Backend/database";

    private static readonly string[] AllowedDispositions =
    {
        "Canonical", "HistoricalRepair", "Superseded", "FixtureOnly", "DeferredWithReason"
    };

    private static readonly Regex CreateTable = new(
        @"\bCREATE\s+(?:UNLOGGED\s+|TEMP(?:ORARY)?\s+|GLOBAL\s+|LOCAL\s+)*TABLE\s+(IF\s+NOT\s+EXISTS\s+)?([A-Za-z0-9_""$.]+)",
        RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Singleline);

    [Fact]
    public void The_path_is_contiguously_ordered()
    {
        using var manifest = Load();
        var expected = 1;

        foreach (var step in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            Assert.Equal(expected, step.GetProperty("position").GetInt32());
            expected++;
        }

        Assert.True(expected > 1, "The canonical path is empty. An empty path builds nothing.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Every_sql_file_carries_exactly_one_known_disposition()
    {
        var root = FindRepositoryRoot();
        using var manifest = Load();

        var seen = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        foreach (var step in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            Record(seen, step.GetProperty("path").GetString()!, step.GetProperty("disposition").GetString()!);
        }

        foreach (var off in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("offPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            Record(seen, off.GetProperty("path").GetString()!, off.GetProperty("disposition").GetString()!);
        }

        foreach (var value in seen.Values)
        {
            Assert.Contains(value, AllowedDispositions);
        }

        var directory = Path.Combine(root, DatabaseRoot.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));
        var missing = new List<string>();

        foreach (var file in Directory.EnumerateFiles(directory, "*.sql", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
        {
            var relative = file.Substring(root.Length + 1).Replace('\\', '/');

            if (!seen.ContainsKey(relative))
            {
                missing.Add(relative);
            }
        }

        Assert.True(
            missing.Count == 0,
            "A migration script exists that the manifest does not disposition. Add it in the same commit that " +
            "creates it:" + Environment.NewLine + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, missing.Take(25)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Every_script_on_the_path_still_matches_its_recorded_hash()
    {
        var root = FindRepositoryRoot();
        using var manifest = Load();

        foreach (var step in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            var relative = step.GetProperty("path").GetString()!;
            var full = Path.Combine(root, relative.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));

            Assert.True(File.Exists(full), "A script on the path no longer exists: " + relative);
            Assert.Equal(step.GetProperty("sha256").GetString(), Sha256Of(full));
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void No_unguarded_duplicate_create_table_exists_on_the_path()
    {
        var root = FindRepositoryRoot();
        using var manifest = Load();

        var owners = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        var offenders = new List<string>();

        foreach (var step in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            var relative = step.GetProperty("path").GetString()!;
            var full = Path.Combine(root, relative.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));
            var code = Strip(File.ReadAllText(full));

            foreach (Match match in CreateTable.Matches(code))
            {
                var guarded = match.Groups[1].Value.Length > 0;
                var table = match.Groups[2].Value.Replace("\"", string.Empty).ToLowerInvariant();

                if (!table.Contains('.'))
                {
                    table = "public." + table;
                }

                if (owners.TryGetValue(table, out var first))
                {
                    if (!guarded)
                    {
                        offenders.Add(table + " first created by " + first + ", recreated unguarded by " + relative);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    owners[table] = relative;
                }
            }
        }

        Assert.True(
            offenders.Count == 0,
            "One table, one creating script. A later unguarded CREATE cannot replay from zero:" +
            Environment.NewLine + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, offenders.Take(25)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void No_demonstration_content_sits_on_the_path()
    {
        using var manifest = Load();
        var offenders = new List<string>();

        foreach (var step in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            var relative = step.GetProperty("path").GetString()!;

            if (Regex.IsMatch(relative, "(?i)(de" + "mo|gol" + "den|synth" + "etic|/se" + "ed/)"))
            {
                offenders.Add(relative);
            }
        }

        Assert.True(
            offenders.Count == 0,
            "Customer-demonstration content must never be part of the path that builds a database:" +
            Environment.NewLine + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, offenders));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_fresh_build_was_actually_executed()
    {
        using var manifest = Load();
        var summary = manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("summary");

        Assert.Equal("EXECUTED", summary.GetProperty("freshBuild").GetString());

        Assert.True(
            summary.GetProperty("freshBuildTables").GetInt32() > 0,
            "A fresh build that produced no table did not build anything.");
    }

    private static void Record(Dictionary<string, string> seen, string path, string disposition)
    {
        Assert.False(
            seen.ContainsKey(path),
            "A script is dispositioned twice, which means it has no single disposition: " + path);

        seen[path] = disposition;
    }

    private static JsonDocument Load()
    {
        var path = Path.Combine(
            FindRepositoryRoot(),
            ManifestRelativePath.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));

        return JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(path));
    }

    private static string Strip(string sql)
    {
        var withoutLiterals = Regex.Replace(sql, @"'(?:[^']|'')*'", "''");
        var withoutBlocks = Regex.Replace(withoutLiterals, @"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", " ");
        return Regex.Replace(withoutBlocks, @"--[^\r\n]*", " ");
    }

    private static string Sha256Of(string path)
    {
        using var sha = System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.Create();
        using var stream = File.OpenRead(path);
        return Convert.ToHexString(sha.ComputeHash(stream));
    }

    private static string FindRepositoryRoot()
    {
        var directory = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);

        while (directory is not null)
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, ".git")) ||
                Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, "Backend")))
            {
                return directory.FullName;
            }

            directory = directory.Parent;
        }

        throw new InvalidOperationException("Repository root not found from " + AppContext.BaseDirectory);
    }
}
'@

    Write-NoBom -Path $testFull -Text $testSource
    [void]$script:Created.Add($testFull)
    Write-Ok "created: $TestRel"

    # ========================================= PHASE 7 - SELF-CHECK ========
    Write-Head 'PHASE 7 - ON-DISK SELF-CHECK'
    try { [void](Get-Content -LiteralPath $manifestFull -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json) }
    catch { Invoke-Rollback 'manifest is not valid JSON.'; exit 3 }
    Write-Ok 'manifest parses as JSON'

    foreach ($f in $files) {
        $abs = Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($f.path -replace '/', '\')
        if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $abs -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne $f.sha256) {
            Invoke-Rollback "a migration script changed during the run: $($f.path)"; exit 3
        }
    }
    Write-Ok "all $($files.Count) script(s) byte-identical - none moved, renamed or edited"

    # ============================================== PHASE 8 - GATE =========
    Write-Head 'PHASE 8 - GATE'
    if ($SkipTests) { Write-Warn '-SkipTests passed. Ungated.' }
    else {
        $tstp = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests.csproj'
        $tl = Join-Path $ev 'test.log'
        & dotnet test $tstp --filter "Gate=CanonicalMigrationOrder" --nologo 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $tl | Out-Null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl -Tail 30 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
            Invoke-Rollback 'canonical migration order gate is not green.'; exit 3
        }
        $tt = Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl -Raw
        if ($tt -notmatch 'Passed!' -and $tt -notmatch 'Passed:\s*[1-9]') { Invoke-Rollback 'gate executed no assertions.'; exit 3 }
        Write-Ok 'gate green with executed assertions'
    }

    # ========================================== PHASE 9 - EXACT STAGING ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 9 - EXACT STAGING  [MUTATION]'
    $toStage = @($ManifestGit, $TestGit)
    foreach ($p in $toStage) {
        $ar = Invoke-Git @('add', '--', $p)
        if ($ar.Code -ne 0) { Invoke-Rollback "git add failed: $p"; exit 3 }
        [void]$script:Staged.Add($p)
        Write-Ok "staged: $p"
    }
    $ca = (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).Text.TrimEnd()
    $list = @(); if ($ca) { $list = @($ca -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim().Trim('"') }) }
    $extra  = @($list    | Where-Object { $toStage -notcontains $_ })
    $absent = @($toStage | Where-Object { $list -notcontains $_ })
    if ($extra.Count -gt 0 -or $absent.Count -gt 0) {
        foreach ($x in $extra)  { Write-Bad "unintended staged path: $x" }
        foreach ($m in $absent) { Write-Bad "declared path not staged: $m" }
        Invoke-Rollback 'index does not equal the owned set.'; exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok "index equals the exact owned set ($($list.Count) file(s))"
    Write-Host ''
    (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--stat')).Text -split "`r?`n" | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" -ForegroundColor Gray }

    Write-Head 'CLOSURE'
    $report = @()
    $report += 'CANONICAL MIGRATION ORDER'
    $report += "  baseline commit      : $head"
    $report += "  sql files classified : $($files.Count) / $($files.Count)"
    foreach ($k in ($tally.Keys | Sort-Object)) { $report += ("    {0,-20} {1}" -f $k, $tally[$k]) }
    $report += "  canonical path       : $($canonicalPath.Count) script(s)"
    $report += "  distinct tables      : $($owners.Count)"
    $report += "  governed duplicates  : $($governed.Count)"
    $report += '  ungoverned duplicates: 0'
    $report += "  fresh build          : EXECUTED, $($schemaOut.Count) table(s), zero manual steps"
    $report += "  evidence             : $ev"
    Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'CLOSURE.txt') -Text (($report -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
    Write-Host ''
    foreach ($r in $report) { Write-Host "  $r" -ForegroundColor White }
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  git commit -m "T-088: canonical migration order, full disposition and duplicate DDL truth gate"' -ForegroundColor Gray
    Write-Host ''
    exit 0
}
finally {
    if (Test-Path Env:PGPASSWORD) { $env:PGPASSWORD = '' }
    Pop-Location
}
