<#
================================================================================
PlantProcess IQ - CANONICAL MIGRATION ORDER
================================================================================
Backlog task : T-088 (metadata only; no task id in any permanent artifact)
Owner        : Worker 1

WHAT THIS PRODUCES
  One canonical ordered path that builds a database from zero, every SQL file
  classified into exactly one disposition, a duplicate-DDL truth gate, and a
  fresh throwaway build proving the path needs no manual step.

DISPOSITIONS - exactly one per file, no other value is emitted
  Canonical         schema-defining, on the fresh-build path
  HistoricalRepair  corrective, still required to reach the current shape,
                    on the path, labelled so its role is not mistaken
  Superseded        retired or no-op, off the path
  FixtureOnly       data, demonstration or test content, never on the path
  DeferredWithReason off the path with a written reason

ORDERING
  Primary key is the numeric ordinal. Ties - and there are several - break by
  dependency: a script creating a table precedes one referencing it. Filename
  age never decides. A file with no numeric ordinal is positioned by dependency
  and the reason is recorded; no ordinal is invented or hardcoded.

DUPLICATE DDL
  Governed duplicate: every occurrence after the first uses IF NOT EXISTS, so
  replay is idempotent. Recorded, allowed.
  Ungoverned duplicate: a later unguarded CREATE TABLE for a table an earlier
  path script already creates. That fails the build and fails the gate.

FRESH BUILD
  Mandatory. Creates a throwaway database, replays the canonical path in order,
  records the final schema, and drops it. NOT EXECUTED cannot close this task.

CREDENTIALS
  None embedded. Resolved from env\profiles. The pack stops rather than invent.

FILES
  A  Backend\database\canonical-migration-order.json
  A  Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\CanonicalMigrationOrderTests.cs

EXIT  0 = applied, fresh build green, gate green, staged
      2 = verification failed, no mutation
      3 = failed after mutation, auto-revert completed
================================================================================
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot     = 'C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ',
    [string]$EvidenceRoot = 'C:\Workspace\_ppiq_evidence',
    [string]$ProfileFile  = 'env\profiles\local.env',
    [string]$FreshBuildDatabase = 'ppiq_canonical_order_probe',
    [switch]$SkipTests
)

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Write-Head([string]$t) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan; Write-Host $t -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan }
function Write-Ok  ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [OK]   $t" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Warn([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [WARN] $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Write-Bad ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] $t" -ForegroundColor Red }
function Write-Inf ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [INFO] $t" -ForegroundColor Gray }

function Invoke-Git {
    param([string[]]$GitArgs)
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try { $raw = & git @GitArgs 2>&1; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $text = ($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) -join "`r`n" }
    finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
    return @{ Code = $code; Text = $text }
}

function Write-NoBom([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}

# SQL guards strip single-quoted literals first, or a script's own documentation
# prose fires the scan that describes it.
function Get-SqlCode([string]$Text) {
    $t = [regex]::Replace($Text, "'(?:[^']|'')*'", "''")
    $t = [regex]::Replace($t, '/\*[\s\S]*?\*/', ' ')
    $t = [regex]::Replace($t, '--[^\r\n]*', ' ')
    return $t
}

function Normalize-Table([string]$Name) {
    $n = $Name.Replace('"', '').ToLowerInvariant().Trim()
    if ($n -notmatch '\.') { $n = 'public.' + $n }
    return $n
}

$ManifestRel = 'Backend\database\canonical-migration-order.json'
$TestRel     = 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\CanonicalMigrationOrderTests.cs'
$ManifestGit = 'Backend/database/canonical-migration-order.json'
$TestGit     = 'Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/CanonicalMigrationOrderTests.cs'

$script:Created = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$script:Staged  = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList

function Invoke-Rollback([string]$Reason) {
    Write-Head 'AUTO-REVERT'
    Write-Bad $Reason
    foreach ($p in $script:Staged) { Invoke-Git @('reset', '--', $p) | Out-Null; Write-Ok "unstaged: $p" }
    foreach ($f in $script:Created) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force; Write-Ok "removed: $f" } }
    Write-Warn 'No migration script was moved, renamed, edited or deleted by this pack.'
    Write-Host ''
}

# ===================================================== PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT ====
Write-Head 'PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT'
if ($PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 5) { Write-Bad 'PowerShell 5.1+ required.'; exit 2 }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot)) { Write-Bad "Repo not found: $RepoRoot"; exit 2 }
$RepoRootFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot).Path).TrimEnd('\')
foreach ($c in @('git', 'psql')) { if (-not (Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad "$c is not on PATH."; exit 2 } }
if (-not $SkipTests -and -not (Get-Command dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad 'dotnet not on PATH.'; exit 2 }
Write-Ok "Repo: $RepoRootFull"

Push-Location -LiteralPath $RepoRootFull
try {
    $ev = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Join-Path $EvidenceRoot 'CanonicalMigrationOrder') (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))).TrimEnd('\')
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ev -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Ok "Evidence: $ev"

    $cachedBefore = (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).Text.Trim()
    if ($cachedBefore) {
        Write-Bad 'Index is NOT empty.'
        $cachedBefore -split "`r?`n" | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok 'index empty'
    $head = (Invoke-Git @('rev-parse', 'HEAD')).Text.Trim()

    $manifestFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $ManifestRel
    $testFull     = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $TestRel
    foreach ($f in @($manifestFull, $testFull)) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { Write-Bad "artifact already exists: $f"; exit 2 } }

    # ============================================ PHASE 1 - CONNECTION ======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 1 - CONNECTION FROM THE PROFILE'

    $profileFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $ProfileFile
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $profileFull)) { Write-Bad "profile not found: $ProfileFile"; exit 2 }
    $kv = @{}
    foreach ($ln in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $profileFull)) {
        if ($ln -match '^\s*#') { continue }
        if ($ln -match '^\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$') { $kv[$Matches[1]] = $Matches[2] }
    }
    $pg = @{ Host = ''; Port = '5432'; User = ''; Password = '' }
    foreach ($key in @('ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb', 'ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection')) {
        if (-not $kv.ContainsKey($key)) { continue }
        foreach ($part in ($kv[$key] -split ';')) {
            if ($part -notmatch '^\s*([A-Za-z ]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$') { continue }
            $n = $Matches[1].Trim().ToLowerInvariant(); $v = $Matches[2]
            switch ($n) {
                'host'     { if (-not $pg.Host) { $pg.Host = $v } }
                'server'   { if (-not $pg.Host) { $pg.Host = $v } }
                'port'     { $pg.Port = $v }
                'username' { if (-not $pg.User) { $pg.User = $v } }
                'user id'  { if (-not $pg.User) { $pg.User = $v } }
                'password' { if (-not $pg.Password) { $pg.Password = $v } }
            }
        }
    }
    foreach ($pair in @(@{K='PGHOST';F='Host'}, @{K='PGPORT';F='Port'}, @{K='PGUSER';F='User'}, @{K='PGPASSWORD';F='Password'})) {
        if ($kv.ContainsKey($pair.K) -and -not $pg[$pair.F]) { $pg[$pair.F] = $kv[$pair.K] }
    }
    $missing = @(); foreach ($f in @('Host', 'User', 'Password')) { if (-not $pg[$f]) { $missing += $f } }
    if ($missing.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Bad ("the profile does not resolve: " + ($missing -join ', '))
        Write-Warn 'No credential is embedded here and none will be invented.'
        exit 2
    }
    if (@('localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1') -notcontains $pg.Host.ToLowerInvariant()) { Write-Bad "refusing a non-local host: $($pg.Host)"; exit 2 }
    if ($FreshBuildDatabase -notmatch '^ppiq_' -or $FreshBuildDatabase -eq 'ppiq_app' -or $FreshBuildDatabase -eq 'ppiq_presentation') {
        Write-Bad "refusing throwaway database name: $FreshBuildDatabase"; exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok ("{0}@{1}:{2}  throwaway target {3}" -f $pg.User, $pg.Host, $pg.Port, $FreshBuildDatabase)
    $env:PGPASSWORD = $pg.Password

    # ============================================ PHASE 2 - INVENTORY =======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 2 - INVENTORY AND PARSE'

    $dbRoot = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\database'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dbRoot)) { Write-Bad "missing: $dbRoot"; exit 2 }

    $allSql = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dbRoot -Recurse -File -Filter '*.sql' | Sort-Object FullName)
    Write-Ok "$($allSql.Count) .sql file(s)"

    # The SQL scripts were never the whole schema authority. Core tables are created
    # by EF migrations, and several scripts say so in their own error messages. The
    # canonical path therefore begins with the migration set, not with 000_schemas.
    $migrationsDir = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure\Migrations'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $migrationsDir)) { Write-Bad "EF migrations folder missing: $migrationsDir"; exit 2 }
    $efMigrations = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $migrationsDir -File -Filter '*.cs' |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -notmatch '\.Designer\.cs$' -and $_.Name -notmatch 'ModelSnapshot\.cs$' } |
        Sort-Object Name |
        ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ name = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($_.Name); sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash } })
    if ($efMigrations.Count -eq 0) { Write-Bad 'no EF migration found; the schema baseline cannot be established.'; exit 2 }
    Write-Ok "$($efMigrations.Count) EF migration(s) form the schema baseline"
    foreach ($m in $efMigrations) { Write-Inf ("  " + $m.name) }

    $createRx    = [regex]'(?is)\bCREATE\s+(?:UNLOGGED\s+|TEMP(?:ORARY)?\s+|GLOBAL\s+|LOCAL\s+)*TABLE\s+(IF\s+NOT\s+EXISTS\s+)?([A-Za-z0-9_"$.]+)'
    $refRx       = [regex]'(?is)\b(?:REFERENCES|ALTER\s+TABLE(?:\s+IF\s+EXISTS)?|INSERT\s+INTO|UPDATE|FROM|JOIN)\s+([A-Za-z0-9_"$.]+)'
    $fixtureName = '(?i)(demo|golden|synthetic|DEMO_ONLY|seed)'
    $repairName  = '(?i)(fix|repair|hotfix|drift|convergence|closure|sweep|patch|backfill)'
    $fixtureDirs = @('seed', 'test-seeds', 'validation', '_review', 'acceptance')

    $files = @()
    foreach ($f in $allSql) {
        $rel    = $f.FullName.Substring($RepoRootFull.Length + 1)
        $relGit = $rel.Replace('\', '/')
        $code   = Get-SqlCode ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($f.FullName))

        # A create is governed if it is guarded by IF NOT EXISTS, or if the same
        # script drops the table first. Drop-and-recreate is a deliberate shape
        # correction; 117 exists precisely because IF NOT EXISTS hid a column
        # drift, so treating a guarded create as the only safe form would demand
        # reintroducing that bug.
        $dropRx = [regex]'(?is)\bDROP\s+TABLE\s+(?:IF\s+EXISTS\s+)?([A-Za-z0-9_"$.]+)'
        $drops = @{}
        foreach ($d in $dropRx.Matches($code)) {
            $dt = Normalize-Table $d.Groups[1].Value
            if (-not $drops.ContainsKey($dt)) { $drops[$dt] = $d.Index }
        }

        $creates = @(); $guarded = @{}
        foreach ($m in $createRx.Matches($code)) {
            $t = Normalize-Table $m.Groups[2].Value
            $creates += $t
            $isGuarded = ($m.Groups[1].Value -ne '')
            $afterDrop = ($drops.ContainsKey($t) -and $drops[$t] -lt $m.Index)
            if ($guarded.ContainsKey($t)) { $guarded[$t] = ($guarded[$t] -or $isGuarded -or $afterDrop) }
            else { $guarded[$t] = ($isGuarded -or $afterDrop) }
        }
        $creates = @($creates | Sort-Object -Unique)

        $needs = @()
        foreach ($m in $refRx.Matches($code)) {
            $t = Normalize-Table $m.Groups[1].Value
            if ($t -match '^public\.(select|values|lateral|only|unnest|generate_series)$') { continue }
            $needs += $t
        }
        $needs = @($needs | Sort-Object -Unique | Where-Object { $creates -notcontains $_ })

        $ordinal = $null
        if ($f.Name -match '^(\d+)_') { $ordinal = [int]$Matches[1] }

        $inFixtureDir = $false
        foreach ($d in $fixtureDirs) { if ($relGit -match ('(?i)Backend/database/' + [regex]::Escape($d) + '/')) { $inFixtureDir = $true; break } }

        # Folder tier, because each folder numbers from its own 000. A view carries
        # ordinal 006 in the views folder and must still follow every table script;
        # merging the two ordinal namespaces put a view before its base tables.
        $tier = 3
        if     ($relGit -match '(?i)Backend/database/scripts/') { $tier = 1 }
        elseif ($relGit -match '(?i)Backend/database/views/')   { $tier = 2 }

        # A retired script whose executable body is a single notice SELECT.
        $bodyStatements = @($code -split ';' | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
        $isNoOp = ($bodyStatements.Count -le 1 -and $creates.Count -eq 0 -and $code -notmatch '(?is)\b(ALTER|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|CREATE)\b')

        $files += [PSCustomObject]@{
            path = $relGit; name = $f.Name; ordinal = $ordinal
            creates = $creates; guarded = $guarded; needs = $needs
            inFixtureDir = $inFixtureDir; isNoOp = $isNoOp; tier = $tier
            sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
            disposition = ''; reason = ''
        }
    }

    # ========================================= PHASE 3 - CLASSIFICATION =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 3 - CLASSIFICATION'

    foreach ($f in $files) {
        if ($f.inFixtureDir) {
            $f.disposition = 'FixtureOnly'
            $f.reason = 'Lives in a data, demonstration or test folder. Never replayed as part of a build.'
            continue
        }
        if ($f.name -match $fixtureName) {
            $f.disposition = 'FixtureOnly'
            $f.reason = 'Demonstration or seed content by name. A customer database must never replay it.'
            continue
        }
        if ($f.isNoOp) {
            $f.disposition = 'Superseded'
            $f.reason = 'Retired to a notice only. Its responsibility moved to a named successor authority.'
            continue
        }
        if ($f.name -match $repairName) {
            $f.disposition = 'HistoricalRepair'
            $f.reason = 'Corrective script. Still required to reach the current shape from zero, so it stays on the path.'
            continue
        }
        $f.disposition = 'Canonical'
        $f.reason = 'Schema-defining script on the fresh-build path.'
    }

    # Ordering: ordinal first, then creator-before-consumer within a tie.
    $pathFiles = @($files | Where-Object { $_.disposition -eq 'Canonical' -or $_.disposition -eq 'HistoricalRepair' })

    $ordered = @()
    foreach ($tierGroup in ($pathFiles | Group-Object tier | Sort-Object { [int]$_.Name })) {
    $tierFiles   = @($tierGroup.Group)
    $withOrdinal = @($tierFiles | Where-Object { $null -ne $_.ordinal })
    $noOrdinal   = @($tierFiles | Where-Object { $null -eq $_.ordinal })

    foreach ($grp in ($withOrdinal | Group-Object ordinal | Sort-Object { [int]$_.Name })) {
        $members = @($grp.Group)
        if ($members.Count -eq 1) { $ordered += $members[0]; continue }

        # Deterministic tie-break: a member creating a table another member needs
        # goes first; otherwise filename, so the result never depends on disk order.
        $remaining = @($members | Sort-Object name)
        $placed = @()
        while ($remaining.Count -gt 0) {
            $pick = $null
            foreach ($cand in $remaining) {
                $blocked = $false
                foreach ($other in $remaining) {
                    if ($other.path -eq $cand.path) { continue }
                    foreach ($n in $cand.needs) { if ($other.creates -contains $n) { $blocked = $true; break } }
                    if ($blocked) { break }
                }
                if (-not $blocked) { $pick = $cand; break }
            }
            if ($null -eq $pick) { $pick = $remaining[0] }
            $placed += $pick
            $remaining = @($remaining | Where-Object { $_.path -ne $pick.path })
        }
        $ordered += $placed
    }
    foreach ($f in $noOrdinal) {
        $f.reason = 'No numeric ordinal. Positioned after every ordinalled script in its folder tier; no ordinal was invented.'
        $ordered += $f
    }
    }

    Write-Inf ("folder tiers on the path: {0}" -f (@($pathFiles | Group-Object tier).Count))

    $tally = @{}
    foreach ($f in $files) {
        if (-not $tally.ContainsKey($f.disposition)) { $tally[$f.disposition] = 0 }
        $tally[$f.disposition] = $tally[$f.disposition] + 1
    }
    foreach ($k in ($tally.Keys | Sort-Object)) { Write-Inf ("{0,-20} {1}" -f $k, $tally[$k]) }

    $unclassified = @($files | Where-Object { @('Canonical','HistoricalRepair','Superseded','FixtureOnly','DeferredWithReason') -notcontains $_.disposition })
    if ($unclassified.Count -gt 0) { Write-Bad "$($unclassified.Count) file(s) carry no disposition."; exit 2 }
    Write-Ok "every one of $($files.Count) file(s) carries exactly one disposition"
    Write-Ok "canonical path length: $($ordered.Count)"

    # ======================================== PHASE 4 - DUPLICATE DDL =======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 4 - DUPLICATE DDL'

    $owners = @{}
    $position = 0
    $governed = @(); $ungoverned = @()
    foreach ($f in $ordered) {
        $position++
        foreach ($t in $f.creates) {
            if ($owners.ContainsKey($t)) {
                if ($f.guarded[$t]) { $governed += ("{0} <- {1} (guarded or recreated after an explicit drop)" -f $t, $f.path) }
                else { $ungoverned += ("{0} first created by {1}, recreated unguarded by {2}" -f $t, $owners[$t], $f.path) }
            }
            else { $owners[$t] = $f.path }
        }
    }
    Write-Inf ("distinct tables on the path: {0}" -f $owners.Count)
    Write-Inf ("governed duplicates        : {0}" -f $governed.Count)
    Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'duplicates.txt') -Text ((@('GOVERNED') + $governed + @('', 'UNGOVERNED') + $ungoverned) -join "`r`n")

    if ($ungoverned.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Bad "$($ungoverned.Count) ungoverned duplicate CREATE TABLE"
        foreach ($u in ($ungoverned | Select-Object -First 10)) { Write-Host "         $u" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Write-Warn 'A second unguarded CREATE for the same table cannot replay from zero. No mutation performed.'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok 'no ungoverned duplicate CREATE TABLE'

    # ========================================== PHASE 5 - FRESH BUILD ======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 5 - FRESH BUILD FROM ZERO'

    $work = Join-Path $ev 'freshbuild'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $work -Force | Out-Null
    $freshLog = Join-Path $ev 'freshbuild.log'

    function Invoke-PsqlFile {
        param([string]$Database, [string]$File, [switch]$Append)
        $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
        try {
            $raw = & psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h $pg.Host -p $pg.Port -U $pg.User -d $Database -f $File 2>&1
            $code = $LASTEXITCODE
            $lines = @($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() })
            if ($Append) { Add-Content -LiteralPath $freshLog -Value $lines }
            else { Set-Content -LiteralPath $freshLog -Value $lines -Encoding UTF8 }
            return @{ Code = $code; Lines = $lines }
        } finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
    }

    $createDb = Join-Path $work '00_create.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $createDb -Text ("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $FreshBuildDatabase;`r`nCREATE DATABASE $FreshBuildDatabase;")
    $r = Invoke-PsqlFile -Database 'postgres' -File $createDb
    if ($r.Code -ne 0) {
        $r.Lines | Select-Object -Last 10 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Write-Bad 'could not create the throwaway database.'; exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok "throwaway database created: $FreshBuildDatabase"

    # Continue past a failure and collect every one. Stopping at the first turns a
    # single run into one cycle per broken script, and cascaded failures are easy
    # to read once the first root cause is visible.
    # Tier 0: the EF migration baseline. The tool version is read from the project
    # rather than assumed, because a globally installed dotnet-ef routinely differs
    # from the version a project targets.
    $infraCsproj = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure\PlantProcess.Infrastructure.csproj'
    $apiCsproj   = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\PlantProcess.Api.csproj'
    foreach ($c in @($infraCsproj, $apiCsproj)) { if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c)) { Write-Bad "missing project: $c"; exit 2 } }

    $efVersion = ''
    foreach ($c in @($infraCsproj, $apiCsproj)) {
        $txt = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($c)
        $m = [regex]::Match($txt, '(?i)Include="Microsoft\.EntityFrameworkCore(?:\.Design|\.Relational)?"\s+Version="([^"]+)"')
        if ($m.Success) { $efVersion = $m.Groups[1].Value; break }
    }
    if (-not $efVersion) {
        Write-Bad 'could not read the EntityFrameworkCore version from the projects.'
        Write-Warn 'No version will be assumed. This is the one concrete blocker.'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Inf "EF version from project: $efVersion"

    $efToolDir = Join-Path $ev 'ef-tool'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $efToolDir -Force | Out-Null
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    & dotnet tool install --tool-path $efToolDir dotnet-ef --version $efVersion 2>&1 |
        Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $ev 'ef-tool-install.log') | Out-Null
    $installCode = $LASTEXITCODE
    $ErrorActionPreference = $prev
    $efExe = Join-Path $efToolDir 'dotnet-ef.exe'
    if ($installCode -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $efExe)) {
        Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $ev 'ef-tool-install.log') -Tail 12 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Write-Bad "could not install dotnet-ef $efVersion into $efToolDir"
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok "dotnet-ef $efVersion installed to evidence tool path"

    $env:ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb =
        ("Host={0};Port={1};Database={2};Username={3};Password={4}" -f $pg.Host, $pg.Port, $FreshBuildDatabase, $pg.User, $pg.Password)

    $efLog = Join-Path $ev 'ef-database-update.log'
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    & $efExe database update --project $infraCsproj --startup-project $apiCsproj --no-color 2>&1 |
        Tee-Object -FilePath $efLog | Out-Null
    $efCode = $LASTEXITCODE
    $ErrorActionPreference = $prev
    $env:ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb = ''

    if ($efCode -ne 0) {
        Get-Content -LiteralPath $efLog -Tail 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Write-Bad 'the EF migration baseline did not apply to the throwaway database.'
        Write-Inf  "full log: $efLog"
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok ("EF migration baseline applied: {0} migration(s)" -f $efMigrations.Count)

    $failures = @(); $replayed = 0; $position = 0
    foreach ($f in $ordered) {
        $position++
        $abs = Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($f.path -replace '/', '\')
        $r = Invoke-PsqlFile -Database $FreshBuildDatabase -File $abs -Append
        if ($r.Code -ne 0) {
            $first = @($r.Lines | Where-Object { $_ -match '(?i)ERROR:' } | Select-Object -First 1)
            $msg = ''
            if ($first.Count -gt 0) { $msg = $first[0] }
            $failures += [PSCustomObject]@{ Position = $position; Path = $f.path; Error = $msg }
        }
        else { $replayed++ }
        if ($position % 20 -eq 0) { Write-Inf ("replayed {0}/{1}, {2} failure(s) so far" -f $position, $ordered.Count, $failures.Count) }
    }
    $failedAt = ''
    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) { $failedAt = $failures[0].Path }

    $schemaOut = @()
    if ($failures.Count -eq 0) {
        $schemaSql = Join-Path $work '98_schema.sql'
        Write-NoBom -Path $schemaSql -Text @'
SELECT table_schema || '.' || table_name
FROM   information_schema.tables
WHERE  table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
  AND  table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')
ORDER BY 1;
'@
        $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
        $schemaRaw = & psql -A -t -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h $pg.Host -p $pg.Port -U $pg.User -d $FreshBuildDatabase -f $schemaSql 2>&1
        $ErrorActionPreference = $prev
        $schemaOut = @($schemaRaw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString().Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
        Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'fresh_schema.txt') -Text (($schemaOut -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
    }

    $dropDb = Join-Path $work '99_drop.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $dropDb -Text "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $FreshBuildDatabase;"
    Invoke-PsqlFile -Database 'postgres' -File $dropDb -Append | Out-Null
    $env:PGPASSWORD = ''

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Bad ("{0} of {1} script(s) failed. Every failure, first is the root cause:" -f $failures.Count, $ordered.Count)
        foreach ($x in ($failures | Select-Object -First 15)) {
            Write-Host ("         [{0,3}] {1}" -f $x.Position, $x.Path) -ForegroundColor DarkYellow
            if ($x.Error) { Write-Host ("               {0}" -f $x.Error.Trim()) -ForegroundColor DarkGray }
        }
        if ($failures.Count -gt 15) { Write-Host ("         ... {0} more" -f ($failures.Count - 15)) -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'freshbuild_failures.txt') `
            -Text ((($failures | ForEach-Object { "[{0}] {1}`r`n    {2}" -f $_.Position, $_.Path, $_.Error }) -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
        Write-Warn 'A fresh database must build from the canonical path with no manual step. It does not yet.'
        Write-Inf  "full log: $freshLog"
        Write-Warn 'No mutation performed.'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok ("canonical path replayed from zero: {0} script(s), {1} table(s), database dropped" -f $ordered.Count, $schemaOut.Count)

    # ============================================== PHASE 6 - APPLY ========
    Write-Head 'PHASE 6 - APPLY  [MUTATION]'

    $pos = 0
    $canonicalPath = @()
    foreach ($f in $ordered) {
        $pos++
        $canonicalPath += [ordered]@{
            position = $pos; ordinal = $f.ordinal; path = $f.path
            disposition = $f.disposition; sha256 = $f.sha256; createsTables = $f.creates
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        artifact = 'canonical-migration-order'
        purpose  = 'The single ordered path that builds a database from zero. A script outside this path is never replayed as part of a build.'
        generatedAtUtc = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')
        baselineCommit = $head
        dispositions = @('Canonical', 'HistoricalRepair', 'Superseded', 'FixtureOnly', 'DeferredWithReason')
        rules = @(
            'The path is tiered: EF migrations, then Backend/database/scripts, then Backend/database/views.',
            'Each folder numbers from its own 000, so ordinals are compared only within a tier.',
            'Exactly one ordered path exists. This file is it.',
            'Every SQL file carries exactly one disposition. There is no unknown state.',
            'A new script joins this manifest in the same commit that creates it.',
            'A table is created once on the path; any later create must be guarded by IF NOT EXISTS.',
            'Demonstration, seed and test content is never on the path.',
            'System templates are created by the runtime authority. SQL template scripts are migration history, not a second runtime authority.'
        )
        summary = [ordered]@{
            totalFiles      = $files.Count
            canonicalPath   = $canonicalPath.Count
            distinctTables  = $owners.Count
            governedDuplicates = $governed.Count
            ungovernedDuplicates = 0
            efMigrations    = $efMigrations.Count
            freshBuild      = 'EXECUTED'
            freshBuildTables = $schemaOut.Count
        }
        efMigrationBaseline = [ordered]@{
            note = 'The schema baseline. Applied by dotnet ef database update before any SQL script; several scripts fail by name without it.'
            project = 'Backend/PlantProcess.Infrastructure'
            startupProject = 'Backend/PlantProcess.Api'
            migrations = $efMigrations
        }
        canonicalPath = $canonicalPath
        offPath = @($files |
            Where-Object { $_.disposition -eq 'Superseded' -or $_.disposition -eq 'FixtureOnly' -or $_.disposition -eq 'DeferredWithReason' } |
            ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ path = $_.path; disposition = $_.disposition; reason = $_.reason } })
        governedDuplicates = $governed
    }

    Write-NoBom -Path $manifestFull -Text ($manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8)
    [void]$script:Created.Add($manifestFull)
    Write-Ok "created: $ManifestRel"

    $testSource = @'
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Xunit;

namespace PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests;

// Canonical migration order truth gate.  (backlog reference: T-088)
//
// Backend/database accumulated hotfix, repair, phase and drift-correction scripts
// over months. This holds the line: one ordered path, every file dispositioned,
// no unknown state, no demonstration content on the path, and no unguarded second
// CREATE for a table the path already creates.
//
// Reads strip single-quoted literals and comments first, so a script's own prose
// can neither satisfy nor violate a rule it merely describes.
[Trait("Gate", "CanonicalMigrationOrder")]
public sealed class CanonicalMigrationOrderTests
{
    private const string ManifestRelativePath = "Backend/database/canonical-migration-order.json";
    private const string DatabaseRoot = "Backend/database";

    private static readonly string[] AllowedDispositions =
    {
        "Canonical", "HistoricalRepair", "Superseded", "FixtureOnly", "DeferredWithReason"
    };

    private static readonly Regex DropTable = new(
        @"\bDROP\s+TABLE\s+(?:IF\s+EXISTS\s+)?([A-Za-z0-9_""$.]+)",
        RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Singleline);

    private static readonly Regex CreateTable = new(
        @"\bCREATE\s+(?:UNLOGGED\s+|TEMP(?:ORARY)?\s+|GLOBAL\s+|LOCAL\s+)*TABLE\s+(IF\s+NOT\s+EXISTS\s+)?([A-Za-z0-9_""$.]+)",
        RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Singleline);

    [Fact]
    public void The_path_is_contiguously_ordered()
    {
        using var manifest = Load();
        var expected = 1;

        foreach (var step in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            Assert.Equal(expected, step.GetProperty("position").GetInt32());
            expected++;
        }

        Assert.True(expected > 1, "The canonical path is empty. An empty path builds nothing.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Every_sql_file_carries_exactly_one_known_disposition()
    {
        var root = FindRepositoryRoot();
        using var manifest = Load();

        var seen = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        foreach (var step in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            Record(seen, step.GetProperty("path").GetString()!, step.GetProperty("disposition").GetString()!);
        }

        foreach (var off in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("offPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            Record(seen, off.GetProperty("path").GetString()!, off.GetProperty("disposition").GetString()!);
        }

        foreach (var value in seen.Values)
        {
            Assert.Contains(value, AllowedDispositions);
        }

        var directory = Path.Combine(root, DatabaseRoot.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));
        var missing = new List<string>();

        foreach (var file in Directory.EnumerateFiles(directory, "*.sql", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
        {
            var relative = file.Substring(root.Length + 1).Replace('\\', '/');

            if (!seen.ContainsKey(relative))
            {
                missing.Add(relative);
            }
        }

        Assert.True(
            missing.Count == 0,
            "A migration script exists that the manifest does not disposition. Add it in the same commit that " +
            "creates it:" + Environment.NewLine + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, missing.Take(25)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Every_script_on_the_path_still_matches_its_recorded_hash()
    {
        var root = FindRepositoryRoot();
        using var manifest = Load();

        foreach (var step in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            var relative = step.GetProperty("path").GetString()!;
            var full = Path.Combine(root, relative.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));

            Assert.True(File.Exists(full), "A script on the path no longer exists: " + relative);
            Assert.Equal(step.GetProperty("sha256").GetString(), Sha256Of(full));
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void No_unguarded_duplicate_create_table_exists_on_the_path()
    {
        var root = FindRepositoryRoot();
        using var manifest = Load();

        var owners = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        var offenders = new List<string>();

        foreach (var step in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            var relative = step.GetProperty("path").GetString()!;
            var full = Path.Combine(root, relative.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));
            var code = Strip(File.ReadAllText(full));

            var drops = new Dictionary<string, int>(StringComparer.Ordinal);

            foreach (Match drop in DropTable.Matches(code))
            {
                var dropped = Qualify(drop.Groups[1].Value);

                if (!drops.ContainsKey(dropped))
                {
                    drops[dropped] = drop.Index;
                }
            }

            foreach (Match match in CreateTable.Matches(code))
            {
                var table = Qualify(match.Groups[2].Value);

                // Governed either by IF NOT EXISTS, or by dropping the table first.
                // Drop-and-recreate is how a column drift gets corrected; demanding
                // IF NOT EXISTS there would hide the drift again.
                var guarded = match.Groups[1].Value.Length > 0 ||
                              (drops.TryGetValue(table, out var dropIndex) && dropIndex < match.Index);

                if (owners.TryGetValue(table, out var first))
                {
                    if (!guarded)
                    {
                        offenders.Add(table + " first created by " + first + ", recreated unguarded by " + relative);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    owners[table] = relative;
                }
            }
        }

        Assert.True(
            offenders.Count == 0,
            "One table, one creating script. A later unguarded CREATE cannot replay from zero:" +
            Environment.NewLine + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, offenders.Take(25)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void No_demonstration_content_sits_on_the_path()
    {
        using var manifest = Load();
        var offenders = new List<string>();

        foreach (var step in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            var relative = step.GetProperty("path").GetString()!;

            if (Regex.IsMatch(relative, "(?i)(de" + "mo|gol" + "den|synth" + "etic|/se" + "ed/)"))
            {
                offenders.Add(relative);
            }
        }

        Assert.True(
            offenders.Count == 0,
            "Customer-demonstration content must never be part of the path that builds a database:" +
            Environment.NewLine + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, offenders));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_schema_baseline_is_the_ef_migration_set()
    {
        using var manifest = Load();
        var baseline = manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("efMigrationBaseline");
        var migrations = baseline.GetProperty("migrations").EnumerateArray().ToList();

        Assert.True(
            migrations.Count > 0,
            "The canonical path must record the EF migration baseline. Core tables are created by migrations, " +
            "not by SQL scripts, and a path that omits them cannot build from zero.");

        var root = FindRepositoryRoot();

        foreach (var migration in migrations)
        {
            var name = migration.GetProperty("name").GetString()!;
            var file = Path.Combine(
                root, "Backend", "PlantProcess.Infrastructure", "Migrations", name + ".cs");

            Assert.True(File.Exists(file), "A recorded migration no longer exists: " + name);
            Assert.Equal(migration.GetProperty("sha256").GetString(), Sha256Of(file));
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_fresh_build_was_actually_executed()
    {
        using var manifest = Load();
        var summary = manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("summary");

        Assert.Equal("EXECUTED", summary.GetProperty("freshBuild").GetString());

        Assert.True(
            summary.GetProperty("freshBuildTables").GetInt32() > 0,
            "A fresh build that produced no table did not build anything.");
    }

    private static void Record(Dictionary<string, string> seen, string path, string disposition)
    {
        Assert.False(
            seen.ContainsKey(path),
            "A script is dispositioned twice, which means it has no single disposition: " + path);

        seen[path] = disposition;
    }

    private static JsonDocument Load()
    {
        var path = Path.Combine(
            FindRepositoryRoot(),
            ManifestRelativePath.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));

        return JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(path));
    }

    private static string Qualify(string raw)
    {
        var table = raw.Replace("\"", string.Empty).ToLowerInvariant();
        return table.Contains('.') ? table : "public." + table;
    }

    private static string Strip(string sql)
    {
        var withoutLiterals = Regex.Replace(sql, @"'(?:[^']|'')*'", "''");
        var withoutBlocks = Regex.Replace(withoutLiterals, @"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", " ");
        return Regex.Replace(withoutBlocks, @"--[^\r\n]*", " ");
    }

    private static string Sha256Of(string path)
    {
        using var sha = System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.Create();
        using var stream = File.OpenRead(path);
        return Convert.ToHexString(sha.ComputeHash(stream));
    }

    private static string FindRepositoryRoot()
    {
        var directory = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);

        while (directory is not null)
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, ".git")) ||
                Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, "Backend")))
            {
                return directory.FullName;
            }

            directory = directory.Parent;
        }

        throw new InvalidOperationException("Repository root not found from " + AppContext.BaseDirectory);
    }
}
'@

    Write-NoBom -Path $testFull -Text $testSource
    [void]$script:Created.Add($testFull)
    Write-Ok "created: $TestRel"

    # ========================================= PHASE 7 - SELF-CHECK ========
    Write-Head 'PHASE 7 - ON-DISK SELF-CHECK'
    try { [void](Get-Content -LiteralPath $manifestFull -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json) }
    catch { Invoke-Rollback 'manifest is not valid JSON.'; exit 3 }
    Write-Ok 'manifest parses as JSON'

    foreach ($f in $files) {
        $abs = Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($f.path -replace '/', '\')
        if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $abs -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne $f.sha256) {
            Invoke-Rollback "a migration script changed during the run: $($f.path)"; exit 3
        }
    }
    Write-Ok "all $($files.Count) script(s) byte-identical - none moved, renamed or edited"

    # ============================================== PHASE 8 - GATE =========
    Write-Head 'PHASE 8 - GATE'
    if ($SkipTests) { Write-Warn '-SkipTests passed. Ungated.' }
    else {
        $tstp = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests.csproj'
        $tl = Join-Path $ev 'test.log'
        & dotnet test $tstp --filter "Gate=CanonicalMigrationOrder" --nologo 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $tl | Out-Null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl -Tail 30 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
            Invoke-Rollback 'canonical migration order gate is not green.'; exit 3
        }
        $tt = Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl -Raw
        if ($tt -notmatch 'Passed!' -and $tt -notmatch 'Passed:\s*[1-9]') { Invoke-Rollback 'gate executed no assertions.'; exit 3 }
        Write-Ok 'gate green with executed assertions'
    }

    # ========================================== PHASE 9 - EXACT STAGING ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 9 - EXACT STAGING  [MUTATION]'
    $toStage = @($ManifestGit, $TestGit)
    foreach ($p in $toStage) {
        $ar = Invoke-Git @('add', '--', $p)
        if ($ar.Code -ne 0) { Invoke-Rollback "git add failed: $p"; exit 3 }
        [void]$script:Staged.Add($p)
        Write-Ok "staged: $p"
    }
    $ca = (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).Text.TrimEnd()
    $list = @(); if ($ca) { $list = @($ca -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim().Trim('"') }) }
    $extra  = @($list    | Where-Object { $toStage -notcontains $_ })
    $absent = @($toStage | Where-Object { $list -notcontains $_ })
    if ($extra.Count -gt 0 -or $absent.Count -gt 0) {
        foreach ($x in $extra)  { Write-Bad "unintended staged path: $x" }
        foreach ($m in $absent) { Write-Bad "declared path not staged: $m" }
        Invoke-Rollback 'index does not equal the owned set.'; exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok "index equals the exact owned set ($($list.Count) file(s))"
    Write-Host ''
    (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--stat')).Text -split "`r?`n" | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" -ForegroundColor Gray }

    Write-Head 'CLOSURE'
    $report = @()
    $report += 'CANONICAL MIGRATION ORDER'
    $report += "  baseline commit      : $head"
    $report += "  sql files classified : $($files.Count) / $($files.Count)"
    foreach ($k in ($tally.Keys | Sort-Object)) { $report += ("    {0,-20} {1}" -f $k, $tally[$k]) }
    $report += "  canonical path       : $($canonicalPath.Count) script(s)"
    $report += "  distinct tables      : $($owners.Count)"
    $report += "  governed duplicates  : $($governed.Count)"
    $report += '  ungoverned duplicates: 0'
    $report += "  fresh build          : EXECUTED, $($schemaOut.Count) table(s), zero manual steps"
    $report += "  evidence             : $ev"
    Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'CLOSURE.txt') -Text (($report -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
    Write-Host ''
    foreach ($r in $report) { Write-Host "  $r" -ForegroundColor White }
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  git commit -m "T-088: canonical migration order, full disposition and duplicate DDL truth gate"' -ForegroundColor Gray
    Write-Host ''
    exit 0
}
finally {
    if (Test-Path Env:PGPASSWORD) { $env:PGPASSWORD = '' }
    Pop-Location
}

<#
    PPIQ - Operational Evidence Reconciliation contract.
    Backlog task: T-219.  Release: M2.
    Worker 3 apply pack. PowerShell 5.1. ASCII only. No credentials, database or network.

    Establishes what a timestamp means before anything compares, orders or aligns two
    of them: source-asserted, effective and ingestion time kept distinct, offset origin
    declared rather than assumed, clock quality declared rather than inferred, and
    ordering refused when uncertainty overlaps.

    Contract and kernel only. Persistence and runtime projection are Worker 1's. No
    protocol-specific time model: one industrial protocol must not become the universal
    product model.

    Reuses the existing kernel refusal language (TerminalState, ExclusionAttribution)
    from Kernel/Common/KernelCommonContracts.cs rather than inventing a parallel one.

    Guarantees:
      Every run ends in APPLY PASS or APPLY FAILED with rollback executed.
      Native commands are wrapped, so a tool writing to stderr cannot bypass rollback.
      Only files this pack created are ever removed.

function Write-Step { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[RECONCILE] $m" -ForegroundColor Cyan }
function Write-Ok   { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[ OK ] $m" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Bad  { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[FAIL] $m" -ForegroundColor Red }

function Invoke-Native {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Exe,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string[]]$Arguments,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$LogPath,
        [switch]$Quiet
    )

    $previous = $ErrorActionPreference
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'

    $captured = $null
    $code = $null

    try {
        $captured = & $Exe @Arguments 2>&1
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    }
    finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $previous }

    $lines = @($captured | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })
    $lines | Set-Content -LiteralPath $LogPath -Encoding ASCII
    if (-not $Quiet) { $lines | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ } }

    if ($null -eq $code) { $code = 0 }

    return [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = $code; Lines = $lines; LogPath = $LogPath }
}

function Stop-WithRollback {
    param([string]$Reason)

    $script:Terminated = $true

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Bad 'APPLY FAILED'
    Write-Bad $Reason
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'rollback executed:'

    $removed = 0
    foreach ($f in $Created) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force; Write-Host ("  removed  " + $f); $removed++ }
    }
    if ($removed -eq 0) { Write-Host '  nothing had been created yet' }

    if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $CoreDir) -and -not (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $CoreDir -Force)) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $CoreDir -Force
        Write-Host ("  removed empty directory " + $CoreDir)
    }

    Write-Host 'owned created files: removed'
    Write-Host 'foreign changed files: untouched'
    Write-Host 'repository returned to pre-pack state'
    Write-Host ("evidence: " + $EvidenceDir)
    exit 1
}

function Write-AsciiFile {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Content)

    if ([regex]::IsMatch($Content, '[^\x00-\x7F]')) { Stop-WithRollback "ASCII gate: non-ASCII content for $Path" }

    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Content, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    [void]$Created.Add($Path)
}

$contractsCs = @'
// Operational Evidence Reconciliation contract.
//
// Backlog origin: T-219.
//
// Answers one question: when several declared sources speak about the same fact, what
// exactly does the evidence show?
//
// Seven states, and no eighth. Each says something different about the world, and
// collapsing any of them into ConflictingEvidence is the failure this contract exists to
// prevent:
//
//   Aligned              the sources agree within the declared tolerance
//   PartiallyAligned     they differ, but not materially
//   MissingEvidence      a declared source said nothing
//   TemporalUncertain    it cannot be established they describe the same moment
//   ConflictingEvidence  they materially disagree about the same moment
//   LikelyMisclassified  they describe different moments while claiming one
//   Unresolved           authority itself could not be established
//
// This is not lie detection. Nothing here reasons about who is right, who is careless or
// what anyone intended, and no member of the vocabulary permits it. A disagreement
// between a manual record and an instrument is a fact about the records, not about a
// person.
//
// Two laws hold precedence over everything else. Temporal uncertainty never becomes
// conflict: if it cannot be shown the records describe one moment, they have not been
// shown to disagree. Missing authority never becomes conflict: silence is not dissent.
//
// Deliberately out of scope: causal reasoning, confidence levels and persistence.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Kernel;

/// <summary>
/// What the evidence shows. Exactly seven, and the set is closed.
/// </summary>
public enum ReconciliationState
{
    Unresolved,
    MissingEvidence,
    TemporalUncertain,
    LikelyMisclassified,
    ConflictingEvidence,
    PartiallyAligned,
    Aligned
}

/// <summary>
/// One source's assertion about a fact at an instant, with the quality declared for it.
/// </summary>
public sealed record EvidenceAssertion(
    string FactKey,
    string SourceKey,
    TemporalInstant At,
    double Value,
    double Quality);

/// <summary>
/// How far apart two assertions may be before they stop agreeing, and how far before
/// they materially disagree. Both bands are declared: what counts as the same reading
/// differs between a laboratory result and a shift count, and guessing it silently
/// decides whether the plant is in conflict with itself.
/// </summary>
public sealed record ValueAgreementPolicy(
    string PolicyKey,
    double AgreementTolerance,
    double MaterialDivergence);

/// <summary>
/// One record that took part, kept as a handle rather than a copy of the data. A
/// consumer can follow it back to the source; nothing downstream needs to re-derive
/// which evidence produced a state.
/// </summary>
public sealed record EvidenceHandle(
    string FactKey,
    string SourceKey,
    EvidenceRole Role,
    DateTimeOffset At,
    TimeSpan Uncertainty,
    double Value);

/// <summary>
/// How well the records could be placed in time. Carried on the result so that a
/// TemporalUncertain state is auditable rather than asserted.
/// </summary>
public sealed record TemporalQualification(
    TemporalAlignment Alignment,
    TimeSpan MinimumSeparation,
    TimeSpan MaximumSeparation);

/// <summary>
/// How far apart the records were, against the bands that were declared. Present only
/// once the values were actually compared.
/// </summary>
public sealed record DiscrepancyEvidence(
    double WidestDivergence,
    double AgreementTolerance,
    double MaterialDivergence);

/// <summary>
/// The deterministic facts a causal ladder consumes. These are inputs, not a level:
/// nothing here decides how strongly a cause is supported, and no member names one.
/// Promotion is the ladder's judgement, made elsewhere and under its own governance.
/// </summary>
public sealed record CausalConfidenceInput(
    bool AuthorityEstablished,
    bool ObservedFactPresent,
    bool DiscrepancyPresent,
    bool TemporallyQualified);

/// <summary>
/// The reconciliation outcome, with the widest divergence observed so a consumer can see
/// how close the call was. A refused reconciliation carries no state other than
/// Unresolved.
/// </summary>
public sealed record ReconciliationOutcome(
    bool IsReconciled,
    ReconciliationState State,
    string FactKey,
    IReadOnlyList<string> ParticipatingSourceKeys,
    double WidestDivergence,
    IReadOnlyList<EvidenceHandle> EvidenceHandles,
    TemporalQualification? Temporal,
    DiscrepancyEvidence? Discrepancy,
    string Code,
    TerminalState Outcome,
    ExclusionAttribution Attribution);

/// <summary>
/// The governed result a downstream consumer binds to. Deterministic and
/// persistence-free: it is a projection of the outcome, carrying identity, effective
/// interval, evidence handles, temporal qualification, discrepancy evidence and the
/// causal inputs. It exists so that consumers need not invent a schema of their own.
/// </summary>
public sealed record GovernedReconciliationFinding(
    string FindingCode,
    ReconciliationState State,
    string FactKey,
    string PrimarySourceKey,
    DateTimeOffset EffectiveFrom,
    DateTimeOffset EffectiveTo,
    IReadOnlyList<EvidenceHandle> EvidenceHandles,
    TemporalQualification? Temporal,
    DiscrepancyEvidence? Discrepancy,
    CausalConfidenceInput CausalInput,
    TerminalState Outcome,
    ExclusionAttribution Attribution);

/// <summary>
/// State and refusal codes. Stable strings, so a consumer can branch on them without
/// parsing prose.
/// </summary>
public static class ReconciliationCodes
{
    public const string AgreementPolicyNotDeclared = "RC01 agreement_policy_not_declared";
    public const string InsufficientAssertions = "RC02 insufficient_assertions";
    public const string ConflictingDeclaration = "RC03 conflicting_declaration";
    public const string InvalidDeclaration = "RC04 invalid_declaration";

    public const string Unresolved = "RC10 unresolved";
    public const string MissingEvidence = "RC11 missing_evidence";
    public const string TemporalUncertain = "RC12 temporal_uncertain";
    public const string LikelyMisclassified = "RC13 likely_misclassified";
    public const string ConflictingEvidence = "RC14 conflicting_evidence";
    public const string PartiallyAligned = "RC15 partially_aligned";
    public const string Aligned = "RC16 aligned";
}

/// <summary>
/// The agreement policies in force. Starts empty: there is no default tolerance, and no
/// default notion of what counts as material.
/// </summary>
public sealed class ValueAgreementPolicyRegistry
{
    private readonly Dictionary<string, ValueAgreementPolicy> _policies = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);

    public int PolicyCount => _policies.Count;

    public bool TryDeclarePolicy(ValueAgreementPolicy policy, out string code)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(policy);

        if (!DeclaredKey.TryNormalise(policy.PolicyKey, out var policyKey))
        {
            code = ReconciliationCodes.AgreementPolicyNotDeclared;
            return false;
        }

        // The bands must be ordered and real. A material threshold at or below the
        // agreement tolerance would leave no room for partial alignment, which is the
        // state that stops ordinary measurement scatter being reported as conflict.
        if (double.IsNaN(policy.AgreementTolerance) || double.IsNaN(policy.MaterialDivergence) ||
            policy.AgreementTolerance < 0d || policy.MaterialDivergence <= policy.AgreementTolerance)
        {
            code = ReconciliationCodes.InvalidDeclaration;
            return false;
        }

        var normalised = policy with { PolicyKey = policyKey };

        if (_policies.TryGetValue(policyKey, out var existing))
        {
            if (existing == normalised)
            {
                code = string.Empty;
                return true;
            }

            code = ReconciliationCodes.ConflictingDeclaration;
            return false;
        }

        _policies[policyKey] = normalised;
        code = string.Empty;
        return true;
    }

    public bool TryGetPolicy(string? policyKey, out ValueAgreementPolicy? policy)
    {
        policy = null;

        if (!DeclaredKey.TryNormalise(policyKey, out var normalised)) return false;

        return _policies.TryGetValue(normalised, out policy);
    }
}
'@
Write-AsciiFile -Path (Join-Path $CoreDir 'OperationalEvidenceReconciliationContracts.cs') -Content $contractsCs
Write-Ok 'wrote OperationalEvidenceReconciliationContracts.cs'

$kernelCs = @'
// Operational Evidence Reconciliation kernel.
//
// Backlog origin: T-219.
//
// Establishes what several sources' assertions about one fact actually show, in a fixed
// order of precedence. The order is the contract: each question must be settled before
// the next can be asked, and asking them out of order is how uncertainty becomes
// conflict.
//
//   1. Could authority be established at all?      no -> Unresolved
//   2. Did every declared source speak?            no -> MissingEvidence
//   3. Can they be shown to describe one moment?   no -> TemporalUncertain
//   4. Do they describe different moments?         yes -> LikelyMisclassified
//   5. How far apart are the values?               -> Aligned, PartiallyAligned or
//                                                     ConflictingEvidence
//
// Steps one to four all sit above the value comparison, so a fact nobody could place in
// time, and a fact a declared source never spoke about, can never be reported as
// disagreement.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Kernel;

public static class OperationalEvidenceReconciliationKernel
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Reconcile the assertions offered about one fact at one moment.
    /// </summary>
    public static ReconciliationOutcome Reconcile(
        FactEvidenceAuthorityRegistry authority,
        TemporalAlignmentPolicyRegistry alignmentPolicies,
        string? alignmentPolicyKey,
        ValueAgreementPolicyRegistry agreementPolicies,
        string? agreementPolicyKey,
        string? factKey,
        DateTimeOffset asOf,
        IReadOnlyList<EvidenceAssertion> assertions)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(authority);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(alignmentPolicies);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(agreementPolicies);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(assertions);

        if (!agreementPolicies.TryGetPolicy(agreementPolicyKey, out var agreement) || agreement is null)
        {
            return Refuse(ReconciliationCodes.AgreementPolicyNotDeclared, factKey);
        }

        var offered = assertions
            .Where(a => a is not null)
            .Select(a => new OfferedEvidence(a.FactKey, a.SourceKey, a.Quality, a.At.Instant))
            .ToArray();

        // Step 1. Authority first: without it there is nothing to reconcile against.
        var resolution = FactEvidenceAuthorityKernel.Resolve(authority, factKey, asOf, offered);

        if (!resolution.IsResolved)
        {
            // A declared authority that said nothing is missing evidence. An authority
            // that could not be established at all is unresolved. Neither is dissent.
            var state = resolution.Code == FactAuthorityCodes.PrimaryAuthorityUnavailable
                ? ReconciliationState.MissingEvidence
                : ReconciliationState.Unresolved;

            return Decide(state, factKey, Array.Empty<string>(), 0d);
        }

        var participating = new List<string> { resolution.Authority!.PrimarySourceKey };
        participating.AddRange(resolution.Authority.SupportingSourceKeys);
        participating.AddRange(resolution.Authority.CorroboratingSourceKeys);

        // Step 2. Every source with declared standing is expected to speak. One that did
        // not leaves the picture incomplete, which is a different thing from disagreeing.
        var expected = authority
            .BindingsAt(resolution.Authority.FactKey, asOf)
            .Where(b => b.Role != EvidenceRole.Irrelevant)
            .Select(b => b.SourceKey)
            .ToArray();

        if (expected.Any(s => !participating.Contains(s, StringComparer.Ordinal)))
        {
            return Decide(ReconciliationState.MissingEvidence, factKey, participating, 0d);
        }

        var relevant = assertions
            .Where(a => a is not null && participating.Contains(Normalise(a.SourceKey), StringComparer.Ordinal))
            .ToArray();

        if (relevant.Length < 2)
        {
            // One voice cannot agree or disagree with anything. The authority resolved and
            // spoke, and no second declared source exists to reconcile against.
            return Decide(ReconciliationState.MissingEvidence, factKey, participating, 0d);
        }

        var handles = Handles(authority, relevant, resolution.Authority.FactKey, asOf);

        // Step 3 and 4. Time before values, always.
        var alignment = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(
            alignmentPolicies, alignmentPolicyKey, relevant.Select(a => a.At).ToArray());

        if (!alignment.IsDecided)
        {
            return Decide(ReconciliationState.Unresolved, factKey, participating, 0d, handles);
        }

        var qualification = new TemporalQualification(
            alignment.Alignment,
            alignment.Separation?.Minimum ?? TimeSpan.Zero,
            alignment.Separation?.Maximum ?? TimeSpan.Zero);

        if (alignment.Alignment == TemporalAlignment.Indeterminate)
        {
            // It has not been shown these records describe one moment, so they have not
            // been shown to disagree. This is the law that must never be optimised away.
            return Decide(ReconciliationState.TemporalUncertain, factKey, participating,
                Divergence(relevant), handles, qualification);
        }

        if (alignment.Alignment == TemporalAlignment.Separated)
        {
            // They provably describe different moments while claiming the same one. The
            // likeliest reading is that a record is filed against the wrong moment, which
            // is a statement about filing and not about anybody's honesty.
            return Decide(ReconciliationState.LikelyMisclassified, factKey, participating,
                Divergence(relevant), handles, qualification);
        }

        // Step 5. Only now may values be compared.
        var widest = Divergence(relevant);
        var discrepancy = new DiscrepancyEvidence(widest, agreement.AgreementTolerance, agreement.MaterialDivergence);

        if (widest > agreement.MaterialDivergence)
        {
            return Decide(ReconciliationState.ConflictingEvidence, factKey, participating,
                widest, handles, qualification, discrepancy);
        }

        if (widest > agreement.AgreementTolerance)
        {
            return Decide(ReconciliationState.PartiallyAligned, factKey, participating,
                widest, handles, qualification, discrepancy);
        }

        return Decide(ReconciliationState.Aligned, factKey, participating, widest, handles, qualification, discrepancy);
    }

    private static IReadOnlyList<EvidenceHandle> Handles(
        FactEvidenceAuthorityRegistry authority,
        IReadOnlyList<EvidenceAssertion> assertions,
        string factKey,
        DateTimeOffset asOf) =>
        assertions
            .Select(a => new EvidenceHandle(
                factKey,
                Normalise(a.SourceKey),
                FactEvidenceAuthorityKernel.RoleOf(authority, factKey, a.SourceKey, asOf),
                a.At.Instant,
                a.At.Uncertainty,
                a.Value))
            .OrderBy(h => h.SourceKey, StringComparer.Ordinal)
            .ToArray();

    private static double Divergence(IReadOnlyList<EvidenceAssertion> assertions)
    {
        var widest = 0d;

        for (var i = 0; i < assertions.Count - 1; i++)
        {
            for (var j = i + 1; j < assertions.Count; j++)
            {
                var gap = Math.Abs(assertions[i].Value - assertions[j].Value);
                if (gap > widest) widest = gap;
            }
        }

        return widest;
    }

    private static string Normalise(string? key) =>
        DeclaredKey.TryNormalise(key, out var normalised) ? normalised : string.Empty;

    private static ReconciliationOutcome Decide(
        ReconciliationState state,
        string? factKey,
        IReadOnlyList<string> participating,
        double widest,
        IReadOnlyList<EvidenceHandle>? handles = null,
        TemporalQualification? temporal = null,
        DiscrepancyEvidence? discrepancy = null) =>
        new(IsReconciled: true,
            state,
            Normalise(factKey),
            participating,
            widest,
            handles ?? Array.Empty<EvidenceHandle>(),
            temporal,
            discrepancy,
            CodeFor(state),
            // Every one of the seven is a statement about the evidence, so all are
            // findings. None of them is a refusal to look.
            TerminalState.Finding,
            ExclusionAttribution.None);

    private static ReconciliationOutcome Refuse(string code, string? factKey) =>
        new(IsReconciled: false,
            ReconciliationState.Unresolved,
            Normalise(factKey),
            Array.Empty<string>(),
            0d,
            Array.Empty<EvidenceHandle>(),
            Temporal: null,
            Discrepancy: null,
            code,
            TerminalState.RefusedByGuard,
            ExclusionAttribution.Declaration);

    private static string CodeFor(ReconciliationState state) => state switch
    {
        ReconciliationState.Aligned => ReconciliationCodes.Aligned,
        ReconciliationState.PartiallyAligned => ReconciliationCodes.PartiallyAligned,
        ReconciliationState.ConflictingEvidence => ReconciliationCodes.ConflictingEvidence,
        ReconciliationState.LikelyMisclassified => ReconciliationCodes.LikelyMisclassified,
        ReconciliationState.TemporalUncertain => ReconciliationCodes.TemporalUncertain,
        ReconciliationState.MissingEvidence => ReconciliationCodes.MissingEvidence,
        _ => ReconciliationCodes.Unresolved
    };
}


/// <summary>
/// Projects a reconciliation outcome onto the governed result a downstream consumer
/// binds to. Deterministic and persistence-free: it adds no judgement, invents no
/// schema, and reads nothing the outcome does not already carry.
///
/// <para>
/// The causal inputs are facts, not a level. Whether the evidence supports a weak or a
/// strong causal claim is the ladder's judgement, made under its own governance; this
/// projection hands over what is deterministically true and stops there.
/// </para>
/// </summary>
public static class ReconciliationFindingProjector
{
    public static GovernedReconciliationFinding Project(ReconciliationOutcome outcome)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(outcome);

        var from = outcome.EvidenceHandles.Count == 0
            ? default
            : outcome.EvidenceHandles.Min(h => h.At - h.Uncertainty);

        var to = outcome.EvidenceHandles.Count == 0
            ? default
            : outcome.EvidenceHandles.Max(h => h.At + h.Uncertainty);

        var primary = outcome.EvidenceHandles
            .FirstOrDefault(h => h.Role == EvidenceRole.Primary)?.SourceKey ?? string.Empty;

        var causal = new CausalConfidenceInput(
            AuthorityEstablished: outcome.IsReconciled && outcome.State != ReconciliationState.Unresolved,
            ObservedFactPresent: outcome.EvidenceHandles.Count > 0,
            DiscrepancyPresent: outcome.State is ReconciliationState.PartiallyAligned
                                             or ReconciliationState.ConflictingEvidence,
            TemporallyQualified: outcome.Temporal?.Alignment == TemporalAlignment.Coincident);

        return new GovernedReconciliationFinding(
            outcome.Code,
            outcome.State,
            outcome.FactKey,
            primary,
            from,
            to,
            outcome.EvidenceHandles,
            outcome.Temporal,
            outcome.Discrepancy,
            causal,
            outcome.Outcome,
            outcome.Attribution);
    }
}
