================================================================================
PPIQ APPLY PACK - Route Invariant Coverage Verdict
================================================================================
Backlog origin : T-203   Release: M2   Owner: Worker 2 (Release Truth)
Lock           : Release-truth E2E harness only. One file. No product source.

WHY A THIRD PACK EXISTS
  The two-pack budget is spent. This pack is raised under the standing clause
  "no extra diagnostics unless certification exposes an actual harness defect".
  It did, and the defect is a FALSE GREEN in the gate's own evidence file.

THE DEFECT, MEASURED
  Run 2: 27 of 39 tests failed. The evidence file said:
      routes observed = 0
      VERDICT         = PASS
  When a route visit throws inside login(), the test never reaches
  observations.push. afterAll then derives the verdict from an EMPTY array and
  concludes there are no failing routes. A gate whose evidence can say PASS
  while the run is red is worse than no gate.

THE FIX
  1. Coverage is part of the verdict. routesExpected must equal routesObserved
     or the verdict is FAIL with a named fatal reason. A partial inventory
     cannot produce a green.
  2. Every route records an entry, including one that could not be visited.
     A visit that throws is written as a visit-failed violation before the
     error is rethrown, so a dead API is attributed to named routes instead of
     vanishing from the evidence.

NOT DONE HERE
  Why the API exited mid-run is not yet known and is not guessed at. With this
  fix the next run attributes it to named routes in the evidence, which is the
  prerequisite for diagnosing it honestly.

Files touched (1, exact):
  Frontend/PlantProcess.Web/e2e/release-truth/customer-route-invariant.spec.ts

Modes: -Mode Verify | Apply | Revert
================================================================================
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot     = "C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ",
    [ValidateSet("Verify","Apply","Revert")]
    [string]$Mode         = "Verify",
    [string]$BackupRoot   = "C:\Workspace\_ppiq_pack_backups\route-invariant-coverage-verdict",
    [string]$BackupFolder = ""
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0

$script:Failures = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$script:Stamp    = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"

function Write-Step { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[STEP] $m" -ForegroundColor Cyan }
function Write-Ok   { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[ OK ] $m" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Bad  { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[FAIL] $m" -ForegroundColor Red; [void]$script:Failures.Add($m) }
function Write-Note { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[NOTE] $m" -ForegroundColor Yellow }

function Get-DominantEol { param([string]$Text)
    $crlf = ([regex]::Matches($Text, "`r`n")).Count
    $lf   = ([regex]::Matches($Text, "(?<!`r)`n")).Count
    if ($crlf -ge $lf) { return "CRLF" } else { return "LF" } }
function ConvertTo-Lf   { param([string]$Text) return $Text.Replace("`r`n","`n").Replace("`r","`n") }
function ConvertFrom-Lf { param([string]$Text,[string]$Eol) if ($Eol -eq "CRLF") { return $Text.Replace("`n","`r`n") } return $Text }
function Test-Bom { param([string]$Path)
    $b = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Path)
    if ($b.Length -lt 3) { return $false }
    return ($b[0] -eq 0xEF -and $b[1] -eq 0xBB -and $b[2] -eq 0xBF) }

$VerdictOld = @'
test.afterAll(() => {
  const failing = observations.filter((o) => o.violations.length > 0 || !o.settled);
'@

$VerdictNew = @'
test.afterAll(() => {
  const failing = observations.filter((o) => o.violations.length > 0 || !o.settled);

  // COVERAGE IS PART OF THE VERDICT.
  // A route whose visit threw before it could be observed leaves no entry. If the
  // verdict were derived only from the entries present, an aborted run would
  // report PASS on an empty array - which is what this gate produced on its
  // second execution: 27 tests failed and the evidence said PASS. Expected and
  // observed counts must agree before any green is written.
  const incomplete = observations.length !== gated.length;
'@

$WriteOld = @'
        verdict: failing.length === 0 ? "PASS" : "FAIL",
'@

$WriteNew = @'
        routesExpected: gated.length,
        routesObserved: observations.length,
        incompleteRun: incomplete,
        verdict: failing.length === 0 && !incomplete ? "PASS" : "FAIL",
        fatal: incomplete
          ? `incomplete run: ${observations.length} of ${gated.length} routes were observed. ` +
            "A verdict cannot be drawn from a partial inventory."
          : null,
'@

$VisitOld = @'
    await login(context.request);
    const guard = installRouteInvariantGuard(page, route.path);

    await page.goto(route.path, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
    const settled = await guard.settle();
    const observation = await guard.collect(settled);
    observations.push(observation);
'@

$VisitNew = @'
    // Every route records an entry, including one that could not be visited.
    // An unrecorded failure is indistinguishable from a route that was never
    // required, and that is how a partial run turns into a false green.
    let guard;
    try {
      await login(context.request);
      guard = installRouteInvariantGuard(page, route.path);
      await page.goto(route.path, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });
    } catch (error) {
      observations.push({
        route: route.path,
        settled: false,
        violations: [
          {
            kind: "visit-failed",
            detail: String(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error).slice(0, 300),
          },
        ],
        allowances: [],
        requestCount: 0,
        widgetStates: [],
      });
      throw error;
    }

    const settled = await guard.settle();
    const observation = await guard.collect(settled);
    observations.push(observation);
'@

foreach ($a in @(@{N="afterAll verdict";O=$VerdictOld}, @{N="manifest verdict field";O=$WriteOld}, @{N="route visit body";O=$VisitOld})) {

    if ($c -eq 1) { Write-Ok ("Anchor located once: " + $a.N) }

Copy-Item $SpecFile (Join-Path $ThisBackup "customer-route-invariant.spec.ts") -Force
Write-Ok "Backed up -> $ThisBackup"

if ($s.IndexOf("routesExpected") -lt 0)  { Write-Bad "routesExpected absent" }  else { Write-Ok "routesExpected recorded" }
if ($s.IndexOf("routesObserved") -lt 0)  { Write-Bad "routesObserved absent" }  else { Write-Ok "routesObserved recorded" }
if ($s.IndexOf("incompleteRun") -lt 0)   { Write-Bad "incompleteRun absent" }   else { Write-Ok "incompleteRun recorded" }
if ($s.IndexOf('kind: "visit-failed"') -lt 0) { Write-Bad "visit-failed recording absent" } else { Write-Ok "Unvisitable routes still record an entry" }

# The verdict must not be derivable from the entry list alone.
if ($s -match 'verdict:\s*failing\.length === 0\s*\?') { Write-Bad "Verdict still ignores coverage - a partial run could report PASS" }
elseif ($s.IndexOf("failing.length === 0 && !incomplete") -lt 0) { Write-Bad "Coverage is not part of the verdict expression" }
else { Write-Ok "Coverage is part of the verdict (partial run cannot report PASS)" }

if ((Get-DominantEol -Text ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($SpecFile))) -ne $Eol) { Write-Bad "Line endings changed - whole-file diff" }
else { Write-Ok "Line-ending convention unchanged" }

if ($script:Failures.Count -gt 0) { throw "Self-check failed." }

Write-Step "Gated checks"
Push-Location $Web
try {
    & npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 15 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "    $_" }
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Bad "tsc --noEmit failed" } else { Write-Ok "TypeScript compiles" }

    else {

        if ($joined -match "(?m)Total:\s*([1-9][0-9]*)\s*test") { Write-Ok ("Gate loads: " + $Matches[1] + " tests discovered") }

function Get-DominantEol { param([string]$Text)
    $crlf = ([regex]::Matches($Text, "`r`n")).Count
    $lf   = ([regex]::Matches($Text, "(?<!`r)`n")).Count

function ConvertTo-Lf   { param([string]$Text) return $Text.Replace("`r`n","`n").Replace("`r","`n") }
function ConvertFrom-Lf { param([string]$Text,[string]$Eol) if ($Eol -eq "CRLF") { return $Text.Replace("`n","`r`n") } return $Text }
function Test-Bom { param([string]$Path)
    $b = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Path)
    if ($b.Length -lt 3) { return $false }
    return ($b[0] -eq 0xEF -and $b[1] -eq 0xBB -and $b[2] -eq 0xBF) }

function Test-SingleAnchor {
    param([string]$Name,[string]$Text,[string]$Anchor)
    $count = ([regex]::Matches($Text, [regex]::Escape($Anchor))).Count
    if ($count -eq 1) { Write-Ok ("Anchor located once: " + $Name); return }
    Write-Bad ("Anchor '" + $Name + "' found " + $count + " times, expected 1")
    $probe = ($Anchor -split "`n")[0].Trim()
    if ($probe.Length -gt 34) { $probe = $probe.Substring(0,34) }
    $near = @($Text -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_.Contains($probe) })
    if ($near.Count -eq 0) { Write-Note ("  No line on disk contains '" + $probe + "'. Diagnosis is stale.") }
    else { Write-Note ("  " + $near.Count + " line(s) contain '" + $probe + "'; nearest:"); $near | Select-Object -First 3 | ForEach-Object { Write-Note ("    >>" + $_ + "<<") } }
}

$TabEol  = Get-DominantEol -Text $tabRaw
$SpecEol = Get-DominantEol -Text $specRaw
$TabBom  = Test-Bom -Path $TabFile
$SpecBom = Test-Bom -Path $SpecFile
Write-Note ("Line endings: tab=" + $TabEol + " spec=" + $SpecEol)
$tab  = ConvertTo-Lf -Text $tabRaw
$spec = ConvertTo-Lf -Text $specRaw

$ReactImportOld = @'
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
'@

$ReactImportNew = @'
import { Fragment, useEffect, useState } from "react";
'@

$FragOpenOld = @'
{connections.map((conn) => (
            <>
              <tr key={conn.id}>
'@

$FragOpenNew = @'
{connections.map((conn) => (
            <Fragment key={conn.id}>
              <tr>
'@

$FragCloseOld = @'
            </>
          ))}
'@

$FragCloseNew = @'
            </Fragment>
          ))}
'@

$SerialOld = @'
test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" });
'@

$SerialNew = @'
// Deliberately NOT serial. Playwright skips the remainder of a serial group
// after the first failure, so the gate reported one route and left 37 unrun.
// A route-inventory gate must report EVERY defective route in one pass;
// determinism comes from workers:1 in the configuration, not from serial mode.
'@

Test-SingleAnchor -Name "react import"           -Text $tab  -Anchor $ReactImportOld
Test-SingleAnchor -Name "keyless fragment open"  -Text $tab  -Anchor $FragOpenOld
Test-SingleAnchor -Name "keyless fragment close" -Text $tab  -Anchor $FragCloseOld
Test-SingleAnchor -Name "serial short-circuit"   -Text $spec -Anchor $SerialOld

if ($tab.IndexOf("<Fragment key={conn.id}>") -ge 0) { Write-Bad "Product fix already applied" } else { Write-Ok "Product fix not yet applied" }

if ($Mode -eq "Verify") {
    Write-Host ""
    if ($script:Failures.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Host "VERIFY: NOT READY TO APPLY" -ForegroundColor Red
        $script:Failures | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "   - $_" -ForegroundColor Red }
        exit 1 }
    Write-Host "VERIFY: READY TO APPLY. Nothing was written." -ForegroundColor Green
    exit 0
}
if ($script:Failures.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host "`nANCHOR FAILURE - nothing written." -ForegroundColor Red
    $script:Failures | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "   - $_" -ForegroundColor Red }
    exit 1 }

Write-Step "Backup (outside the repository)"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ThisBackup -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item $TabFile  (Join-Path $ThisBackup "AdminDbConfigurationTab.tsx") -Force
Copy-Item $SpecFile (Join-Path $ThisBackup "customer-route-invariant.spec.ts") -Force
Write-Ok "Backed up both files -> $ThisBackup"

try {

Write-Step "Apply: product fix (keyless list child)"
$newTab = $tab.Replace($ReactImportOld, $ReactImportNew).Replace($FragOpenOld, $FragOpenNew).Replace($FragCloseOld, $FragCloseNew)
if ($newTab -eq $tab) { throw "Product replace produced no change." }
Write-Back -Path $TabFile -Text $newTab -Eol $TabEol -Bom $TabBom
Write-Ok ("Fragment now carries the list key (" + $TabEol + " preserved)")

Write-Step "Apply: harness fix (report every route in one pass)"
$newSpec = $spec.Replace($SerialOld, $SerialNew)
if ($newSpec -eq $spec) { throw "Harness replace produced no change." }
Write-Back -Path $SpecFile -Text $newSpec -Eol $SpecEol -Bom $SpecBom
Write-Ok ("Serial short-circuit removed (" + $SpecEol + " preserved)")

Write-Step "On-disk self-check"
$t = ConvertTo-Lf -Text ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($TabFile))
$s = ConvertTo-Lf -Text ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($SpecFile))

if ($t.IndexOf("<Fragment key={conn.id}>") -lt 0) { Write-Bad "Fragment key absent" } else { Write-Ok "Fragment carries the list key" }
if ($t.IndexOf("import { Fragment, useEffect, useState }") -lt 0) { Write-Bad "Fragment import absent" } else { Write-Ok "Fragment imported" }
if (([regex]::Matches($t, [regex]::Escape('<tr key={conn.id}>'))).Count -ne 0) { Write-Bad "Inner tr still carries the key - it would shadow the fragment key" } else { Write-Ok "Inner row no longer duplicates the key" }
if ($s -match 'describe\.configure\(\{\s*mode:\s*"serial"') { Write-Bad "Serial mode still present - the gate would still short-circuit" } else { Write-Ok "No serial short-circuit in the gate" }

if ((Get-DominantEol -Text ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($TabFile)))  -ne $TabEol)  { Write-Bad "Tab line endings changed - whole-file diff" }  else { Write-Ok "Tab line-ending convention unchanged" }
if ((Get-DominantEol -Text ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($SpecFile))) -ne $SpecEol) { Write-Bad "Spec line endings changed - whole-file diff" } else { Write-Ok "Spec line-ending convention unchanged" }

if ($script:Failures.Count -gt 0) { throw "Self-check failed." }

Write-Step "Gated checks"
Push-Location $Web
try {
    & npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 15 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "    $_" }
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Bad "tsc --noEmit failed" } else { Write-Ok "TypeScript compiles" }

    $listed = & npx playwright test --config=playwright.release-truth.config.ts --list 2>&1
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Bad "Playwright could not load the gate" }
    else {
        $joined = ($listed -join "`n")
        if ($joined -match "(?m)Total:\s*([1-9][0-9]*)\s*test") { Write-Ok ("Gate loads: " + $Matches[1] + " tests discovered") }
        else { Write-Bad "Gate listed zero tests" }
    }
} finally { Pop-Location }

Write-Note "--list proves the gate LOADS. It is not execution and is not acceptance."

if ($script:Failures.Count -gt 0) { throw "Gated checks failed." }

} catch {
    Write-Host "`n!!! APPLY FAILED - AUTO-REVERTING !!!" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message -ForegroundColor Red
    Copy-Item (Join-Path $ThisBackup "AdminDbConfigurationTab.tsx") $TabFile -Force
    Copy-Item (Join-Path $ThisBackup "customer-route-invariant.spec.ts") $SpecFile -Force
    Write-Host "AUTO-REVERT COMPLETE. Repository is back to its pre-pack state." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    exit 1
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "================================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host " ROUTE INVARIANT FIRST FINDINGS - APPLIED" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "================================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host " Modified:"
Write-Host "   Frontend/PlantProcess.Web/src/pages/Admin/AdminDbConfigurationTab.tsx"
Write-Host "   Frontend/PlantProcess.Web/e2e/release-truth/customer-route-invariant.spec.ts"
Write-Host ""
Write-Host " Backup: $ThisBackup"
Write-Host ""
Write-Host " NEXT - rerun the gate. It will now report EVERY defective route," -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host " not just the first. Expect more findings on this pass."
Write-Host "   cd `"$Web`""
Write-Host "   npx playwright test --config=playwright.release-truth.config.ts"
Write-Host ""
Write-Host " NO git add. NO commit. Nothing was staged." -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host "================================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
exit 0

[FILE_START]
[METADATA: Path='tools\packs\Apply-PPIQ-RuntimeTemplateAuthorityProof.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='Tooling Script', Lines=484, SizeKB=22.94, SHA256='18F7008691ECEC889A29730FAD504DFCE85E65812CEFFF19867AF6F5D240D952', Modified='2026-08-25 15:20:35']

<#
================================================================================
PlantProcess IQ - SYSTEM TEMPLATE RUNTIME AUTHORITY PROOF
================================================================================
Owner : Worker 1
Type  : PROOF ONLY. No repository file is written, staged or committed.

WHAT THIS ANSWERS
  The retirement proof showed the legacy SQL template family is gone and left
  zero product templates. Zero is not the approved architecture: the approved
  architecture is ONE canonical operational authority. A Release Truth pass over
  no templates proves nothing.

  So this proves the runtime authority actually produces the family, on the
  canonical startup path, idempotently.

METHOD
  1. Resolve the connection from the existing profile. Nothing is embedded.
  2. Refuse unless the resolved database is the application database.
  3. Stop any running API. Snapshot the baseline.
  4. Start the API on the canonical local profile. Wait for health.
  5. Snapshot the canonical family semantically, not by count.
  6. Non-vacuity gate: dashboards > 0 and widgets > 0, or STOP.
  7. Stop the API. Start it again. Snapshot again.
  8. The two semantic snapshots must be byte-identical.
  9. The two retired widgets must not have returned, and no active product
     dashboard may sit outside the canonical family.

  A snapshot compares dashboard_code, widget_code, dimension_code, measure_code,
  parameter_code, source_system and active/deleted state - counts alone would
  hide content drift.

CREDENTIALS
  None embedded. Read from env\profiles in this order: an already-set PG*
  environment, then a connection string, then discrete keys. If none resolves the
  pack stops and says so. No value is printed except host, port, database, user.

EXIT  0 = runtime authority proven   2 = could not run, nothing changed
      3 = proof failed - read the reported reason, it is a real finding
================================================================================
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot      = 'C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ',
    [string]$EvidenceRoot  = 'C:\Workspace\_ppiq_evidence',
    [string]$ProfileFile   = 'env\profiles\local.env',
    [string]$ApiLauncher   = 'scripts\dev\run-api-local.ps1',
    [ValidateSet('DotnetRun','Runner')]
    [string]$LaunchMode    = 'DotnetRun',
    [string]$ApiHealthUrl  = '',
    [int]   $StartupWaitSeconds = 240,
    [int]   $SettleSeconds = 5
)

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Write-Head([string]$t) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan; Write-Host $t -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan }
function Write-Ok  ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [OK]   $t" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Warn([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [WARN] $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Write-Bad ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] $t" -ForegroundColor Red }
function Write-Inf ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [INFO] $t" -ForegroundColor Gray }

function Write-NoBom {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Text)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}

$script:Pg = @{}

function Invoke-PsqlTuples {
    param([string]$SqlFile, [string]$LogFile)
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try {
        $raw = & psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -A -F '|' -t `
            -h $script:Pg.Host -p $script:Pg.Port -U $script:Pg.User -d $script:Pg.Database `
            -f $SqlFile 2>&1
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
        $lines = @($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString().TrimEnd() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
        Write-NoBom -Path $LogFile -Text (($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
        return @{ Code = $code; Lines = $lines; Text = ($lines -join "`n") }
    } finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
}

function Stop-Api {
    $p = @(Get-Process -Name 'PlantProcess.Api' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
    if ($p.Count -gt 0) {
        $p | Stop-Process -Force
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
        Write-Inf ("stopped {0} API process(es)" -f $p.Count)
    }
}

function Test-Health([string]$Base) {
    try {
        $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ($Base.TrimEnd('/') + '/health') -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5
        return ($r.StatusCode -eq 200)
    } catch { return $false }
}

# Launches the API and CAPTURES its output. A launcher that throws in the first
# second is otherwise indistinguishable from a slow start, which is exactly how
# the previous revision of this pack wasted a ninety second timeout.
function Start-ApiAndWait {
    param([string]$Base, [int]$WaitSeconds, [string]$OutLog, [string]$ErrLog)

    if ($LaunchMode -eq 'Runner') {
        $launcherFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $ApiLauncher
        Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' `
            -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', $launcherFull) `
            -RedirectStandardOutput $OutLog -RedirectStandardError $ErrLog `
            -WorkingDirectory $RepoRootFull | Out-Null
    }
    else {
        # The child inherits this process's environment, which Phase 1 populated
        # from the profile. No dependency on user-scoped variables.
        $csproj = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\PlantProcess.Api.csproj'
        Start-Process -FilePath 'dotnet' `
            -ArgumentList @('run', '--no-launch-profile', '--no-build', '--project', $csproj) `
            -RedirectStandardOutput $OutLog -RedirectStandardError $ErrLog `
            -WorkingDirectory $RepoRootFull | Out-Null
    }

    $waited = 0
    while ($waited -lt $WaitSeconds) {
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
        $waited += 5
        if (Test-Health $Base) { return $waited }
        if ($waited % 30 -eq 0) { Write-Inf ("still waiting, ${waited}s") }
    }
    return -1
}

function Show-LauncherFailure {
    param([string]$OutLog, [string]$ErrLog)
    foreach ($pair in @(@{N='stderr'; P=$ErrLog}, @{N='stdout'; P=$OutLog})) {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $pair.P)) { continue }
        $tail = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $pair.P -Tail 15 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
        if ($tail.Count -eq 0) { continue }
        Write-Inf ("--- launcher " + $pair.N + " ---")
        foreach ($l in $tail) { Write-Host "         $l" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
    }
}

# ===================================================== PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT ====
Write-Head 'PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT'

if ($PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 5) { Write-Bad 'PowerShell 5.1+ required.'; exit 2 }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot)) { Write-Bad "Repo not found: $RepoRoot"; exit 2 }
$RepoRootFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot).Path).TrimEnd('\')
foreach ($cmd in @('psql')) {
    if (-not (Get-Command $cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad "$cmd is not on PATH."; exit 2 }
}
Write-Ok "Repo: $RepoRootFull"

if ($LaunchMode -eq 'Runner') {
    $launcherProbe = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $ApiLauncher
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $launcherProbe)) {
        Write-Bad "API launcher not found: $ApiLauncher"
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok "launch mode: Runner via $ApiLauncher"
    Write-Warn 'That runner reads USER-scoped variables while the profile loader writes PROCESS-scoped ones. If it throws, use the default -LaunchMode DotnetRun.'
}
else {
    Write-Ok 'launch mode: DotnetRun - the profile is applied to this process and inherited by the API'
}
if (-not (Get-Command dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad 'dotnet is not on PATH.'; exit 2 }

Push-Location -LiteralPath $RepoRootFull
try {
    $ev = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Join-Path $EvidenceRoot 'SystemTemplateRuntimeAuthority') (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))).TrimEnd('\')
    if ($ev.ToLowerInvariant().StartsWith(($RepoRootFull + '\').ToLowerInvariant())) { Write-Bad 'EvidenceRoot resolves inside the repository.'; exit 2 }
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ev -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Ok "Evidence: $ev"

    # ==================================== PHASE 1 - RESOLVE THE CONNECTION ===
    Write-Head 'PHASE 1 - CONNECTION FROM THE PROFILE'
    Write-Inf 'Nothing is embedded in this pack. Only host, port, database and user are printed.'

    $profileFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $ProfileFile
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $profileFull)) {
        Write-Bad "profile not found: $ProfileFile"
        Write-Warn 'Pass -ProfileFile with the canonical local profile. No credential is invented.'
        exit 2
    }

    $kv = @{}
    foreach ($ln in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $profileFull)) {
        if ($ln -match '^\s*#') { continue }
        if ($ln -match '^\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$') { $kv[$Matches[1]] = $Matches[2] }
    }

    $script:Pg = @{ Host = ''; Port = '5432'; Database = ''; User = ''; Password = '' }

    # 1. an already-exported environment wins
    foreach ($pair in @(@{K='PGHOST';F='Host'}, @{K='PGPORT';F='Port'}, @{K='PGDATABASE';F='Database'}, @{K='PGUSER';F='User'}, @{K='PGPASSWORD';F='Password'})) {
        $envVal = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($pair.K)
        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($envVal)) { $script:Pg[$pair.F] = $envVal }
    }

    # 2. a connection string in the profile
    foreach ($key in @('ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb', 'ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection', 'PPIQ_DB_CONNECTION')) {
        if (-not $kv.ContainsKey($key)) { continue }
        foreach ($part in ($kv[$key] -split ';')) {
            if ($part -notmatch '^\s*([A-Za-z ]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$') { continue }
            $n = $Matches[1].Trim().ToLowerInvariant(); $v = $Matches[2]
            switch ($n) {
                'host'     { if (-not $script:Pg.Host)     { $script:Pg.Host = $v } }
                'server'   { if (-not $script:Pg.Host)     { $script:Pg.Host = $v } }
                'port'     { $script:Pg.Port = $v }
                'database' { if (-not $script:Pg.Database) { $script:Pg.Database = $v } }
                'username' { if (-not $script:Pg.User)     { $script:Pg.User = $v } }
                'user id'  { if (-not $script:Pg.User)     { $script:Pg.User = $v } }
                'password' { if (-not $script:Pg.Password) { $script:Pg.Password = $v } }
            }
        }
    }

    # 3. discrete keys in the profile
    foreach ($pair in @(@{K='PGHOST';F='Host'}, @{K='PGPORT';F='Port'}, @{K='PGDATABASE';F='Database'}, @{K='PGUSER';F='User'}, @{K='PGPASSWORD';F='Password'})) {
        if ($kv.ContainsKey($pair.K) -and -not $script:Pg[$pair.F]) { $script:Pg[$pair.F] = $kv[$pair.K] }
    }

    $missing = @()
    foreach ($f in @('Host', 'Database', 'User', 'Password')) { if (-not $script:Pg[$f]) { $missing += $f } }
    if ($missing.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Bad ("the profile does not resolve: " + ($missing -join ', '))
        Write-Warn 'This pack embeds no credential and will not invent one. Point -ProfileFile at the canonical profile.'
        exit 2
    }

    if (@('localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1') -notcontains $script:Pg.Host.ToLowerInvariant()) { Write-Bad "Refusing a non-local host: $($script:Pg.Host)"; exit 2 }
    if ($script:Pg.Database -eq 'ppiq_presentation') { Write-Bad 'The profile resolves to the frozen historical database. Refusing.'; exit 2 }
    if ($script:Pg.Database -notmatch '^ppiq_') { Write-Bad "Refusing an unexpected database name: $($script:Pg.Database)"; exit 2 }

    Write-Ok ("resolved: {0}@{1}:{2}/{3}" -f $script:Pg.User, $script:Pg.Host, $script:Pg.Port, $script:Pg.Database)
    Write-Inf 'no silent fallback: the database name above is the one every query below uses'
    $env:PGPASSWORD = $script:Pg.Password

    # health url, discovered not invented
    $base = $ApiHealthUrl
    if (-not $base) {
        foreach ($key in @('ASPNETCORE_URLS', 'PPIQ_API_BASE_URL')) {
            if (-not $kv.ContainsKey($key)) { continue }
            foreach ($piece in ($kv[$key] -split ';')) {
                $piece = $piece.Trim()
                if ($piece -match '^https?://[^@\s]+$' -and -not $base) { $base = $piece }
            }
        }
    }
    if (-not $base) {
        Write-Bad 'No API base URL supplied or discovered. No port will be invented.'
        Write-Warn 'Re-run with -ApiHealthUrl "http://localhost:<port>".'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok "api base: $base"

    # Apply the profile to THIS process so the API child inherits it. This is the
    # same configuration the runner would supply; it simply does not rely on the
    # process/user scope hand-off between the loader and the runner, which does
    # not connect.
    $applied = 0
    foreach ($k in $kv.Keys) {
        if ($k -match '^(ConnectionStrings__|ASPNETCORE_|DOTNET_|PLANTPROCESS_|PlantProcess__)') {
            Set-Item -Path ("Env:" + $k) -Value $kv[$k]
            $applied++
        }
    }
    Write-Ok "$applied profile variable(s) applied to this process for the API child"

    $childCs = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb')
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($childCs)) {
        Write-Bad 'the profile defines no ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb; the API cannot start from it.'
        exit 2
    }
    if ($childCs -notmatch ('(?i)Database\s*=\s*' + [regex]::Escape($script:Pg.Database) + '\s*(;|$)')) {
        Write-Bad 'the connection string the API would use does not target the database this pack verifies.'
        Write-Warn 'Refusing rather than measuring one database while the API writes another.'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok "the API will use the same database this pack queries: $($script:Pg.Database)"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ queries ---
    $work = Join-Path $ev 'sql'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $work -Force | Out-Null

    $snapshotSql = Join-Path $work 'snapshot.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $snapshotSql -Text @'
SELECT d.dashboard_code,
       coalesce(w.widget_code, '(none)'),
       coalesce(w.dimension_code, ''),
       coalesce(w.measure_code, ''),
       coalesce(w.parameter_code, '(none)'),
       d.source_system,
       d.is_active,
       coalesce(w.is_active::text, ''),
       coalesce(w.is_deleted::text, '')
FROM   dashboard_definitions d
LEFT JOIN dashboard_widget_definitions w
       ON w.dashboard_definition_id = d.id AND w.is_deleted = FALSE
WHERE  d.source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  d.is_deleted = FALSE
ORDER BY d.dashboard_code, coalesce(w.widget_code, '(none)');
'@

    $countsSql = Join-Path $work 'counts.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $countsSql -Text @'
SELECT 'canonical_dashboards', count(*) FROM dashboard_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE AND source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  dashboard_code LIKE 'SYSTEM\_%';
SELECT 'canonical_widgets', count(*) FROM dashboard_widget_definitions w
JOIN   dashboard_definitions d ON d.id = w.dashboard_definition_id
WHERE  w.is_deleted = FALSE AND d.is_deleted = FALSE
  AND  w.source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  d.dashboard_code LIKE 'SYSTEM\_%';
SELECT 'legacy_unprefixed_dashboards', count(*) FROM dashboard_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE AND source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  dashboard_code NOT LIKE 'SYSTEM\_%';
SELECT 'retired_widgets_active', count(*) FROM dashboard_widget_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE
  AND  widget_code IN ('CORR_PARAMETER_AVG_BY_EQUIPMENT', 'DQ_BY_TYPE');
SELECT 'parameterless_average_widgets', count(*) FROM dashboard_widget_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE
  AND  lower(measure_code) = 'avgparametervalue'
  AND  (parameter_code IS NULL OR btrim(parameter_code) = '');
'@

    function Get-Counts([string]$Tag) {
        $r = Invoke-PsqlTuples -SqlFile $countsSql -LogFile (Join-Path $ev ("counts_$Tag.log"))
        if ($r.Code -ne 0) { return $null }
        $h = @{}
        foreach ($l in $r.Lines) {
            $p = $l -split '\|'
            if ($p.Count -ge 2) { $h[$p[0].Trim()] = [int]$p[1].Trim() }
        }
        return $h
    }

    # ============================================ PHASE 2 - BASELINE ========
    Write-Head 'PHASE 2 - BASELINE BEFORE ANY STARTUP'

    Stop-Api
    $baseline = Get-Counts 'baseline'
    if ($null -eq $baseline) { Write-Bad 'could not read the database.'; exit 2 }
    foreach ($k in @('canonical_dashboards','canonical_widgets','legacy_unprefixed_dashboards','retired_widgets_active','parameterless_average_widgets')) {
        Write-Inf ("{0,-32} {1}" -f $k, $baseline[$k])
    }

    # ================================= PHASE 3 - FIRST CANONICAL STARTUP ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 3 - FIRST CANONICAL STARTUP'

    Write-Inf 'building the API first so the health window is not spent compiling'
    $buildLog = Join-Path $ev 'build.log'
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    & dotnet build (Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\PlantProcess.Api.csproj') -c Debug --nologo 2>&1 |
        Tee-Object -FilePath $buildLog | Out-Null
    $buildCode = $LASTEXITCODE
    $ErrorActionPreference = $prev
    if ($buildCode -ne 0) {
        Get-Content -LiteralPath $buildLog -Tail 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Write-Bad 'the API does not build; the runtime authority cannot be proven.'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok 'API builds'

    $waited = Start-ApiAndWait -Base $base -WaitSeconds $StartupWaitSeconds `
        -OutLog (Join-Path $ev 'api_start1_stdout.log') -ErrLog (Join-Path $ev 'api_start1_stderr.log')
    if ($waited -lt 0) {
        Write-Bad "API did not report healthy within $StartupWaitSeconds seconds."
        Show-LauncherFailure -OutLog (Join-Path $ev 'api_start1_stdout.log') -ErrLog (Join-Path $ev 'api_start1_stderr.log')
        Stop-Api
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok "API healthy after ${waited}s"
    Start-Sleep -Seconds $SettleSeconds

    $snapA = Invoke-PsqlTuples -SqlFile $snapshotSql -LogFile (Join-Path $ev 'snapshot_startup1.log')
    if ($snapA.Code -ne 0) { Stop-Api; Write-Bad 'could not snapshot after the first startup.'; exit 3 }
    $countsA = Get-Counts 'startup1'

    Write-Inf "canonical family after startup 1:"
    foreach ($l in $snapA.Lines) { Write-Host "         $l" -ForegroundColor DarkGray }

    # ============================================ PHASE 4 - NON-VACUITY =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 4 - NON-VACUITY GATE'

    $d = $countsA['canonical_dashboards']
    $w = $countsA['canonical_widgets']
    Write-Inf ("canonical dashboards {0}, canonical widgets {1}" -f $d, $w)

    if ($d -le 0 -or $w -le 0) {
        Write-Bad 'The canonical runtime family is empty after a clean startup.'
        Write-Warn 'The retirement succeeded and nothing replaced it, so a Release Truth pass here would be vacuous.'
        Write-Warn 'Finding: the runtime authority is not executing on the canonical startup path, or it is incomplete.'
        Write-Warn 'This is Worker-1 owned. It is NOT solved by restoring the retired SQL seed.'
        Stop-Api
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok 'canonical family is non-empty'

    # ================================ PHASE 5 - SECOND CANONICAL STARTUP ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 5 - SECOND CANONICAL STARTUP'

    Stop-Api
    $waited2 = Start-ApiAndWait -Base $base -WaitSeconds $StartupWaitSeconds `
        -OutLog (Join-Path $ev 'api_start2_stdout.log') -ErrLog (Join-Path $ev 'api_start2_stderr.log')
    if ($waited2 -lt 0) {
        Write-Bad 'API did not report healthy on the second start.'
        Show-LauncherFailure -OutLog (Join-Path $ev 'api_start2_stdout.log') -ErrLog (Join-Path $ev 'api_start2_stderr.log')
        Stop-Api; exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok "API healthy after ${waited2}s"
    Start-Sleep -Seconds $SettleSeconds

    $snapB = Invoke-PsqlTuples -SqlFile $snapshotSql -LogFile (Join-Path $ev 'snapshot_startup2.log')
    if ($snapB.Code -ne 0) { Stop-Api; Write-Bad 'could not snapshot after the second startup.'; exit 3 }
    $countsB = Get-Counts 'startup2'

    # =========================================== PHASE 6 - SEMANTIC DRIFT ===
    Write-Head 'PHASE 6 - SEMANTIC DRIFT'

    if ($snapA.Text -ne $snapB.Text) {
        Write-Bad 'The second startup changed the canonical family.'
        $onlyA = @($snapA.Lines | Where-Object { $snapB.Lines -notcontains $_ })
        $onlyB = @($snapB.Lines | Where-Object { $snapA.Lines -notcontains $_ })
        foreach ($l in $onlyA) { Write-Host "         only after startup 1: $l" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        foreach ($l in $onlyB) { Write-Host "         only after startup 2: $l" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Stop-Api
        Write-Warn 'The runtime authority is not idempotent. That is the finding.'
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok ("semantic snapshot identical across two fresh startups ({0} rows compared)" -f $snapA.Lines.Count)

    # ======================================= PHASE 7 - RETIREMENT HOLDS =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 7 - THE RETIRED WIDGETS DID NOT RETURN'

    $failed = $false
    if ($countsB['retired_widgets_active'] -ne 0) {
        Write-Bad ("CORR_PARAMETER_AVG_BY_EQUIPMENT or DQ_BY_TYPE is active again: {0} row(s)" -f $countsB['retired_widgets_active'])
        $failed = $true
    } else { Write-Ok 'neither retired widget was recreated' }

    if ($countsB['parameterless_average_widgets'] -ne 0) {
        Write-Bad ("a parameterless average-parameter widget exists again: {0} row(s)" -f $countsB['parameterless_average_widgets'])
        $failed = $true
    } else { Write-Ok 'no average-parameter widget exists without a parameter' }

    if ($countsB['legacy_unprefixed_dashboards'] -ne 0) {
        Write-Bad ("{0} active product dashboard(s) sit outside the canonical family" -f $countsB['legacy_unprefixed_dashboards'])
        $failed = $true
    } else { Write-Ok 'every active product dashboard belongs to the canonical family' }

    Stop-Api

    if ($failed) { Write-Warn 'Proof failed. Nothing was written to the repository.'; exit 3 }

    # ================================================= PHASE 8 - CLOSURE ====
    Write-Head 'CLOSURE'

    $report = @()
    $report += 'SYSTEM TEMPLATE RUNTIME AUTHORITY PROOF'
    $report += ("  database                     : {0}" -f $script:Pg.Database)
    $report += ("  canonical system dashboards  : {0}" -f $countsB['canonical_dashboards'])
    $report += ("  canonical system widgets     : {0}" -f $countsB['canonical_widgets'])
    $report += ("  legacy unprefixed dashboards : {0}" -f $countsB['legacy_unprefixed_dashboards'])
    $report += ("  retired widgets active       : {0}" -f $countsB['retired_widgets_active'])
    $report += ("  parameterless average widgets: {0}" -f $countsB['parameterless_average_widgets'])
    $report += ("  second fresh startup         : zero semantic drift ({0} rows)" -f $snapB.Lines.Count)
    $report += ("  evidence                     : {0}" -f $ev)
    $report += '  repository                   : untouched by this pack'
    Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'CLOSURE.txt') -Text (($report -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")

    Write-Host ''
    foreach ($r in $report) { Write-Host "  $r" -ForegroundColor White }
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  Nothing to commit. This pack proves runtime behaviour; it changes no file.' -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host ''
    exit 0
}
finally {
    if (Test-Path Env:PGPASSWORD) { $env:PGPASSWORD = '' }
    Pop-Location
}

[FILE_START]
[METADATA: Path='tools\packs\Apply-PPIQ-SchemaReferenceScan.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='Tooling Script', Lines=278, SizeKB=13.82, SHA256='6B50B879F69C7B67C8AEDAA6D36F93A2F1D45BCCC79C72CF18ED65D82F6AA0DE', Modified='2026-08-26 22:48:57']

<#
================================================================================
PlantProcess IQ - THREE SCHEMA RUNTIME REFERENCE SCAN
================================================================================
Backlog task : T-087 (metadata only)
Owner        : Worker 1
Type         : READ-ONLY. No repository mutation. No database access. No commit.

WHAT IT DOES
  Reads the frozen static assignment and searches current runtime source for
  every explicitly schema-qualified reference to a moved object. EF LINQ is
  covered by ToTable(schema:) and is out of scope here; explicit raw SQL is not,
  and is what this finds.

  It emits one patch ledger: file, line, old reference, target reference, owner,
  action. It changes nothing.

SCOPE
  Backend/PlantProcess.Api
  Backend/PlantProcess.Application
  Backend/PlantProcess.Infrastructure
  Backend/PlantProcess.Workers
  Backend/database/views
  canonical SQL only, read from the committed migration-authority manifest

  search_path is not treated as a substitute for an explicit qualification.
  A bare table name is not reported: only old-schema-qualified references are.

EXIT  0 = ledger produced   2 = could not run, one concrete reason
================================================================================
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot      = 'C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ',
    [string]$EvidenceRoot  = 'C:\Workspace\_ppiq_evidence',
    [string]$AssignmentCsv = ''
)

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Write-Head([string]$t) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan; Write-Host $t -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan }
function Write-Ok  ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [OK]   $t" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Warn([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [WARN] $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Write-Bad ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] $t" -ForegroundColor Red }
function Write-Inf ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [INFO] $t" -ForegroundColor Gray }

function Write-NoBom([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}

Write-Head 'PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT'
if ($PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 5) { Write-Bad 'PowerShell 5.1+ required.'; exit 2 }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot)) { Write-Bad "Repo not found: $RepoRoot"; exit 2 }
$RepoRootFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot).Path).TrimEnd('\')
Write-Ok "Repo: $RepoRootFull"

if (-not $AssignmentCsv) { $AssignmentCsv = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads\t087_static_assignment.csv' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $AssignmentCsv)) {
    Write-Bad "static assignment not found: $AssignmentCsv"
    Write-Warn 'Save t087_static_assignment.csv and pass -AssignmentCsv if it is elsewhere.'
    exit 2
}

Push-Location -LiteralPath $RepoRootFull
try {
    $ev = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Join-Path $EvidenceRoot 'ThreeSchemaReferenceScan') (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))).TrimEnd('\')
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ev -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Ok "Evidence: $ev"
    Write-Inf ("HEAD: " + (& git rev-parse --short HEAD))

    # ======================================== PHASE 1 - MOVED OBJECT MAP ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 1 - MOVED OBJECTS'

    $rows = @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $AssignmentCsv)
    if ($rows.Count -eq 0) { Write-Bad 'the assignment csv is empty.'; exit 2 }
    Write-Ok "$($rows.Count) assigned table(s) read"

    # old qualified name -> target qualified name, only where the schema changes
    $moves = @{}
    foreach ($r in $rows) {
        if ($r.target_schema -eq $r.old_schema) { continue }
        $moves[($r.old_schema + '.' + $r.table)] = ($r.target_schema + '.' + $r.table)
    }
    Write-Ok "$($moves.Count) object(s) change schema"

    $staying = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.target_schema -eq $_.old_schema })
    Write-Inf ("{0} object(s) stay where they are" -f $staying.Count)

    # =============================================== PHASE 2 - FILE SET =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 2 - FILES IN SCOPE'

    $files = @()
    foreach ($proj in @('Backend\PlantProcess.Api', 'Backend\PlantProcess.Application', 'Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure', 'Backend\PlantProcess.Workers')) {
        $dir = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $proj
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { Write-Warn "scope directory absent: $proj"; continue }
        $files += @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Recurse -File -Include '*.cs', '*.json' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
                    Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\(bin|obj)\\' -and $_.Name -notmatch '\.Designer\.cs$' })
    }

    $viewsDir = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\database\views'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $viewsDir) {
        $files += @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $viewsDir -Recurse -File -Filter '*.sql')
    }

    $manifestPath = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\database\canonical-migration-order.json'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $manifestPath)) { Write-Bad 'the canonical migration authority manifest is missing.'; exit 2 }
    $manifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath $manifestPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $canonicalSql = @()
    foreach ($step in $manifest.canonicalPath) {
        $abs = Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($step.path -replace '/', '\')
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $abs) { $canonicalSql += (Get-Item -LiteralPath $abs) }
    }
    Write-Ok ("{0} source file(s), {1} canonical SQL file(s)" -f $files.Count, $canonicalSql.Count)
    $files = @($files) + @($canonicalSql)
    $files = @($files | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ })

    if ($files.Count -eq 0) { Write-Bad 'the file set is empty; there is nothing to scan.'; exit 2 }

    $byExt = @{}
    foreach ($f in $files) {
        $e = $f.Extension.ToLowerInvariant()
        if (-not $byExt.ContainsKey($e)) { $byExt[$e] = 0 }
        $byExt[$e] = $byExt[$e] + 1
    }
    foreach ($k in ($byExt.Keys | Sort-Object)) { Write-Inf ("  {0,-8} {1}" -f $k, $byExt[$k]) }

    # ================================================= PHASE 3 - SCAN =======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 3 - EXPLICIT OLD-SCHEMA REFERENCES'

    # Only explicitly qualified references. A bare table name is not reported,
    # because search_path is not a substitute for qualification and guessing at
    # unqualified names would bury the real hits in noise.
    $oldSchemas = @('public', 'acquisition', 'canon', 'dump_store')
    $rx = [regex]('(?i)\b(' + ($oldSchemas -join '|') + ')\.([a-z0-9_]+)\b')

    $ledger = @()
    $unmapped = @()
    $scanned = 0
    $opened = 0
    $linesRead = 0
    $rawMatches = 0
    $readFailures = @()

    foreach ($f in $files) {
        $scanned++
        if ($scanned % 200 -eq 0) { Write-Inf ("scanned {0}/{1}, {2} raw qualified reference(s) so far" -f $scanned, $files.Count, $rawMatches) }

        $rel = $f.FullName.Substring($RepoRootFull.Length + 1).Replace('\', '/')

        $content = $null
        try { $content = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllLines($f.FullName) }
        catch { $readFailures += ("{0}: {1}" -f $rel, $_.Exception.Message); continue }
        $opened++

        $lineNo = 0
        foreach ($line in $content) {
            $lineNo++
            $linesRead++
            foreach ($m in $rx.Matches($line)) {
                $rawMatches++
                $old = ($m.Groups[1].Value.ToLowerInvariant() + '.' + $m.Groups[2].Value.ToLowerInvariant())
                if (-not $moves.ContainsKey($old)) {
                    # a qualified reference to something that is not moving, or to
                    # a function/type rather than a table
                    $unmapped += ("{0}:{1}  {2}" -f $rel, $lineNo, $m.Value)
                    continue
                }

                $owner = 'Worker 1 - backend'
                if ($rel -match '(?i)^Backend/database/views/') { $owner = 'Worker 1 - read-model view' }
                elseif ($rel -match '(?i)^Backend/database/scripts/') { $owner = 'Worker 1 - canonical SQL' }

                $action = 'qualify to ' + $moves[$old]
                if ($rel -match '(?i)^Backend/database/scripts/') {
                    $action = 'no edit: the convergence SQL moves this object; the historical script keeps its original text'
                }

                $ledger += [PSCustomObject]@{
                    file = $rel; line = $lineNo
                    old_reference = $m.Value; target_reference = $moves[$old]
                    owner = $owner; action = $action
                    context = $line.Trim()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Write-Head 'SCAN NON-VACUITY'
    Write-Inf ("files in set        : {0}" -f $files.Count)
    Write-Inf ("files opened        : {0}" -f $opened)
    Write-Inf ("lines read          : {0}" -f $linesRead)
    Write-Inf ("raw qualified refs  : {0}" -f $rawMatches)
    if ($readFailures.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Warn ("{0} file(s) could not be read:" -f $readFailures.Count)
        foreach ($r in ($readFailures | Select-Object -First 5)) { Write-Host "         $r" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
    }

    # A scanner that reports zero must first prove it looked. Across a thousand
    # backend files and ninety-seven SQL scripts, zero schema-qualified references
    # of any kind means the scan did not run, not that the codebase is clean.
    if ($opened -eq 0) { Write-Bad 'no file was opened. The scan did not run.'; exit 2 }
    if ($linesRead -eq 0) { Write-Bad 'no line was read. The scan did not run.'; exit 2 }
    if ($rawMatches -eq 0) {
        Write-Bad 'zero schema-qualified references of any kind were found across the whole scope.'
        Write-Warn 'That is not a clean codebase; it is a broken scan. Refusing to report a vacuous zero.'
        Write-Inf  'Independent check, run it yourself:'
        Write-Inf  '  git grep -n "public\." -- Backend/PlantProcess.Api | Measure-Object -Line'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok ("scan is non-vacuous: {0} raw qualified reference(s) across {1} opened file(s)" -f $rawMatches, $opened)

    $ledger = @($ledger | Sort-Object file, line)
    $needEdit = @($ledger | Where-Object { $_.action -like 'qualify*' })

    $ledger | Select-Object file, line, old_reference, target_reference, owner, action |
        Export-Csv -LiteralPath (Join-Path $ev 't087_patch_ledger.csv') -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8
    Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'unmapped_qualified_references.txt') -Text ((@($unmapped | Sort-Object -Unique) -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")

    Write-Ok ("{0} explicit old-schema reference(s) to moved objects" -f $ledger.Count)
    Write-Ok ("{0} need an edit; the rest are historical SQL that keeps its original text" -f $needEdit.Count)
    Write-Inf ("{0} qualified reference(s) point at objects that are not moving" -f (@($unmapped | Sort-Object -Unique)).Count)

    Write-Head 'FILES NEEDING AN EDIT'
    $byFile = @($needEdit | Group-Object file | Sort-Object Name)
    foreach ($g in $byFile) {
        Write-Host ("  {0,-78} {1}" -f $g.Name, $g.Count) -ForegroundColor White
        foreach ($h in ($g.Group | Select-Object -First 4)) {
            Write-Host ("      {0,5}  {1}  ->  {2}" -f $h.line, $h.old_reference, $h.target_reference) -ForegroundColor DarkGray
        }
        if ($g.Count -gt 4) { Write-Host ("      ... {0} more" -f ($g.Count - 4)) -ForegroundColor DarkGray }
    }

    # ================================== PHASE 4 - STAGING CONFIGURATION =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 4 - STAGING SCHEMA CONFIGURATION'

    $cfg = @()
    foreach ($root in @('Backend', 'env')) {
        $dir = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $root
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { continue }
        $cand = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Recurse -File -Include '*.cs', '*.json', '*.env' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
                  Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\(bin|obj|node_modules)\\' })
        foreach ($c in $cand) {
            foreach ($h in @(Select-String -LiteralPath $c.FullName -Pattern 'StagingSchema|dump_store' -AllMatches -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
                $cfg += ("{0}:{1}  {2}" -f $c.FullName.Substring($RepoRootFull.Length + 1).Replace('\', '/'), $h.LineNumber, $h.Line.Trim())
            }
        }
    }
    Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'staging_configuration.txt') -Text ((@($cfg | Sort-Object -Unique) -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
    Write-Ok ("{0} staging configuration reference(s)" -f (@($cfg | Sort-Object -Unique)).Count)
    foreach ($c in (@($cfg | Sort-Object -Unique) | Select-Object -First 10)) { Write-Host "         $c" -ForegroundColor DarkGray }

    Write-Head 'CLOSURE'
    $report = @()
    $report += 'THREE SCHEMA RUNTIME REFERENCE SCAN'
    $report += ("  objects changing schema      : {0}" -f $moves.Count)
    $report += ("  files in set                 : {0}" -f $files.Count)
    $report += ("  files opened                 : {0}" -f $opened)
    $report += ("  lines read                   : {0}" -f $linesRead)
    $report += ("  raw qualified references     : {0}" -f $rawMatches)
    $report += ("  explicit old-schema hits     : {0}" -f $ledger.Count)
    $report += ("  hits needing an edit         : {0}" -f $needEdit.Count)
    $report += ("  files needing an edit        : {0}" -f $byFile.Count)
    $report += ("  qualified refs not moving    : {0}" -f (@($unmapped | Sort-Object -Unique)).Count)
    $report += ("  staging configuration refs   : {0}" -f (@($cfg | Sort-Object -Unique)).Count)
    $report += ("  ledger                       : {0}" -f (Join-Path $ev 't087_patch_ledger.csv'))
    Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'CLOSURE.txt') -Text (($report -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
    Write-Host ''
    foreach ($r in $report) { Write-Host "  $r" -ForegroundColor White }
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  Nothing was written to the repository and no database was contacted.' -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host ''
    exit 0
}
finally { Pop-Location }
