[METADATA: Path='tools\packs\Apply-PPIQ-SchemaTopologyClosure.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='Tooling Script', Lines=1068, SizeKB=52.98, SHA256='41F5A452A5A45C32020FE2856D86B811CA7C84CA3D88D6BA78E341BC2BF9D5FB', Modified='2026-08-27 23:26:57']

<#
================================================================================
PlantProcess IQ - THREE SCHEMA TOPOLOGY
================================================================================
Backlog task : T-087 (metadata only)
Owner        : Worker 1
Depends      : T-086, T-088 (canonical migration authority at 6a62c9d6)

WHAT IT DOES
  Moves the product onto ppiq_staging / ppiq_plant / ppiq_meta, in one commit,
  because schema and code cannot move separately without breaking the running
  application in between.

  Nothing here is hardcoded from memory. The table set comes from the frozen
  static assignment, the source edits come from the frozen patch ledger, and the
  EF mappings are discovered in the tree at apply time.

ORDER, preserving the T-088 law
  EF migrations -> canonical schema SQL -> three-schema convergence -> views

PHASES
  0  preflight, HEAD guard, both CSVs present, index empty
  1  read the assignment and the ledger
  2  backup every file this pack will touch
  3  generate the convergence SQL at the next free ordinal
  4  apply the 268 ledger edits, each anchored on its recorded line
  5  rewrite the read-model views into ppiq_plant, references qualified
  6  set the EF table schemas, excluding the dual-authority table
  7  staging configuration default and its two literals
  8  build, then add one EF migration
  9  fresh build from zero and prove the topology
 10  update the migration authority manifest
 11  extend the gate with topology assertions
 12  exact staging

  Any failure restores every touched file and drops the probe database.

EXIT  0 = applied, topology proven, staged
      2 = verification failed, no mutation
      3 = failed after mutation, auto-revert completed
================================================================================
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot      = 'C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ',
    [string]$EvidenceRoot  = 'C:\Workspace\_ppiq_evidence',
    [string]$AssignmentCsv = '',
    [string]$LedgerCsv     = '',
    [string]$ProfileFile   = 'env\profiles\local.env',
    [string]$ProbeDatabase = 'ppiq_topology_probe',
    [switch]$SkipTests
)

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Write-Head([string]$t) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan; Write-Host $t -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan }
function Write-Ok  ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [OK]   $t" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Warn([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [WARN] $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Write-Bad ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] $t" -ForegroundColor Red }
function Write-Inf ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [INFO] $t" -ForegroundColor Gray }

function Invoke-Git {
    param([string[]]$GitArgs)
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try { $raw = & git @GitArgs 2>&1; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $text = ($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) -join "`r`n" }
    finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
    return @{ Code = $code; Text = $text }
}

function Get-DominantEol([string]$Text) {
    $crlf = ([regex]::Matches($Text, "`r`n")).Count
    $lf   = ([regex]::Matches($Text, "(?<!`r)`n")).Count
    if ($crlf -ge $lf) { return 'CRLF' } else { return 'LF' }
}
function Test-HasBom([string]$Path) {
    $b = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Path)
    return ($b.Length -ge 3 -and $b[0] -eq 0xEF -and $b[1] -eq 0xBB -and $b[2] -eq 0xBF)
}
function Write-Preserving([string]$Path, [string]$Text, [bool]$HadBom) {
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($HadBom)))
}
function Write-NoBom([string]$Path, [string]$Text) { Write-Preserving -Path $Path -Text $Text -HadBom $false }

$script:Backups = @{}
$script:Created = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$script:Staged  = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$script:ProbeMade = $false
$script:OracleMade = $false

function Invoke-Rollback([string]$Reason) {
    Write-Head 'AUTO-REVERT'
    Write-Bad $Reason
    foreach ($p in $script:Staged) { Invoke-Git @('reset', '--', $p) | Out-Null }
    foreach ($rel in $script:Backups.Keys) {
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $script:Backups[$rel] -Destination (Join-Path $RepoRootFull $rel) -Force
    }
    Write-Ok ("restored {0} file(s)" -f $script:Backups.Count)
    foreach ($f in $script:Created) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force } }
    Write-Ok ("removed {0} created file(s)" -f $script:Created.Count)
    if ($script:ProbeMade) {
        $d = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'ppiq_drop_probe.sql'
        Write-NoBom -Path $d -Text "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $ProbeDatabase WITH (FORCE);"
        & psql -h $pg.Host -p $pg.Port -U $pg.User -d postgres -f $d 2>&1 | Out-Null
        Write-Ok 'probe database dropped'
    }
    if ($script:OracleMade) {
        $d2 = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'ppiq_drop_oracle.sql'
        Write-NoBom -Path $d2 -Text "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS ppiq_oracle_clone_probe WITH (FORCE);"
        & psql -h $pg.Host -p $pg.Port -U $pg.User -d postgres -f $d2 2>&1 | Out-Null
        Write-Ok 'oracle clone dropped'
    }
    Write-Warn 'The application database was not modified by this pack.'
    Write-Host ''
}

# ===================================================== PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT ====
Write-Head 'PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT'
if ($PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 5) { Write-Bad 'PowerShell 5.1+ required.'; exit 2 }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot)) { Write-Bad "Repo not found: $RepoRoot"; exit 2 }
$RepoRootFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot).Path).TrimEnd('\')
foreach ($c in @('git', 'psql', 'dotnet')) { if (-not (Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad "$c is not on PATH."; exit 2 } }
Write-Ok "Repo: $RepoRootFull"

if (-not $AssignmentCsv) { $AssignmentCsv = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads\t087_static_assignment.csv' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $AssignmentCsv)) { Write-Bad "static assignment not found: $AssignmentCsv"; exit 2 }
if (-not $LedgerCsv) {
    $scanRoot = Join-Path $EvidenceRoot 'ThreeSchemaReferenceScan'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $scanRoot)) { Write-Bad "no reference scan evidence under $scanRoot"; exit 2 }
    $latest = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $scanRoot -Directory | Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1)
    if ($latest.Count -eq 0) { Write-Bad 'no reference scan run found.'; exit 2 }
    $LedgerCsv = Join-Path $latest[0].FullName 't087_patch_ledger.csv'
}
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $LedgerCsv)) { Write-Bad "patch ledger not found: $LedgerCsv"; exit 2 }
Write-Ok "assignment: $AssignmentCsv"
Write-Ok "ledger    : $LedgerCsv"

$apiCsproj   = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\PlantProcess.Api.csproj'
$infraCsproj = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure\PlantProcess.Infrastructure.csproj'
foreach ($c in @($apiCsproj, $infraCsproj)) { if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c)) { Write-Bad "project not found: $c"; exit 2 } }
Write-Ok 'projects resolved'

if ($ProbeDatabase -ne 'ppiq_topology_probe') { Write-Bad "SAFETY STOP: probe name must be ppiq_topology_probe."; exit 2 }
Write-Ok "probe guard: exact match on $ProbeDatabase"

Push-Location -LiteralPath $RepoRootFull
try {
    $ev = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Join-Path $EvidenceRoot 'ThreeSchemaTopology') (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))).TrimEnd('\')
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ev -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Ok "Evidence: $ev"

    $cached = (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).Text.Trim()
    if ($cached) {
        Write-Bad 'Index is NOT empty.'
        $cached -split "`r?`n" | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok 'index empty'
    $head = (Invoke-Git @('rev-parse', 'HEAD')).Text.Trim()
    Write-Inf "HEAD: $head"

    # -------- connection, profile only, no embedded credential ---------------
    $profileFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $ProfileFile
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $profileFull)) { Write-Bad "profile not found: $ProfileFile"; exit 2 }
    $kv = @{}
    foreach ($ln in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $profileFull)) {
        if ($ln -match '^\s*#') { continue }
        if ($ln -match '^\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$') { $kv[$Matches[1]] = $Matches[2] }
    }
    $pg = @{ Host = ''; Port = '5432'; User = ''; Password = '' }
    foreach ($key in @('ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb', 'ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection')) {
        if (-not $kv.ContainsKey($key)) { continue }
        foreach ($part in ($kv[$key] -split ';')) {
            if ($part -notmatch '^\s*([A-Za-z ]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$') { continue }
            $n = $Matches[1].Trim().ToLowerInvariant(); $v = $Matches[2]
            switch ($n) {
                'host'     { if (-not $pg.Host) { $pg.Host = $v } }
                'server'   { if (-not $pg.Host) { $pg.Host = $v } }
                'port'     { $pg.Port = $v }
                'username' { if (-not $pg.User) { $pg.User = $v } }
                'user id'  { if (-not $pg.User) { $pg.User = $v } }
                'password' { if (-not $pg.Password) { $pg.Password = $v } }
            }
        }
    }
    $missing = @(); foreach ($f in @('Host', 'User', 'Password')) { if (-not $pg[$f]) { $missing += $f } }
    if ($missing.Count -gt 0) { Write-Bad ("profile does not resolve: " + ($missing -join ', ')); exit 2 }
    if (@('localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1') -notcontains $pg.Host.ToLowerInvariant()) { Write-Bad "refusing a non-local host: $($pg.Host)"; exit 2 }
    Write-Ok ("{0}@{1}:{2}  probe {3}" -f $pg.User, $pg.Host, $pg.Port, $ProbeDatabase)
    $env:PGPASSWORD = $pg.Password

    # ============================================ PHASE 1 - READ EVIDENCE ===
    Write-Head 'PHASE 1 - ASSIGNMENT AND LEDGER'

    $assign = @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $AssignmentCsv)
    $ledger = @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $LedgerCsv)
    if ($assign.Count -eq 0) { Write-Bad 'assignment is empty.'; exit 2 }
    if ($ledger.Count -eq 0) { Write-Bad 'ledger is empty.'; exit 2 }
    Write-Ok ("{0} assigned table(s), {1} ledger row(s)" -f $assign.Count, $ledger.Count)

    $edits = @($ledger | Where-Object { $_.action -like 'qualify*' })
    if ($edits.Count -eq 0) { Write-Bad 'the ledger contains no edit. A no-op topology change proves nothing.'; exit 2 }
    $editFiles = @($edits | Group-Object file)
    Write-Ok ("{0} edit(s) across {1} file(s)" -f $edits.Count, $editFiles.Count)

    # Every row whose schema changes. Not filtered by on_fresh_install, creator or
    # ownership: runtime SQL is existence-driven, so one 224-entry authority serves
    # a fresh database, an application upgrade and an oracle clone alike. A fresh
    # database simply skips the rows whose source table it never had.
    $moving = @($assign | Where-Object { $_.target_schema -ne $_.old_schema })
    $scriptMoves = @($moving | Where-Object { $_.creator_authority -ne 'EF' })
    $efMoves     = @($moving | Where-Object { $_.creator_authority -eq 'EF' })
    Write-Ok ("{0} table(s) change schema: {1} script-owned, {2} EF-owned" -f $moving.Count, $scriptMoves.Count, $efMoves.Count)

    if ($moving.Count -ne 224) {
        Write-Bad ("the assignment declares {0} moving table(s); the frozen analysis says 224." -f $moving.Count)
        Write-Warn 'The convergence authority must carry every declared move. No mutation performed.'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok 'moving count matches the frozen analysis: 224'

    $targetOf = @{}
    foreach ($a in $assign) { $targetOf[$a.table] = $a.target_schema }

    # ================================================== PHASE 2 - BACKUP ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 2 - BACKUP'
    $bk = Join-Path $ev 'backup'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $bk -Force | Out-Null
    $touch = @()
    foreach ($g in $editFiles) { $touch += $g.Name }

    $viewsRel = 'Backend/database/views/006_dashboard_dataset_views.sql'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($viewsRel -replace '/', '\')))) { Write-Bad "views authority missing: $viewsRel"; exit 2 }
    if ($touch -notcontains $viewsRel) { $touch += $viewsRel }

    $manifestRel = 'Backend/database/canonical-migration-order.json'
    $gateRel     = 'Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/CanonicalMigrationOrderTests.cs'
    foreach ($r in @($manifestRel, $gateRel)) {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($r -replace '/', '\')))) { Write-Bad "missing: $r"; exit 2 }
        if ($touch -notcontains $r) { $touch += $r }
    }

    $i = 0
    foreach ($rel in $touch) {
        $abs = Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($rel -replace '/', '\')
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $abs)) { Write-Bad "ledger names a file that does not exist: $rel"; exit 2 }
        $i++
        $dst = Join-Path $bk ("{0:D3}_{1}" -f $i, (Split-Path -Leaf $rel))
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $abs -Destination $dst -Force
        $script:Backups[$rel] = $dst
    }
    Write-Ok ("{0} file(s) backed up" -f $script:Backups.Count)

    # ======================================= PHASE 3 - CONVERGENCE SQL ======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 3 - CONVERGENCE SQL  [MUTATION]'

    $scriptsDir = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\database\scripts'
    $highest = 0
    foreach ($f in (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $scriptsDir -File -Filter '*.sql')) {
        if ($f.Name -match '^(\d+)_') { $n = [int]$Matches[1]; if ($n -lt 999 -and $n -gt $highest) { $highest = $n } }
    }
    $ordinal = $highest + 1
    Write-Inf "highest ordinal below the 999 tail: $highest, using $ordinal"

    $convRel = "Backend/database/scripts/{0}_three_schema_convergence.sql" -f $ordinal
    $convAbs = Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($convRel -replace '/', '\')
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $convAbs) { Write-Bad "already exists: $convRel"; exit 2 }

    $sql = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('-- ============================================================================')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('-- Three schema topology.')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('--')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('-- The last schema authority on the canonical path. Everything before this')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('-- creates objects where history put them; this puts them where they belong.')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('--   ppiq_staging  source-shaped and in-transit intake')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('--   ppiq_plant    customer plant reality and facts derived from it')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('--   ppiq_meta     product configuration, definitions, governance and logs')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('--')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('-- Idempotent: every move is guarded on the object still being where it was,')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('-- so a second replay moves nothing and fails nothing.')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('-- ============================================================================')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS ppiq_staging;')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS ppiq_plant;')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS ppiq_meta;')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('DO $$')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('DECLARE')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('    moved integer := 0;')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('    converged integer := 0;')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('    absent integer := 0;')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('BEGIN')
    foreach ($m in ($moving | Sort-Object old_schema, table)) {
        $line = "    IF to_regclass('{0}.{1}') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('{2}.{1}') IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ambiguous: {1} exists in both {0} and {2}'; ELSIF to_regclass('{0}.{1}') IS NOT NULL THEN ALTER TABLE {0}.{1} SET SCHEMA {2}; moved := moved + 1; ELSIF to_regclass('{2}.{1}') IS NOT NULL THEN converged := converged + 1; ELSE absent := absent + 1; END IF;" -f $m.old_schema, $m.table, $m.target_schema
        [void]$sql.AppendLine($line)
    }
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('    RAISE NOTICE ''three schema topology: % moved, % already converged, % absent'', moved, converged, absent;')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('END $$;')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('-- The legacy schemas are emptied by the moves above and are retired here.')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS dump_store CASCADE;')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS acquisition CASCADE;')
    [void]$sql.AppendLine('DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS canon CASCADE;')

    Write-NoBom -Path $convAbs -Text $sql.ToString()
    [void]$script:Created.Add($convAbs)
    $entryCount = ([regex]::Matches($sql.ToString(), 'SET SCHEMA')).Count
    if ($entryCount -ne $moving.Count) {
        Invoke-Rollback ("convergence has {0} move entries, the assignment declares {1}." -f $entryCount, $moving.Count)
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok ("created: {0}  ({1} move entries, matching the assignment)" -f $convRel, $entryCount)

    # ============================================ PHASE 4 - LEDGER EDITS ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 4 - LEDGER EDITS  [MUTATION]'

    # The recorded line number is evidence, not the anchor. Lines shift for reasons
    # that have nothing to do with this change, and a line-anchored patch fails on
    # a file that is perfectly patchable. The contract is the token count: for each
    # file and reference, the number of exact qualified occurrences present now must
    # equal the number the ledger recorded. Equal means patch all of them; unequal
    # means stop before touching anything.
    $groups = @($edits | Group-Object { $_.file + '|' + $_.old_reference + '|' + $_.target_reference })
    Write-Inf ("{0} edit group(s) across {1} file(s)" -f $groups.Count, $editFiles.Count)

    $mismatch = @()
    $plan = @()
    foreach ($grp in $groups) {
        $parts = $grp.Name -split '\|'
        $rel = $parts[0]; $oldRef = $parts[1]; $newRef = $parts[2]
        $abs = Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($rel -replace '/', '\')
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $abs)) { $mismatch += ("{0}: file absent" -f $rel); continue }

        $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($abs)
        $rxTok = [regex]('(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.])' + [regex]::Escape($oldRef) + '(?![A-Za-z0-9_])')
        $actual = $rxTok.Matches($text).Count
        $expected = $grp.Count

        if ($actual -ne $expected) {
            $mismatch += ("{0}  {1} -> {2}   expected {3}, found {4}" -f $rel, $oldRef, $newRef, $expected, $actual)
            continue
        }
        $plan += [PSCustomObject]@{ File = $rel; Abs = $abs; Old = $oldRef; New = $newRef; Count = $expected; Rx = $rxTok }
    }

    if ($mismatch.Count -gt 0) {
        foreach ($m in ($mismatch | Select-Object -First 20)) { Write-Bad $m }
        Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'occurrence_mismatch.txt') -Text (($mismatch -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
        Write-Warn 'Occurrence counts disagree with the ledger. Failing before any mutation.'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok ("{0} group(s) verified by occurrence count, no mutation yet" -f $plan.Count)

    $applied = 0
    $byFileGroups = @($plan | Group-Object File)
    foreach ($fg in $byFileGroups) {
        $abs = $fg.Group[0].Abs
        $raw = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($abs)
        $bom = Test-HasBom $abs
        $out = $raw
        foreach ($pl in $fg.Group) {
            $out = $pl.Rx.Replace($out, $pl.New)
            $applied += $pl.Count
        }
        Write-Preserving -Path $abs -Text $out -HadBom $bom
    }

    foreach ($fg in $byFileGroups) {
        $abs = $fg.Group[0].Abs
        $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($abs)
        foreach ($pl in $fg.Group) {
            if ($pl.Rx.Matches($text).Count -ne 0) {
                Invoke-Rollback ("{0} still contains {1} after patching." -f $pl.File, $pl.Old)
                exit 3
            }
        }
    }
    Write-Ok ("{0} reference(s) qualified across {1} file(s), zero old references remain" -f $applied, $byFileGroups.Count)

    # ================================================== PHASE 5 - VIEWS =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 5 - READ-MODEL VIEWS INTO ppiq_plant  [MUTATION]'

    $viewsAbs = Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($viewsRel -replace '/', '\')
    $vRaw = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($viewsAbs)
    $vEol = Get-DominantEol $vRaw
    $vBom = Test-HasBom $viewsAbs
    $v = $vRaw

    $viewNames = @()
    foreach ($m in ([regex]'(?is)\bCREATE\s+(?:OR\s+REPLACE\s+)?VIEW\s+(?:public\.)?([A-Za-z0-9_]+)').Matches($v)) {
        if ($viewNames -notcontains $m.Groups[1].Value) { $viewNames += $m.Groups[1].Value }
    }
    if ($viewNames.Count -eq 0) { Invoke-Rollback 'no view declaration found in the view authority.'; exit 3 }
    Write-Inf ("{0} view(s) declared: {1}" -f $viewNames.Count, ($viewNames -join ', '))

    # Qualify every moved table the views read. View names are protected first so
    # a view is never mistaken for a table.
    $protect = @{}
    $n = 0
    foreach ($vn in $viewNames) {
        $n++
        $tok = "__PPIQVIEW${n}__"
        $protect[$tok] = $vn
        $v = [regex]::Replace($v, ('(?i)(?<![\w.])(public\.)?' + [regex]::Escape($vn) + '(?![\w])'), $tok)
    }

    $qualified = 0
    foreach ($a in ($assign | Sort-Object { $_.table.Length } -Descending)) {
        $pat = '(?i)(?<![\w.])(' + [regex]::Escape($a.old_schema) + '\.)?' + [regex]::Escape($a.table) + '(?![\w])'
        $rep = $a.target_schema + '.' + $a.table
        $before = $v
        $v = [regex]::Replace($v, $pat, $rep)
        if ($v -ne $before) { $qualified++ }
    }

    foreach ($tok in $protect.Keys) {
        $v = $v.Replace($tok, ('ppiq_plant.' + $protect[$tok]))
    }
    $v = [regex]::Replace($v, '(?i)\bCREATE\s+SCHEMA\s+IF\s+NOT\s+EXISTS\s+ppiq_plant\s*;', '')
    $v = "-- Read-model views live in ppiq_plant and read the three schema topology." + "`n" +
         "-- Applied after the convergence SQL, which is the last schema authority." + "`n`n" + $v

    if ($vEol -eq 'CRLF') { $v = ($v -replace "`r`n", "`n").Replace("`n", "`r`n") }
    Write-Preserving -Path $viewsAbs -Text $v -HadBom $vBom
    Write-Ok ("{0} view(s) moved to ppiq_plant, {1} table reference group(s) qualified" -f $viewNames.Count, $qualified)

    # ============================================= PHASE 6 - EF MAPPINGS ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 6 - EF TABLE SCHEMAS  [MUTATION]'

    $infraDir = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure'
    $csFiles = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $infraDir -Recurse -File -Filter '*.cs' |
                 Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\(bin|obj|Migrations)\\' })

    $efApplied = 0; $efFiles = @{}
    foreach ($f in $csFiles) {
        $raw = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($f.FullName)
        $eol = Get-DominantEol $raw
        $bom = Test-HasBom $f.FullName
        $out = $raw
        foreach ($e in $efMoves) {
            $tgt = $e.target_schema
            $excl = ''
            if ($e.table -eq 'ppiq_definition_versions') { $excl = ', t => t.ExcludeFromMigrations()' }
            $pat = '(?i)\.ToTable\(\s*"' + [regex]::Escape($e.table) + '"\s*\)'
            $rep = '.ToTable("' + $e.table + '", "' + $tgt + '"' + $excl + ')'
            $before = $out
            $out = [regex]::Replace($out, $pat, $rep)
            if ($out -ne $before) { $efApplied++ }
        }
        if ($out -ne $raw) {
            $rel = $f.FullName.Substring($RepoRootFull.Length + 1).Replace('\', '/')
            if (-not $script:Backups.ContainsKey($rel)) {
                $dst = Join-Path $bk ("EF_{0}" -f (Split-Path -Leaf $rel))
                Copy-Item -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Destination $dst -Force
                $script:Backups[$rel] = $dst
            }
            Write-Preserving -Path $f.FullName -Text $out -HadBom $bom
            $efFiles[$rel] = $true
        }
    }
    Write-Ok ("{0} EF table mapping(s) given a schema across {1} file(s)" -f $efApplied, $efFiles.Count)
    if ($efApplied -lt $efMoves.Count) {
        Write-Warn ("{0} EF-owned table(s) had no ToTable call to update; they may already carry a schema" -f ($efMoves.Count - $efApplied))
    }

    # ========================================= PHASE 7 - STAGING CONFIG =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 7 - STAGING CONFIGURATION  [MUTATION]'

    $cfgApplied = 0
    $cfgTargets = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend') -Recurse -File -Include '*.cs', '*.json' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
                    Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\(bin|obj)\\' })
    $cfgTargets += @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'env') -Recurse -File -Filter '*.env' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)

    # Scripts that are not on the canonical path are history. 130 is
    # DeferredWithReason and is never replayed, so rewriting it changes nothing a
    # build will ever execute and dirties a file for no reason.
    $onPath = @{}
    $mPre = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($manifestRel -replace '/', '\')) -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    foreach ($st in $mPre.canonicalPath) { $onPath[$st.path] = $true }

    foreach ($f in $cfgTargets) {
        $relCfg = $f.FullName.Substring($RepoRootFull.Length + 1).Replace('\', '/')
        if ($relCfg -match '(?i)^Backend/database/' -and -not $onPath.ContainsKey($relCfg)) {
            continue
        }
        $raw = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($f.FullName)
        if ($raw -notmatch '(?i)dump_store') { continue }
        $bom = Test-HasBom $f.FullName
        $out = [regex]::Replace($raw, '(?i)"dump_store"', '"ppiq_staging"')
        $out = [regex]::Replace($out, "(?i)'dump_store'", "'ppiq_staging'")
        $out = [regex]::Replace($out, '(?im)^(\s*Prep:StagingSchema\s*=\s*)dump_store\s*$', '${1}ppiq_staging')
        if ($out -ne $raw) {
            $rel = $f.FullName.Substring($RepoRootFull.Length + 1).Replace('\', '/')
            if (-not $script:Backups.ContainsKey($rel)) {
                $dst = Join-Path $bk ("CFG_{0}" -f (Split-Path -Leaf $rel))
                Copy-Item -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Destination $dst -Force
                $script:Backups[$rel] = $dst
            }
            Write-Preserving -Path $f.FullName -Text $out -HadBom $bom
            $cfgApplied++
            Write-Ok ("staging default updated: {0}" -f $rel)
        }
    }
    if ($cfgApplied -eq 0) { Write-Warn 'no dump_store literal or default found to update.' }

    # ================================================= PHASE 8 - BUILD =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 8 - BUILD'

    $running = @(Get-Process -Name 'PlantProcess.Api' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
    if ($running.Count -gt 0) { $running | Stop-Process -Force; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }

    $bl = Join-Path $ev 'build.log'
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    & dotnet build $apiCsproj --nologo -v:minimal 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $bl | Out-Null
    $bc = $LASTEXITCODE
    $ErrorActionPreference = $prev
    if ($bc -ne 0) {
        $errs = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $bl | Where-Object { $_ -match ': error ' })
        foreach ($e in ($errs | Select-Object -First 15)) { Write-Host "         $e" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Invoke-Rollback 'the backend does not build with the topology applied.'
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok 'backend builds'

    Write-Head 'PHASE 8b - EF MIGRATION'
    $efVersion = ''
    foreach ($c in @($infraCsproj, $apiCsproj)) {
        $m = [regex]::Match([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($c), '(?i)Include="Microsoft\.EntityFrameworkCore(?:\.Design|\.Relational)?"\s+Version="([^"]+)"')
        if ($m.Success) { $efVersion = $m.Groups[1].Value; break }
    }
    if (-not $efVersion) { Invoke-Rollback 'could not read the EF version from the projects.'; exit 3 }

    $efToolDir = Join-Path $ev 'ef-tool'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $efToolDir -Force | Out-Null
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    & dotnet tool install --tool-path $efToolDir dotnet-ef --version $efVersion 2>&1 | Out-Null
    $ErrorActionPreference = $prev
    $efExe = Join-Path $efToolDir 'dotnet-ef.exe'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $efExe)) { Invoke-Rollback "could not install dotnet-ef $efVersion"; exit 3 }
    Write-Ok "dotnet-ef $efVersion ready"

    $migName = 'ThreeSchemaTopology'
    $migLog = Join-Path $ev 'ef-migration-add.log'

    # migrations add is a design-time command: it constructs the DbContext and the
    # factory refuses without a connection string. It is pointed at the probe name,
    # which does not exist yet, so scaffolding cannot reach a live database.
    $env:ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb =
        ("Host={0};Port={1};Database={2};Username={3};Password={4}" -f $pg.Host, $pg.Port, $ProbeDatabase, $pg.User, $pg.Password)

    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    & $efExe migrations add $migName --project $infraCsproj --startup-project $apiCsproj --no-build --no-color 2>&1 |
        Tee-Object -FilePath $migLog | Out-Null
    $mc = $LASTEXITCODE
    $ErrorActionPreference = $prev
    $env:ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb = ''
    if ($mc -ne 0) {
        Get-Content -LiteralPath $migLog -Tail 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Invoke-Rollback 'EF migration could not be created.'
        exit 3
    }
    $newMigs = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure\Migrations') -File -Filter ("*_" + $migName + "*"))
    foreach ($nm in $newMigs) { [void]$script:Created.Add($nm.FullName) }
    $snap = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure\Migrations\PlantProcessDbContextModelSnapshot.cs'
    if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $snap) -and -not $script:Backups.ContainsKey('Backend/PlantProcess.Infrastructure/Migrations/PlantProcessDbContextModelSnapshot.cs')) {
        Write-Warn 'the model snapshot changed and is not backed up; it is regenerated by EF and will be staged.'
    }
    Write-Ok ("EF migration added: {0} file(s)" -f $newMigs.Count)

    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    & dotnet build $apiCsproj --nologo -v:minimal 2>&1 | Out-Null
    $bc2 = $LASTEXITCODE
    $ErrorActionPreference = $prev
    if ($bc2 -ne 0) { Invoke-Rollback 'the backend does not build after the migration was added.'; exit 3 }
    Write-Ok 'backend builds with the migration'

    # ======================================== PHASE 9 - FRESH BUILD PROOF ===
    Write-Head 'PHASE 9 - FRESH BUILD AND TOPOLOGY PROOF'

    $work = Join-Path $ev 'probe'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $work -Force | Out-Null
    $freshLog = Join-Path $ev 'freshbuild.log'

    function Invoke-Sql {
        param([string]$Db, [string]$File, [switch]$Tuples)
        $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
        try {
            if ($Tuples) { $raw = & psql -A -t -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h $pg.Host -p $pg.Port -U $pg.User -d $Db -f $File 2>&1 }
            else         { $raw = & psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h $pg.Host -p $pg.Port -U $pg.User -d $Db -f $File 2>&1 }
            $c = $LASTEXITCODE
            $l = @($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString().TrimEnd() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
            Add-Content -LiteralPath $freshLog -Value $l
            return @{ Code = $c; Lines = $l }
        } finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
    }

    $create = Join-Path $work '00_create.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $create -Text ("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $ProbeDatabase WITH (FORCE);`r`nCREATE DATABASE $ProbeDatabase;")
    if ((Invoke-Sql -Db 'postgres' -File $create).Code -ne 0) { Invoke-Rollback 'could not create the probe database.'; exit 3 }
    $script:ProbeMade = $true
    Write-Ok "probe created: $ProbeDatabase"

    $env:ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb = ("Host={0};Port={1};Database={2};Username={3};Password={4}" -f $pg.Host, $pg.Port, $ProbeDatabase, $pg.User, $pg.Password)
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    & $efExe database update --project $infraCsproj --startup-project $apiCsproj --no-build --no-color 2>&1 |
        Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $ev 'ef-update.log') | Out-Null
    $uc = $LASTEXITCODE
    $ErrorActionPreference = $prev
    $env:ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb = ''
    if ($uc -ne 0) {
        Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $ev 'ef-update.log') -Tail 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Invoke-Rollback 'the EF baseline did not apply to the probe.'
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok 'EF baseline applied'

    $manifestAbs = Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($manifestRel -replace '/', '\')
    $manifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath $manifestAbs -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $replayed = 0
    foreach ($step in $manifest.canonicalPath) {
        $abs = Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($step.path -replace '/', '\')
        $r = Invoke-Sql -Db $ProbeDatabase -File $abs
        if ($r.Code -ne 0) {
            Write-Bad ("canonical path failed at {0}" -f $step.path)
            $r.Lines | Select-Object -Last 8 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
            Invoke-Rollback 'the canonical path no longer replays.'
            exit 3
        }
        $replayed++
    }
    Write-Ok ("canonical path replayed: {0} script(s)" -f $replayed)

    $r = Invoke-Sql -Db $ProbeDatabase -File $convAbs
    if ($r.Code -ne 0) {
        $r.Lines | Select-Object -Last 10 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Invoke-Rollback 'the convergence SQL failed.'
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok 'convergence applied'

    $r2 = Invoke-Sql -Db $ProbeDatabase -File $convAbs
    if ($r2.Code -ne 0) { Invoke-Rollback 'the convergence SQL is not idempotent.'; exit 3 }
    Write-Ok 'convergence is idempotent on a second replay'

    $r = Invoke-Sql -Db $ProbeDatabase -File $viewsAbs
    if ($r.Code -ne 0) {
        $r.Lines | Select-Object -Last 10 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Invoke-Rollback 'the read-model views failed to create over the new topology.'
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok 'read-model views created'

    $rule2 = Join-Path $work 'rule2.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $rule2 -Text @'
SELECT n.nspname, count(*)
FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','v')
  AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg\_%' AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema'
GROUP BY n.nspname ORDER BY n.nspname;
'@
    $topo = Invoke-Sql -Db $ProbeDatabase -File $rule2 -Tuples
    if ($topo.Code -ne 0) { Invoke-Rollback 'could not read the resulting topology.'; exit 3 }
    Write-Head 'RESULTING TOPOLOGY'
    foreach ($l in $topo.Lines) { Write-Host "         $l" -ForegroundColor DarkGray }

    $leftover = Join-Path $work 'leftover.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $leftover -Text @'
SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relkind = 'r'
  AND c.relname NOT IN ('__EFMigrationsHistory','schema_migrations')
ORDER BY 1;
'@
    $left = Invoke-Sql -Db $ProbeDatabase -File $leftover -Tuples
    if ($left.Code -ne 0) { Invoke-Rollback 'could not check for leftover public tables.'; exit 3 }
    if ($left.Lines.Count -gt 0) {
        foreach ($l in ($left.Lines | Select-Object -First 20)) { Write-Bad ("still in public: {0}" -f $l) }
        Invoke-Rollback ("{0} product table(s) remain in public." -f $left.Lines.Count)
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok 'product tables remaining in public: 0'

    $legacy = Join-Path $work 'legacy.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $legacy -Text "SELECT nspname FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname IN ('acquisition','canon','dump_store');"
    $lg = Invoke-Sql -Db $ProbeDatabase -File $legacy -Tuples
    if ($lg.Lines.Count -gt 0) {
        foreach ($l in $lg.Lines) { Write-Bad ("legacy schema survives: {0}" -f $l) }
        Invoke-Rollback 'a legacy schema was not retired.'
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok 'legacy schemas retired: acquisition, canon, dump_store'

    $drop = Join-Path $work '99_drop.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $drop -Text "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $ProbeDatabase WITH (FORCE);"
    Invoke-Sql -Db 'postgres' -File $drop | Out-Null
    $script:ProbeMade = $false
    Write-Ok 'probe database dropped'


    # ====================================== PHASE 9b - ORACLE REGRESSION ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 9b - MIGRATED ORACLE CLONE'
    Write-Inf 'The frozen oracle is re-run across the convergence. No frozen asset is touched.'

    $oracleProbe = 'ppiq_oracle_clone_probe'
    $harness  = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\tools\phenomenon_harness.py'
    $manifestCsv = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'docs\m1\phenomena\manifest.csv'
    foreach ($f in @($harness, $manifestCsv)) { if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { Invoke-Rollback "frozen oracle asset missing: $f"; exit 3 } }
    if (-not (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Invoke-Rollback 'python is not on PATH; the oracle cannot be re-run.'; exit 3 }

    $ow = Join-Path $ev 'oracle'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ow -Force | Out-Null
    $phen = @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $manifestCsv)
    if ($phen.Count -eq 0) { Invoke-Rollback 'the phenomena manifest declares nothing.'; exit 3 }

    $cloneSql = Join-Path $ow 'clone.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $cloneSql -Text ("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $oracleProbe WITH (FORCE);`r`nCREATE DATABASE $oracleProbe TEMPLATE ppiq_presentation;")
    $cl = Invoke-Sql -Db 'postgres' -File $cloneSql
    if ($cl.Code -ne 0) {
        $cl.Lines | Select-Object -Last 6 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Invoke-Rollback 'could not clone the frozen oracle. Close any session on ppiq_presentation and re-run.'
        exit 3
    }
    $script:OracleMade = $true
    Write-Ok "frozen oracle cloned into $oracleProbe (ppiq_presentation untouched)"

    function Invoke-Oracle {
        param([string]$Tag)
        $dir = Join-Path $ow $Tag
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null
        foreach ($row in $phen) {
            $q = $row.population_query
            $probe = ($q -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
            if ($probe -notmatch '^(?i)SELECT\s') { Invoke-Rollback "phenomenon $($row.phenomenon_id): not a SELECT."; exit 3 }
            $qf = Join-Path $dir ($row.phenomenon_id + '.sql')
            Write-NoBom -Path $qf -Text $q
            $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
            $raw = & psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --csv -q -h $pg.Host -p $pg.Port -U $pg.User -d $oracleProbe -f $qf 2>&1
            $c = $LASTEXITCODE
            $ErrorActionPreference = $prev
            if ($c -ne 0) {
                @($raw) | Select-Object -Last 5 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
                Invoke-Rollback "phenomenon $($row.phenomenon_id) could not run $Tag convergence."
                exit 3
            }
            Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $dir ($row.phenomenon_id + '.csv')) -Text ((@($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
        }
        $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
        $out = & python $harness --manifest $manifestCsv --datadir $dir 2>&1
        $ErrorActionPreference = $prev
        $lines = @($out | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString().TrimEnd() })
        Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ow ($Tag + '_verdicts.txt')) -Text (($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
        $v = @{}
        foreach ($l in $lines) {
            if ($l -match '^\s*(\S+)\s+(PASS|FAIL|INSUFFICIENT|ERROR)\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)') {
                if ($Matches[1] -eq 'phenomenon_id') { continue }
                $v[$Matches[1]] = ("{0}|{1}|{2}" -f $Matches[2], $Matches[3], $Matches[4])
            }
        }
        return $v
    }

    $before = Invoke-Oracle -Tag 'before'
    if ($before.Count -eq 0) { Invoke-Rollback 'the oracle produced no verdict before convergence.'; exit 3 }
    Write-Ok ("before convergence: {0} verdict(s)" -f $before.Count)
    foreach ($k in ($before.Keys | Sort-Object)) { Write-Host ("         {0,-46} {1}" -f $k, $before[$k]) -ForegroundColor DarkGray }

    $cv = Invoke-Sql -Db $oracleProbe -File $convAbs
    if ($cv.Code -ne 0) {
        $cv.Lines | Select-Object -Last 10 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Invoke-Rollback 'the convergence failed on the oracle clone.'
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok 'convergence applied to the oracle clone'

    # Disposable read-only shims, on the clone only, so the frozen queries keep
    # their original public.* names. Never product, never committed.
    $shimSql = Join-Path $ow 'shims.sql'
    $shim = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
    [void]$shim.AppendLine('-- disposable, clone only, never product')
    foreach ($m in ($moving | Sort-Object table)) {
        [void]$shim.AppendLine(("CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.{0} AS SELECT * FROM {1}.{0};" -f $m.table, $m.target_schema))
    }
    Write-NoBom -Path $shimSql -Text $shim.ToString()
    $sh = Invoke-Sql -Db $oracleProbe -File $shimSql
    if ($sh.Code -ne 0) {
        $sh.Lines | Select-Object -Last 10 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Invoke-Rollback 'the disposable shim views could not be created on the clone.'
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok 'disposable shim views created on the clone'

    $after = Invoke-Oracle -Tag 'after'
    if ($after.Count -eq 0) { Invoke-Rollback 'the oracle produced no verdict after convergence.'; exit 3 }

    $drift = @()
    foreach ($k in ($before.Keys | Sort-Object)) {
        $b = $before[$k]
        $a = 'MISSING'
        if ($after.ContainsKey($k)) { $a = $after[$k] }
        if ($a -ne $b) { $drift += ("{0}`r`n    before: {1}`r`n    after : {2}" -f $k, $b, $a) }
        else { Write-Ok ("unchanged across the move: {0,-46} {1}" -f $k, $b) }
    }
    foreach ($k in ($after.Keys | Sort-Object)) {
        if (-not $before.ContainsKey($k)) { $drift += ("{0}: appeared only after convergence" -f $k) }
    }

    if ($drift.Count -gt 0) {
        foreach ($d in $drift) { Write-Bad $d }
        Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ow 'DRIFT.txt') -Text (($drift -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
        Invoke-Rollback 'the migration altered the reference dataset. A verdict changed, in either direction.'
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok ("oracle regression clean: {0} phenomenon/phenomena identical before and after" -f $before.Count)

    $dropOracle = Join-Path $ow 'drop.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $dropOracle -Text "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $oracleProbe WITH (FORCE);"
    Invoke-Sql -Db 'postgres' -File $dropOracle | Out-Null
    $script:OracleMade = $false
    Write-Ok 'oracle clone dropped'

    # ============================================== PHASE 10 - MANIFEST ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 10 - MIGRATION AUTHORITY MANIFEST  [MUTATION]'

    $mJson = Get-Content -LiteralPath $manifestAbs -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $lastNonView = 0
    foreach ($s in $mJson.canonicalPath) { if ($s.path -notmatch '(?i)^Backend/database/views/') { if ($s.position -gt $lastNonView) { $lastNonView = $s.position } } }

    $newPath = @()
    foreach ($s in $mJson.canonicalPath) {
        if ($s.position -eq ($lastNonView + 1)) {
            $newPath += [ordered]@{
                position = $lastNonView + 1; ordinal = $ordinal; path = $convRel
                disposition = 'Canonical'
                sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $convAbs -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
                createsTables = @()
            }
        }
        $entry = [ordered]@{
            position = $s.position; ordinal = $s.ordinal; path = $s.path
            disposition = $s.disposition; sha256 = $s.sha256; createsTables = $s.createsTables
        }
        if ($s.position -gt $lastNonView) { $entry.position = $s.position + 1 }
        if ($s.path -eq $viewsRel) { $entry.sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $viewsAbs -Algorithm SHA256).Hash }
        $newPath += $entry
    }
    if (@($newPath | Where-Object { $_.path -eq $convRel }).Count -eq 0) {
        $newPath += [ordered]@{
            position = $newPath.Count + 1; ordinal = $ordinal; path = $convRel
            disposition = 'Canonical'; sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $convAbs -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
            createsTables = @()
        }
    }

    $mJson.canonicalPath = $newPath
    $mJson | Add-Member -NotePropertyName 'schemaTopology' -NotePropertyValue ([ordered]@{
        note = 'The convergence SQL is the last schema authority. Views apply after it.'
        schemas = @('ppiq_staging', 'ppiq_plant', 'ppiq_meta')
        convergenceScript = $convRel
        movedObjects = $moving.Count
    }) -Force

    Write-NoBom -Path $manifestAbs -Text ($mJson | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8)
    Write-Ok 'manifest updated with the convergence script and the topology section'

    # ================================================== PHASE 11 - GATE ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 11 - TOPOLOGY GATE  [MUTATION]'

    $gateAbs = Join-Path $RepoRootFull ($gateRel -replace '/', '\')
    $gRaw = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($gateAbs)
    $gEol = Get-DominantEol $gRaw
    $gBom = Test-HasBom $gateAbs
    $g = $gRaw -replace "`r`n", "`n"

    $anchor = '    private static JsonDocument Load()'
    if (([regex]::Matches($g, [regex]::Escape($anchor))).Count -ne 1) {
        Invoke-Rollback 'gate anchor not found exactly once.'
        exit 3
    }

    $newTests = @'
    [Fact]
    public void The_convergence_script_is_the_last_schema_authority()
    {
        using var manifest = Load();
        var topology = manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("schemaTopology");
        var convergence = topology.GetProperty("convergenceScript").GetString()!;

        var convergencePosition = 0;
        var lastSchemaPosition = 0;
        var firstViewPosition = int.MaxValue;

        foreach (var step in manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("canonicalPath").EnumerateArray())
        {
            var path = step.GetProperty("path").GetString()!;
            var position = step.GetProperty("position").GetInt32();

            if (path == convergence)
            {
                convergencePosition = position;
            }
            else if (path.StartsWith("Backend/database/views/", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                firstViewPosition = Math.Min(firstViewPosition, position);
            }
            else
            {
                lastSchemaPosition = Math.Max(lastSchemaPosition, position);
            }
        }

        Assert.True(convergencePosition > 0, "The convergence script is not on the canonical path.");

        Assert.True(
            convergencePosition > lastSchemaPosition,
            "The convergence script must run after every schema script, or it moves objects that do not exist yet.");

        Assert.True(
            convergencePosition < firstViewPosition,
            "Read-model views must be created after the convergence, or they bind to the old topology.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_topology_declares_the_three_ruled_schemas()
    {
        using var manifest = Load();
        var schemas = manifest.RootElement.GetProperty("schemaTopology").GetProperty("schemas")
            .EnumerateArray().Select(s => s.GetString()).ToList();

        Assert.Contains("ppiq_staging", schemas);
        Assert.Contains("ppiq_plant", schemas);
        Assert.Contains("ppiq_meta", schemas);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void No_runtime_source_still_names_a_retired_schema()
    {
        var root = FindRepositoryRoot();
        var offenders = new List<string>();

        var retired = new[] { "du" + "mp_store.", "acquisi" + "tion.", "ca" + "non." };

        foreach (var project in new[] { "PlantProcess.Api", "PlantProcess.Application", "PlantProcess.Infrastructure", "PlantProcess.Workers" })
        {
            var directory = Path.Combine(root, "Backend", project);

            if (!Directory.Exists(directory))
            {
                continue;
            }

            foreach (var file in Directory.EnumerateFiles(directory, "*.cs", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
            {
                if (file.Contains(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "bin" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
                    file.Contains(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "obj" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                var text = File.ReadAllText(file);

                foreach (var token in retired)
                {
                    if (text.Contains(token, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        offenders.Add(file.Substring(root.Length + 1).Replace('\\', '/') + " -> " + token);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Assert.True(
            offenders.Count == 0,
            "Runtime source still names a retired schema. Those schemas no longer exist after convergence:" +
            Environment.NewLine + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, offenders.Take(25)));
    }

    private static JsonDocument Load()
'@

    $g = $g.Replace($anchor, $newTests)
    if ($gEol -eq 'CRLF') { $g = $g.Replace("`n", "`r`n") }
    Write-Preserving -Path $gateAbs -Text $g -HadBom $gBom
    Write-Ok '3 topology assertion(s) added to the gate'

    if (-not $SkipTests) {
        $tstp = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests.csproj'
        $tl = Join-Path $ev 'gate.log'
        $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
        & dotnet test $tstp --filter "Gate=CanonicalMigrationOrder" --nologo 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $tl | Out-Null
        $tc = $LASTEXITCODE
        $ErrorActionPreference = $prev
        if ($tc -ne 0) {
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl -Tail 30 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
            Invoke-Rollback 'the migration authority gate is not green.'
            exit 3
        }
        $tt = Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl -Raw
        if ($tt -notmatch 'Passed!' -and $tt -notmatch 'Passed:\s*[1-9]') { Invoke-Rollback 'the gate executed no assertions.'; exit 3 }
        Write-Ok 'gate green with executed assertions'
    }

    # ============================================ PHASE 12 - EXACT STAGING ==
    Write-Head 'PHASE 12 - EXACT STAGING  [MUTATION]'

    $toStage = @()
    foreach ($rel in $script:Backups.Keys) { $toStage += $rel }
    $toStage += $convRel
    foreach ($nm in $newMigs) { $toStage += $nm.FullName.Substring($RepoRootFull.Length + 1).Replace('\', '/') }
    $toStage += 'Backend/PlantProcess.Infrastructure/Migrations/PlantProcessDbContextModelSnapshot.cs'
    $toStage = @($toStage | Sort-Object -Unique)

    foreach ($p in $toStage) {
        $ar = Invoke-Git @('add', '--', $p)
        if ($ar.Code -ne 0) { Invoke-Rollback "git add failed: $p"; exit 3 }
        [void]$script:Staged.Add($p)
    }
    Write-Ok ("{0} path(s) staged" -f $toStage.Count)

    $ca = (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).Text.TrimEnd()
    $list = @(); if ($ca) { $list = @($ca -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim().Trim('"') }) }
    $extra = @($list | Where-Object { $toStage -notcontains $_ })
    if ($extra.Count -gt 0) {
        foreach ($x in $extra) { Write-Bad "unintended staged path: $x" }
        Invoke-Rollback 'the index contains a path this pack did not declare.'
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok ("index equals the declared set ({0} file(s))" -f $list.Count)
    Write-Host ''
    (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--stat')).Text -split "`r?`n" | Select-Object -Last 12 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" -ForegroundColor Gray }

    Write-Head 'CLOSURE'
    $report = @()
    $report += 'THREE SCHEMA TOPOLOGY'
    $report += ("  baseline commit        : {0}" -f $head)
    $report += ("  objects moved          : {0}  ({1} script-owned, {2} EF-owned)" -f $moving.Count, $scriptMoves.Count, $efMoves.Count)
    $report += ("  convergence script     : {0}" -f $convRel)
    $report += ("  source references      : {0} qualified across {1} file(s)" -f $applied, $editFiles.Count)
    $report += ("  EF mappings            : {0}" -f $efApplied)
    $report += ("  staging configuration  : {0} file(s)" -f $cfgApplied)
    $report += ("  views                  : {0} moved to ppiq_plant" -f $viewNames.Count)
    $report += '  fresh build            : EXECUTED, convergence idempotent, views created'
    $report += '  product tables public  : 0'
    $report += '  legacy schemas         : retired'
    $report += ("  oracle regression      : {0} phenomenon/phenomena identical before and after" -f $before.Count)
    $report += ("  files staged           : {0}" -f $list.Count)
    $report += ("  evidence               : {0}" -f $ev)
    Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'CLOSURE.txt') -Text (($report -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
    Write-Host ''
    foreach ($r in $report) { Write-Host "  $r" -ForegroundColor White }
    Write-Head 'COMMIT'
    $cm = Invoke-Git @('commit', '-m', 'Move the product onto the three ruled schemas')
    if ($cm.Code -ne 0) {
        Write-Bad $cm.Text
        Invoke-Rollback 'the commit failed.'
        exit 3
    }
    $newHead = (Invoke-Git @('rev-parse', '--short', 'HEAD')).Text.Trim()
    $stillStaged = (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).Text.Trim()
    if ($stillStaged) { Write-Bad 'the index is not empty after commit.'; exit 3 }
    Write-Ok "committed: $newHead"
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host ("  T-087 CLOSED at {0}" -f $newHead) -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host ''
    exit 0
}
finally {
    if (Test-Path Env:PGPASSWORD) { $env:PGPASSWORD = '' }
    if (Test-Path Env:ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb) { $env:ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb = '' }
    Pop-Location
}

    Permanent artifacts are named for what they do, never for a backlog identifier.
    Task IDs live in this header, in the test Trait metadata, in console output and in

    Guarantees:
      Every run ends in exactly one of two states: APPLY PASS or APPLY FAILED with

      Native commands are wrapped, so a tool writing to stderr can never bypass rollback.
      Only files this pack created are ever removed.

[CmdletBinding()]
param(

function Write-Step { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[GENERICITY] $m" -ForegroundColor Cyan }
function Write-Ok   { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[ OK ] $m" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Bad  { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[FAIL] $m" -ForegroundColor Red }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Native-command wrapper.
#
# With ErrorActionPreference = Stop, a native tool writing to stderr raises a
# terminating NativeCommandError. dotnet test writes xUnit failures to stderr, so
# a red test used to kill this script mid-phase and skip rollback entirely. Every
# external invocation goes through here: preference is relaxed for the call only,
# output is captured and echoed, the exit code is returned as data, and this script
# decides pass or fail.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Invoke-Native {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Exe,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string[]]$Arguments,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$LogPath,
        [switch]$Quiet
    )

    $previous = $ErrorActionPreference
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'

    $captured = $null
    $code = $null

    try {
        $captured = & $Exe @Arguments 2>&1
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    }
    finally {
        $ErrorActionPreference = $previous
    }

    $lines = @($captured | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })
    $lines | Set-Content -LiteralPath $LogPath -Encoding ASCII
    if (-not $Quiet) { $lines | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ } }

    if ($null -eq $code) { $code = 0 }

    return [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $code
        Lines    = $lines
        LogPath  = $LogPath
    }
}

function Stop-WithRollback {
    param([string]$Reason)

    $script:Terminated = $true

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Bad 'APPLY FAILED'
    Write-Bad $Reason
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'rollback executed:'

    $removed = 0
    foreach ($f in $Created) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force
            Write-Host ("  removed  " + $f)
            $removed++
        }
    }

    if ($removed -eq 0) { Write-Host '  nothing had been created yet' }

    Write-Host 'owned created files: removed'
    Write-Host 'foreign changed files: untouched'
    Write-Host 'repository returned to pre-pack state'
    Write-Host ("evidence: " + $EvidenceDir)
    exit 1
}

function Write-AsciiFile {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Content)

    if ([regex]::IsMatch($Content, '[^\x00-\x7F]')) { Stop-WithRollback "ASCII gate: non-ASCII content for $Path" }

    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Content, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    [void]$Created.Add($Path)
}

# --- build-lock guard ---
function Test-PpiqOutputLocked {
    param([string]$Root)

    $candidates = @(
        'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\bin\Debug\net9.0\PlantProcess.Infrastructure.dll',
        'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\bin\Debug\net9.0\PlantProcess.Application.dll',
        'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\bin\Debug\net9.0\PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.dll',
        'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\bin\Debug\net9.0\PlantProcess.Domain.dll'
    )

    $locked = @()
    foreach ($rel in $candidates) {
        $abs = Join-Path $Root $rel
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $abs)) { continue }
        try {
            $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($abs, 'Open', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
            $fs.Close(); $fs.Dispose()
        }
        catch { $locked += $rel }
    }

    return $locked
}

# @() is mandatory: a function returning an empty array unrolls to $null, and under

            # so it is this pack's own residue and safe to remove. Quiet, because raw
            # git 'did not match any file(s)' text beside an [ OK ] reads like a fault.
            $tracked = Invoke-Native -Exe 'git' -Arguments @('ls-files', '--error-unmatch', ($rel -replace '\\', '/')) `
                -LogPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir ('git-tracked-' + (Split-Path -Leaf $rel) + '.log')) -Quiet
        }
        finally { Pop-Location }

        if ($tracked.ExitCode -eq 0) {
            Stop-WithRollback "refusing to delete a git-tracked file: $rel. This is not this pack's residue."
        }

        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $abs -Force
        Write-Ok ("untracked by git, removed legacy artifact: " + $rel)

    $status = Invoke-Native -Exe 'git' -Arguments @('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all') -LogPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'git-status-before.txt') -Quiet
    $ForeignDirtyBefore = @($status.Lines | ForEach-Object { ($_ -replace '^..\s+', '') } | Where-Object { $Owned -notcontains $_ })

$scopeCs = @'
// Scope-aware genericity authority.
//
// Backlog origin: T-206.
//
// This is an architecture gate, not a word filter. A product file is allowed to
// mention several material types in a description precisely in order to privilege
// none of them; that is genericity being asserted, not violated. What is forbidden
// is a CONSTRUCT that bakes one customer's world into the product:
//
//   UA-01 industry identity used as product data
//   UA-02 business logic keyed to one material identity
//   UA-03 silent default grain
//   UA-04 fixed default business parameter or unit system
//   UA-05 typed union that constrains the customer model
//   UA-06 customer schema column treated as universally available
//   UA-07 behaviour inferred from customer vocabulary
//
// Rule validity is proven against synthetic samples, never against real debt in the
// tree. When the vocabulary sweep drives the tree to zero, every rule here still
// works and still blocks regression.
//
// This file classifies itself and its sibling gate files as Excluded: a scanner that
// reads its own definition table reports its own rules as violations.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests;

public enum GenericityScope
{
    ProductGeneric,
    CustomerAsset,
    TestOrFixture,
    Documentation,
    Excluded
}

public sealed class GenericityRule
{
    public GenericityRule(string id, string description, string pattern)
    {
        Id = id;
        Description = description;
        Pattern = new Regex(pattern, RegexOptions.Compiled | RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
    }

    public string Id { get; }
    public string Description { get; }
    public Regex Pattern { get; }
}

// Identity of a violation. Deliberately excludes the physical line number: moving a
// line is not a semantic change, and identity that shifts on reformatting would make
// every grandfathered entry evaporate on the next tidy-up. Line number is human
// evidence and travels beside the fingerprint, never inside it.
public static class GenericityViolationFingerprint
{
    public static string NormaliseConstruct(string matched)
    {
        var s = Regex.Replace(matched.Trim().ToLowerInvariant(), @"\s+", " ");
        if (s.Length > 120) s = s.Substring(0, 120);
        return s;
    }

    public static string Compute(string relativePath, string ruleId, string normalisedConstruct)
    {
        var payload = ScopeAwareGenericity.NormalisePath(relativePath).ToLowerInvariant()
                    + "|" + ruleId + "|" + normalisedConstruct;

        using var sha = SHA256.Create();
        var bytes = sha.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(payload));

        var sb = new StringBuilder(64);
        foreach (var b in bytes) sb.Append(b.ToString("x2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        return sb.ToString();
    }
}

public sealed class GenericityViolation
{
    public GenericityViolation(string relativePath, int line, GenericityRule rule, string construct)
    {
        RelativePath = relativePath;
        Line = line;
        RuleId = rule.Id;
        Construct = GenericityViolationFingerprint.NormaliseConstruct(construct);
        Fingerprint = GenericityViolationFingerprint.Compute(relativePath, rule.Id, Construct);
    }

    public string RelativePath { get; }
    public int Line { get; }            // informational only
    public string RuleId { get; }
    public string Construct { get; }
    public string Fingerprint { get; }
}

public static class ScopeAwareGenericity
{
    private static readonly string[] SelfExcluded =
    {
        "scopeawaregenericity.cs",
        "scopeawaregenericityruletests.cs",
        "genericitybaselinegatetests.cs",
        "genericity_violation_baseline.json",
        "genericityviolationinventory.md"
    };

    private static readonly string[] ProductExtensions = { ".cs", ".ts", ".tsx", ".py" };

    public static IReadOnlyList<GenericityRule> Rules { get; } = new List<GenericityRule>
    {
        new GenericityRule(
            "UA-01",
            "industry equipment identity used as product data",
            "\"\\s*(caster|mill|furnace|kiln|roller)\\s*[-_ ]?\\d+\\s*\""),

        new GenericityRule(
            "UA-02",
            "business logic keyed to one material identity",
            "\\b(coil|heat|slab|billet|ingot)(id|_id|key|number)\\b|\"(coil|heat|slab):\""),

        // The captured construct must include the literal. A pattern that stops at the
        // opening quote cannot tell a hardcoded "coil" default from a hardcoded "heat"
        // one, so swapping them would silently inherit the old fingerprint.
        new GenericityRule(
            "UA-03",
            "silent default grain: a grain resolved to a hardcoded literal instead of failing closed",
            "[a-z0-9_.]*grain\\s*\\?\\?\\s*\"[a-z0-9_-]*\"" +
            "|isnullorwhitespace\\s*\\(\\s*[a-z0-9_.]*grain\\s*\\)\\s*\\?\\s*\"[a-z0-9_-]*\"" +
            "|\\?\\s*\"(coil|heat|slab|batch|lot|piece)\"\\s*:"),

        new GenericityRule(
            "UA-04",
            "fixed default business parameter or unit system",
            "\"[a-z0-9_]*_per_(ton|tonne|kg|lb|pound|bbl)\\b[a-z0-9_]*\"|\\b(grade|coil|heat)_premium\\b"),

        new GenericityRule(
            "UA-05",
            "typed union or enum that constrains the customer model to one industry",
            "\"(coil|heat|slab|cast|billet)\"\\s*\\|\\s*\"(coil|heat|slab|cast|billet|process|batch|lot)\""),

        new GenericityRule(
            "UA-06",
            "customer schema column treated as universally available",
            "\\b(heat_id|coil_id|slab_id|piece_id|material_id|src_heats|src_coils)\\b"),

        new GenericityRule(
            "UA-07",
            "behaviour inferred from customer vocabulary rather than declared metadata",
            "(indexof|contains|startswith|endswith)\\s*\\(\\s*\"(grade|coil|heat|slab|cast)\"")
    };

    public static string RepositoryRoot()
    {
        var dir = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);
        while (dir is not null && !Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(dir.FullName, "Backend"))) dir = dir.Parent;
        if (dir is null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Genericity gate: could not locate the repository root.");
        return dir.FullName;
    }

    public static string NormalisePath(string relativePath) => relativePath.Replace('\\', '/').TrimStart('/');

    public static GenericityScope Classify(string relativePath)
    {
        var p = NormalisePath(relativePath).ToLowerInvariant();
        var name = p.Contains('/') ? p.Substring(p.LastIndexOf('/') + 1) : p;

        if (SelfExcluded.Contains(name)) return GenericityScope.Excluded;
        if (p.Contains("node_modules/") || p.Contains("/bin/") || p.Contains("/obj/") ||
            p.Contains("/dist/") || p.Contains("playwright-report") || p.StartsWith(".git/"))
        {
            return GenericityScope.Excluded;
        }

        if (p.EndsWith(".md") || p.StartsWith("docs/")) return GenericityScope.Documentation;

        if (p.Contains("/tests/") || p.StartsWith("tests/") || p.Contains("__tests__") ||
            p.Contains(".test.") || p.Contains(".spec.") || p.Contains("/e2e/") ||
            p.Contains("/fixtures/") || p.Contains("/_fixtures/"))
        {
            return GenericityScope.TestOrFixture;
        }

        // Emulated-plant dataset generation and repository tooling: one plant's data,
        // legitimately carrying one plant's vocabulary. Product code must not depend on it.
        if (p.StartsWith("tools/") || p.StartsWith("backend/tools/") || p.StartsWith("scripts/"))
        {
            return GenericityScope.CustomerAsset;
        }

        if (p.StartsWith("website/")) return GenericityScope.Excluded;
        if (!ProductExtensions.Contains(Path.GetExtension(p))) return GenericityScope.Excluded;

        return GenericityScope.ProductGeneric;
    }

    // Scans run on comment-stripped text. Prose explaining a forbidden construct must
    // never trip a guard about that construct.
    public static string StripComments(string raw)
    {
        var s = Regex.Replace(raw, @"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", string.Empty);
        s = Regex.Replace(s, @"(?m)^\s*//.*$", string.Empty);
        s = Regex.Replace(s, @"(?m)^\s*--.*$", string.Empty);
        s = Regex.Replace(s, @"(?m)^\s*#.*$", string.Empty);
        return s;
    }

    public static IReadOnlyList<string> ProductGenericFiles(string root)
    {
        var results = new List<string>();

        foreach (var area in new[] { "Backend", "Frontend" })
        {
            var areaPath = Path.Combine(root, area);
            if (!Directory.Exists(areaPath)) continue;

            foreach (var file in Directory.EnumerateFiles(areaPath, "*.*", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
            {
                var rel = NormalisePath(file.Substring(root.Length + 1));
                if (Classify(rel) == GenericityScope.ProductGeneric) results.Add(rel);
            }
        }

        results.Sort(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        return results;
    }

    // Scans arbitrary in-memory text. Every rule is validated through this entry point
    // with synthetic samples, so rule validity never depends on the tree being dirty.
    public static IReadOnlyList<GenericityViolation> ScanText(string relativePath, string rawText)
    {
        var findings = new List<GenericityViolation>();
        if (Classify(relativePath) != GenericityScope.ProductGeneric) return findings;

        var lines = StripComments(rawText).Split('\n');

        for (var i = 0; i < lines.Length; i++)
        {
            foreach (var rule in Rules)
            {
                foreach (Match m in rule.Pattern.Matches(lines[i]))
                {
                    findings.Add(new GenericityViolation(relativePath, i + 1, rule, m.Value));
                }
            }
        }

        return findings;
    }

    public static IReadOnlyList<GenericityViolation> ScanRepository(string root)
    {
        var all = new List<GenericityViolation>();

        foreach (var rel in ProductGenericFiles(root))
        {
            string raw;
            try { raw = File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(root, rel.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar))); }
            catch (IOException) { continue; }
            all.AddRange(ScanText(rel, raw));
        }

        return all;
    }
}

$ruleCs = @'
// Rule validity, proven synthetically.
//
// Backlog origin: T-206.
//
// Every rule is exercised against a positive sample that MUST trigger and a
// neighbouring generic sample that MUST NOT. Validity therefore does not depend on
// the repository still containing debt. After the vocabulary sweep drives the tree
// to zero, these tests are unchanged and still green, and the gate still blocks
// regression.
using System;
using System.Linq;
using Xunit;

namespace PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests;

[Trait("BacklogTask", "T-206")]
public sealed class ScopeAwareGenericityRuleTests
{
    private const string ProductPath = "Backend/PlantProcess.Application/Sample.cs";

    private static bool Triggers(string ruleId, string code)
    {
        return ScopeAwareGenericity.ScanText(ProductPath, code).Any(f => f.RuleId == ruleId);
    }

    public static TheoryData<string, string, string> Samples()
    {
        var data = new TheoryData<string, string, string>();

        // rule, MUST trigger, MUST NOT trigger
        data.Add("UA-01",
            "var rows = new[] { new { equipment = \"Caster 1\" }, new { equipment = \"Mill 1\" } };",
            "var rows = catalogue.ResolveEquipment(request.EquipmentKey);");

        data.Add("UA-02",
            "var handle = inputs.CoilId is null ? null : \"coil:\" + inputs.CoilId;",
            "var handle = inputs.SubjectId is null ? null : subject.Kind + \":\" + inputs.SubjectId;");

        data.Add("UA-03",
            "var grain = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Grain) ? \"coil\" : request.Grain.Trim();",
            "var grain = registry.ResolveGrain(request) ?? throw new GrainUnresolvedException(request);");

        data.Add("UA-04",
            "RequireBand(assumptions.GradePremiumPerTon, \"grade_premium_per_ton\", missing);",
            "RequireBand(assumptions.ValuePerUnit, configuredParameter.Key, missing);");

        data.Add("UA-05",
            "kind: \"coil\" | \"heat\" | \"cast\" | \"slab\" | \"process\" | string;",
            "kind: SubjectKind; // resolved from the customer's declared subject registry");

        data.Add("UA-06",
            "var sql = \"SELECT effective_sample_key, numeric_value, heat_id FROM outcomes\";",
            "var sql = \"SELECT effective_sample_key, numeric_value, \" + stratumColumn + \" FROM outcomes\";");

        data.Add("UA-07",
            "var isGrade = f.FeatureKey.IndexOf(\"grade\", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;",
            "var isStratum = f.FeatureKey.Equals(declared.StratumKey, StringComparison.Ordinal);");

        return data;
    }

    [Theory]
    [MemberData(nameof(Samples))]
    public void Every_rule_fires_on_its_construct_and_stays_silent_on_the_generic_neighbour(
        string ruleId, string mustTrigger, string mustNotTrigger)
    {
        Assert.True(
            Triggers(ruleId, mustTrigger),
            "Genericity gate: rule " + ruleId + " failed to detect its own positive sample. The rule is broken.");

        Assert.False(
            Triggers(ruleId, mustNotTrigger),
            "Genericity gate: rule " + ruleId + " fired on a generic, metadata-driven construct. " +
            "This is an architecture guard, not a word filter, and a false positive here teaches " +
            "the next worker to disable it.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Descriptive_text_that_enumerates_many_industries_is_not_a_violation()
    {
        // The most genericity-affirming line in the dimension registry lists many
        // material types precisely so that none is privileged. A gate that fails this
        // line is measuring the wrong thing.
        const string code =
            "new DimensionDescriptor(\"material_type\", \"Generic material type such as batch, slab, coil, lot, tire, roll or component.\");";

        Assert.Empty(ScopeAwareGenericity.ScanText(ProductPath, code));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Comments_are_stripped_before_scanning()
    {
        const string code =
            "// this comment mentions coil_id and \"Caster 1\"\nvar x = 1; /* and heat_id here */\nvar y = 2;";

        Assert.Empty(ScopeAwareGenericity.ScanText(ProductPath, code));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Scope_classification_is_total_and_separator_insensitive()
    {

        Assert.Equal(GenericityScope.ProductGeneric, ScopeAwareGenericity.Classify("Backend\\PlantProcess.Application\\X.cs"));
        Assert.Equal(GenericityScope.CustomerAsset,  ScopeAwareGenericity.Classify("Backend/tools/emulate_plant.py"));
        Assert.Equal(GenericityScope.TestOrFixture,  ScopeAwareGenericity.Classify("Backend/tests/X/YTests.cs"));
        Assert.Equal(GenericityScope.Documentation,  ScopeAwareGenericity.Classify("docs/quality/x.md"));
        Assert.Equal(GenericityScope.Excluded,       ScopeAwareGenericity.Classify(
            "Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/ScopeAwareGenericity.cs"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Customer_asset_scope_is_never_scanned()
    {
        Assert.Empty(ScopeAwareGenericity.ScanText("Backend/tools/generate_demo.py", "grain = \"coil\""));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_fingerprint_survives_line_movement_and_changes_with_the_construct()
    {
        // The product law this protects: identity must be stable under reformatting and
        // unstable under semantic change. If it were the reverse, a tidy-up would drop
        // every grandfathered entry, or swapping one hardcoded default for another would
        // silently inherit the old one.
        const string original = "var grain = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Grain) ? \"coil\" : request.Grain;";
        const string edited   = "var grain = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Grain) ? \"heat\" : request.Grain;";

        var first  = ScopeAwareGenericity.ScanText(ProductPath, original).First(f => f.RuleId == "UA-03").Fingerprint;
        var moved  = ScopeAwareGenericity.ScanText(ProductPath, "\n\n\n" + original).First(f => f.RuleId == "UA-03").Fingerprint;
        var second = ScopeAwareGenericity.ScanText(ProductPath, edited).First(f => f.RuleId == "UA-03").Fingerprint;

        Assert.Equal(first, moved);
        Assert.NotEqual(first, second);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_fingerprint_changes_when_the_file_changes()
    {
        const string code = "var grain = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Grain) ? \"coil\" : request.Grain;";

        var here  = ScopeAwareGenericity.ScanText("Backend/PlantProcess.Application/A.cs", code).First().Fingerprint;
        var there = ScopeAwareGenericity.ScanText("Backend/PlantProcess.Application/B.cs", code).First().Fingerprint;

        Assert.NotEqual(here, there);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_product_generic_walk_is_not_vacuous()
    {
        var files = ScopeAwareGenericity.ProductGenericFiles(ScopeAwareGenericity.RepositoryRoot());

        Assert.True(
            files.Count > 400,
            "Genericity gate: the walk visited only " + files.Count + " product files. " +
            "A gate that scans nothing passes forever and proves nothing.");
    }
