[METADATA: Path='tools\packs\Apply-PPIQ-SystemTemplateDatabaseReconcile.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='Tooling Script', Lines=338, SizeKB=16.37, SHA256='D43BFADAE67AB9688290B4547509D3271DF8F69EE53EDBC63CAE1E77B6A9D139', Modified='2026-08-24 22:54:02']

<#
================================================================================
PlantProcess IQ - SYSTEM TEMPLATE DATABASE RECONCILE
================================================================================
Owner : Worker 1
Why   : The repository half of the system-template convergence is committed at
        8c4a6a81, but the database half never ran.

        The reconcile script was written with Set-Content -Encoding UTF8, which
        in PowerShell 5.1 emits a UTF-8 BOM. psql then reads the first line as
        an invalid meta-command, prints its output anyway, and exits non-zero.
        The pack read that as "database unavailable" and skipped Phase 5. The
        preflight rows had already printed, which is how the contradiction was
        visible in the console but not to the pack.

        So in ppiq_app the legacy system-template family is still active and
        CORR_PARAMETER_AVG_BY_EQUIPMENT is still shipped as a parameterless
        avgParameterValue widget. CurrentRelease is still FAILED = 1.

WHAT THIS DOES
  1. Rewrites the committed reconcile script without a BOM. Content is compared
     byte-for-byte after the BOM is removed, so this cannot smuggle an edit.
  2. Captures the six reported widgets from ppiq_app before reconciliation.
  3. Runs the reconcile script, snapshots, runs it again, snapshots again, and
     fails unless the two snapshots are identical.
  4. Captures the same six widgets after, so the retirement is visible.
  5. Stages exactly the one rewritten script.

  No SQL file this pack writes contains a psql meta-command, and every file is
  written without a BOM through .NET rather than Set-Content.

CREDENTIALS
  Local development values from the Identity and Topology reference section 2.1.
  Refuses any host but localhost, any database not named ppiq_, and refuses
  ppiq_presentation by name.

FILE   M  Backend\database\scripts\830_system_template_single_authority.sql  (BOM removed)

EXIT  0 = reconciled, idempotent, staged   2 = verification failed, no mutation
      3 = failed after mutation, auto-revert completed
================================================================================
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot     = 'C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ',
    [string]$EvidenceRoot = 'C:\Workspace\_ppiq_evidence',
    [string]$PgHost     = 'localhost',
    [int]   $PgPort     = 5432,
    [string]$PgDatabase = 'ppiq_app',
    [string]$PgUser     = 'ppiq_dev',
    [string]$PgPassword = 'ppiq_dev_local_only'
)

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Write-Head([string]$t) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan; Write-Host $t -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan }
function Write-Ok  ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [OK]   $t" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Warn([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [WARN] $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Write-Bad ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] $t" -ForegroundColor Red }
function Write-Inf ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [INFO] $t" -ForegroundColor Gray }

function Invoke-Git {
    param([string[]]$GitArgs)
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try { $raw = & git @GitArgs 2>&1; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $text = ($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) -join "`r`n" }
    finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
    return @{ Code = $code; Text = $text }
}

# Always BOM-free, always through .NET. Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 is the defect
# this pack exists to correct and is deliberately not used anywhere in it.
function Write-NoBom {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Text)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}

$ScriptRel = 'Backend\database\scripts\830_system_template_single_authority.sql'
$ScriptGit = 'Backend/database/scripts/830_system_template_single_authority.sql'

$script:Backup = ''
$script:Staged = $false

function Invoke-Rollback([string]$Reason) {
    Write-Head 'AUTO-REVERT'
    Write-Bad $Reason
    if ($script:Staged) { Invoke-Git @('reset', '--', $ScriptGit) | Out-Null; Write-Ok "unstaged: $ScriptGit" }
    if ($script:Backup -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script:Backup)) {
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $script:Backup -Destination (Join-Path $RepoRootFull $ScriptRel) -Force
        Write-Ok "restored: $ScriptRel"
    }
    Write-Warn 'Database rows already retired by a completed run are not rolled back. The script is idempotent and re-runnable.'
    Write-Host ''
}

function Invoke-Psql {
    param([string]$SqlFile, [string]$LogFile)
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try {
        $raw = & psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h $PgHost -p $PgPort -U $PgUser -d $PgDatabase -f $SqlFile 2>&1
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
        ($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) | Set-Content -LiteralPath $LogFile -Encoding UTF8
        return @{ Code = $code; Lines = @($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) }
    } finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
}

Write-Head 'PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT'
if ($PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 5) { Write-Bad 'PowerShell 5.1+ required.'; exit 2 }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot)) { Write-Bad "Repo not found: $RepoRoot"; exit 2 }
$RepoRootFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot).Path).TrimEnd('\')
if (-not (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad 'git not on PATH.'; exit 2 }
if (-not (Get-Command psql -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
    Write-Bad 'psql is not on PATH. This pack exists to run SQL; there is no useful degraded mode.'
    exit 2
}
Write-Ok "Repo: $RepoRootFull"

if (@('localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1') -notcontains $PgHost.ToLowerInvariant()) { Write-Bad "Refusing a non-local host: $PgHost"; exit 2 }
if ($PgDatabase -notmatch '^ppiq_') { Write-Bad "Refusing an unexpected database name: $PgDatabase"; exit 2 }
if ($PgDatabase -eq 'ppiq_presentation') { Write-Bad 'Refusing ppiq_presentation.'; exit 2 }
Write-Ok "target: $PgUser@${PgHost}:$PgPort/$PgDatabase"

Push-Location -LiteralPath $RepoRootFull
try {
    $ev = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Join-Path $EvidenceRoot 'SystemTemplateDatabaseReconcile') (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))).TrimEnd('\')
    if ($ev.ToLowerInvariant().StartsWith(($RepoRootFull + '\').ToLowerInvariant())) { Write-Bad 'EvidenceRoot resolves inside the repository.'; exit 2 }
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ev -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Ok "Evidence: $ev"

    $cached = (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).Text.Trim()
    if ($cached) {
        Write-Bad 'Index is NOT empty.'
        $cached -split "`r?`n" | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok 'index empty'

    # ==================================== PHASE 1 - REWRITE WITHOUT A BOM ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 1 - REMOVE THE BOM FROM THE COMMITTED SCRIPT'

    $scriptFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $ScriptRel
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $scriptFull)) { Write-Bad "missing: $ScriptRel"; exit 2 }

    $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($scriptFull)
    $hasBom = ($bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and $bytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and $bytes[2] -eq 0xBF)

    if (-not $hasBom) { Write-Ok 'script already has no BOM; nothing to rewrite' }
    else {
        Write-Inf 'BOM present - this is why psql exited non-zero'
        $script:Backup = Join-Path $ev '830_system_template_single_authority.sql.orig'
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $scriptFull -Destination $script:Backup -Force

        $textBefore = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($scriptFull)   # BOM stripped by the reader
        Write-NoBom -Path $scriptFull -Text $textBefore
        $textAfter = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($scriptFull)

        if ($textAfter -ne $textBefore) { Invoke-Rollback 'rewrite changed the script content, not only its encoding.'; exit 3 }

        $newBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($scriptFull)
        if ($newBytes.Length -ge 3 -and $newBytes[0] -eq 0xEF) { Invoke-Rollback 'BOM survived the rewrite.'; exit 3 }
        Write-Ok 'BOM removed; content byte-identical apart from the BOM'
    }

    $sqlCode = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($scriptFull)
    if ($sqlCode -match '(?m)^\s*\\') { Write-Bad 'the reconcile script contains a psql meta-command; it must be pure SQL.'; exit 2 }
    Write-Ok 'reconcile script is pure SQL'

    $work = Join-Path $ev 'sql'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $work -Force | Out-Null
    $env:PGPASSWORD = $PgPassword

    # ============================================ PHASE 2 - BEFORE STATE =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 2 - STATE BEFORE RECONCILIATION'

    $widgetsSql = Join-Path $work 'widgets.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $widgetsSql -Text @'
SELECT d.dashboard_code, w.widget_code, w.dimension_code, w.measure_code,
       coalesce(w.parameter_code, '(none)') AS parameter_code, w.is_active
FROM   dashboard_widget_definitions w
JOIN   dashboard_definitions d ON d.id = w.dashboard_definition_id
WHERE  w.widget_code IN ('RISK_BY_CLASS','RISK_BY_EQUIPMENT','DQ_BY_SOURCE',
                         'DQ_BY_TYPE','INV_MATERIAL_BY_TYPE','CORR_PARAMETER_AVG_BY_EQUIPMENT')
  AND  w.is_deleted = FALSE
ORDER BY d.dashboard_code, w.widget_code;
'@

    $countsSql = Join-Path $work 'counts.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $countsSql -Text @'
SELECT count(*) AS active_product_template_widgets
FROM   dashboard_widget_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE AND source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates';
SELECT count(*) AS active_product_template_dashboards
FROM   dashboard_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE AND source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates';
SELECT count(*) AS legacy_unprefixed_dashboards
FROM   dashboard_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE AND source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  dashboard_code NOT LIKE 'SYSTEM\_%';
SELECT count(*) AS customer_authored_dashboards
FROM   dashboard_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE AND coalesce(source_system, '') <> 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates';
'@

    $before = Invoke-Psql -SqlFile $widgetsSql -LogFile (Join-Path $ev 'widgets_before.log')
    if ($before.Code -ne 0) {
        $before.Lines | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Invoke-Rollback "psql exited $($before.Code) reading the current state."; exit 3
    }
    $before.Lines | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkGray }
    Write-Ok 'before state captured'

    $countsBefore = Invoke-Psql -SqlFile $countsSql -LogFile (Join-Path $ev 'counts_before.log')
    if ($countsBefore.Code -ne 0) { Invoke-Rollback 'could not read counts before reconciliation.'; exit 3 }
    $customerBefore = ($countsBefore.Lines -join "`n")

    # ============================================== PHASE 3 - RECONCILE ======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 3 - RECONCILE  [DATABASE MUTATION]'

    $run1 = Invoke-Psql -SqlFile $scriptFull -LogFile (Join-Path $ev 'reconcile_run1.log')
    if ($run1.Code -ne 0) {
        $run1.Lines | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Invoke-Rollback "reconcile failed on first run, psql exit $($run1.Code)."; exit 3
    }
    $run1.Lines | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkGray }
    Write-Ok 'reconcile run 1 completed'

    $snap1 = Invoke-Psql -SqlFile $countsSql -LogFile (Join-Path $ev 'counts_after_run1.log')
    if ($snap1.Code -ne 0) { Invoke-Rollback 'could not snapshot after run 1.'; exit 3 }

    # ============================================= PHASE 4 - IDEMPOTENCE =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 4 - IDEMPOTENCE PROOF'

    $run2 = Invoke-Psql -SqlFile $scriptFull -LogFile (Join-Path $ev 'reconcile_run2.log')
    if ($run2.Code -ne 0) { Invoke-Rollback "reconcile failed on second run, psql exit $($run2.Code)."; exit 3 }

    $snap2 = Invoke-Psql -SqlFile $countsSql -LogFile (Join-Path $ev 'counts_after_run2.log')
    if ($snap2.Code -ne 0) { Invoke-Rollback 'could not snapshot after run 2.'; exit 3 }

    $a = ($snap1.Lines -join "`n")
    $b = ($snap2.Lines -join "`n")
    if ($a -ne $b) {
        Write-Bad 'the second run changed the counts'
        Write-Inf "after run 1:`n$a"
        Write-Inf "after run 2:`n$b"
        Invoke-Rollback 'idempotence proof failed.'; exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok 'second run changed nothing - idempotent'
    $snap2.Lines | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkGray }

    # ================================== PHASE 5 - CUSTOMER DATA UNTOUCHED ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 5 - CUSTOMER-AUTHORED DEFINITIONS UNTOUCHED'

    $customerBeforeCount = ''
    $customerAfterCount  = ''
    $m1 = [regex]::Match($customerBefore, 'customer_authored_dashboards[\s\S]*?(\d+)')
    $m2 = [regex]::Match($b, 'customer_authored_dashboards[\s\S]*?(\d+)')
    if ($m1.Success) { $customerBeforeCount = $m1.Groups[1].Value }
    if ($m2.Success) { $customerAfterCount  = $m2.Groups[1].Value }

    if ($customerBeforeCount -ne $customerAfterCount) {
        Write-Bad "customer-authored dashboards changed: $customerBeforeCount -> $customerAfterCount"
        Invoke-Rollback 'reconciliation touched definitions outside product provenance.'; exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok "customer-authored dashboards unchanged ($customerBeforeCount before, $customerAfterCount after)"

    # ============================================== PHASE 6 - AFTER STATE ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 6 - STATE AFTER RECONCILIATION'

    $after = Invoke-Psql -SqlFile $widgetsSql -LogFile (Join-Path $ev 'widgets_after.log')
    if ($after.Code -ne 0) { Invoke-Rollback 'could not read the resulting state.'; exit 3 }
    $after.Lines | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkGray }

    $afterText = ($after.Lines -join "`n")
    foreach ($gone in @('CORR_PARAMETER_AVG_BY_EQUIPMENT', 'DQ_BY_TYPE')) {
        if ($afterText -match [regex]::Escape($gone)) {
            Write-Bad "$gone is still active after reconciliation"
            Invoke-Rollback 'a widget this correction retires survived.'; exit 3
        }
    }
    Write-Ok 'CORR_PARAMETER_AVG_BY_EQUIPMENT and DQ_BY_TYPE are no longer active'

    $env:PGPASSWORD = ''

    # ============================================= PHASE 7 - EXACT STAGING ===
    Write-Head 'PHASE 7 - EXACT STAGING'

    $dirty = (Invoke-Git @('status', '--porcelain', '--', $ScriptGit)).Text.Trim()
    if (-not $dirty) {
        Write-Ok 'script needed no rewrite; nothing to stage'
        $staged = $false
    }
    else {
        $ar = Invoke-Git @('add', '--', $ScriptGit)
        if ($ar.Code -ne 0) { Invoke-Rollback "git add failed: $ScriptGit"; exit 3 }
        $script:Staged = $true
        $staged = $true
        Write-Ok "staged: $ScriptGit"

        $ca = (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).Text.TrimEnd()
        $list = @(); if ($ca) { $list = @($ca -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim().Trim('"') }) }
        $extra = @($list | Where-Object { $_ -ne $ScriptGit })
        if ($extra.Count -gt 0) {
            foreach ($x in $extra) { Write-Bad "unintended staged path: $x" }
            Invoke-Rollback 'index contains a path this pack did not stage.'; exit 3
        }
        Write-Ok 'index contains exactly 1 file'
        Write-Host ''
        (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--stat')).Text -split "`r?`n" | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" -ForegroundColor Gray }
    }

    Write-Head 'CLOSURE'
    $report = @()
    $report += 'SYSTEM TEMPLATE DATABASE RECONCILE'
    $report += "  database        : $PgDatabase (explicit, no fallback)"
    $report += '  reconcile run 1 : OK'
    $report += '  reconcile run 2 : OK, zero drift'
    $report += "  customer data   : unchanged ($customerBeforeCount dashboards)"
    $report += '  retired         : CORR_PARAMETER_AVG_BY_EQUIPMENT, DQ_BY_TYPE'
    $report += "  script encoding : $(if ($hasBom) { 'BOM removed, staged' } else { 'already clean' })"
    $report += "  evidence        : $ev"
    Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'CLOSURE.txt') -Text ($report -join "`r`n")
    Write-Host ''
    foreach ($r in $report) { Write-Host "  $r" -ForegroundColor White }
    Write-Host ''
    if ($staged) {
        Write-Host '  NOT COMMITTED. Commit on your instruction:' -ForegroundColor Yellow
        Write-Host '    git commit -m "Reconcile script: remove UTF-8 BOM so psql executes it"' -ForegroundColor Gray
    } else {
        Write-Host '  Nothing to commit. The database is reconciled.' -ForegroundColor Green
    }
    Write-Host ''
    exit 0
}
finally {
    if (Test-Path Env:PGPASSWORD) { $env:PGPASSWORD = '' }
    Pop-Location
}

[METADATA: Path='tools\packs\Apply-PPIQ-SystemTemplateRuntimeAuthorityProof.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='Tooling Script', Lines=399, SizeKB=18.58, SHA256='53A93705AE27BC4785392BF9510FA45A6288589581C79E719F11DE3D07ED583F', Modified='2026-08-25 15:15:06']

<#
================================================================================
PlantProcess IQ - SYSTEM TEMPLATE RUNTIME AUTHORITY PROOF
================================================================================
Owner : Worker 1
Type  : PROOF ONLY. No repository file is written, staged or committed.

WHAT THIS ANSWERS
  The retirement proof showed the legacy SQL template family is gone and left
  zero product templates. Zero is not the approved architecture: the approved
  architecture is ONE canonical operational authority. A Release Truth pass over
  no templates proves nothing.

  So this proves the runtime authority actually produces the family, on the
  canonical startup path, idempotently.

METHOD
  1. Resolve the connection from the existing profile. Nothing is embedded.
  2. Refuse unless the resolved database is the application database.
  3. Stop any running API. Snapshot the baseline.
  4. Start the API on the canonical local profile. Wait for health.
  5. Snapshot the canonical family semantically, not by count.
  6. Non-vacuity gate: dashboards > 0 and widgets > 0, or STOP.
  7. Stop the API. Start it again. Snapshot again.
  8. The two semantic snapshots must be byte-identical.
  9. The two retired widgets must not have returned, and no active product
     dashboard may sit outside the canonical family.

  A snapshot compares dashboard_code, widget_code, dimension_code, measure_code,
  parameter_code, source_system and active/deleted state - counts alone would
  hide content drift.

CREDENTIALS
  None embedded. Read from env\profiles in this order: an already-set PG*
  environment, then a connection string, then discrete keys. If none resolves the
  pack stops and says so. No value is printed except host, port, database, user.

EXIT  0 = runtime authority proven   2 = could not run, nothing changed
      3 = proof failed - read the reported reason, it is a real finding
================================================================================
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot      = 'C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ',
    [string]$EvidenceRoot  = 'C:\Workspace\_ppiq_evidence',
    [string]$ProfileFile   = 'env\profiles\local.env',
    [string]$ApiLauncher   = 'scripts\dev\run-api-local.ps1',
    [string]$ApiHealthUrl  = '',
    [int]   $StartupWaitSeconds = 90,
    [int]   $SettleSeconds = 5
)

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Write-Head([string]$t) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan; Write-Host $t -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan }
function Write-Ok  ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [OK]   $t" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Warn([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [WARN] $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Write-Bad ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] $t" -ForegroundColor Red }
function Write-Inf ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [INFO] $t" -ForegroundColor Gray }

function Write-NoBom {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Text)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}

$script:Pg = @{}

function Invoke-PsqlTuples {
    param([string]$SqlFile, [string]$LogFile)
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try {
        $raw = & psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -A -F '|' -t `
            -h $script:Pg.Host -p $script:Pg.Port -U $script:Pg.User -d $script:Pg.Database `
            -f $SqlFile 2>&1
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
        $lines = @($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString().TrimEnd() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
        Write-NoBom -Path $LogFile -Text (($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
        return @{ Code = $code; Lines = $lines; Text = ($lines -join "`n") }
    } finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
}

function Stop-Api {
    $p = @(Get-Process -Name 'PlantProcess.Api' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
    if ($p.Count -gt 0) {
        $p | Stop-Process -Force
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
        Write-Inf ("stopped {0} API process(es)" -f $p.Count)
    }
}

function Test-Health([string]$Base) {
    try {
        $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ($Base.TrimEnd('/') + '/health') -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5
        return ($r.StatusCode -eq 200)
    } catch { return $false }
}

function Start-ApiAndWait {
    param([string]$LauncherFull, [string]$Base, [int]$WaitSeconds)
    Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' `
        -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', $LauncherFull) | Out-Null
    $waited = 0
    while ($waited -lt $WaitSeconds) {
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
        $waited += 5
        if (Test-Health $Base) { return $waited }
    }
    return -1
}

# ===================================================== PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT ====
Write-Head 'PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT'

if ($PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 5) { Write-Bad 'PowerShell 5.1+ required.'; exit 2 }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot)) { Write-Bad "Repo not found: $RepoRoot"; exit 2 }
$RepoRootFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot).Path).TrimEnd('\')
foreach ($cmd in @('psql')) {
    if (-not (Get-Command $cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad "$cmd is not on PATH."; exit 2 }
}
Write-Ok "Repo: $RepoRootFull"

$launcherFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $ApiLauncher
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $launcherFull)) {
    Write-Bad "API launcher not found: $ApiLauncher"
    Write-Warn 'Pass -ApiLauncher with the canonical local runner. No launcher is invented.'
    exit 2
}
Write-Ok "launcher: $ApiLauncher"

Push-Location -LiteralPath $RepoRootFull
try {
    $ev = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Join-Path $EvidenceRoot 'SystemTemplateRuntimeAuthority') (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))).TrimEnd('\')
    if ($ev.ToLowerInvariant().StartsWith(($RepoRootFull + '\').ToLowerInvariant())) { Write-Bad 'EvidenceRoot resolves inside the repository.'; exit 2 }
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ev -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Ok "Evidence: $ev"

    # ==================================== PHASE 1 - RESOLVE THE CONNECTION ===
    Write-Head 'PHASE 1 - CONNECTION FROM THE PROFILE'
    Write-Inf 'Nothing is embedded in this pack. Only host, port, database and user are printed.'

    $profileFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $ProfileFile
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $profileFull)) {
        Write-Bad "profile not found: $ProfileFile"
        Write-Warn 'Pass -ProfileFile with the canonical local profile. No credential is invented.'
        exit 2
    }

    $kv = @{}
    foreach ($ln in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $profileFull)) {
        if ($ln -match '^\s*#') { continue }
        if ($ln -match '^\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$') { $kv[$Matches[1]] = $Matches[2] }
    }

    $script:Pg = @{ Host = ''; Port = '5432'; Database = ''; User = ''; Password = '' }

    # 1. an already-exported environment wins
    foreach ($pair in @(@{K='PGHOST';F='Host'}, @{K='PGPORT';F='Port'}, @{K='PGDATABASE';F='Database'}, @{K='PGUSER';F='User'}, @{K='PGPASSWORD';F='Password'})) {
        $envVal = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($pair.K)
        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($envVal)) { $script:Pg[$pair.F] = $envVal }
    }

    # 2. a connection string in the profile
    foreach ($key in @('ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb', 'ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection', 'PPIQ_DB_CONNECTION')) {
        if (-not $kv.ContainsKey($key)) { continue }
        foreach ($part in ($kv[$key] -split ';')) {
            if ($part -notmatch '^\s*([A-Za-z ]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$') { continue }
            $n = $Matches[1].Trim().ToLowerInvariant(); $v = $Matches[2]
            switch ($n) {
                'host'     { if (-not $script:Pg.Host)     { $script:Pg.Host = $v } }
                'server'   { if (-not $script:Pg.Host)     { $script:Pg.Host = $v } }
                'port'     { $script:Pg.Port = $v }
                'database' { if (-not $script:Pg.Database) { $script:Pg.Database = $v } }
                'username' { if (-not $script:Pg.User)     { $script:Pg.User = $v } }
                'user id'  { if (-not $script:Pg.User)     { $script:Pg.User = $v } }
                'password' { if (-not $script:Pg.Password) { $script:Pg.Password = $v } }
            }
        }
    }

    # 3. discrete keys in the profile
    foreach ($pair in @(@{K='PGHOST';F='Host'}, @{K='PGPORT';F='Port'}, @{K='PGDATABASE';F='Database'}, @{K='PGUSER';F='User'}, @{K='PGPASSWORD';F='Password'})) {
        if ($kv.ContainsKey($pair.K) -and -not $script:Pg[$pair.F]) { $script:Pg[$pair.F] = $kv[$pair.K] }
    }

    $missing = @()
    foreach ($f in @('Host', 'Database', 'User', 'Password')) { if (-not $script:Pg[$f]) { $missing += $f } }
    if ($missing.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Bad ("the profile does not resolve: " + ($missing -join ', '))
        Write-Warn 'This pack embeds no credential and will not invent one. Point -ProfileFile at the canonical profile.'
        exit 2
    }

    if (@('localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1') -notcontains $script:Pg.Host.ToLowerInvariant()) { Write-Bad "Refusing a non-local host: $($script:Pg.Host)"; exit 2 }
    if ($script:Pg.Database -eq 'ppiq_presentation') { Write-Bad 'The profile resolves to the frozen historical database. Refusing.'; exit 2 }
    if ($script:Pg.Database -notmatch '^ppiq_') { Write-Bad "Refusing an unexpected database name: $($script:Pg.Database)"; exit 2 }

    Write-Ok ("resolved: {0}@{1}:{2}/{3}" -f $script:Pg.User, $script:Pg.Host, $script:Pg.Port, $script:Pg.Database)
    Write-Inf 'no silent fallback: the database name above is the one every query below uses'
    $env:PGPASSWORD = $script:Pg.Password

    # health url, discovered not invented
    $base = $ApiHealthUrl
    if (-not $base) {
        foreach ($key in @('ASPNETCORE_URLS', 'PPIQ_API_BASE_URL')) {
            if (-not $kv.ContainsKey($key)) { continue }
            foreach ($piece in ($kv[$key] -split ';')) {
                $piece = $piece.Trim()
                if ($piece -match '^https?://[^@\s]+$' -and -not $base) { $base = $piece }
            }
        }
    }
    if (-not $base) {
        Write-Bad 'No API base URL supplied or discovered. No port will be invented.'
        Write-Warn 'Re-run with -ApiHealthUrl "http://localhost:<port>".'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok "api base: $base"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ queries ---
    $work = Join-Path $ev 'sql'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $work -Force | Out-Null

    $snapshotSql = Join-Path $work 'snapshot.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $snapshotSql -Text @'
SELECT d.dashboard_code,
       coalesce(w.widget_code, '(none)'),
       coalesce(w.dimension_code, ''),
       coalesce(w.measure_code, ''),
       coalesce(w.parameter_code, '(none)'),
       d.source_system,
       d.is_active,
       coalesce(w.is_active::text, ''),
       coalesce(w.is_deleted::text, '')
FROM   dashboard_definitions d
LEFT JOIN dashboard_widget_definitions w
       ON w.dashboard_definition_id = d.id AND w.is_deleted = FALSE
WHERE  d.source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  d.is_deleted = FALSE
ORDER BY d.dashboard_code, coalesce(w.widget_code, '(none)');
'@

    $countsSql = Join-Path $work 'counts.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $countsSql -Text @'
SELECT 'canonical_dashboards', count(*) FROM dashboard_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE AND source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  dashboard_code LIKE 'SYSTEM\_%';
SELECT 'canonical_widgets', count(*) FROM dashboard_widget_definitions w
JOIN   dashboard_definitions d ON d.id = w.dashboard_definition_id
WHERE  w.is_deleted = FALSE AND d.is_deleted = FALSE
  AND  w.source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  d.dashboard_code LIKE 'SYSTEM\_%';
SELECT 'legacy_unprefixed_dashboards', count(*) FROM dashboard_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE AND source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  dashboard_code NOT LIKE 'SYSTEM\_%';
SELECT 'retired_widgets_active', count(*) FROM dashboard_widget_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE
  AND  widget_code IN ('CORR_PARAMETER_AVG_BY_EQUIPMENT', 'DQ_BY_TYPE');
SELECT 'parameterless_average_widgets', count(*) FROM dashboard_widget_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE
  AND  lower(measure_code) = 'avgparametervalue'
  AND  (parameter_code IS NULL OR btrim(parameter_code) = '');
'@

    function Get-Counts([string]$Tag) {
        $r = Invoke-PsqlTuples -SqlFile $countsSql -LogFile (Join-Path $ev ("counts_$Tag.log"))
        if ($r.Code -ne 0) { return $null }
        $h = @{}
        foreach ($l in $r.Lines) {
            $p = $l -split '\|'
            if ($p.Count -ge 2) { $h[$p[0].Trim()] = [int]$p[1].Trim() }
        }
        return $h
    }

    # ============================================ PHASE 2 - BASELINE ========
    Write-Head 'PHASE 2 - BASELINE BEFORE ANY STARTUP'

    Stop-Api
    $baseline = Get-Counts 'baseline'
    if ($null -eq $baseline) { Write-Bad 'could not read the database.'; exit 2 }
    foreach ($k in @('canonical_dashboards','canonical_widgets','legacy_unprefixed_dashboards','retired_widgets_active','parameterless_average_widgets')) {
        Write-Inf ("{0,-32} {1}" -f $k, $baseline[$k])
    }

    # ================================= PHASE 3 - FIRST CANONICAL STARTUP ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 3 - FIRST CANONICAL STARTUP'

    $waited = Start-ApiAndWait -LauncherFull $launcherFull -Base $base -WaitSeconds $StartupWaitSeconds
    if ($waited -lt 0) {
        Write-Bad "API did not report healthy within $StartupWaitSeconds seconds."
        Stop-Api
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok "API healthy after ${waited}s"
    Start-Sleep -Seconds $SettleSeconds

    $snapA = Invoke-PsqlTuples -SqlFile $snapshotSql -LogFile (Join-Path $ev 'snapshot_startup1.log')
    if ($snapA.Code -ne 0) { Stop-Api; Write-Bad 'could not snapshot after the first startup.'; exit 3 }
    $countsA = Get-Counts 'startup1'

    Write-Inf "canonical family after startup 1:"
    foreach ($l in $snapA.Lines) { Write-Host "         $l" -ForegroundColor DarkGray }

    # ============================================ PHASE 4 - NON-VACUITY =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 4 - NON-VACUITY GATE'

    $d = $countsA['canonical_dashboards']
    $w = $countsA['canonical_widgets']
    Write-Inf ("canonical dashboards {0}, canonical widgets {1}" -f $d, $w)

    if ($d -le 0 -or $w -le 0) {
        Write-Bad 'The canonical runtime family is empty after a clean startup.'
        Write-Warn 'The retirement succeeded and nothing replaced it, so a Release Truth pass here would be vacuous.'
        Write-Warn 'Finding: the runtime authority is not executing on the canonical startup path, or it is incomplete.'
        Write-Warn 'This is Worker-1 owned. It is NOT solved by restoring the retired SQL seed.'
        Stop-Api
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok 'canonical family is non-empty'

    # ================================ PHASE 5 - SECOND CANONICAL STARTUP ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 5 - SECOND CANONICAL STARTUP'

    Stop-Api
    $waited2 = Start-ApiAndWait -LauncherFull $launcherFull -Base $base -WaitSeconds $StartupWaitSeconds
    if ($waited2 -lt 0) { Write-Bad 'API did not report healthy on the second start.'; Stop-Api; exit 3 }
    Write-Ok "API healthy after ${waited2}s"
    Start-Sleep -Seconds $SettleSeconds

    $snapB = Invoke-PsqlTuples -SqlFile $snapshotSql -LogFile (Join-Path $ev 'snapshot_startup2.log')
    if ($snapB.Code -ne 0) { Stop-Api; Write-Bad 'could not snapshot after the second startup.'; exit 3 }
    $countsB = Get-Counts 'startup2'

    # =========================================== PHASE 6 - SEMANTIC DRIFT ===
    Write-Head 'PHASE 6 - SEMANTIC DRIFT'

    if ($snapA.Text -ne $snapB.Text) {
        Write-Bad 'The second startup changed the canonical family.'
        $onlyA = @($snapA.Lines | Where-Object { $snapB.Lines -notcontains $_ })
        $onlyB = @($snapB.Lines | Where-Object { $snapA.Lines -notcontains $_ })
        foreach ($l in $onlyA) { Write-Host "         only after startup 1: $l" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        foreach ($l in $onlyB) { Write-Host "         only after startup 2: $l" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Stop-Api
        Write-Warn 'The runtime authority is not idempotent. That is the finding.'
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok ("semantic snapshot identical across two fresh startups ({0} rows compared)" -f $snapA.Lines.Count)

    # ======================================= PHASE 7 - RETIREMENT HOLDS =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 7 - THE RETIRED WIDGETS DID NOT RETURN'

    $failed = $false
    if ($countsB['retired_widgets_active'] -ne 0) {
        Write-Bad ("CORR_PARAMETER_AVG_BY_EQUIPMENT or DQ_BY_TYPE is active again: {0} row(s)" -f $countsB['retired_widgets_active'])
        $failed = $true
    } else { Write-Ok 'neither retired widget was recreated' }

    if ($countsB['parameterless_average_widgets'] -ne 0) {
        Write-Bad ("a parameterless average-parameter widget exists again: {0} row(s)" -f $countsB['parameterless_average_widgets'])
        $failed = $true
    } else { Write-Ok 'no average-parameter widget exists without a parameter' }

    if ($countsB['legacy_unprefixed_dashboards'] -ne 0) {
        Write-Bad ("{0} active product dashboard(s) sit outside the canonical family" -f $countsB['legacy_unprefixed_dashboards'])
        $failed = $true
    } else { Write-Ok 'every active product dashboard belongs to the canonical family' }

    Stop-Api

    if ($failed) { Write-Warn 'Proof failed. Nothing was written to the repository.'; exit 3 }

    # ================================================= PHASE 8 - CLOSURE ====
    Write-Head 'CLOSURE'

    $report = @()
    $report += 'SYSTEM TEMPLATE RUNTIME AUTHORITY PROOF'
    $report += ("  database                     : {0}" -f $script:Pg.Database)
    $report += ("  canonical system dashboards  : {0}" -f $countsB['canonical_dashboards'])
    $report += ("  canonical system widgets     : {0}" -f $countsB['canonical_widgets'])
    $report += ("  legacy unprefixed dashboards : {0}" -f $countsB['legacy_unprefixed_dashboards'])
    $report += ("  retired widgets active       : {0}" -f $countsB['retired_widgets_active'])
    $report += ("  parameterless average widgets: {0}" -f $countsB['parameterless_average_widgets'])
    $report += ("  second fresh startup         : zero semantic drift ({0} rows)" -f $snapB.Lines.Count)
    $report += ("  evidence                     : {0}" -f $ev)
    $report += '  repository                   : untouched by this pack'
    Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'CLOSURE.txt') -Text (($report -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")

    Write-Host ''
    foreach ($r in $report) { Write-Host "  $r" -ForegroundColor White }
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  Nothing to commit. This pack proves runtime behaviour; it changes no file.' -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host ''
    exit 0
}
finally {
    if (Test-Path Env:PGPASSWORD) { $env:PGPASSWORD = '' }
    Pop-Location
}

<#
================================================================================
PlantProcess IQ - SYSTEM TEMPLATE SINGLE AUTHORITY
================================================================================
Owner : Worker 1
Scope : CurrentRelease system-template authority defect. Worker-1 items only.

THE DEFECT
  Three independent authorities create the same product system templates:
    1  Backend\database\seed\090_phase1_system_dashboard_templates.sql
       INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (widget_code) DO UPDATE - every replay OVERWRITES
       whatever the runtime reconciled. Unprefixed dashboard codes.
    2  Backend\database\scripts\070_repair_system_template_widget_codes.sql
       UPDATEs dimension/measure on the same widget codes. It exists only because
       1 and 3 disagreed, and live ppiq_app already shows its effect: DQ_BY_TYPE
       persists as materialUnitType, not the defectType the seed inserted.
    3  DashboardDefinitionService.EnsureSystemTemplatesAsync
       INSERT + drift-repair at runtime. SYSTEM_ prefixed dashboard codes.

RULING IMPLEMENTED
  3 becomes the single operational authority. 1 and 2 are retired in place, and
  legacy unprefixed rows already in a database are soft-retired by provenance.
  No fourth authority is introduced: no new template JSON, DSL or config file.

WORKER-1 OWNED ITEMS ONLY
  A  single system-template authority
  B  retirement of the SQL seed and the 070 repair authority
  C  CORR_PARAMETER_AVG_BY_EQUIPMENT retirement - avgParameterValue with a null
     parameter cannot be seeded, and cannot be fixed by choosing a plant-specific
     parameter, so the widget is removed rather than invented
  D  DQ_BY_TYPE orphan resolution - SQL-only widget with no runtime counterpart

  The four executor failures were handed to Worker 2 and are not touched here.

FILES
  M  Backend\database\seed\090_phase1_system_dashboard_templates.sql
  M  Backend\database\scripts\070_repair_system_template_widget_codes.sql
  A  Backend\database\scripts\830_system_template_single_authority.sql
  A  Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\SystemTemplateAuthorityTests.cs

  830 is the next free ordinal read from the live sequence (highest is 828).

CREDENTIALS
  Local development values from the Identity and Topology reference section 2.1.
  The pack REFUSES to run against any host other than localhost, and refuses any
  database whose name does not begin with ppiq_. Server credentials never appear.
  psql is always invoked with -f against a written file, never -c.

EXIT  0 = applied, gates green, staged   2 = verification failed, no mutation
      3 = failed after mutation, auto-revert completed
================================================================================
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot     = 'C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ',
    [string]$EvidenceRoot = 'C:\Workspace\_ppiq_evidence',

    [string]$PgHost     = 'localhost',
    [int]   $PgPort     = 5432,
    [string]$PgDatabase = 'ppiq_app',
    [string]$PgUser     = 'ppiq_dev',
    [string]$PgPassword = 'ppiq_dev_local_only',

    [switch]$SkipDatabase,
    [switch]$SkipTests
)

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Write-Head([string]$t) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan; Write-Host $t -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan }
function Write-Ok  ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [OK]   $t" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Warn([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [WARN] $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Write-Bad ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] $t" -ForegroundColor Red }
function Write-Inf ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [INFO] $t" -ForegroundColor Gray }

function Invoke-Git {
    param([string[]]$GitArgs)
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try { $raw = & git @GitArgs 2>&1; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $text = ($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) -join "`r`n" }
    finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
    return @{ Code = $code; Text = $text }
}

$SeedRel   = 'Backend\database\seed\090_phase1_system_dashboard_templates.sql'
$RepairRel = 'Backend\database\scripts\070_repair_system_template_widget_codes.sql'
$NewRel    = 'Backend\database\scripts\830_system_template_single_authority.sql'
$TestRel   = 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\SystemTemplateAuthorityTests.cs'
$SeedGit   = 'Backend/database/seed/090_phase1_system_dashboard_templates.sql'
$RepairGit = 'Backend/database/scripts/070_repair_system_template_widget_codes.sql'
$NewGit    = 'Backend/database/scripts/830_system_template_single_authority.sql'
$TestGit   = 'Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/SystemTemplateAuthorityTests.cs'

$script:Backups = @{}
$script:Created = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$script:Staged  = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList

function Invoke-Rollback([string]$Reason) {
    Write-Head 'AUTO-REVERT'
    Write-Bad $Reason
    foreach ($p in $script:Staged) { Invoke-Git @('reset', '--', $p) | Out-Null; Write-Ok "unstaged: $p" }
    foreach ($rel in $script:Backups.Keys) {
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $script:Backups[$rel] -Destination (Join-Path $RepoRootFull $rel) -Force
        Write-Ok "restored: $rel"
    }
    foreach ($f in $script:Created) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force; Write-Ok "removed: $f" } }
    Write-Warn 'Database rows already changed by a completed SQL run are NOT rolled back; the retirement script is idempotent and re-runnable.'
    Write-Host ''
}

function Invoke-Psql {
    param([string]$SqlFile, [string]$LogFile, [switch]$Append)
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try {
        if ($Append) { & psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h $PgHost -p $PgPort -U $PgUser -d $PgDatabase -f $SqlFile 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $LogFile -Append }
        else         { & psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h $PgHost -p $PgPort -U $PgUser -d $PgDatabase -f $SqlFile 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $LogFile }
        return $LASTEXITCODE
    } finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
}

# ===================================================== PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT ====
Write-Head 'PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT'
if ($PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 5) { Write-Bad 'PowerShell 5.1+ required.'; exit 2 }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot)) { Write-Bad "Repo not found: $RepoRoot"; exit 2 }
$RepoRootFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot).Path).TrimEnd('\')
if (-not (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad 'git not on PATH.'; exit 2 }
Write-Ok "Repo: $RepoRootFull"

# Hard guard. Local development only, by construction.
if (@('localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1') -notcontains $PgHost.ToLowerInvariant()) {
    Write-Bad "Refusing to run against a non-local host: $PgHost"
    Write-Warn 'This pack carries local development values only and must never touch a server database.'
    exit 2
}
if ($PgDatabase -notmatch '^ppiq_') {
    Write-Bad "Refusing an unexpected database name: $PgDatabase"
    exit 2
}
if ($PgDatabase -eq 'ppiq_presentation') {
    Write-Bad 'Refusing ppiq_presentation. The frozen historical database is never the target of an M2 correction.'
    exit 2
}
Write-Ok "target: $PgUser@${PgHost}:$PgPort/$PgDatabase  (local development)"

Push-Location -LiteralPath $RepoRootFull
try {
    $ev = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Join-Path $EvidenceRoot 'SystemTemplateAuthority') (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))).TrimEnd('\')
    if ($ev.ToLowerInvariant().StartsWith(($RepoRootFull + '\').ToLowerInvariant())) { Write-Bad 'EvidenceRoot resolves inside the repository.'; exit 2 }
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ev -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Ok "Evidence: $ev"

    $cachedBefore = (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).Text.Trim()
    if ($cachedBefore) {
        Write-Bad 'Index is NOT empty. Commit law forbids staging on top of foreign staged work.'
        $cachedBefore -split "`r?`n" | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok 'git diff --cached --name-only is empty'
    $head = (Invoke-Git @('rev-parse', 'HEAD')).Text.Trim()
    Write-Inf "HEAD: $head"

    # ==================================== PHASE 1 - ANCHOR VERIFICATION ======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 1 - ANCHOR VERIFICATION'

    $seedFull   = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $SeedRel
    $repairFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $RepairRel
    $newFull    = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $NewRel
    $testFull   = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $TestRel

    foreach ($pair in @(@{P = $seedFull; N = $SeedRel}, @{P = $repairFull; N = $RepairRel})) {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $pair.P)) { Write-Bad "target missing: $($pair.N)"; exit 2 }
    }
    foreach ($pair in @(@{P = $newFull; N = $NewRel}, @{P = $testFull; N = $TestRel})) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $pair.P) { Write-Bad "artifact already exists: $($pair.N)"; exit 2 }
    }
    Write-Ok 'two targets present, two artifacts free'

    $seedText = Get-Content -LiteralPath $seedFull -Raw
    foreach ($anchor in @('PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates', 'ON CONFLICT (widget_code)', 'CORR_PARAMETER_AVG_BY_EQUIPMENT')) {
        if ($seedText -notmatch [regex]::Escape($anchor)) { Write-Bad "seed anchor absent: $anchor"; exit 2 }
    }
    Write-Ok 'seed carries the expected system-template anchors'

    $repairText = Get-Content -LiteralPath $repairFull -Raw
    if ($repairText -notmatch 'UPDATE dashboard_widget_definitions') { Write-Bad 'repair-script anchor absent.'; exit 2 }
    Write-Ok 'repair script carries the expected update anchor'

    # Next ordinal must come from the live sequence, never be assumed.
    $scriptsDir = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\database\scripts'
    $highest = 0
    foreach ($f in (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $scriptsDir -File -Filter '*.sql')) {
        if ($f.Name -match '^(\d+)_' ) {
            $n = [int]$Matches[1]
            if ($n -lt 999 -and $n -gt $highest) { $highest = $n }
        }
    }
    Write-Inf "highest ordinal below the 999 tail: $highest"
    if ($highest -ge 830) {
        Write-Bad "Ordinal 830 is no longer free; the live sequence has reached $highest."
        Write-Warn 'Re-issue the pack with the next free ordinal. Numbers are read, never assumed.'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok 'ordinal 830 is free'

    # ================================ PHASE 2 - READ-ONLY DATABASE PREFLIGHT ==
    Write-Head 'PHASE 2 - READ-ONLY DATABASE PREFLIGHT'

    $dbAvailable = $false
    if ($SkipDatabase) { Write-Warn '-SkipDatabase passed. No database evidence will be gathered.' }
    elseif (-not (Get-Command psql -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        Write-Warn 'psql is not on PATH. Database evidence and the idempotence proof will be recorded as NOT-EXECUTED.'
    }
    else {
        $env:PGPASSWORD = $PgPassword
        $work = Join-Path $ev 'sql'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $work -Force | Out-Null

        $probe = Join-Path $work 'preflight.sql'
        Set-Content -LiteralPath $probe -Encoding UTF8 -Value @'
\echo === system template families ===
SELECT d.dashboard_code,
       CASE WHEN d.dashboard_code LIKE 'SYSTEM\_%' THEN 'runtime-authority' ELSE 'legacy-sql-authority' END AS family,
       count(w.id) AS widgets
FROM   dashboard_definitions d
LEFT JOIN dashboard_widget_definitions w
       ON w.dashboard_definition_id = d.id AND w.is_deleted = FALSE
WHERE  d.source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  d.is_deleted = FALSE
GROUP BY d.dashboard_code
ORDER BY family, d.dashboard_code;

\echo === the six reported widgets, exact stored values ===
SELECT d.dashboard_code, w.widget_code, w.dimension_code, w.measure_code,
       coalesce(w.parameter_code, '(null)') AS parameter_code,
       w.source_system, w.is_active, w.updated_at_utc,
       length(w.measure_code) AS measure_len
FROM   dashboard_widget_definitions w
JOIN   dashboard_definitions d ON d.id = w.dashboard_definition_id
WHERE  w.widget_code IN ('RISK_BY_CLASS','RISK_BY_EQUIPMENT','DQ_BY_SOURCE',
                         'DQ_BY_TYPE','INV_MATERIAL_BY_TYPE','CORR_PARAMETER_AVG_BY_EQUIPMENT')
  AND  w.is_deleted = FALSE
ORDER BY d.dashboard_code, w.widget_code;
'@
        $log = Join-Path $ev 'preflight.log'
        if ((Invoke-Psql -SqlFile $probe -LogFile $log) -ne 0) {
            Write-Warn "Could not read $PgDatabase. Evidence recorded as NOT-EXECUTED."
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $log -Tail 8 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        }
        else {
            $dbAvailable = $true
            Write-Ok "read-only evidence captured -> $log"
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $log | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkGray }
        }
    }

    # =================================================== PHASE 3 - APPLY =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 3 - APPLY  [MUTATION]'

    $bk = Join-Path $ev 'backup'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $bk -Force | Out-Null
    foreach ($rel in @($SeedRel, $RepairRel)) {
        $dst = Join-Path $bk (Split-Path -Leaf $rel)
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepoRootFull $rel) -Destination $dst -Force
        $script:Backups[$rel] = $dst
    }
    Write-Ok '2 file(s) backed up'

    $retiredSeed = @'
-- ============================================================================
-- RETIRED. This file no longer creates system dashboard templates.
--
-- Why:
--   Three mechanisms created the same product system templates. This seed used
--   INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (widget_code) DO UPDATE, so every replay silently
--   overwrote whatever the runtime had reconciled, and a companion repair
--   script then rewrote the same rows again. Live evidence: DQ_BY_TYPE was
--   inserted here as defectType and persists in the application database as
--   materialUnitType, because a different authority won.
--
-- Single authority:
--   DashboardDefinitionService.EnsureSystemTemplatesAsync is the operational
--   authority for product system templates. It is idempotent, repairs drift,
--   runs on every deployment regardless of which SQL was replayed, and is the
--   only mechanism that can honour a product that starts empty.
--
-- Two widgets were not carried across:
--   CORR_PARAMETER_AVG_BY_EQUIPMENT declared avgParameterValue with a null
--     parameter. A product template cannot know which parameters a plant has,
--     and cannot choose one without embedding plant-specific vocabulary, so the
--     widget is retired rather than given an invented default.
--   DQ_BY_TYPE was rewritten in place by the repair script into the definition the
--     runtime authority already publishes as DQ_BY_MATERIAL_TYPE, so it is a duplicate
--     under a legacy code rather than a broken widget.
--
-- Existing databases are reconciled by:
--   Backend/database/scripts/830_system_template_single_authority.sql
--
-- This file is kept as a deliberate no-op so any replay list that still names
-- it continues to succeed. Do not reintroduce template writes here.
-- ============================================================================

SELECT 'system dashboard templates are created by the runtime authority; this seed is retired' AS notice;
'@

    $retiredRepair = @'
-- ============================================================================
-- SUPERSEDED. This repair script no longer rewrites widget definitions.
--
-- It existed only to reconcile two disagreeing system-template authorities, by
-- UPDATE-ing dimension_code and measure_code on rows another mechanism had just
-- written. With a single runtime authority in place it has nothing to repair,
-- and leaving it active would mean it keeps fighting that authority on every
-- replay.
--
-- Its historical effect is still visible in existing databases and is reconciled
-- by Backend/database/scripts/830_system_template_single_authority.sql.
--
-- Kept as a deliberate no-op so replay lists that name it continue to succeed.
-- ============================================================================

SELECT 'system template widget-code repair is superseded by the runtime authority' AS notice;
'@

    $reconcile = @'
-- ============================================================================
-- System templates: one authority.
--
-- Retires legacy product-generated system-template rows so the runtime
-- authority owns the family alone. Scoped strictly by product provenance:
-- only rows whose source_system is the product template marker are touched.
-- Customer-authored dashboards carry a different source_system and are never
-- matched by any statement below.
--
-- Idempotent: every statement filters on is_deleted = FALSE, so a second run
-- affects zero rows.
--
-- Nothing is hard-deleted. Rows are soft-retired so the history stays readable
-- and so the widget_code uniqueness index, which applies only to rows that are
-- not deleted, releases the code for the runtime authority.
-- ============================================================================

BEGIN;

-- 1. Widgets of legacy, unprefixed product template dashboards.
UPDATE dashboard_widget_definitions w
SET    is_deleted     = TRUE,
       deleted_at_utc = NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',
       deleted_reason = 'superseded by the runtime system-template authority',
       is_active      = FALSE,
       updated_at_utc = NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
FROM   dashboard_definitions d
WHERE  d.id = w.dashboard_definition_id
  AND  w.is_deleted = FALSE
  AND  w.source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  d.source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  d.dashboard_code NOT LIKE 'SYSTEM\_%';

-- 2. The legacy dashboards themselves.
UPDATE dashboard_definitions
SET    is_deleted     = TRUE,
       deleted_at_utc = NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',
       deleted_reason = 'superseded by the runtime system-template authority',
       is_active      = FALSE,
       updated_at_utc = NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE
  AND  source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  dashboard_code NOT LIKE 'SYSTEM\_%';

-- 3. A product template cannot declare an average-parameter measure without a
--    parameter, and cannot choose one without embedding plant vocabulary.
--    Retired wherever it persists, including inside the runtime family.
UPDATE dashboard_widget_definitions
SET    is_deleted     = TRUE,
       deleted_at_utc = NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',
       deleted_reason = 'average-parameter measure cannot be seeded without a parameter selection',
       is_active      = FALSE,
       updated_at_utc = NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE
  AND  source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  widget_code = 'CORR_PARAMETER_AVG_BY_EQUIPMENT';

-- 4. Legacy widget code for a definition the runtime authority already publishes.
--    The repair script rewrote this widget to materialUnitType, which is exactly the
--    runtime widget DQ_BY_MATERIAL_TYPE under an older code. It is a duplicate under a
--    legacy name, not a broken definition, and retiring it leaves the question itself
--    answered by the runtime family.
UPDATE dashboard_widget_definitions
SET    is_deleted     = TRUE,
       deleted_at_utc = NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',
       deleted_reason = 'duplicate of the runtime widget under a legacy code',
       is_active      = FALSE,
       updated_at_utc = NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE
  AND  source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  widget_code = 'DQ_BY_TYPE';

COMMIT;
'@

    Set-Content -LiteralPath $seedFull   -Value $retiredSeed   -Encoding UTF8
    Set-Content -LiteralPath $repairFull -Value $retiredRepair -Encoding UTF8
    Set-Content -LiteralPath $newFull    -Value $reconcile     -Encoding UTF8
    [void]$script:Created.Add($newFull)
    Write-Ok "retired:  $SeedRel"
    Write-Ok "retired:  $RepairRel"
    Write-Ok "created:  $NewRel"

    $testSource = @'
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Xunit;

namespace PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests;

// =====================================================================================
// System template single-authority gate.
//
// Three mechanisms once created the same product system templates: a SQL seed that
// overwrote on every replay, a repair script that rewrote the same rows again, and
// the runtime reconciler. The runtime reconciler is now the single authority.
//
// This gate is self-contained on purpose. It resolves the repository root itself and
// declares no shared type, so it compiles whether or not any other gate is present.
//
// Every searched token is assembled from fragments and every read strips comments, so
// this file cannot satisfy its own rules and a comment cannot violate them.
// =====================================================================================

[Trait("Gate", "SystemTemplateAuthority")]
public sealed class SystemTemplateAuthorityTests
{
    private const string RuntimeAuthorityPath =
        "Backend/PlantProcess.Application/Dashboarding/Services/Dashboards/DashboardDefinitionService.cs";

    private const string DatabaseRoot = "Backend/database";

    private const string ProvenanceMarker = "PlantProcessIQ" + ".SystemTemplates";

    // Measures that cannot be evaluated without an explicit parameter selection.
    private static readonly string[] ParameterDependentMeasures =
    {
        "avgParameterValue",
        "maxParameterValue",
        "minParameterValue",
        "parameterValueDistribution",
        "parameterValueSpread",
        "parameterRelationship"
    };

    // Plant-specific vocabulary that must never appear in a product template.
    private static readonly string[] PlantVocabulary =
    {
        "Casting" + "Speed",
        "co" + "il",
        "he" + "at",
        "cas" + "ter",
        "tun" + "dish"
    };

    [Fact]
    public void No_sql_file_creates_product_system_templates()
    {
        var root = FindRepositoryRoot();
        var databaseDirectory = Path.Combine(root, DatabaseRoot.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));
        var offenders = new List<string>();

        foreach (var file in Directory.EnumerateFiles(databaseDirectory, "*.sql", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
        {
            var code = StripSqlCommentsAndLiterals(File.ReadAllText(file));

            if (!code.Contains(ProvenanceMarker, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (Regex.IsMatch(code, @"INSERT\s+INTO\s+dashboard_(widget_)?definitions", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase))
            {
                offenders.Add(file.Substring(root.Length + 1).Replace('\\', '/'));
            }
        }

        Assert.True(
            offenders.Count == 0,
            "Product system templates have exactly one authority, and it is the runtime reconciler. " +
            "These SQL files create them as well, which is how three mechanisms came to fight over the same rows:" +
            Environment.NewLine + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, offenders));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Runtime_authority_declares_no_parameter_dependent_template_widget()
    {
        var source = ReadRuntimeAuthority();
        var offenders = ParameterDependentMeasures
            .Where(measure => source.Contains("Measures." + Capitalise(measure), StringComparison.Ordinal))
            .ToList();

        Assert.True(
            offenders.Count == 0,
            "A system template widget declares a measure that cannot be evaluated without an explicit parameter " +
            "selection. A product template does not know which parameters a plant has, and choosing one embeds " +
            "plant-specific vocabulary. This is the defect that left a seeded widget failing on every install:" +
            Environment.NewLine + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, offenders));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Runtime_authority_contains_no_plant_specific_vocabulary()
    {
        var source = ReadRuntimeAuthority();
        var offenders = PlantVocabulary
            .Where(term => Regex.IsMatch(source, @"\b" + term + @"s?\b", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase))
            .ToList();

        Assert.True(
            offenders.Count == 0,
            "The system-template authority must stay generic across industries:" +
            Environment.NewLine + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, offenders));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Runtime_authority_is_idempotent_by_construction()
    {
        var source = ReadRuntimeAuthority();

        Assert.Contains("EnsureSystemTemplatesAsync", source, StringComparison.Ordinal);

        Assert.True(
            Regex.IsMatch(source, @"OrdinalIgnoreCase", RegexOptions.None),
            "The authority must match existing widgets case-insensitively, or a casing difference creates a " +
            "duplicate instead of being repaired.");
    }

    private static string ReadRuntimeAuthority()
    {
        var path = Path.Combine(
            FindRepositoryRoot(),
            RuntimeAuthorityPath.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));

        Assert.True(File.Exists(path), "The runtime system-template authority is missing: " + RuntimeAuthorityPath);

        return StripCsharpComments(File.ReadAllText(path));
    }

    private static string Capitalise(string value)
    {
        return char.ToUpperInvariant(value[0]) + value.Substring(1);
    }

    private static string StripCsharpComments(string source)
    {
        var withoutBlocks = Regex.Replace(source, @"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", string.Empty);
        return Regex.Replace(withoutBlocks, @"//[^\r\n]*", string.Empty);
    }

    private static string StripSqlCommentsAndLiterals(string sql)
    {
        var withoutBlocks = Regex.Replace(sql, @"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", " ");
        var withoutLine = Regex.Replace(withoutBlocks, @"--[^\r\n]*", " ");
        return withoutLine;
    }

    private static string FindRepositoryRoot()
    {
        var directory = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);

        while (directory is not null)
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, ".git")) ||
                Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, "Backend")))
            {
                return directory.FullName;
            }

            directory = directory.Parent;
        }

        throw new InvalidOperationException("Repository root not found from " + AppContext.BaseDirectory);
    }
}
'@

    Set-Content -LiteralPath $testFull -Value $testSource -Encoding UTF8
    [void]$script:Created.Add($testFull)
    Write-Ok "created:  $TestRel"

    # ========================================= PHASE 4 - ON-DISK SELF-CHECK ==
    Write-Head 'PHASE 4 - ON-DISK SELF-CHECK'

    $seedAfter = Get-Content -LiteralPath $seedFull -Raw
    $seedCode = [regex]::Replace($seedAfter, '--[^\r\n]*', ' ')
    if ($seedCode -match '(?i)INSERT\s+INTO\s+dashboard_') { Invoke-Rollback 'self-check failed: the seed still inserts template rows.'; exit 3 }
    Write-Ok 'retired seed performs no template insert'

    $repairCode = [regex]::Replace((Get-Content -LiteralPath $repairFull -Raw), '--[^\r\n]*', ' ')
    if ($repairCode -match '(?i)UPDATE\s+dashboard_') { Invoke-Rollback 'self-check failed: the repair script still updates template rows.'; exit 3 }
    Write-Ok 'superseded repair script performs no update'

    $newText = Get-Content -LiteralPath $newFull -Raw
    foreach ($req in @('is_deleted = FALSE', 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates', 'CORR_PARAMETER_AVG_BY_EQUIPMENT', 'DQ_BY_TYPE')) {
        if ($newText -notmatch [regex]::Escape($req)) { Invoke-Rollback "self-check failed: reconcile script missing - $req"; exit 3 }
    }
    if ($newText -match '(?i)\bDELETE\s+FROM\b') { Invoke-Rollback 'self-check failed: reconcile script hard-deletes rows.'; exit 3 }
    Write-Ok 'reconcile script is provenance-scoped, soft-retiring, idempotent by filter'

    # ============================================ PHASE 5 - IDEMPOTENCE ======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 5 - RECONCILE AND IDEMPOTENCE PROOF'

    $idem = 'NOT-EXECUTED'
    if (-not $dbAvailable) { Write-Warn 'Database unavailable. Reconcile and idempotence recorded as NOT-EXECUTED.' }
    else {
        $work = Join-Path $ev 'sql'
        $snap = Join-Path $work 'snapshot.sql'
        Set-Content -LiteralPath $snap -Encoding UTF8 -Value @'
SELECT count(*) AS active_product_template_widgets
FROM   dashboard_widget_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE AND source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates';
SELECT count(*) AS active_product_template_dashboards
FROM   dashboard_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE AND source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates';
SELECT count(*) AS legacy_unprefixed_dashboards
FROM   dashboard_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE AND source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  dashboard_code NOT LIKE 'SYSTEM\_%';
'@
        $run1 = Join-Path $ev 'reconcile_run1.log'
        if ((Invoke-Psql -SqlFile $newFull -LogFile $run1) -ne 0) {
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $run1 -Tail 15 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
            Invoke-Rollback 'Reconcile script failed on first run.'; exit 3
        }
        $s1 = Join-Path $ev 'snapshot_after_run1.log'
        Invoke-Psql -SqlFile $snap -LogFile $s1 | Out-Null
        Write-Ok 'reconcile run 1 completed'

        $run2 = Join-Path $ev 'reconcile_run2.log'
        if ((Invoke-Psql -SqlFile $newFull -LogFile $run2) -ne 0) {
            Invoke-Rollback 'Reconcile script failed on second run.'; exit 3
        }
        $s2 = Join-Path $ev 'snapshot_after_run2.log'
        Invoke-Psql -SqlFile $snap -LogFile $s2 | Out-Null

        $a = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $s1 -Raw)
        $b = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $s2 -Raw)
        if ($a -ne $b) {
            Write-Bad 'Second run changed the counts. The script is not idempotent.'
            Invoke-Rollback 'Idempotence proof failed.'; exit 3
        }
        $idem = 'PASS'
        Write-Ok 'reconcile run 2 changed nothing - idempotent'
        Get-Content -LiteralPath $s2 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkGray }

        $env:PGPASSWORD = ''
    }

    # ================================================== PHASE 6 - GATE ======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 6 - GATE'
    if ($SkipTests) { Write-Warn '-SkipTests passed. Ungated. Do not commit without a green run.' }
    else {
        $tstp = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests.csproj'
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tstp)) { Invoke-Rollback "test project missing: $tstp"; exit 3 }
        $tl = Join-Path $ev 'test.log'
        & dotnet test $tstp --filter "Gate=SystemTemplateAuthority" --nologo 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $tl | Out-Null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl -Tail 30 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
            Invoke-Rollback 'System template authority gate is not green.'; exit 3
        }
        $tt = Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl -Raw
        if ($tt -notmatch 'Passed!' -and $tt -notmatch 'Passed:\s*[1-9]') { Invoke-Rollback 'Gate produced no executed assertions.'; exit 3 }
        Write-Ok 'gate green with executed assertions'
    }

    # ============================================= PHASE 7 - EXACT STAGING ===
    Write-Head 'PHASE 7 - EXACT STAGING  [MUTATION]'
    $toStage = @($SeedGit, $RepairGit, $NewGit, $TestGit)
    foreach ($p in $toStage) {
        $ar = Invoke-Git @('add', '--', $p)
        if ($ar.Code -ne 0) { Invoke-Rollback "git add failed: $p"; exit 3 }
        [void]$script:Staged.Add($p)
        Write-Ok "staged: $p"
    }
    $ca = (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).Text.TrimEnd()
    $list = @(); if ($ca) { $list = @($ca -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim().Trim('"') }) }
    $extra  = @($list    | Where-Object { $toStage -notcontains $_ })
    $absent = @($toStage | Where-Object { $list -notcontains $_ })
    if ($extra.Count -gt 0 -or $absent.Count -gt 0) {
        foreach ($x in $extra)  { Write-Bad "unintended staged path: $x" }
        foreach ($m in $absent) { Write-Bad "declared path not staged: $m" }
        Invoke-Rollback 'Index does not equal the exact owned set.'; exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok "index equals the exact owned set ($($list.Count) file(s))"
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  --- git diff --cached --name-only ---' -ForegroundColor Gray
    foreach ($l in $list) { Write-Host "  $l" -ForegroundColor Gray }
    Write-Host '  --- git diff --cached --stat ---' -ForegroundColor Gray
    (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--stat')).Text -split "`r?`n" | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" -ForegroundColor Gray }

    # =================================================== PHASE 8 - CLOSURE ===
    Write-Head 'CLOSURE'
    $report = @()
    $report += 'SYSTEM TEMPLATE SINGLE AUTHORITY'
    $report += "  baseline commit : $head"
    $report += '  authority       : DashboardDefinitionService.EnsureSystemTemplatesAsync (runtime)'
    $report += '  retired         : seed 090 template writes, 070 widget-code repair'
    $report += '  reconcile       : Backend/database/scripts/830_system_template_single_authority.sql'
    $report += '  widgets retired : CORR_PARAMETER_AVG_BY_EQUIPMENT, DQ_BY_TYPE'
    $report += "  db evidence     : $(if ($dbAvailable) { 'captured from ' + $PgDatabase } else { 'NOT-EXECUTED' })"
    $report += "  idempotence     : $idem"
    $report += "  gate            : $(if ($SkipTests) { 'SKIPPED - do not commit' } else { 'green' })"
    $report += "  evidence        : $ev"

<#
================================================================================
PlantProcess IQ - SYSTEM TEMPLATE STARTUP PROVISIONING
================================================================================
Owner : Worker 1

THE GAP THE PROOF FOUND
  The runtime authority exists and is idempotent, but nothing invokes it on the
  startup path. EnsureSystemTemplatesAsync is reachable only through
  POST /definitions/system-templates/ensure. While the retired SQL seed was
  still running, that did not show: the seed created the family on every replay.
  With the seed retired, a clean start now yields zero product templates, which
  the non-vacuity gate correctly refused.

  Measured: API healthy in 10s, canonical dashboards 0, canonical widgets 0.

THE CORRECTION
  A startup provisioning service calls the single authority once per boot, using
  the pattern already established by FirstRunProvisioningHostedService: resolve
  in a scope, do the work, and never let a failure stop the API. That service is
  the precedent - it provisions the permanent system account at install time, so
  product-owned provisioning at startup is an existing decision, not a new one.

  The authority itself is unchanged. This only makes it reachable where the
  architecture already said it was operational.

RULE 2
  "Starts empty" governs customer and demonstration data. System templates are
  product surfaces, like the system account the first-run service creates. No
  customer row, no demonstration row and no plant vocabulary is created here. If
  the Tech Lead reads Rule 2 as also excluding product template provisioning at
  boot, then the alternative is an explicit onboarding call, and this pack should
  be rejected rather than adjusted - that is a product ruling, not an edit.

FILES
  A  Backend\PlantProcess.Api\Hosting\SystemTemplateProvisioningHostedService.cs
  M  Backend\PlantProcess.Api\Program.cs                        (one line added)
  A  Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\SystemTemplateProvisioningTests.cs

LINE ENDINGS
  Repository C# files are CRLF; this pack's here-strings are LF. Every anchor is
  therefore SINGLE-LINE, matching runs against an LF-normalised copy, and the
  file is written back in its own convention. A self-check fails the pack if the
  convention changes, because that would produce a whole-file diff.

EXIT  0 = applied, gates green, staged   2 = verification failed, no mutation
      3 = failed after mutation, auto-revert completed
================================================================================
#>

[CmdletBinding()]

function Write-Head([string]$t) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan; Write-Host $t -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan }
function Write-Ok  ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [OK]   $t" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Warn([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [WARN] $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Write-Bad ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] $t" -ForegroundColor Red }
function Write-Inf ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [INFO] $t" -ForegroundColor Gray }

function Invoke-Git {
    param([string[]]$GitArgs)
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try { $raw = & git @GitArgs 2>&1; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $text = ($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) -join "`r`n" }
    finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
    return @{ Code = $code; Text = $text }
}

function Get-DominantEol([string]$Text) {
    $crlf = ([regex]::Matches($Text, "`r`n")).Count
    $lf   = ([regex]::Matches($Text, "(?<!`r)`n")).Count
    if ($crlf -ge $lf) { return 'CRLF' } else { return 'LF' }
}
function ConvertTo-Lf([string]$Text) { return $Text.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n") }
function ConvertFrom-Lf([string]$Text, [string]$Eol) { if ($Eol -eq 'CRLF') { return $Text.Replace("`n", "`r`n") } return $Text }

function Write-NoBom([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}

using PlantProcess.Application.Dashboarding.Interfaces;

namespace PlantProcess.Api.Hosting;

/// <summary>
/// Invokes the system-template authority once per start.
///
/// The product has one operational authority for system dashboard templates,
/// IDashboardDefinitionService.EnsureSystemTemplatesAsync. Until this service
/// existed nothing called it on the startup path: it was reachable only through
/// the ensure endpoint, and a retired SQL seed happened to create the same
/// family on every replay, which hid the gap. With that seed retired, a clean
/// installation produced no templates at all.
///
/// The authority is idempotent and repairs drift, so calling it every start is
/// the whole mechanism. A second start changes nothing.
///
/// Failure never stops the API, matching FirstRunProvisioningHostedService: a
/// template that could not be reconciled is a degraded surface, not a reason to
/// refuse to serve. The failure is logged and the ensure endpoint remains
/// available to retry it.
/// </summary>
public sealed class SystemTemplateProvisioningHostedService : IHostedService
{
    private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
    private readonly ILogger<SystemTemplateProvisioningHostedService> _logger;

    public SystemTemplateProvisioningHostedService(
        IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory,
        ILogger<SystemTemplateProvisioningHostedService> logger)
    {
        _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task StartAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        try
        {
            await using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();
            var authority = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IDashboardDefinitionService>();

            var result = await authority.EnsureSystemTemplatesAsync(cancellationToken);

            if (!result.IsSuccess)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "System template provisioning did not succeed: {Error}. The API will continue to start and the " +
                    "ensure endpoint can retry it.",
                    result.Error);

                return;
            }

            if (result.Value == 0)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("System templates already present; nothing created.");
            }
            else
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("System templates provisioned: {Created} created.", result.Value);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(
                ex,
                "System template provisioning failed; the API will continue to start. Provisioning can be retried " +
                "through the ensure endpoint.");
        }
    }

    public Task StopAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken) => Task.CompletedTask;
}
