using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Xunit;

namespace PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests;

// =====================================================================================
// System template startup provisioning gate.
//
// The product has one operational authority for system dashboard templates. This gate
// holds the line that the authority is actually invoked on the startup path, which is
// the failure a retired SQL seed hid for months: the templates existed, but not because
// anything in the running product created them.
//
// Self-contained: it resolves the repository root itself and declares no shared type,
// so it compiles regardless of which other gates are present.
// =====================================================================================

[Trait("Gate", "SystemTemplateProvisioning")]
public sealed class SystemTemplateProvisioningTests
{
    private const string ProgramPath =
        "Backend/PlantProcess.Api/Program.cs";

    private const string ServicePath =
        "Backend/PlantProcess.Api/Hosting/SystemTemplateProvisioningHostedService.cs";

    private const string ServiceTypeName = "SystemTemplateProvisioningHostedService";

    [Fact]
    public void The_authority_is_invoked_on_the_startup_path()
    {
        var program = ReadStripped(ProgramPath);

        Assert.True(
            Regex.IsMatch(program, @"AddHostedService<[^>]*" + ServiceTypeName + @">"),
            "Nothing invokes the system-template authority at startup. A clean installation would then " +
            "produce no system templates at all, and a Release Truth pass over them would be vacuous.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_startup_service_calls_the_single_authority_and_nothing_else()
    {
        var source = ReadStripped(ServicePath);

        Assert.Contains("EnsureSystemTemplatesAsync", source, StringComparison.Ordinal);

        Assert.False(
            Regex.IsMatch(source, @"INSERT\s+INTO|CREATE\s+TABLE|ExecuteSqlRaw", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase),
            "Startup provisioning must delegate to the authority. Writing definitions directly would make it a " +
            "second authority, which is the defect this whole correction removes.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_provisioning_failure_does_not_stop_the_api()
    {
        var source = ReadStripped(ServicePath);

        Assert.True(
            Regex.IsMatch(source, @"catch\s*\(\s*Exception"),
            "A template that cannot be reconciled is a degraded surface, not a reason to refuse to serve. " +
            "Startup provisioning must not be able to prevent the API from starting.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Startup_provisioning_carries_no_plant_specific_vocabulary()
    {
        var source = ReadStripped(ServicePath);

        var terms = new[] { "Casting" + "Speed", "co" + "il", "he" + "at", "cas" + "ter" };
        var offenders = terms.Where(t => Regex.IsMatch(source, @"\b" + t + @"s?\b", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)).ToList();

        Assert.True(
            offenders.Count == 0,
            "Startup provisioning must stay generic across industries:" +
            Environment.NewLine + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, offenders));
    }

    private static string ReadStripped(string relativePath)
    {
        var full = Path.Combine(
            FindRepositoryRoot(),
            relativePath.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));

        Assert.True(File.Exists(full), "Expected file is missing: " + relativePath);

        var text = File.ReadAllText(full);
        var withoutBlocks = Regex.Replace(text, @"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", string.Empty);
        return Regex.Replace(withoutBlocks, @"//[^\r\n]*", string.Empty);
    }

    private static string FindRepositoryRoot()
    {
        var directory = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);

        while (directory is not null)
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, ".git")) ||
                Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, "Backend")))
            {
                return directory.FullName;
            }

            directory = directory.Parent;
        }

        throw new InvalidOperationException("Repository root not found from " + AppContext.BaseDirectory);
    }
}
'@

[METADATA: Path='tools\packs\Apply-PPIQ-SystemWidgetSetConvergence.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='Tooling Script', Lines=357, SizeKB=16.39, SHA256='F9D27830ACF1D8628A77F4BD109C7C88657BB20C5C8C80C625B2E9640982008F', Modified='2026-08-25 16:15:17']

<#
================================================================================
PlantProcess IQ - SYSTEM WIDGET SET CONVERGENCE
================================================================================
Owner : Worker 1

DEFECT
  EnsureSystemTemplatesAsync creates and repairs, but never retires. Removing a
  widget from the declarations leaves the persisted row active, so two widgets
  deleted in source kept executing and kept failing Release Truth.

FIX
  After seeding a dashboard's declared widgets, retire every still-active
  product-owned widget on that dashboard that the declarations no longer name.
  Retirement uses the repository's existing convention: Deactivate() then
  SoftDelete(reason). Nothing is physically deleted.

SAFETY BOUNDARY
  Bounded by provenance. Only rows whose SourceSystem is the product template
  marker are considered, compared ordinally. A customer-authored widget survives
  even if its code, dimension or measure matches a product one, and even if it
  sits on a canonical system dashboard.

FILES
  M  Backend\PlantProcess.Application\Dashboarding\Services\Dashboards\DashboardDefinitionService.cs
  M  Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\CanonicalTemplateBindingTests.cs

EXIT  0 = applied, gates green, staged   2 = verification failed, no mutation
      3 = failed after mutation, auto-revert completed
================================================================================
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot     = 'C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ',
    [string]$EvidenceRoot = 'C:\Workspace\_ppiq_evidence',
    [switch]$SkipTests
)

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Write-Head([string]$t) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan; Write-Host $t -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan }
function Write-Ok  ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [OK]   $t" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Warn([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [WARN] $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Write-Bad ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] $t" -ForegroundColor Red }
function Write-Inf ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [INFO] $t" -ForegroundColor Gray }

function Invoke-Git {
    param([string[]]$GitArgs)
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try { $raw = & git @GitArgs 2>&1; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $text = ($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) -join "`r`n" }
    finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
    return @{ Code = $code; Text = $text }
}

function Get-DominantEol([string]$Text) {
    $crlf = ([regex]::Matches($Text, "`r`n")).Count
    $lf   = ([regex]::Matches($Text, "(?<!`r)`n")).Count
    if ($crlf -ge $lf) { return 'CRLF' } else { return 'LF' }
}
function ConvertTo-Lf([string]$Text) { return $Text.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n") }
function ConvertFrom-Lf([string]$Text, [string]$Eol) { if ($Eol -eq 'CRLF') { return $Text.Replace("`n", "`r`n") } return $Text }
function Test-HasBom([string]$Path) {
    $b = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Path)
    return ($b.Length -ge 3 -and $b[0] -eq 0xEF -and $b[1] -eq 0xBB -and $b[2] -eq 0xBF)
}
function Write-PreservingBom([string]$Path, [string]$Text, [bool]$HadBom) {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($HadBom)))
}

$SvcRel  = 'Backend\PlantProcess.Application\Dashboarding\Services\Dashboards\DashboardDefinitionService.cs'
$TestRel = 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\CanonicalTemplateBindingTests.cs'
$SvcGit  = 'Backend/PlantProcess.Application/Dashboarding/Services/Dashboards/DashboardDefinitionService.cs'
$TestGit = 'Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/CanonicalTemplateBindingTests.cs'

$script:Backups = @{}
$script:Staged  = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList

function Invoke-Rollback([string]$Reason) {
    Write-Head 'AUTO-REVERT'
    Write-Bad $Reason
    foreach ($p in $script:Staged) { Invoke-Git @('reset', '--', $p) | Out-Null; Write-Ok "unstaged: $p" }
    foreach ($rel in $script:Backups.Keys) {
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $script:Backups[$rel] -Destination (Join-Path $RepoRootFull $rel) -Force
        Write-Ok "restored: $rel"
    }
    Write-Host ''
}

Write-Head 'PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT'
if ($PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 5) { Write-Bad 'PowerShell 5.1+ required.'; exit 2 }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot)) { Write-Bad "Repo not found: $RepoRoot"; exit 2 }
$RepoRootFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot).Path).TrimEnd('\')
if (-not (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad 'git not on PATH.'; exit 2 }
if (-not $SkipTests -and -not (Get-Command dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad 'dotnet not on PATH.'; exit 2 }
Write-Ok "Repo: $RepoRootFull"

Push-Location -LiteralPath $RepoRootFull
try {
    $ev = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Join-Path $EvidenceRoot 'SystemWidgetSetConvergence') (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))).TrimEnd('\')
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ev -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Ok "Evidence: $ev"

    $cachedBefore = (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).Text.Trim()
    if ($cachedBefore) {
        Write-Bad 'Index is NOT empty.'
        $cachedBefore -split "`r?`n" | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok 'index empty'

    Write-Head 'PHASE 1 - ANCHOR VERIFICATION'

    $svcFull  = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $SvcRel
    $testFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $TestRel
    foreach ($f in @($svcFull, $testFull)) { if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { Write-Bad "missing: $f"; exit 2 } }

    $svcRaw = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($svcFull)
    $svcEol = Get-DominantEol $svcRaw
    $svcBom = Test-HasBom $svcFull
    $svc    = ConvertTo-Lf $svcRaw
    Write-Inf "service  eol=$svcEol bom=$svcBom"

    $testRaw = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($testFull)
    $testEol = Get-DominantEol $testRaw
    $testBom = Test-HasBom $testFull
    $test    = ConvertTo-Lf $testRaw
    Write-Inf "test     eol=$testEol bom=$testBom"

    if ($svc.IndexOf('RetireUndeclaredProductWidgets', [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal) -ge 0) {
        Write-Bad 'convergence already present - pack already applied'; exit 2
    }

    # Matching runs against an LF-normalised copy, so a multi-line anchor is safe.
    $svcAnchor = "    return changed;`n}`n`npublic async Task<ApplicationResult<int>> RepairSystemTemplatesAsync("
    $hits = ([regex]::Matches($svc, [regex]::Escape($svcAnchor))).Count
    if ($hits -ne 1) {
        Write-Bad "service anchor found $hits times, expected 1"
        $near = @($svc -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_.Contains('RepairSystemTemplatesAsync') })
        foreach ($l in ($near | Select-Object -First 4)) { Write-Host "         >>$l<<" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok 'service anchor located once'

    $testAnchor = '    private static string Source()'
    if (([regex]::Matches($test, [regex]::Escape($testAnchor))).Count -ne 1) {
        Write-Bad 'test anchor not unique'; exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok 'test anchor located once'

    Write-Head 'PHASE 2 - BACKUP'
    foreach ($pair in @(@{R=$SvcRel;P=$svcFull;N='DashboardDefinitionService.cs'}, @{R=$TestRel;P=$testFull;N='CanonicalTemplateBindingTests.cs'})) {
        $dst = Join-Path $ev ($pair.N + '.orig')
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $pair.P -Destination $dst -Force
        $script:Backups[$pair.R] = $dst
    }
    Write-Ok '2 file(s) backed up'

    Write-Head 'PHASE 3 - APPLY  [MUTATION]'

    $convergence = @'
    RetireUndeclaredProductWidgets(dashboard, widgets, ref changed);

    return changed;
}

/// <summary>
/// Convergence, not accumulation.
///
/// This authority created and repaired widgets but never retired one. Deleting a
/// widget from the declarations therefore left the persisted row active and
/// executing: two widgets removed at source kept failing the release replay
/// afterwards, because nothing had told the database they were gone.
///
/// The persisted product-owned set now converges to the declared set. A widget
/// the declarations no longer name is retired through the repository's existing
/// convention - deactivated, then soft-deleted with a reason - so the history
/// stays readable and the widget-code uniqueness index releases the code.
///
/// Bounded by provenance, not by code. Only rows this authority wrote are
/// considered, compared ordinally against the product template marker. A
/// customer-authored widget survives even when its code, dimension or measure
/// matches a product one, and even when it sits on a canonical system dashboard.
/// Product authority reconciles its own rows and nothing else.
/// </summary>
private static void RetireUndeclaredProductWidgets(
    DashboardDefinition dashboard,
    IEnumerable<TemplateWidgetSeed> widgets,
    ref int changed)
{
    var declared = new HashSet<string>(
        widgets.Select(seed => seed.Code),
        StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    var undeclared = dashboard.Widgets
        .Where(widget =>
            !widget.IsDeleted &&
            string.Equals(widget.SourceSystem, "PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates", StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
            !declared.Contains(widget.WidgetCode))
        .ToList();

    foreach (var widget in undeclared)
    {
        widget.Deactivate();
        widget.SoftDelete("no longer declared by the canonical system-template authority");
        changed++;
    }
}

public async Task<ApplicationResult<int>> RepairSystemTemplatesAsync(
'@

    $svcNew = $svc.Replace($svcAnchor, $convergence)
    if ($svcNew -eq $svc) { Invoke-Rollback 'service replacement produced no change.'; exit 3 }
    Write-PreservingBom -Path $svcFull -Text (ConvertFrom-Lf -Text $svcNew -Eol $svcEol) -HadBom $svcBom
    Write-Ok 'convergence added to EnsureTemplateAsync'

    $newTests = @'
    [Fact]
    public void The_authority_converges_the_persisted_set_to_the_declared_set()
    {
        var source = Source();

        Assert.Contains("RetireUndeclaredProductWidgets", source, StringComparison.Ordinal);

        Assert.True(
            Regex.IsMatch(source, @"RetireUndeclaredProductWidgets\(\s*dashboard\s*,\s*widgets\s*,\s*ref\s+changed\s*\)\s*;"),
            "Convergence must run for every seeded dashboard, or a widget deleted at source keeps executing.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Retirement_is_bounded_by_product_provenance()
    {
        var source = Source();
        var method = Regex.Match(
            source,
            @"private static void RetireUndeclaredProductWidgets[\s\S]*?\n\}",
            RegexOptions.Singleline);

        Assert.True(method.Success, "The convergence method is missing.");

        Assert.Contains("PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates", method.Value, StringComparison.Ordinal);

        Assert.True(
            Regex.IsMatch(method.Value, @"SourceSystem[\s\S]{0,120}StringComparison\.Ordinal"),
            "Provenance must be compared ordinally. A customer-authored widget must survive reconciliation " +
            "even when its code, dimension or measure matches a product one.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Retirement_uses_the_existing_soft_convention_and_never_deletes_rows()
    {
        var source = Source();
        var method = Regex.Match(
            source,
            @"private static void RetireUndeclaredProductWidgets[\s\S]*?\n\}",
            RegexOptions.Singleline);

        Assert.True(method.Success, "The convergence method is missing.");
        Assert.Contains("Deactivate()", method.Value, StringComparison.Ordinal);
        Assert.Contains("SoftDelete(", method.Value, StringComparison.Ordinal);

        Assert.False(
            Regex.IsMatch(method.Value, @"\.Remove\(|RemoveRange\(|ExecuteDelete"),
            "Retirement must not physically delete a definition row.");
    }

    private static string Source()
'@

    $testNew = $test.Replace($testAnchor, $newTests)
    if ($testNew -eq $test) { Invoke-Rollback 'test replacement produced no change.'; exit 3 }
    Write-PreservingBom -Path $testFull -Text (ConvertFrom-Lf -Text $testNew -Eol $testEol) -HadBom $testBom
    Write-Ok '3 convergence assertions added'

    Write-Head 'PHASE 4 - ON-DISK SELF-CHECK'

    $afterRaw = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($svcFull)
    if ((Get-DominantEol $afterRaw) -ne $svcEol) { Invoke-Rollback 'service eol changed.'; exit 3 }
    if ((Test-HasBom $svcFull) -ne $svcBom) { Invoke-Rollback 'service bom changed.'; exit 3 }
    Write-Ok "service eol/bom unchanged ($svcEol/$svcBom)"

    $testAfterRaw = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($testFull)
    if ((Get-DominantEol $testAfterRaw) -ne $testEol) { Invoke-Rollback 'test eol changed.'; exit 3 }
    if ((Test-HasBom $testFull) -ne $testBom) { Invoke-Rollback 'test bom changed.'; exit 3 }
    Write-Ok "test eol/bom unchanged ($testEol/$testBom)"

    $after = ConvertTo-Lf $afterRaw
    $callCount = ([regex]::Matches($after, 'RetireUndeclaredProductWidgets\(dashboard')).Count
    if ($callCount -ne 1) { Invoke-Rollback "expected 1 convergence call site, found $callCount"; exit 3 }
    Write-Ok 'exactly one convergence call site'

    foreach ($req in @('PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates', 'Deactivate()', 'SoftDelete(')) {
        if ($after.IndexOf($req, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal) -lt 0) { Invoke-Rollback "self-check: missing $req"; exit 3 }
    }
    Write-Ok 'provenance bound and soft-retirement present'

    if (([regex]::Matches($after, 'TemplateWidget\("')).Count -ne 13) { Invoke-Rollback 'declared widget count is no longer 13.'; exit 3 }
    Write-Ok '13 declared widgets unchanged'

    Write-Head 'PHASE 5 - GATES'
    if ($SkipTests) { Write-Warn '-SkipTests passed. Ungated.' }
    else {
        $app  = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\PlantProcess.Application\PlantProcess.Application.csproj'
        $tstp = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests.csproj'

        $bl = Join-Path $ev 'build.log'
        & dotnet build $app -c Debug --nologo 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $bl | Out-Null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $bl -Tail 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
            Invoke-Rollback 'PlantProcess.Application does not compile.'; exit 3
        }
        Write-Ok 'Application builds'

        foreach ($gate in @('CanonicalTemplateBinding', 'SystemTemplateAuthority', 'SystemTemplateProvisioning')) {
            $tl = Join-Path $ev ("test_$gate.log")
            & dotnet test $tstp --filter "Gate=$gate" --nologo 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $tl | Out-Null
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
                Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl -Tail 25 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
                Invoke-Rollback "gate $gate is not green."; exit 3
            }
            $tt = Get-Content -LiteralPath $tl -Raw
            if ($tt -notmatch 'Passed!' -and $tt -notmatch 'Passed:\s*[1-9]') { Invoke-Rollback "gate $gate executed no assertions."; exit 3 }
            Write-Ok "gate green: $gate"
        }
    }

    Write-Head 'PHASE 6 - EXACT STAGING  [MUTATION]'
    $toStage = @($SvcGit, $TestGit)
    foreach ($p in $toStage) {
        $ar = Invoke-Git @('add', '--', $p)
        if ($ar.Code -ne 0) { Invoke-Rollback "git add failed: $p"; exit 3 }
        [void]$script:Staged.Add($p)
        Write-Ok "staged: $p"
    }
    $ca = (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')).Text.TrimEnd()
    $list = @(); if ($ca) { $list = @($ca -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim().Trim('"') }) }
    $extra  = @($list    | Where-Object { $toStage -notcontains $_ })
    $absent = @($toStage | Where-Object { $list -notcontains $_ })
    if ($extra.Count -gt 0 -or $absent.Count -gt 0) {
        foreach ($x in $extra)  { Write-Bad "unintended staged path: $x" }
        foreach ($m in $absent) { Write-Bad "declared path not staged: $m" }
        Invoke-Rollback 'index does not equal the owned set.'; exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok "index equals the exact owned set ($($list.Count) file(s))"
    Write-Host ''
    (Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--stat')).Text -split "`r?`n" | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" -ForegroundColor Gray }

    Write-Head 'COMMIT-READY'
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  git commit -m "Reconcile persisted system widgets to the canonical definition set"' -ForegroundColor Gray
    Write-Host '  powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\tools\packs\Apply-PPIQ-TemplateConvergenceProof.ps1' -ForegroundColor Gray
    Write-Host ''
    exit 0
}
finally { Pop-Location }

function Write-Step { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[STEP] $m" -ForegroundColor Cyan }
function Write-Ok   { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[ OK ] $m" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Bad  { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[FAIL] $m" -ForegroundColor Red; [void]$script:Failures.Add($m) }
function Write-Note { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[NOTE] $m" -ForegroundColor Yellow }

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param([string]$Path,[string]$Text)
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}

function Test-HasUtf8Bom {
    param([string]$Path)
    if (-not (Test-Path $Path)) { return $false }
    $b = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Path)
    if ($b.Length -lt 3) { return $false }
    return ($b[0] -eq 0xEF -and $b[1] -eq 0xBB -and $b[2] -eq 0xBF)
}

function Write-PreservingBom {
    param([string]$Path,[string]$Text,[bool]$HadBom)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($HadBom)))
}

$Gate = @'
// ============================================================================
// T-202 - Persisted page/widget definition replay gate
// Owner: Worker 2 (Release Truth). Backlog v2.17.
//
// SCOPE (bounded): enumerate every ACTIVE persisted dashboard/widget/page
// definition from the real release database and prove each replays through the

//   NOT cross-filter correctness  -> T-204
//   NOT route/console invariants  -> T-203

//   NOT Day-1 customer flow       -> T-247
//
// TERMINAL STATES (Release 1):
//   POPULATED     2xx, recognised result shape, rows > 0
//   EMPTY         2xx, recognised result shape, rows == 0
//   BLOCKED       reserved for an explicitly declared licence/entitlement
//                 envelope. NOT inferred from 401/403.
//   FAILED        any unexpected status, including 401/403
//   UNCLASSIFIED  2xx whose body is not a recognised result shape -> FAIL
//
// 401/403 is a FAILURE, never a valid terminal state. An inaccessible customer
// surface must not appear as a successful outcome.
//
// CONFIGURATION: consumed from the existing PPIQ profile only. This harness
// introduces no new credential convention and prints no secret.
// ============================================================================

import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const OUT_DIR  = path.resolve(process.cwd(), "reports/release-truth");
const OUT_FILE = path.join(OUT_DIR, "T202_definition_replay.json");

const FALSIFY_PREFIX = "T202_FALSIFY_";

const results = [];
let fatal = null;

function record(e) { results.push(e); }

function pick(obj, ...names) {
  if (!obj || typeof obj !== "object") return undefined;
  for (const n of names) {
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, n)) return obj[n];
    const lo = n.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + n.slice(1);
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, lo)) return obj[lo];
    const up = n.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + n.slice(1);
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, up)) return obj[up];
  }
  return undefined;
}

function parseJsonOrNull(t) {
  if (typeof t !== "string" || t.trim() === "") return null;
  try { return JSON.parse(t); } catch { return null; }
}

// --- configuration resolved from the established PPIQ profile ---------------
function resolveConfig() {
  const base =
    process.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL ||
    process.env.ASPNETCORE_URLS ||
    (process.env.PPIQ_API_HOST && process.env.PPIQ_API_PORT
      ? "http://" + process.env.PPIQ_API_HOST + ":" + process.env.PPIQ_API_PORT
      : null);

  const user = process.env.PPIQ_SMOKE_USERNAME || process.env.VITE_SMOKE_USERNAME;
  const pass = process.env.PPIQ_SMOKE_PASSWORD || process.env.VITE_SMOKE_PASSWORD;
  const db   = process.env.POSTGRES_DB || process.env.POSTGRES_APP_DB;

  const missing = [];
  if (!base) missing.push("VITE_API_BASE_URL / PPIQ_API_HOST+PPIQ_API_PORT");
  if (!user) missing.push("PPIQ_SMOKE_USERNAME");
  if (!pass) missing.push("PPIQ_SMOKE_PASSWORD");
  if (!db)   missing.push("POSTGRES_DB");

  return { base: base ? base.split(";")[0].replace(/\/+$/, "") : null, user, pass, db, missing };
}

async function api(base, method, route, token, body) {
  const headers = { Accept: "application/json" };
  if (token) {
    headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + token;
    headers["X-PPIQ-MFA-Verified"] = "true";
  }
  if (body !== undefined) headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
  const res = await fetch(base + route, {
    method, headers, body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body)
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  let json = null;
  try { json = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null; } catch { json = null; }
  return { status: res.status, ok: res.ok, json, text };
}

function classify(res) {
  if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403) {
    return {
      state: "FAILED",
      reason: "http " + res.status + " on the Release-1 replay identity. " +
              "An inaccessible customer surface is a gate failure, not a terminal state."
    };
  }
  if (!res.ok) return { state: "FAILED", reason: "unexpected http " + res.status };

  const body = res.json;
  if (body === null || typeof body !== "object") {
    return { state: "UNCLASSIFIED", reason: "2xx with non-object body" };
  }

  const licence = pick(body, "LicenceState", "LicenseState", "EntitlementState");
  if (typeof licence === "string" && licence.length > 0) {
    return { state: "BLOCKED", reason: "declared entitlement envelope: " + licence };
  }

  const rows = pick(body, "Rows");
  const widget = pick(body, "Widget");
  if (!Array.isArray(rows) || widget === undefined) {
    return {
      state: "UNCLASSIFIED",
      reason: "2xx but not a DashboardWidgetQueryResultDto shape; keys=" +
              Object.keys(body).slice(0, 12).join(",")
    };
  }

  const warn = pick(body, "Warnings");
  const warnings = Array.isArray(warn) ? warn : [];
  return rows.length > 0
    ? { state: "POPULATED", rowCount: rows.length, warnings }
    : { state: "EMPTY", rowCount: 0, warnings };
}

function buildQuery(w) {
  const filters = parseJsonOrNull(pick(w, "FilterJson"));
  return {
    widgetType:    pick(w, "WidgetType"),
    chartType:     pick(w, "ChartType"),
    dimensionCode: pick(w, "DimensionCode"),
    measureCode:   pick(w, "MeasureCode"),
    parameterCode: pick(w, "ParameterCode") ?? null,
    filters: (filters && typeof filters === "object" && Object.keys(filters).length > 0) ? filters : null,
    options: null
  };
}

async function main() {
  const cfg = resolveConfig();
  if (cfg.missing.length > 0) {
    fatal = "T-202 configuration missing from the loaded PPIQ profile: " +
            cfg.missing.join(", ") + ". Run Invoke-T202-ReplayGate.ps1, which loads " +
            "scripts\\env\\use-profile.ps1 -Profile presentation. This gate does not skip.";
    return;
  }

  // --- database identity refusal (guards the ppiq_app fallback) -------------
  const cs = process.env.ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb || "";
  const m = /Database=([^;]+)/i.exec(cs);
  const actualDb = m ? m[1].trim() : null;
  if (actualDb && actualDb.toLowerCase() !== cfg.db.toLowerCase()) {
    fatal = "T-202 refuses to run: connection string database '" + actualDb +
            "' does not match profile POSTGRES_DB '" + cfg.db + "'.";
    return;
  }
  record({ scope: "config", id: "database", state: "EVIDENCE", database: cfg.db, apiBase: cfg.base });

  // --- authenticate with the established local smoke identity --------------
  let login;
  try {
    login = await api(cfg.base, "POST", "/auth/login", null,
      { UserName: cfg.user, Password: cfg.pass });
  } catch (err) {
    fatal = "T-202 could not reach the API at " + cfg.base + ": " + String(err && err.message);
    return;
  }
  if (!login.ok) { fatal = "T-202 login failed: http " + login.status; return; }
  const token = pick(login.json, "accessToken", "token");
  if (!token) { fatal = "T-202 login returned no bearer token."; return; }

  // --- runtime database evidence (documented in scripts\run\start-api.ps1) --
  try {
    const readiness = await api(cfg.base, "GET", "/api/ml/foundation/readiness", token);
    if (readiness.ok) {
      record({ scope: "config", id: "runtime-db-evidence", state: "EVIDENCE",
               note: "start-api.ps1 documents that ppiq_presentation reports outcome_values " +
                     "near 195,221 and correlation_results near 320. Materially different " +
                     "numbers mean the API reached ppiq_app.",
               readinessExcerpt: readiness.text.slice(0, 400) });
    }
  } catch { /* evidence only, never fatal */ }

  // --- enumerate persisted definitions -------------------------------------
  const defsRes = await api(cfg.base, "GET", "/analytics/dashboard/definitions", token);
  if (!defsRes.ok) {
    fatal = "T-202 could not enumerate dashboard definitions: http " + defsRes.status;
    return;
  }
  const raw = Array.isArray(defsRes.json) ? defsRes.json : pick(defsRes.json, "items", "Items");
  const definitions = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : [];

  const pagesRes = await api(cfg.base, "GET", "/pages", token);
  const pages = pagesRes.ok && Array.isArray(pagesRes.json) ? pagesRes.json : [];
  for (const p of pages) {
    record({ scope: "page", id: pick(p, "Slug") || pick(p, "Id"), title: pick(p, "Title"),
             backingDashboardDefinitionId: pick(p, "BackingDashboardDefinitionId") ?? null,
             state: pick(p, "IsDeleted") === true ? "SKIPPED_DELETED" : "ENUMERATED" });
  }

  let widgetCount = 0;

  for (const def of definitions) {
    const defId = pick(def, "Id");
    const defCode = pick(def, "DashboardCode");
    const isFalsifyArtifact = typeof defCode === "string" && defCode.startsWith(FALSIFY_PREFIX);

    if (pick(def, "IsActive") === false) {
      record({ scope: "dashboard", id: defId, code: defCode, state: "SKIPPED_INACTIVE" });
      continue;
    }

    let widgets = pick(def, "Widgets");
    if (!Array.isArray(widgets)) {
      const one = await api(cfg.base, "GET", "/analytics/dashboard/definitions/" + defId, token);
      if (!one.ok) {
        record({ scope: "dashboard", id: defId, code: defCode, state: "FAILED",
                 reason: "definition detail http " + one.status });
        continue;
      }
      widgets = pick(one.json, "Widgets");
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(widgets)) widgets = [];

    record({ scope: "dashboard", id: defId, code: defCode, state: "ENUMERATED",
             widgetCount: widgets.length,
             note: isFalsifyArtifact
               ? "Falsification artifact. If this appears outside a falsification run, a " +
                 "previous run failed to clean up - delete it before trusting the gate."
               : undefined });

    for (const w of widgets) {
      if (pick(w, "IsActive") === false) {
        record({ scope: "widget", dashboard: defCode, id: pick(w, "WidgetCode"), state: "SKIPPED_INACTIVE" });
        continue;
      }
      widgetCount += 1;

      const exprEnabled = pick(w, "ExpressionEnabled") === true;
      const expr = pick(w, "QueryExpression");

      let route, res;
      if (exprEnabled && expr) {
        route = "/analytics/dashboard/widgets/execute";
        res = await api(cfg.base, "POST", route, token,
          { queryExpression: expr, widgetType: pick(w, "WidgetType"), chartType: pick(w, "ChartType") });
      } else {
        route = "/analytics/dashboard/widgets/query";
        res = await api(cfg.base, "POST", route, token, buildQuery(w));
      }

      const verdict = classify(res);
      record({
        scope: "widget",
        dashboard: defCode,
        id: pick(w, "WidgetCode"),
        title: pick(w, "WidgetTitle"),
        route,
        chartType: pick(w, "ChartType"),
        dimensionCode: pick(w, "DimensionCode"),
        measureCode: pick(w, "MeasureCode"),
        parameterCode: pick(w, "ParameterCode") ?? null,
        expressionEnabled: exprEnabled,
        httpStatus: res.status,
        falsificationArtifact: isFalsifyArtifact || undefined,
        ...verdict,
        bodyExcerpt: (verdict.state === "FAILED" || verdict.state === "UNCLASSIFIED")
          ? res.text.slice(0, 400) : undefined
      });
    }
  }

  if (definitions.length === 0) {
    fatal = "T-202 refuses GREEN: zero dashboard definitions enumerated. " +
            "An empty inventory is indistinguishable from a passing replay.";
    return;
  }
  if (widgetCount === 0) {
    fatal = "T-202 refuses GREEN: zero active widget definitions replayed across " +
            definitions.length + " dashboard definition(s).";
    return;
  }
}

const started = new Date().toISOString();
main()
  .catch((e) => { fatal = "T-202 harness threw: " + String(e && e.stack ? e.stack : e); })
  .finally(() => {
    const counts = {};
    for (const r of results) counts[r.state] = (counts[r.state] || 0) + 1;

    const failCount = (counts.FAILED || 0) + (counts.UNCLASSIFIED || 0);
    const verdict = (fatal || failCount > 0) ? "FAIL" : "PASS";

    const manifest = {
      gate: "T-202",
      task: "Persisted page/widget definition replay gate",
      startedAtUtc: started,
      finishedAtUtc: new Date().toISOString(),
      apiBase: process.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || null,
      database: process.env.POSTGRES_DB || null,
      verdict, fatal, counts, entries: results
    };

    fs.mkdirSync(OUT_DIR, { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(OUT_FILE, JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2), "utf8");

    console.log("");
    console.log("T-202 PERSISTED DEFINITION REPLAY GATE");
    console.log("  api      : " + (manifest.apiBase || "?"));
    console.log("  database : " + (manifest.database || "?"));
    console.log("  manifest : " + OUT_FILE);
    console.log("  counts   : " + JSON.stringify(counts));
    if (fatal) console.log("  fatal    : " + fatal);
    for (const r of results) {
      if (r.state === "FAILED" || r.state === "UNCLASSIFIED") {
        console.log("  [" + r.state + "] " + (r.dashboard || r.scope) + "/" + (r.id || "") +
                    " :: " + (r.reason || ""));
      }
    }
    console.log("  VERDICT  : " + verdict);
    process.exit(verdict === "PASS" ? 0 : 2);
  });
'@

# ------------------------------------------------- falsification driver ---
$Falsify = @'
// ============================================================================
// T-202 falsification driver.
//
// Proves the gate can go RED on a broken persisted definition.
//
// SAFETY: by default this NEVER mutates a real Release-1 definition. It creates
// an isolated, disposable dashboard definition prefixed T202_FALSIFY_, gives it
// one deliberately broken widget, proves the gate goes RED, deletes it, and
// proves the gate returns GREEN. Release Truth must not create the defect it is
// trying to detect.
//
// Mutating a real persisted definition requires --allow-real-mutation AND
// explicit tech-lead approval. It is not the default and not recommended.
// ============================================================================

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import path from "node:path";

const PREFIX = "T202_FALSIFY_";
const BROKEN_MEASURE = "__PPIQ_T202_NO_SUCH_MEASURE__";
const ALLOW_REAL = process.argv.includes("--allow-real-mutation");

function pick(o, ...names) {
  if (!o || typeof o !== "object") return undefined;
  for (const n of names) {
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(o, n)) return o[n];
    const lo = n.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + n.slice(1);
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(o, lo)) return o[lo];
  }
  return undefined;
}

async function api(base, method, route, token, body) {
  const headers = { Accept: "application/json" };
  if (token) { headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + token; headers["X-PPIQ-MFA-Verified"] = "true"; }
  if (body !== undefined) headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
  const res = await fetch(base + route, {
    method, headers, body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body)
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  let json = null;
  try { json = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null; } catch { json = null; }
  return { status: res.status, ok: res.ok, json, text };
}

function runGate() {
  const gate = path.resolve(process.cwd(), "tests/release-truth/t202-definition-replay.mjs");
  return spawnSync(process.execPath, [gate], { stdio: "inherit", env: process.env }).status;
}

function resolveBase() {
  const b = process.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || process.env.ASPNETCORE_URLS;
  if (!b) throw new Error("No API base in the loaded profile. Run Invoke-T202-ReplayGate.ps1 -Falsify.");
  return b.split(";")[0].replace(/\/+$/, "");
}

async function main() {
  if (ALLOW_REAL) {
    throw new Error("--allow-real-mutation is refused by default. Mutating a real Release-1 " +
                    "persisted definition requires an explicit tech-lead ruling recorded in the " +
                    "task evidence. The isolated path proves the same property safely.");
  }

  const base = resolveBase();
  const login = await api(base, "POST", "/auth/login", null, {
    UserName: process.env.PPIQ_SMOKE_USERNAME || process.env.VITE_SMOKE_USERNAME,
    Password: process.env.PPIQ_SMOKE_PASSWORD || process.env.VITE_SMOKE_PASSWORD
  });
  if (!login.ok) throw new Error("login failed: http " + login.status);
  const token = pick(login.json, "accessToken", "token");

  const code = PREFIX + Date.now();
  let defId = null;

  console.log("\n--- T-202 FALSIFICATION: creating isolated definition " + code + " ---");
  try {
    const created = await api(base, "POST", "/analytics/dashboard/definitions", token, {
      dashboardCode: code,
      name: "T-202 falsification (disposable)",
      description: "Created by the T-202 falsification driver. Safe to delete.",
      layoutJson: "{}",
      isDefault: false,
      isSystemTemplate: false,
      isSynthetic: true
    });
    if (!created.ok) throw new Error("could not create isolated definition: http " + created.status +
                                     " " + created.text.slice(0, 300));
    defId = pick(created.json, "Id");
    if (!defId) throw new Error("create returned no definition id");

    const widget = await api(base, "POST",
      "/analytics/dashboard/definitions/" + defId + "/widgets", token, {
        widgetCode: "T202_FALSIFY_WIDGET",
        widgetTitle: "Deliberately broken",
        widgetType: "chart",
        chartType: "bar",
        dimensionCode: "__PPIQ_T202_NO_SUCH_DIMENSION__",
        measureCode: BROKEN_MEASURE,
        filterJson: "{}",
        layoutJson: "{}",
        displayOptionsJson: "{}",
        sortOrder: 0,
        isSynthetic: true
      });
    if (!widget.ok) throw new Error("could not create broken widget: http " + widget.status +
                                    " " + widget.text.slice(0, 300));

    const red = runGate();
    if (red === 0) {
      throw new Error("FALSIFICATION FAILED: gate returned PASS while a broken persisted " +
                      "definition existed. The gate cannot detect a broken definition.");
    }
    console.log("--- gate correctly went RED (exit " + red + ") ---");
  } finally {
    if (defId) {
      const del = await api(base, "DELETE", "/analytics/dashboard/definitions/" + defId, token);
      console.log(del.ok
        ? "--- isolated definition removed ---"
        : "!!! CLEANUP FAILED http " + del.status + " - remove dashboardCode " + code + " manually");
      if (!del.ok) process.exitCode = 2;
    }
  }

  const green = runGate();
  if (green !== 0) throw new Error("RESTORE VERIFY FAILED: gate still RED after cleanup (exit " + green + ").");
  console.log("--- gate correctly returned GREEN after cleanup ---");
  console.log("\nT-202 FALSIFICATION: PASS");
}

main().catch((e) => {
  console.error("\nT-202 FALSIFICATION: FAIL - " + String(e && e.message ? e.message : e));
  process.exit(2);
});
'@

# ------------------------------------------------------ canonical runner ---
$Runner = @'
<#
T-202 canonical runner.

One command. Loads the established PPIQ presentation profile, reuses the running
API if it is healthy, otherwise starts it with the canonical launcher and waits
for health. Never invents a port. Never prints a secret.
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot = "C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ",
    [ValidateSet("local","test","server","presentation")]
    [string]$Profile  = "presentation",
    [int]$HealthTimeoutSeconds = 180,
    [switch]$Falsify,
    [switch]$NoLaunch
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$UseProfile = Join-Path $RepoRoot "scripts\env\use-profile.ps1"
$StartApi   = Join-Path $RepoRoot "scripts\run\start-api.ps1"
$WebRoot    = Join-Path $RepoRoot "Frontend\PlantProcess.Web"

if (-not (Test-Path $UseProfile)) { throw "Canonical profile loader missing: $UseProfile" }
if (-not (Test-Path $WebRoot))    { throw "Frontend root missing: $WebRoot" }

Write-Host "[T-202] Loading profile '$Profile' via the canonical loader" -ForegroundColor Cyan
& $UseProfile -Profile $Profile

$ApiBase = $env:VITE_API_BASE_URL
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ApiBase)) { $ApiBase = ($env:ASPNETCORE_URLS -split ';')[0] }
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ApiBase)) { throw "Profile '$Profile' declares no API base URL." }
$ApiBase = $ApiBase.TrimEnd('/')

Write-Host "[T-202] API base   : $ApiBase"
Write-Host "[T-202] Database   : $($env:POSTGRES_DB)"

function Test-ApiHealthy {
    param([string]$Base)
    try {
        $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$Base/health" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5
        return ($r.StatusCode -ge 200 -and $r.StatusCode -lt 300)
    } catch { return $false }
}

if (Test-ApiHealthy -Base $ApiBase) {
    Write-Host "[T-202] Reusing the already-healthy API at $ApiBase" -ForegroundColor Green
} elseif ($NoLaunch) {
    throw "API is not healthy at $ApiBase and -NoLaunch was specified."
} else {
    if (-not (Test-Path $StartApi)) { throw "Canonical API launcher missing: $StartApi" }
    Write-Host "[T-202] API not healthy. Starting via $StartApi -Profile $Profile" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    $log = Join-Path $env:TEMP "ppiq-t202-api.log"
    $proc = Start-Process powershell `
        -ArgumentList @("-NoProfile","-ExecutionPolicy","Bypass","-File",$StartApi,"-Profile",$Profile) `
        -RedirectStandardOutput $log -RedirectStandardError "$log.err" -PassThru

    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($HealthTimeoutSeconds)
    while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {
        if (Test-ApiHealthy -Base $ApiBase) { break }
        if ($proc.HasExited) { break }
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
    }

    if (-not (Test-ApiHealthy -Base $ApiBase)) {
        Write-Host "[T-202] API LAUNCH FAILED" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host "  launcher : $StartApi -Profile $Profile"
        Write-Host "  exited   : $($proc.HasExited)"
        if ($proc.HasExited) { Write-Host "  exit code: $($proc.ExitCode)" }
        foreach ($f in @($log, "$log.err")) {
            if (Test-Path $f) {
                Write-Host "  --- last 30 lines of $f ---" -ForegroundColor Yellow
                Get-Content $f -Tail 30 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "    $_" }
            }
        }
        throw "T-202 aborted: API never became healthy at $ApiBase within $HealthTimeoutSeconds s."
    }
    Write-Host "[T-202] API healthy" -ForegroundColor Green
}

Push-Location $WebRoot
try {
    if ($Falsify) {
        Write-Host "[T-202] Running falsification (isolated disposable definition)" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        & node "tests\release-truth\t202-falsification.mjs"
    } else {
        Write-Host "[T-202] Running persisted definition replay gate" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        & node "tests\release-truth\t202-definition-replay.mjs"
    }
    $code = $LASTEXITCODE
} finally { Pop-Location }

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[T-202] Manifest: $WebRoot\reports\release-truth\T202_definition_replay.json"
exit $code
'@

# ------------------------------------------------------ contract README ---
$Readme = @'
# T-202 - Persisted page/widget definition replay gate

Owner: Worker 2 (Release Truth). Backlog v2.17.
Lock: frontend E2E + dashboard query test harness. No canonical schema edits.

## Bounded scope

Enumerate every ACTIVE persisted dashboard/widget/page definition in the real
release database and prove each replays through the real API path without a
hidden HTTP/API/runtime failure. Nothing else.

Out of scope, deliberately: cross-filter correctness (T-204), route/network/
console invariants (T-203), frontend suite termination (T-205), customer Day-1
flow (T-247).

## One command

    .\tests\release-truth\Invoke-T202-ReplayGate.ps1
    .\tests\release-truth\Invoke-T202-ReplayGate.ps1 -Falsify

The runner loads `scripts\env\use-profile.ps1 -Profile presentation`, reuses a
healthy API if one is running, otherwise starts it with `scripts\run\start-api.ps1`
and waits for `/health`. It never invents a port and never prints a secret.

No new environment variable convention is introduced. The harness consumes what
the profile already defines: `VITE_API_BASE_URL`, `PPIQ_SMOKE_USERNAME`,
`PPIQ_SMOKE_PASSWORD`, `POSTGRES_DB`, `ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb`.

## Terminal states (Release 1)

| State | Meaning |
|---|---|
| POPULATED | 2xx, recognised result shape, rows > 0 |
| EMPTY | 2xx, recognised result shape, rows == 0 |
| BLOCKED | reserved for an explicitly declared licence/entitlement envelope |
| FAILED | any unexpected status, **including 401/403** |
| UNCLASSIFIED | 2xx whose body is not a recognised result shape - fails the gate |

401/403 is a failure, never a valid terminal state. An inaccessible customer
surface must not appear as a successful outcome. A deliberately
permission-restricted widget belongs in a separate permission scenario, not here.

A richer capability-refusal contract may be added later if the API grows one.
It is explicitly **not** a blocker for T-202.

## Refusal rules

The gate cannot go green by omission:

- configuration missing from the profile -> FAIL, never skip
- API unreachable -> FAIL, never skip
- connection-string database != profile `POSTGRES_DB` -> refuse to run
- zero definitions or zero active widgets -> FAIL
- unrecognised 2xx body -> FAIL as UNCLASSIFIED

## Falsification safety

The driver creates an isolated disposable definition prefixed `T202_FALSIFY_`,
proves the gate goes RED, deletes it, proves the gate returns GREEN. It does
**not** mutate a real Release-1 persisted definition. `--allow-real-mutation`
is refused and requires an explicit tech-lead ruling.

If a `T202_FALSIFY_*` definition ever appears in a normal run, a previous
falsification failed to clean up. The manifest says so. Delete it before
trusting the result.

## Output

`reports/release-truth/T202_definition_replay.json` - machine readable, one
entry per page, dashboard and widget, naming the definition that failed.
'@

Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $GateFile     -Text $Gate;     [void]$script:Created.Add($GateFile);     Write-Ok "Wrote t202-definition-replay.mjs"

function Write-AsciiFile {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Content)
    if ([regex]::IsMatch($Content, '[^\x00-\x7F]')) {
        throw "ASCII gate: refusing to write non-ASCII content to $Path"
    }
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Content, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    [void]$Created.Add($Path)
}

function Invoke-Revert {
    param([string]$Reason)
    Write-Bad "REVERTING. Reason: $Reason"
    foreach ($f in $Created) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force; Write-Host "  removed $f" }
    }
    Write-Bad 'Revert complete. No foreign file was ever touched.'
    exit 1
}

# --- Build-lock guard -------------------------------------------------------
# The test project references PlantProcess.Api, so building it rewrites the API's
# output directory. If the API is running it holds those DLLs open, MSBuild burns
# ten retries and then fails with MSB3027/MSB3021, and a perfectly good gate looks
# broken. Catch it here, before a single file is written.
function Test-PpiqOutputLocked {
    param([string]$Root)

    $candidates = @(
        'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\bin\Debug\net9.0\PlantProcess.Infrastructure.dll',
        'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\bin\Debug\net9.0\PlantProcess.Application.dll',
        'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\bin\Debug\net9.0\PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.dll',
        'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\bin\Debug\net9.0\PlantProcess.Domain.dll'
    )

    $locked = @()
    foreach ($rel in $candidates) {
        $abs = Join-Path $Root $rel
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $abs)) { continue }
        try {
            $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($abs, 'Open', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
            $fs.Close(); $fs.Dispose()
        }
        catch { $locked += $rel }
    }

    return $locked
}

# @() is mandatory here: a function returning an empty array unrolls to $null, and
# under Set-StrictMode 2.0 reading .Count on $null throws. The guard would then fail
# in exactly the case it is meant to pass - when nothing is locked.
$LockedOutputs = @(Test-PpiqOutputLocked -Root $RepoRoot)

if ($LockedOutputs.Count -gt 0) {
    $holders = @()
    try {
        $holders = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='PlantProcess.Api.exe' OR Name='PlantProcess.Workers.exe' OR Name='dotnet.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -match 'PlantProcess\.(Api|Workers)' } |
            ForEach-Object { $_.Name + " (PID " + $_.ProcessId + ")" })
    }
    catch { }

    Write-Bad 'STOP: PlantProcess build outputs are locked by a running process.'
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  Locked files:' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    $LockedOutputs | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ("    " + $_) -ForegroundColor Yellow }
    if ($holders.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Host '  Holding process(es):' -ForegroundColor Yellow
        $holders | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ("    " + $_) -ForegroundColor Yellow }
    }
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  This test project references PlantProcess.Api, so any build rewrites the API'
    Write-Host '  output directory. A running API makes that impossible (MSB3027/MSB3021).'
    Write-Host '  This is an environment condition, not a gate failure.'
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  Stop the running API, then re-run this pack:'
    Write-Host '    Get-Process PlantProcess.Api -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force'
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  Nothing was written to the repository.'
    exit 2
}

Write-Ok 'build outputs are writable: no running PlantProcess process holds them'

    'Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/T206GenericityScope.cs',
    'Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/T206RuleValidationTests.cs',

    'docs/quality/T206_genericity_inventory.md'
)

    if (-not $RetireResolved) {

            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $abs) { throw "collision: $rel already exists. This pack creates files; it does not overwrite them." }
        }
        Write-Ok 'no collision on the five owned paths'
    }

    # Parallel-worker delta guard: record the foreign dirty set now, compare at the end.

        Where-Object { $Owned -notcontains $_ })
    Write-Ok ("foreign dirty paths at start: " + $ForeignDirtyBefore.Count)
}
finally { Pop-Location }

# ===========================================================================
# PHASE 3 - APPLY (three C# files; the scanner is the single source of truth)
# ===========================================================================
Write-Step 'Phase 3 - apply'

$scopeCs = @'
// PPIQ T-206 - scope and universal-assumption authority.
//
// This is an architecture gate, not a word filter. A product file is allowed to
// mention several material types in a description precisely in order to privilege
// none of them; that is genericity being asserted, not violated. What is forbidden
// is a CONSTRUCT that bakes one customer's world into the product:
//
//   UA-01 industry identity used as product data
//   UA-02 business logic keyed to one material identity
//   UA-03 silent default grain
//   UA-04 fixed default business parameter or unit system
//   UA-05 typed union that constrains the customer model
//   UA-06 customer schema column treated as universally available
//   UA-07 behaviour inferred from customer vocabulary
//
// Rule validity is proven against synthetic samples, never against real debt in the
// tree. When Worker 1 finishes T-093/T-094 and the tree is clean, every rule here
// still works and still blocks regression.
//
// This file classifies itself and its sibling gate files as Excluded: a scanner that
// reads its own definition table reports its own rules as violations.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests;

public enum T206Scope
{
    ProductGeneric,
    CustomerAsset,
    TestOrFixture,
    Documentation,
    Excluded
}

public sealed class T206Rule
{
    public T206Rule(string id, string assumption, string description, string pattern)
    {
        Id = id;
        Assumption = assumption;
        Description = description;
        Pattern = new Regex(pattern, RegexOptions.Compiled | RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
    }

    public string Id { get; }
    public string Assumption { get; }
    public string Description { get; }
    public Regex Pattern { get; }
}

public sealed class T206Finding
{
    public T206Finding(string relativePath, int line, T206Rule rule, string construct)
    {
        RelativePath = relativePath;
        Line = line;
        RuleId = rule.Id;
        Assumption = rule.Assumption;
        Construct = T206GenericityScope.NormaliseConstruct(construct);
        Fingerprint = T206GenericityScope.Fingerprint(relativePath, rule.Id, Construct);
    }

    public string RelativePath { get; }

    // Informational only. Line movement is not a semantic change and is never
    // part of the fingerprint.
    public int Line { get; }

    public string RuleId { get; }
    public string Assumption { get; }
    public string Construct { get; }
    public string Fingerprint { get; }
}

public static class T206GenericityScope
{
    private static readonly string[] SelfExcluded =
    {
        "t206genericityscope.cs",
        "t206rulevalidationtests.cs",
        "t206baselinegatetests.cs",
        "t206_genericity_baseline.json",
        "t206_genericity_inventory.md"
    };

    private static readonly string[] ProductExtensions = { ".cs", ".ts", ".tsx", ".py" };

    public static IReadOnlyList<T206Rule> Rules { get; } = new List<T206Rule>
    {
        new T206Rule(
            "UA-01", "UA-01",
            "industry equipment identity used as product data",
            "\"\\s*(caster|mill|furnace|kiln|roller|conveyor line)\\s*[-_ ]?\\d+\\s*\""),

        new T206Rule(
            "UA-02", "UA-02",
            "business logic keyed to one material identity",
            "\\b(coil|heat|slab|billet|ingot)(id|_id|key|number)\\b|\"(coil|heat|slab):\""),

        new T206Rule(
            "UA-03", "UA-03",
            "silent default grain: a grain resolved to a hardcoded literal instead of failing closed",
            "grain[^;\\r\\n]{0,80}\\?\\?\\s*\"|isnullorwhitespace\\s*\\(\\s*[a-z0-9_.]*grain\\s*\\)\\s*\\?\\s*\"|\\?\\s*\"(coil|heat|slab|batch|lot|piece)\"\\s*:"),

        new T206Rule(
            "UA-04", "UA-04",
            "fixed default business parameter or unit system",
            "\"[a-z0-9_]*_per_(ton|tonne|kg|lb|pound|bbl)\\b[a-z0-9_]*\"|\\b(grade|coil|heat)_premium\\b"),

        new T206Rule(
            "UA-05", "UA-05",
            "typed union or enum that constrains the customer model to one industry",
            "\"(coil|heat|slab|cast|billet)\"\\s*\\|\\s*\"(coil|heat|slab|cast|billet|process|batch|lot)\""),

        new T206Rule(
            "UA-06", "UA-06",
            "customer schema column treated as universally available",
            "\\b(heat_id|coil_id|slab_id|piece_id|material_id|src_heats|src_coils)\\b"),

        new T206Rule(
            "UA-07", "UA-07",
            "behaviour inferred from customer vocabulary rather than declared metadata",
            "(indexof|contains|startswith|endswith)\\s*\\(\\s*\"(grade|coil|heat|slab|cast)\"")
    };

    public static string RepositoryRoot()
    {
        var dir = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);
        while (dir is not null && !Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(dir.FullName, "Backend")))
        {
            dir = dir.Parent;
        }

        if (dir is null) throw new InvalidOperationException("PPIQ-T206: could not locate the repository root.");
        return dir.FullName;
    }

    public static string Normalise(string relativePath)
    {
        return relativePath.Replace('\\', '/').TrimStart('/');
    }

    public static T206Scope Classify(string relativePath)
    {
        var p = Normalise(relativePath).ToLowerInvariant();
        var name = p.Contains('/') ? p.Substring(p.LastIndexOf('/') + 1) : p;

        if (SelfExcluded.Contains(name)) return T206Scope.Excluded;
        if (p.Contains("node_modules/") || p.Contains("/bin/") || p.Contains("/obj/") ||
            p.Contains("/dist/") || p.Contains("playwright-report") || p.StartsWith(".git/"))
        {
            return T206Scope.Excluded;
        }

        if (p.EndsWith(".md") || p.StartsWith("docs/")) return T206Scope.Documentation;

        if (p.Contains("/tests/") || p.StartsWith("tests/") || p.Contains("__tests__") ||
            p.Contains(".test.") || p.Contains(".spec.") || p.Contains("/e2e/") ||
            p.Contains("/fixtures/") || p.Contains("/_fixtures/"))
        {
            return T206Scope.TestOrFixture;
        }

        // Emulated-plant dataset generation and repository tooling: one plant's data,
        // legitimately carrying one plant's vocabulary. Product code must not depend on it.
        if (p.StartsWith("tools/") || p.StartsWith("backend/tools/") || p.StartsWith("scripts/"))
        {
            return T206Scope.CustomerAsset;
        }

        if (p.StartsWith("website/")) return T206Scope.Excluded;
        if (!ProductExtensions.Contains(Path.GetExtension(p))) return T206Scope.Excluded;

        return T206Scope.ProductGeneric;
    }

    // Scans run on comment-stripped text. Prose explaining a forbidden construct must
    // never trip a guard about that construct.
    public static string StripComments(string raw)
    {
        var s = Regex.Replace(raw, @"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", string.Empty);
        s = Regex.Replace(s, @"(?m)^\s*//.*$", string.Empty);
        s = Regex.Replace(s, @"(?m)^\s*--.*$", string.Empty);
        s = Regex.Replace(s, @"(?m)^\s*#.*$", string.Empty);
        return s;
    }

    public static string NormaliseConstruct(string matched)
    {
        var s = Regex.Replace(matched.Trim().ToLowerInvariant(), @"\s+", " ");
        if (s.Length > 120) s = s.Substring(0, 120);
        return s;
    }

    // Path + rule + normalised construct. Deliberately NOT line number: moving a line
    // is not a semantic change and must not invalidate a grandfathered entry.
    public static string Fingerprint(string relativePath, string ruleId, string normalisedConstruct)
    {
        var payload = Normalise(relativePath).ToLowerInvariant() + "|" + ruleId + "|" + normalisedConstruct;
        using var sha = SHA256.Create();
        var bytes = sha.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(payload));
        var sb = new StringBuilder(64);
        foreach (var b in bytes) sb.Append(b.ToString("x2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    public static IReadOnlyList<string> ProductGenericFiles(string root)
    {
        var results = new List<string>();

        foreach (var area in new[] { "Backend", "Frontend" })
        {
            var areaPath = Path.Combine(root, area);
            if (!Directory.Exists(areaPath)) continue;

            foreach (var file in Directory.EnumerateFiles(areaPath, "*.*", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
            {
                var rel = Normalise(file.Substring(root.Length + 1));
                if (Classify(rel) == T206Scope.ProductGeneric) results.Add(rel);
            }
        }

        results.Sort(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        return results;
    }

    // Scans arbitrary in-memory text. Every rule is validated through this entry point
    // with synthetic samples, so rule validity never depends on the tree being dirty.
    public static IReadOnlyList<T206Finding> ScanText(string relativePath, string rawText)
    {
        var findings = new List<T206Finding>();
        if (Classify(relativePath) != T206Scope.ProductGeneric) return findings;

        var lines = StripComments(rawText).Split('\n');

        for (var i = 0; i < lines.Length; i++)
        {
            foreach (var rule in Rules)
            {
                foreach (Match m in rule.Pattern.Matches(lines[i]))
                {
                    findings.Add(new T206Finding(relativePath, i + 1, rule, m.Value));
                }
            }
        }

        return findings;
    }

    public static IReadOnlyList<T206Finding> ScanRepository(string root)
    {
        var all = new List<T206Finding>();

        foreach (var rel in ProductGenericFiles(root))
        {
            string raw;
            try { raw = File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(root, rel.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar))); }
            catch (IOException) { continue; }
            all.AddRange(ScanText(rel, raw));
        }

        return all;
    }
}
'@

$ruleCs = @'
// PPIQ T-206 - rule validity, proven synthetically.
//
// Every rule is exercised against a positive sample that MUST trigger and a
// neighbouring generic sample that MUST NOT. Validity therefore does not depend on
// the repository still containing debt. After T-094 drives the tree to zero, these
// tests are unchanged and still green, and the gate still blocks regression.
using System.Linq;
using Xunit;

namespace PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests;

[Trait("Task", "T206")]
public sealed class T206RuleValidationTests
{
    private const string ProductPath = "Backend/PlantProcess.Application/Sample.cs";

    private static bool Triggers(string assumption, string code)
    {
        return T206GenericityScope
            .ScanText(ProductPath, code)
            .Any(f => f.Assumption == assumption);
    }

    public static TheoryData<string, string, string> Samples()
    {
        var data = new TheoryData<string, string, string>();

        // assumption, MUST trigger, MUST NOT trigger
        data.Add("UA-01",
            "var rows = new[] { new { equipment = \"Caster 1\" }, new { equipment = \"Mill 1\" } };",
            "var rows = catalogue.ResolveEquipment(request.EquipmentKey);");

        data.Add("UA-02",
            "var handle = inputs.CoilId is null ? null : \"coil:\" + inputs.CoilId;",
            "var handle = inputs.SubjectId is null ? null : subject.Kind + \":\" + inputs.SubjectId;");

        data.Add("UA-03",
            "var grain = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Grain) ? \"coil\" : request.Grain.Trim();",
            "var grain = registry.ResolveGrain(request) ?? throw new GrainUnresolvedException(request);");

        data.Add("UA-04",
            "RequireBand(assumptions.GradePremiumPerTon, \"grade_premium_per_ton\", missing);",
            "RequireBand(assumptions.ValuePerUnit, configuredParameter.Key, missing);");

        data.Add("UA-05",
            "kind: \"coil\" | \"heat\" | \"cast\" | \"slab\" | \"process\" | string;",
            "kind: SubjectKind; // resolved from the customer's declared subject registry");

        data.Add("UA-06",
            "var sql = \"SELECT effective_sample_key, numeric_value, heat_id FROM outcomes\";",
            "var sql = \"SELECT effective_sample_key, numeric_value, \" + stratumColumn + \" FROM outcomes\";");

        data.Add("UA-07",
            "var isGrade = f.FeatureKey.IndexOf(\"grade\", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;",
            "var isStratum = f.FeatureKey.Equals(declared.StratumKey, StringComparison.Ordinal);");

        return data;
    }

    [Theory]
    [MemberData(nameof(Samples))]
    public void Every_rule_fires_on_its_construct_and_stays_silent_on_the_generic_neighbour(
        string assumption, string mustTrigger, string mustNotTrigger)
    {
        Assert.True(
            Triggers(assumption, mustTrigger),
            "PPIQ-T206: rule " + assumption + " failed to detect its own positive sample. The rule is broken.");

        Assert.False(
            Triggers(assumption, mustNotTrigger),
            "PPIQ-T206: rule " + assumption + " fired on a generic, metadata-driven construct. " +
            "This gate is an architecture guard, not a word filter, and a false positive here " +
            "teaches the next worker to disable it.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Descriptive_text_that_enumerates_many_industries_is_not_a_violation()
    {
        // The most genericity-affirming line in the dimension registry lists many
        // material types precisely so that none is privileged. A gate that fails this
        // line is measuring the wrong thing.
        const string code =
            "new DimensionDescriptor(\"material_type\", \"Generic material type such as batch, slab, coil, lot, tire, roll or component.\");";

        Assert.Empty(T206GenericityScope.ScanText(ProductPath, code));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Comments_are_stripped_before_scanning()
    {
        const string code =
            "// this comment mentions coil_id and \"Caster 1\"\nvar x = 1; /* and heat_id here */\nvar y = 2;";

        Assert.Empty(T206GenericityScope.ScanText(ProductPath, code));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Scope_classification_is_total_and_separator_insensitive()
    {
        Assert.Equal(T206Scope.ProductGeneric, T206GenericityScope.Classify("Backend/PlantProcess.Application/X.cs"));
        Assert.Equal(T206Scope.ProductGeneric, T206GenericityScope.Classify("Backend\\PlantProcess.Application\\X.cs"));
        Assert.Equal(T206Scope.CustomerAsset,  T206GenericityScope.Classify("Backend/tools/emulate_plant.py"));
        Assert.Equal(T206Scope.TestOrFixture,  T206GenericityScope.Classify("Backend/tests/X/YTests.cs"));
        Assert.Equal(T206Scope.Documentation,  T206GenericityScope.Classify("docs/quality/x.md"));
        Assert.Equal(T206Scope.Excluded,       T206GenericityScope.Classify(
            "Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/T206GenericityScope.cs"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Customer_asset_scope_is_never_scanned()
    {
        const string code = "grain = \"coil\"";
        Assert.Empty(T206GenericityScope.ScanText("Backend/tools/generate_demo.py", code));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_fingerprint_survives_line_movement_and_changes_with_the_construct()
    {
        const string original = "var grain = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Grain) ? \"coil\" : request.Grain;";
        var first  = T206GenericityScope.ScanText(ProductPath, original).Single().Fingerprint;
        var moved  = T206GenericityScope.ScanText(ProductPath, "\n\n\n" + original).Single().Fingerprint;
        var edited = T206GenericityScope.ScanText(ProductPath,
            "var grain = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Grain) ? \"heat\" : request.Grain;").Single().Fingerprint;

        Assert.Equal(first, moved);
        Assert.NotEqual(first, edited);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_product_generic_walk_is_not_vacuous()
    {
        var files = T206GenericityScope.ProductGenericFiles(T206GenericityScope.RepositoryRoot());

        Assert.True(
            files.Count > 400,
            "PPIQ-T206: the walk visited only " + files.Count + " product files. " +
            "A gate that scans nothing passes forever and proves nothing.");
    }
}

$gateCs = @'
// PPIQ T-206 - the fingerprint ratchet.
//
// A count is not a security boundary: remove two old violations, add two new ones,
// and a count-based gate stays green while the product acquires fresh customer
// identity. The baseline therefore records exact fingerprints.
//
//   known fingerprint present   -> reported, allowed (Worker 1 owns removal)
//   known fingerprint gone      -> good, nothing required
//   unknown fingerprint present -> BLOCKING FAILURE
//   retired fingerprint returns -> BLOCKING FAILURE
//
// Generation mode (PPIQ_T206_WRITE_BASELINE=1) is how the pack creates the baseline
// and the inventory, so the scanner in this assembly is the single source of truth
// for both the artifact and the gate. Two scanners would drift.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using Xunit;

namespace PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests;

[Trait("Task", "T206")]
public sealed class T206BaselineGateTests
{
    private const string BaselineRelative =
        "Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/T206_genericity_baseline.json";

    private const string InventoryRelative = "docs/quality/T206_genericity_inventory.md";

    private static string Abs(string relative)
    {
        return Path.Combine(
            T206GenericityScope.RepositoryRoot(),
            relative.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));
    }

    private static JsonElement Baseline()
    {
        var path = Abs(BaselineRelative);

        Assert.True(
            File.Exists(path),
            "PPIQ-T206: the committed baseline is missing. Deleting it must fail the build, never silence the gate.");

        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(path));
        return doc.RootElement.Clone();
    }

    private static HashSet<string> Set(JsonElement root, string property)
    {
        var set = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        if (!root.TryGetProperty(property, out var array)) return set;

        foreach (var item in array.EnumerateArray())
        {
            set.Add(item.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String
                ? item.GetString()!
                : item.GetProperty("fingerprint").GetString()!);
        }

        return set;
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Generate_baseline_and_inventory_when_explicitly_asked()
    {
        if (Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("PPIQ_T206_WRITE_BASELINE") != "1") return;

        var root = T206GenericityScope.RepositoryRoot();
        var files = T206GenericityScope.ProductGenericFiles(root);
        var findings = T206GenericityScope.ScanRepository(root);

        Assert.True(files.Count > 400, "PPIQ-T206: refusing to write a baseline from a vacuous scan.");

        var grandfathered = findings
            .GroupBy(f => f.Fingerprint, StringComparer.Ordinal)
            .Select(g => g.First())
            .OrderBy(f => f.RelativePath, StringComparer.Ordinal)
            .ThenBy(f => f.RuleId, StringComparer.Ordinal)
            .ToArray();

        var payload = new
        {
            task = "T-206",
            schema = 2,
            generatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ"),
            productGenericFileCount = files.Count,
            grandfatheredCount = grandfathered.Length,
            note = "Fingerprints, not a count. Entries may only disappear. A fingerprint absent from "
                 + "this list is a blocking failure. Removal is Worker 1 T-093/T-094.",
            grandfathered = grandfathered.Select(f => new
            {
                fingerprint = f.Fingerprint,
                path = f.RelativePath,
                rule = f.RuleId,
                assumption = f.Assumption,
                construct = f.Construct,
                lineWhenCaptured = f.Line
            }).ToArray(),
            retired = Array.Empty<string>()
        };

        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(Abs(InventoryRelative))!);

        File.WriteAllText(
            Abs(BaselineRelative),
            JsonSerializer.Serialize(payload, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true }));

        var md = new StringBuilder();
        md.AppendLine("# T-206 genericity inventory");
        md.AppendLine();
        md.AppendLine("Product-generic files scanned: " + files.Count);
        md.AppendLine("Grandfathered fingerprints: " + grandfathered.Length);
        md.AppendLine();
        md.AppendLine("Handed to Worker 1 for T-093 (term list) and T-094 (removal). Worker 3 does not edit these files.");
        md.AppendLine();

        foreach (var group in grandfathered.GroupBy(f => f.RelativePath, StringComparer.Ordinal)
                                           .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count()))
        {
            md.AppendLine("## " + group.Key + "  (" + group.Count() + ")");
            md.AppendLine();
            foreach (var f in group.OrderBy(x => x.Line))
            {
                md.AppendLine("- [" + f.RuleId + "] L" + f.Line + " `" + f.Construct + "`  fp=" + f.Fingerprint.Substring(0, 12));
            }
            md.AppendLine();
        }

        File.WriteAllText(Abs(InventoryRelative), md.ToString());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_baseline_exists_parses_and_is_not_vacuous()
    {
        var baseline = Baseline();

        Assert.True(baseline.GetProperty("productGenericFileCount").GetInt32() > 400,
            "PPIQ-T206: baseline records an implausibly small product scope.");

        Assert.Equal(
            baseline.GetProperty("grandfatheredCount").GetInt32(),
            Set(baseline, "grandfathered").Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void No_unapproved_genericity_fingerprint_exists()
    {
        var baseline = Baseline();
        var approved = Set(baseline, "grandfathered");
        var current = T206GenericityScope.ScanRepository(T206GenericityScope.RepositoryRoot());

        var unapproved = current
            .Where(f => !approved.Contains(f.Fingerprint))
            .GroupBy(f => f.Fingerprint, StringComparer.Ordinal)
            .Select(g => g.First())
            .ToArray();

        if (unapproved.Length == 0) return;

        var detail = unapproved
            .Take(25)
            .Select(f => f.RelativePath + ":" + f.Line + " [" + f.RuleId + "] " + f.Construct);

        Assert.Fail(
            "PPIQ-T206: " + unapproved.Length + " genericity finding(s) are not in the accepted baseline. " +
            "Product code has acquired customer or industry identity:\n  " +
            string.Join("\n  ", detail) +
            "\n\nThe baseline shrinks by removing violations. It is never widened to accommodate new ones.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_retired_fingerprint_never_returns()
    {
        var baseline = Baseline();
        var retired = Set(baseline, "retired");
        if (retired.Count == 0) return;

        var current = T206GenericityScope
            .ScanRepository(T206GenericityScope.RepositoryRoot())
            .Where(f => retired.Contains(f.Fingerprint))
            .Select(f => f.RelativePath + ":" + f.Line + " [" + f.RuleId + "] " + f.Construct)
            .Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            .ToArray();

        Assert.True(
            current.Length == 0,
            "PPIQ-T206: a previously removed genericity violation has returned:\n  " +
            string.Join("\n  ", current));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_baseline_and_the_inventory_agree()
    {
        var baseline = Baseline();
        var inventoryPath = Abs(InventoryRelative);

        Assert.True(File.Exists(inventoryPath), "PPIQ-T206: the inventory handed to Worker 1 is missing.");

        var inventory = File.ReadAllText(inventoryPath);
        var count = baseline.GetProperty("grandfatheredCount").GetInt32();

        Assert.Contains("Grandfathered fingerprints: " + count, inventory, StringComparison.Ordinal);

        foreach (var fp in Set(baseline, "grandfathered").Take(50))
        {
            Assert.Contains(fp.Substring(0, 12), inventory, StringComparison.Ordinal);
        }
    }
}
