[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot     = 'C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ',
    [string]$EvidenceRoot = 'C:\Workspace\_ppiq_evidence',
    [switch]$SkipTests
)

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Write-Head([string]$t) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan; Write-Host $t -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan }
function Write-Ok  ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [OK]   $t" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Warn([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [WARN] $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Write-Bad ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] $t" -ForegroundColor Red }
function Write-Inf ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [INFO] $t" -ForegroundColor Gray }

function Invoke-Git {
    param([string[]]$GitArgs)
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try { $raw = & git @GitArgs 2>&1; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; $text = ($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) -join "`r`n" }
    finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
    return @{ Code = $code; Text = $text }
}

function Get-DominantEol([string]$Text) {
    $crlf = ([regex]::Matches($Text, "`r`n")).Count
    $lf   = ([regex]::Matches($Text, "(?<!`r)`n")).Count
    if ($crlf -ge $lf) { return 'CRLF' } else { return 'LF' }
}
function ConvertTo-Lf([string]$Text) { return $Text.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n") }
function ConvertFrom-Lf([string]$Text, [string]$Eol) { if ($Eol -eq 'CRLF') { return $Text.Replace("`n", "`r`n") } return $Text }

function Test-HasBom([string]$Path) {
    $b = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Path)
    return ($b.Length -ge 3 -and $b[0] -eq 0xEF -and $b[1] -eq 0xBB -and $b[2] -eq 0xBF)
}
function Write-PreservingBom([string]$Path, [string]$Text, [bool]$HadBom) {
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($HadBom)))
}

$SvcRel  = 'Backend\PlantProcess.Application\Dashboarding\Services\Dashboards\DashboardDefinitionService.cs'
$TestRel = 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\CanonicalTemplateBindingTests.cs'
$SvcGit  = 'Backend/PlantProcess.Application/Dashboarding/Services/Dashboards/DashboardDefinitionService.cs'
$TestGit = 'Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/CanonicalTemplateBindingTests.cs'

$script:Backup  = ''
$script:Created = ''
$script:Staged  = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList

function Invoke-Rollback([string]$Reason) {
    Write-Head 'AUTO-REVERT'
    Write-Bad $Reason
    foreach ($p in $script:Staged) { Invoke-Git @('reset', '--', $p) | Out-Null; Write-Ok "unstaged: $p" }
    if ($script:Backup -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script:Backup)) {
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $script:Backup -Destination (Join-Path $RepoRootFull $SvcRel) -Force
        Write-Ok "restored: $SvcRel"
    }
    if ($script:Created -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script:Created)) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $script:Created -Force; Write-Ok "removed: $TestRel" }
    Write-Host ''
}

using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Xunit;

namespace PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests;

// Canonical template binding gate.
// A seeded template must not advertise a pairing the executor cannot group by.
// defectRate projects no Equipment and no DefectType member, and a donut of one
// effective category is refused by the chart grammar.
[Trait("Gate", "CanonicalTemplateBinding")]
public sealed class CanonicalTemplateBindingTests
{
    private const string AuthorityPath =
        "Backend/PlantProcess.Application/Dashboarding/Services/Dashboards/DashboardDefinitionService.cs";

    [Fact]

    }

    [Fact]

    [Fact]

        var codes = Regex.Matches(Source(), @"dashboardCode:\s*""([A-Z0-9_]+)""")
            .Select(m => m.Groups[1].Value)

        var offenders = codes.Where(c => !c.StartsWith("SYSTEM_", StringComparison.Ordinal)).ToList();

        Assert.True(
            offenders.Count == 0,
            "A seeded dashboard sits outside the canonical family:" +
            Environment.NewLine + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, offenders));
    }

    private static string Source()
    {
        var full = Path.Combine(FindRepositoryRoot(), AuthorityPath.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));
        Assert.True(File.Exists(full), "Missing: " + AuthorityPath);

        var text = File.ReadAllText(full);
        var withoutBlocks = Regex.Replace(text, @"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", string.Empty);
        return Regex.Replace(withoutBlocks, @"//[^\r\n]*", string.Empty);
    }

    private static string FindRepositoryRoot()
    {
        var directory = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);

        while (directory is not null)
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, ".git")) ||
                Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, "Backend")))
            {
                return directory.FullName;
            }

            directory = directory.Parent;
        }

        throw new InvalidOperationException("Repository root not found from " + AppContext.BaseDirectory);
    }
}

[METADATA: Path='tools\packs\Apply-PPIQ-TemplateConvergenceProof.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='Tooling Script', Lines=511, SizeKB=24.54, SHA256='96E1D859BE20F4053BD050C31D06BB513A43AEEFFD58D4944A2145D3AB5C7F7C', Modified='2026-08-25 16:15:17']

<#
================================================================================
PlantProcess IQ - SYSTEM TEMPLATE RUNTIME AUTHORITY PROOF
================================================================================
Owner : Worker 1
Type  : PROOF ONLY. No repository file is written, staged or committed.

WHAT THIS ANSWERS
  The retirement proof showed the legacy SQL template family is gone and left
  zero product templates. Zero is not the approved architecture: the approved
  architecture is ONE canonical operational authority. A Release Truth pass over
  no templates proves nothing.

  So this proves the runtime authority actually produces the family, on the
  canonical startup path, idempotently.

METHOD
  1. Resolve the connection from the existing profile. Nothing is embedded.
  2. Refuse unless the resolved database is the application database.
  3. Stop any running API. Snapshot the baseline.
  4. Start the API on the canonical local profile. Wait for health.
  5. Snapshot the canonical family semantically, not by count.
  6. Non-vacuity gate: dashboards > 0 and widgets > 0, or STOP.
  7. Stop the API. Start it again. Snapshot again.
  8. The two semantic snapshots must be byte-identical.
  9. The two retired widgets must not have returned, and no active product
     dashboard may sit outside the canonical family.

  A snapshot compares dashboard_code, widget_code, dimension_code, measure_code,
  parameter_code, source_system and active/deleted state - counts alone would
  hide content drift.

CREDENTIALS
  None embedded. Read from env\profiles in this order: an already-set PG*
  environment, then a connection string, then discrete keys. If none resolves the
  pack stops and says so. No value is printed except host, port, database, user.

EXIT  0 = runtime authority proven   2 = could not run, nothing changed
      3 = proof failed - read the reported reason, it is a real finding
================================================================================
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot      = 'C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ',
    [string]$EvidenceRoot  = 'C:\Workspace\_ppiq_evidence',
    [string]$ProfileFile   = 'env\profiles\local.env',
    [string]$ApiLauncher   = 'scripts\dev\run-api-local.ps1',
    [ValidateSet('DotnetRun','Runner')]
    [string]$LaunchMode    = 'DotnetRun',
    [string]$ApiHealthUrl  = '',
    [int]   $ExpectedWidgets = 13,
    [int]   $StartupWaitSeconds = 240,
    [int]   $SettleSeconds = 5
)

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Write-Head([string]$t) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan; Write-Host $t -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan }
function Write-Ok  ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [OK]   $t" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Warn([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [WARN] $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Write-Bad ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] $t" -ForegroundColor Red }
function Write-Inf ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [INFO] $t" -ForegroundColor Gray }

function Write-NoBom {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Text)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}

$script:Pg = @{}

function Invoke-PsqlTuples {
    param([string]$SqlFile, [string]$LogFile)
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try {
        $raw = & psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -A -F '|' -t `
            -h $script:Pg.Host -p $script:Pg.Port -U $script:Pg.User -d $script:Pg.Database `
            -f $SqlFile 2>&1
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
        $lines = @($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString().TrimEnd() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
        Write-NoBom -Path $LogFile -Text (($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
        return @{ Code = $code; Lines = $lines; Text = ($lines -join "`n") }
    } finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
}

function Stop-Api {
    $p = @(Get-Process -Name 'PlantProcess.Api' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
    if ($p.Count -gt 0) {
        $p | Stop-Process -Force
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
        Write-Inf ("stopped {0} API process(es)" -f $p.Count)
    }
}

function Test-Health([string]$Base) {
    try {
        $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ($Base.TrimEnd('/') + '/health') -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5
        return ($r.StatusCode -eq 200)
    } catch { return $false }
}

# Launches the API and CAPTURES its output. A launcher that throws in the first
# second is otherwise indistinguishable from a slow start, which is exactly how
# the previous revision of this pack wasted a ninety second timeout.
function Start-ApiAndWait {
    param([string]$Base, [int]$WaitSeconds, [string]$OutLog, [string]$ErrLog)

    if ($LaunchMode -eq 'Runner') {
        $launcherFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $ApiLauncher
        Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' `
            -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', $launcherFull) `
            -RedirectStandardOutput $OutLog -RedirectStandardError $ErrLog `
            -WorkingDirectory $RepoRootFull | Out-Null
    }
    else {
        # The child inherits this process's environment, which Phase 1 populated
        # from the profile. No dependency on user-scoped variables.
        $csproj = Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\PlantProcess.Api.csproj'
        Start-Process -FilePath 'dotnet' `
            -ArgumentList @('run', '--no-launch-profile', '--no-build', '--project', $csproj) `
            -RedirectStandardOutput $OutLog -RedirectStandardError $ErrLog `
            -WorkingDirectory $RepoRootFull | Out-Null
    }

    $waited = 0
    while ($waited -lt $WaitSeconds) {
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
        $waited += 5
        if (Test-Health $Base) { return $waited }
        if ($waited % 30 -eq 0) { Write-Inf ("still waiting, ${waited}s") }
    }
    return -1
}

function Show-LauncherFailure {
    param([string]$OutLog, [string]$ErrLog)
    foreach ($pair in @(@{N='stderr'; P=$ErrLog}, @{N='stdout'; P=$OutLog})) {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $pair.P)) { continue }
        $tail = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $pair.P -Tail 15 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
        if ($tail.Count -eq 0) { continue }
        Write-Inf ("--- launcher " + $pair.N + " ---")
        foreach ($l in $tail) { Write-Host "         $l" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
    }
}

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot)) { Write-Bad "Repo not found: $RepoRoot"; exit 2 }
$RepoRootFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot).Path).TrimEnd('\')
foreach ($cmd in @('psql')) {
    if (-not (Get-Command $cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad "$cmd is not on PATH."; exit 2 }

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $launcherProbe)) {

        exit 2

Push-Location -LiteralPath $RepoRootFull
try {
    $ev = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Join-Path $EvidenceRoot 'SystemTemplateRuntimeAuthority') (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))).TrimEnd('\')
    if ($ev.ToLowerInvariant().StartsWith(($RepoRootFull + '\').ToLowerInvariant())) { Write-Bad 'EvidenceRoot resolves inside the repository.'; exit 2 }
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ev -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Ok "Evidence: $ev"

    # ==================================== PHASE 1 - RESOLVE THE CONNECTION ===
    Write-Head 'PHASE 1 - CONNECTION FROM THE PROFILE'
    Write-Inf 'Nothing is embedded in this pack. Only host, port, database and user are printed.'

    $profileFull = Join-Path $RepoRootFull $ProfileFile
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $profileFull)) {
        Write-Bad "profile not found: $ProfileFile"
        Write-Warn 'Pass -ProfileFile with the canonical local profile. No credential is invented.'
        exit 2
    }

    $kv = @{}
    foreach ($ln in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $profileFull)) {
        if ($ln -match '^\s*#') { continue }
        if ($ln -match '^\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$') { $kv[$Matches[1]] = $Matches[2] }
    }

    $script:Pg = @{ Host = ''; Port = '5432'; Database = ''; User = ''; Password = '' }

    # 1. an already-exported environment wins
    foreach ($pair in @(@{K='PGHOST';F='Host'}, @{K='PGPORT';F='Port'}, @{K='PGDATABASE';F='Database'}, @{K='PGUSER';F='User'}, @{K='PGPASSWORD';F='Password'})) {
        $envVal = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($pair.K)
        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($envVal)) { $script:Pg[$pair.F] = $envVal }
    }

    # 2. a connection string in the profile
    foreach ($key in @('ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb', 'ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection', 'PPIQ_DB_CONNECTION')) {
        if (-not $kv.ContainsKey($key)) { continue }
        foreach ($part in ($kv[$key] -split ';')) {
            if ($part -notmatch '^\s*([A-Za-z ]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$') { continue }
            $n = $Matches[1].Trim().ToLowerInvariant(); $v = $Matches[2]
            switch ($n) {
                'host'     { if (-not $script:Pg.Host)     { $script:Pg.Host = $v } }
                'server'   { if (-not $script:Pg.Host)     { $script:Pg.Host = $v } }
                'port'     { $script:Pg.Port = $v }
                'database' { if (-not $script:Pg.Database) { $script:Pg.Database = $v } }
                'username' { if (-not $script:Pg.User)     { $script:Pg.User = $v } }
                'user id'  { if (-not $script:Pg.User)     { $script:Pg.User = $v } }
                'password' { if (-not $script:Pg.Password) { $script:Pg.Password = $v } }
            }
        }
    }

    # 3. discrete keys in the profile
    foreach ($pair in @(@{K='PGHOST';F='Host'}, @{K='PGPORT';F='Port'}, @{K='PGDATABASE';F='Database'}, @{K='PGUSER';F='User'}, @{K='PGPASSWORD';F='Password'})) {
        if ($kv.ContainsKey($pair.K) -and -not $script:Pg[$pair.F]) { $script:Pg[$pair.F] = $kv[$pair.K] }
    }

    $missing = @()
    foreach ($f in @('Host', 'Database', 'User', 'Password')) { if (-not $script:Pg[$f]) { $missing += $f } }
    if ($missing.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Bad ("the profile does not resolve: " + ($missing -join ', '))
        Write-Warn 'This pack embeds no credential and will not invent one. Point -ProfileFile at the canonical profile.'
        exit 2
    }

    if (@('localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1') -notcontains $script:Pg.Host.ToLowerInvariant()) { Write-Bad "Refusing a non-local host: $($script:Pg.Host)"; exit 2 }
    if ($script:Pg.Database -eq 'ppiq_presentation') { Write-Bad 'The profile resolves to the frozen historical database. Refusing.'; exit 2 }
    if ($script:Pg.Database -notmatch '^ppiq_') { Write-Bad "Refusing an unexpected database name: $($script:Pg.Database)"; exit 2 }

    Write-Ok ("resolved: {0}@{1}:{2}/{3}" -f $script:Pg.User, $script:Pg.Host, $script:Pg.Port, $script:Pg.Database)
    Write-Inf 'no silent fallback: the database name above is the one every query below uses'
    $env:PGPASSWORD = $script:Pg.Password

    # health url, discovered not invented
    $base = $ApiHealthUrl
    if (-not $base) {
        foreach ($key in @('ASPNETCORE_URLS', 'PPIQ_API_BASE_URL')) {
            if (-not $kv.ContainsKey($key)) { continue }
            foreach ($piece in ($kv[$key] -split ';')) {
                $piece = $piece.Trim()
                if ($piece -match '^https?://[^@\s]+$' -and -not $base) { $base = $piece }
            }
        }
    }
    if (-not $base) {
        Write-Bad 'No API base URL supplied or discovered. No port will be invented.'
        Write-Warn 'Re-run with -ApiHealthUrl "http://localhost:<port>".'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok "api base: $base"

    # Apply the profile to THIS process so the API child inherits it. This is the
    # same configuration the runner would supply; it simply does not rely on the
    # process/user scope hand-off between the loader and the runner, which does
    # not connect.
    $applied = 0
    foreach ($k in $kv.Keys) {
        if ($k -match '^(ConnectionStrings__|ASPNETCORE_|DOTNET_|PLANTPROCESS_|PlantProcess__)') {
            Set-Item -Path ("Env:" + $k) -Value $kv[$k]
            $applied++
        }
    }
    Write-Ok "$applied profile variable(s) applied to this process for the API child"

    $childCs = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb')
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($childCs)) {
        Write-Bad 'the profile defines no ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb; the API cannot start from it.'
        exit 2
    }
    if ($childCs -notmatch ('(?i)Database\s*=\s*' + [regex]::Escape($script:Pg.Database) + '\s*(;|$)')) {
        Write-Bad 'the connection string the API would use does not target the database this pack verifies.'
        Write-Warn 'Refusing rather than measuring one database while the API writes another.'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok "the API will use the same database this pack queries: $($script:Pg.Database)"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ queries ---
    $work = Join-Path $ev 'sql'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $work -Force | Out-Null

    $snapshotSql = Join-Path $work 'snapshot.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $snapshotSql -Text @'
SELECT d.dashboard_code,
       coalesce(w.widget_code, '(none)'),
       coalesce(w.dimension_code, ''),
       coalesce(w.measure_code, ''),
       coalesce(w.parameter_code, '(none)'),
       d.source_system,
       d.is_active,
       coalesce(w.is_active::text, ''),
       coalesce(w.is_deleted::text, '')
FROM   dashboard_definitions d
LEFT JOIN dashboard_widget_definitions w
       ON w.dashboard_definition_id = d.id AND w.is_deleted = FALSE
WHERE  d.source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  d.is_deleted = FALSE
ORDER BY d.dashboard_code, coalesce(w.widget_code, '(none)');
'@

    $countsSql = Join-Path $work 'counts.sql'
    Write-NoBom -Path $countsSql -Text @'
SELECT 'canonical_dashboards', count(*) FROM dashboard_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE AND source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  dashboard_code LIKE 'SYSTEM\_%';
SELECT 'canonical_widgets', count(*) FROM dashboard_widget_definitions w
JOIN   dashboard_definitions d ON d.id = w.dashboard_definition_id
WHERE  w.is_deleted = FALSE AND d.is_deleted = FALSE
  AND  w.source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  d.dashboard_code LIKE 'SYSTEM\_%';
SELECT 'legacy_unprefixed_dashboards', count(*) FROM dashboard_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE AND source_system = 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates'
  AND  dashboard_code NOT LIKE 'SYSTEM\_%';
SELECT 'retired_widgets_active', count(*) FROM dashboard_widget_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE
  AND  widget_code IN ('CORR_PARAMETER_AVG_BY_EQUIPMENT', 'DQ_BY_TYPE');
SELECT 'parameterless_average_widgets', count(*) FROM dashboard_widget_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE
  AND  lower(measure_code) = 'avgparametervalue'
  AND  (parameter_code IS NULL OR btrim(parameter_code) = '');
SELECT 'stale_undeclared_widgets', count(*) FROM dashboard_widget_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE
  AND  widget_code IN ('CORR_DEFECT_RATE_BY_EQUIPMENT', 'CORR_DEFECT_RATE_BY_TYPE');
SELECT 'customer_authored_widgets', count(*) FROM dashboard_widget_definitions
WHERE  is_deleted = FALSE
  AND  coalesce(source_system, '') <> 'PlantProcessIQ.SystemTemplates';
'@

    function Get-Counts([string]$Tag) {
        $r = Invoke-PsqlTuples -SqlFile $countsSql -LogFile (Join-Path $ev ("counts_$Tag.log"))
        if ($r.Code -ne 0) { return $null }
        $h = @{}
        foreach ($l in $r.Lines) {
            $p = $l -split '\|'
            if ($p.Count -ge 2) { $h[$p[0].Trim()] = [int]$p[1].Trim() }
        }
        return $h
    }

    # ============================================ PHASE 2 - BASELINE ========
    Write-Head 'PHASE 2 - BASELINE BEFORE ANY STARTUP'

    Stop-Api
    $baseline = Get-Counts 'baseline'
    if ($null -eq $baseline) { Write-Bad 'could not read the database.'; exit 2 }
    foreach ($k in @('canonical_dashboards','canonical_widgets','legacy_unprefixed_dashboards','retired_widgets_active','parameterless_average_widgets','stale_undeclared_widgets','customer_authored_widgets')) {
        Write-Inf ("{0,-32} {1}" -f $k, $baseline[$k])
    }

    # ================================= PHASE 3 - FIRST CANONICAL STARTUP ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 3 - FIRST CANONICAL STARTUP'

    Write-Inf 'building the API first so the health window is not spent compiling'
    $buildLog = Join-Path $ev 'build.log'
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    & dotnet build (Join-Path $RepoRootFull 'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\PlantProcess.Api.csproj') -c Debug --nologo 2>&1 |
        Tee-Object -FilePath $buildLog | Out-Null
    $buildCode = $LASTEXITCODE
    $ErrorActionPreference = $prev
    if ($buildCode -ne 0) {
        Get-Content -LiteralPath $buildLog -Tail 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Write-Bad 'the API does not build; the runtime authority cannot be proven.'
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok 'API builds'

    $waited = Start-ApiAndWait -Base $base -WaitSeconds $StartupWaitSeconds `
        -OutLog (Join-Path $ev 'api_start1_stdout.log') -ErrLog (Join-Path $ev 'api_start1_stderr.log')
    if ($waited -lt 0) {
        Write-Bad "API did not report healthy within $StartupWaitSeconds seconds."
        Show-LauncherFailure -OutLog (Join-Path $ev 'api_start1_stdout.log') -ErrLog (Join-Path $ev 'api_start1_stderr.log')
        Stop-Api
        exit 2
    }
    Write-Ok "API healthy after ${waited}s"
    Start-Sleep -Seconds $SettleSeconds

    $snapA = Invoke-PsqlTuples -SqlFile $snapshotSql -LogFile (Join-Path $ev 'snapshot_startup1.log')
    if ($snapA.Code -ne 0) { Stop-Api; Write-Bad 'could not snapshot after the first startup.'; exit 3 }
    $countsA = Get-Counts 'startup1'

    Write-Inf "canonical family after startup 1:"
    foreach ($l in $snapA.Lines) { Write-Host "         $l" -ForegroundColor DarkGray }

    # ============================================ PHASE 4 - NON-VACUITY =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 4 - NON-VACUITY GATE'

    $d = $countsA['canonical_dashboards']
    $w = $countsA['canonical_widgets']
    Write-Inf ("canonical dashboards {0}, canonical widgets {1}" -f $d, $w)

    if ($d -le 0 -or $w -le 0) {
        Write-Bad 'The canonical runtime family is empty after a clean startup.'
        Write-Warn 'The retirement succeeded and nothing replaced it, so a Release Truth pass here would be vacuous.'
        Write-Warn 'Finding: the runtime authority is not executing on the canonical startup path, or it is incomplete.'
        Write-Warn 'This is Worker-1 owned. It is NOT solved by restoring the retired SQL seed.'
        Stop-Api
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok 'canonical family is non-empty'

    if ($w -ne $ExpectedWidgets) {
        Write-Bad ("canonical widgets = {0}, expected {1}" -f $w, $ExpectedWidgets)
        Write-Warn 'The persisted set has not converged to the declared set.'
        Stop-Api
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok ("canonical widgets = {0}, exactly the declared set" -f $ExpectedWidgets)

    # ================================ PHASE 5 - SECOND CANONICAL STARTUP ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 5 - SECOND CANONICAL STARTUP'

    Stop-Api
    $waited2 = Start-ApiAndWait -Base $base -WaitSeconds $StartupWaitSeconds `
        -OutLog (Join-Path $ev 'api_start2_stdout.log') -ErrLog (Join-Path $ev 'api_start2_stderr.log')
    if ($waited2 -lt 0) {
        Write-Bad 'API did not report healthy on the second start.'
        Show-LauncherFailure -OutLog (Join-Path $ev 'api_start2_stdout.log') -ErrLog (Join-Path $ev 'api_start2_stderr.log')
        Stop-Api; exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok "API healthy after ${waited2}s"
    Start-Sleep -Seconds $SettleSeconds

    $snapB = Invoke-PsqlTuples -SqlFile $snapshotSql -LogFile (Join-Path $ev 'snapshot_startup2.log')
    if ($snapB.Code -ne 0) { Stop-Api; Write-Bad 'could not snapshot after the second startup.'; exit 3 }
    $countsB = Get-Counts 'startup2'

    # =========================================== PHASE 6 - SEMANTIC DRIFT ===
    Write-Head 'PHASE 6 - SEMANTIC DRIFT'

    if ($snapA.Text -ne $snapB.Text) {
        Write-Bad 'The second startup changed the canonical family.'
        $onlyA = @($snapA.Lines | Where-Object { $snapB.Lines -notcontains $_ })
        $onlyB = @($snapB.Lines | Where-Object { $snapA.Lines -notcontains $_ })
        foreach ($l in $onlyA) { Write-Host "         only after startup 1: $l" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        foreach ($l in $onlyB) { Write-Host "         only after startup 2: $l" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
        Stop-Api
        Write-Warn 'The runtime authority is not idempotent. That is the finding.'
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok ("semantic snapshot identical across two fresh startups ({0} rows compared)" -f $snapA.Lines.Count)

    # ======================================= PHASE 7 - RETIREMENT HOLDS =====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 7 - THE RETIRED WIDGETS DID NOT RETURN'

    $failed = $false
    if ($countsB['retired_widgets_active'] -ne 0) {
        Write-Bad ("CORR_PARAMETER_AVG_BY_EQUIPMENT or DQ_BY_TYPE is active again: {0} row(s)" -f $countsB['retired_widgets_active'])
        $failed = $true
    } else { Write-Ok 'neither retired widget was recreated' }

    if ($countsB['parameterless_average_widgets'] -ne 0) {
        Write-Bad ("a parameterless average-parameter widget exists again: {0} row(s)" -f $countsB['parameterless_average_widgets'])
        $failed = $true
    } else { Write-Ok 'no average-parameter widget exists without a parameter' }

    if ($countsB['stale_undeclared_widgets'] -ne 0) {
        Write-Bad ("{0} widget(s) the authority no longer declares are still active" -f $countsB['stale_undeclared_widgets'])
        $failed = $true
    } else { Write-Ok 'no undeclared product widget survives reconciliation' }

    if ($countsB['customer_authored_widgets'] -ne $baseline['customer_authored_widgets']) {
        Write-Bad ("customer-authored widgets changed: {0} -> {1}" -f $baseline['customer_authored_widgets'], $countsB['customer_authored_widgets'])
        $failed = $true
    } else { Write-Ok ("customer-authored widgets unchanged ({0})" -f $countsB['customer_authored_widgets']) }

    if ($countsB['legacy_unprefixed_dashboards'] -ne 0) {
        Write-Bad ("{0} active product dashboard(s) sit outside the canonical family" -f $countsB['legacy_unprefixed_dashboards'])
        $failed = $true
    } else { Write-Ok 'every active product dashboard belongs to the canonical family' }

    Stop-Api

    if ($failed) { Write-Warn 'Proof failed. Nothing was written to the repository.'; exit 3 }

    # ================================================= PHASE 8 - CLOSURE ====
    Write-Head 'CLOSURE'

    $report = @()
    $report += 'SYSTEM TEMPLATE RUNTIME AUTHORITY PROOF'
    $report += ("  database                     : {0}" -f $script:Pg.Database)
    $report += ("  canonical system dashboards  : {0}" -f $countsB['canonical_dashboards'])
    $report += ("  canonical system widgets     : {0}" -f $countsB['canonical_widgets'])
    $report += ("  legacy unprefixed dashboards : {0}" -f $countsB['legacy_unprefixed_dashboards'])
    $report += ("  retired widgets active       : {0}" -f $countsB['retired_widgets_active'])
    $report += ("  parameterless average widgets: {0}" -f $countsB['parameterless_average_widgets'])
    $report += ("  stale undeclared widgets     : {0}" -f $countsB['stale_undeclared_widgets'])
    $report += ("  customer-authored widgets    : {0} (unchanged)" -f $countsB['customer_authored_widgets'])
    $report += ("  second fresh startup         : zero semantic drift ({0} rows)" -f $snapB.Lines.Count)
    $report += ("  evidence                     : {0}" -f $ev)
    $report += '  repository                   : untouched by this pack'
    Write-NoBom -Path (Join-Path $ev 'CLOSURE.txt') -Text (($report -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")

    Write-Host ''
    foreach ($r in $report) { Write-Host "  $r" -ForegroundColor White }
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  Nothing to commit. This pack proves runtime behaviour; it changes no file.' -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host ''
    exit 0
}
finally {
    if (Test-Path Env:PGPASSWORD) { $env:PGPASSWORD = '' }
    Pop-Location
}

<#
    PPIQ - Temporal Alignment contract.
    Backlog task: T-217.  Release: M2.
    Worker 3 apply pack. PowerShell 5.1. ASCII only. No credentials, database or network.

    Establishes what a timestamp means before anything compares, orders or aligns two
    of them: source-asserted, effective and ingestion time kept distinct, offset origin
    declared rather than assumed, clock quality declared rather than inferred, and
    ordering refused when uncertainty overlaps.

    Contract and kernel only. Persistence and runtime projection are Worker 1's. No
    protocol-specific time model: one industrial protocol must not become the universal
    product model.

    Reuses the existing kernel refusal language (TerminalState, ExclusionAttribution)
    from Kernel/Common/KernelCommonContracts.cs rather than inventing a parallel one.

    Guarantees:
      Every run ends in APPLY PASS or APPLY FAILED with rollback executed.
      Native commands are wrapped, so a tool writing to stderr cannot bypass rollback.
      Only files this pack created are ever removed.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot = 'C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ',
    [string]$EvidenceRoot = 'C:\Workspace\_ppiq_evidence',
    [switch]$WhatIfPreflight
)

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$Stamp        = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
$EvidenceDir  = Join-Path $EvidenceRoot ('TemporalAlignment\' + $Stamp)
$CoreDir      = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend\PlantProcess.Analytics.Core\Kernel\Time'
$TestProjDir  = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Tests'
$FixtureDir   = Join-Path $TestProjDir 'GenericValidation'
$CoreProj     = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend\PlantProcess.Analytics.Core\PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.csproj'
$TestProj     = Join-Path $TestProjDir 'PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Tests.csproj'
$ArchProj     = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests.csproj'
$Created      = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$Terminated   = $false

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $EvidenceDir -Force | Out-Null

function Write-Step { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[ALIGN] $m" -ForegroundColor Cyan }
function Write-Ok   { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[ OK ] $m" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Bad  { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[FAIL] $m" -ForegroundColor Red }

function Invoke-Native {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Exe,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string[]]$Arguments,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$LogPath,
        [switch]$Quiet
    )

    $previous = $ErrorActionPreference
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'

    $captured = $null
    $code = $null

    try {
        $captured = & $Exe @Arguments 2>&1
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    }
    finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $previous }

    $lines = @($captured | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })
    $lines | Set-Content -LiteralPath $LogPath -Encoding ASCII
    if (-not $Quiet) { $lines | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ } }

    if ($null -eq $code) { $code = 0 }

    return [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = $code; Lines = $lines; LogPath = $LogPath }
}

function Stop-WithRollback {
    param([string]$Reason)

    $script:Terminated = $true

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Bad 'APPLY FAILED'
    Write-Bad $Reason
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'rollback executed:'

    $removed = 0
    foreach ($f in $Created) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force; Write-Host ("  removed  " + $f); $removed++ }
    }
    if ($removed -eq 0) { Write-Host '  nothing had been created yet' }

    if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $CoreDir) -and -not (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $CoreDir -Force)) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $CoreDir -Force
        Write-Host ("  removed empty directory " + $CoreDir)
    }

    Write-Host 'owned created files: removed'
    Write-Host 'foreign changed files: untouched'
    Write-Host 'repository returned to pre-pack state'
    Write-Host ("evidence: " + $EvidenceDir)
    exit 1
}

function Write-AsciiFile {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Content)

    if ([regex]::IsMatch($Content, '[^\x00-\x7F]')) { Stop-WithRollback "ASCII gate: non-ASCII content for $Path" }

    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Content, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    [void]$Created.Add($Path)
}

    'Backend/PlantProcess.Analytics.Core/Kernel/Time/TemporalAlignmentContracts.cs',
    'Backend/PlantProcess.Analytics.Core/Kernel/Time/TemporalAlignmentKernel.cs',
    'Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Tests/GenericValidation/TemporalAlignmentKnownAnswerTests.cs'

Write-Step 'Phase 1 - preflight  (backlog task T-217, release M2)'

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend'))) { throw 'STOP: not a PlantProcess-IQ repository root' }
foreach ($p in @($CoreProj, $TestProj, $ArchProj)) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) { throw "project not found: $p" }
}
Write-Ok 'analytics core, analytics core tests and architecture tests projects present'

if ($null -eq (Get-Command dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw 'dotnet SDK not on PATH' }
$sdk = Invoke-Native -Exe 'dotnet' -Arguments @('--version') -LogPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'dotnet-version.log') -Quiet
Write-Ok ("dotnet SDK " + ($sdk.Lines -join ''))

function Test-PpiqOutputLocked {
    param([string]$Root)

    $candidates = @(
        'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\bin\Debug\net9.0\PlantProcess.Application.dll',
        'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\bin\Debug\net9.0\PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.dll',
        'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\bin\Debug\net9.0\PlantProcess.Domain.dll'
    )

    $locked = @()
    foreach ($rel in $candidates) {
        $abs = Join-Path $Root $rel
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $abs)) { continue }
        try { $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($abs, 'Open', 'ReadWrite', 'None'); $fs.Close(); $fs.Dispose() }
        catch { $locked += $rel }
    }

    return $locked
}

$LockedOutputs = @(Test-PpiqOutputLocked -Root $RepoRoot)
if ($LockedOutputs.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Bad 'STOP: PlantProcess build outputs are locked by a running process.'
    $LockedOutputs | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ("    " + $_) -ForegroundColor Yellow }
    Write-Host '    Get-Process PlantProcess.Api -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force'
    Write-Host '  Nothing was written to the repository.'
    exit 2
}
Write-Ok 'build outputs are writable'

Push-Location $RepoRoot
try {
    $branch = Invoke-Native -Exe 'git' -Arguments @('rev-parse', '--abbrev-ref', 'HEAD') -LogPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'git-branch.log') -Quiet
    $head   = Invoke-Native -Exe 'git' -Arguments @('rev-parse', '--short', 'HEAD')      -LogPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'git-head.log')   -Quiet
    Write-Ok ("branch " + ($branch.Lines -join '') + " at " + ($head.Lines -join ''))

    $status = Invoke-Native -Exe 'git' -Arguments @('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all') `
        -LogPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'git-status-before.txt') -Quiet

    $ForeignDirtyBefore = @($status.Lines | ForEach-Object { ($_ -replace '^..\s+', '') } | Where-Object { $Owned -notcontains $_ })
    Write-Ok ("foreign dirty paths at start: " + $ForeignDirtyBefore.Count)
}
finally { Pop-Location }

foreach ($rel in $Owned) {

        throw "collision: $rel already exists. This pack creates files; it does not overwrite them."
    }
}
Write-Ok 'no collision on the three owned paths'

Write-Step 'Phase 2 - anchor verification'

$kernelCommon = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend\PlantProcess.Analytics.Core\Kernel\Common\KernelCommonContracts.cs'

$kernelText = Get-Content -LiteralPath $kernelCommon -Raw

    if ($kernelText.IndexOf($t, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal) -lt 0) {
        throw "ANCHOR FAILED: kernel common contracts lack expected text -> $t`n  The refusal language this contract reuses is not where it was. STOP."
    }
    Write-Ok "anchor present: $t"
}

foreach ($proj in @($CoreProj, $TestProj)) {
    $text = Get-Content -LiteralPath $proj -Raw
    if ($text.IndexOf('<TargetFramework>net9.0</TargetFramework>', [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal) -lt 0) { throw "ANCHOR FAILED: $proj is not net9.0" }
    if ($text -match '<Compile\s+Include=') { throw "ANCHOR FAILED: $proj enumerates Compile items; a shared-file edit would be required. STOP." }
}

$contractsCs = @'
// Temporal Alignment contract.
//
// Backlog origin: T-217.
//
// Answers one question: given two or more evidence instants, each carrying the
// uncertainty it was admitted under, and a declared alignment tolerance, may they be
// treated as referring to the same moment?
//
// The answer is one of three, and the third is not a failure to compute the other two:
//
//   Coincident    - the separation is provably within tolerance
//   Separated     - the separation provably exceeds tolerance
//   Indeterminate - uncertainty spans the tolerance boundary, so the question has no
//                   answer from this evidence
//
// This preserves the source time authority law: uncertainty that overlaps cannot be
// silently ordered, and here it cannot be silently aligned either. A product that
// collapses Indeterminate into Coincident invents agreement; one that collapses it into
// Separated invents conflict. Both are worse than saying so.
//
// Deliberately out of scope: persistence, protocol handling, causal reasoning, and any
// reconciliation vocabulary about what a disagreement means. This contract reports
// temporal compatibility and nothing else.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Kernel;

/// <summary>
/// Whether instants may be treated as the same moment.
/// </summary>
public enum TemporalAlignment
{
    Indeterminate,
    Coincident,
    Separated
}

/// <summary>
/// How close two instants must be to count as the same moment. Declared by the
/// customer's engineer: there is no default tolerance, because the right answer differs
/// between a control loop and a shift report, and guessing it silently decides whether
/// evidence agrees.
/// </summary>
public sealed record TemporalAlignmentPolicy(string PolicyKey, TimeSpan Tolerance);

/// <summary>
/// The separation two instants could have, given what is uncertain about each. Both
/// bounds travel with the verdict so a consumer can see how close the call was.
/// </summary>
public sealed record TemporalSeparation(TimeSpan Minimum, TimeSpan Maximum);

public sealed record TemporalAlignmentVerdict(
    bool IsDecided,
    TemporalAlignment Alignment,
    TemporalSeparation? Separation,
    string Code,
    TerminalState Outcome,
    ExclusionAttribution Attribution);

/// <summary>
/// Refusal and verdict codes. Stable strings, so a consumer can branch on them without
/// parsing prose.
/// </summary>
public static class TemporalAlignmentCodes
{
    public const string PolicyNotDeclared = "TA01 alignment_policy_not_declared";
    public const string InsufficientInstants = "TA02 insufficient_instants";
    public const string IncomparableTimeRoles = "TA03 incomparable_time_roles";
    public const string NegativeTolerance = "TA04 negative_alignment_tolerance";
    public const string ConflictingDeclaration = "TA05 conflicting_declaration";

    public const string Coincident = "TA10 temporally_coincident";
    public const string Separated = "TA11 temporally_separated";
    public const string Indeterminate = "TA12 temporally_indeterminate";
}

/// <summary>
/// The alignment policies in force. Starts empty: no default tolerance of any size,
/// including zero. Declaration invariants match the rest of the kernel, so a durable
/// store need not hold a second idea of what redeclaration means.
/// </summary>
public sealed class TemporalAlignmentPolicyRegistry
{
    private readonly Dictionary<string, TemporalAlignmentPolicy> _policies = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);

    public int PolicyCount => _policies.Count;

    public bool TryDeclarePolicy(TemporalAlignmentPolicy policy, out string code)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(policy);

        if (!DeclaredKey.TryNormalise(policy.PolicyKey, out var policyKey))
        {
            code = TemporalAlignmentCodes.PolicyNotDeclared;
            return false;
        }

        // A negative tolerance is not a stricter policy, it is a typo.
        if (policy.Tolerance < TimeSpan.Zero)
        {
            code = TemporalAlignmentCodes.NegativeTolerance;
            return false;
        }

        var normalised = policy with { PolicyKey = policyKey };

        if (_policies.TryGetValue(policyKey, out var existing))
        {
            if (existing == normalised)
            {
                code = string.Empty;
                return true;
            }

            code = TemporalAlignmentCodes.ConflictingDeclaration;
            return false;
        }

        _policies[policyKey] = normalised;
        code = string.Empty;
        return true;
    }

    public bool TryGetPolicy(string? policyKey, out TemporalAlignmentPolicy? policy)
    {
        policy = null;

        if (!DeclaredKey.TryNormalise(policyKey, out var normalised)) return false;

        return _policies.TryGetValue(normalised, out policy);
    }
}
'@
Write-AsciiFile -Path (Join-Path $CoreDir 'TemporalAlignmentContracts.cs') -Content $contractsCs
Write-Ok 'wrote TemporalAlignmentContracts.cs'

$kernelCs = @'
// Temporal Alignment kernel.
//
// Backlog origin: T-217.
//
// Decides whether evidence instants may be treated as the same moment, under a declared
// tolerance. It computes bounds, not guesses: the separation two instants could have
// ranges between a minimum and a maximum given what is uncertain about each, and only a
// bound that lies wholly on one side of the tolerance decides the question.
//
// Every path out of this file is a decided verdict with its separation bounds, or a
// refusal carrying a code. There is no path that resolves uncertainty by choosing.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Kernel;

public static class TemporalAlignmentKernel
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Align two instants under a declared policy.
    /// </summary>
    public static TemporalAlignmentVerdict Align(
        TemporalAlignmentPolicyRegistry registry,
        string? policyKey,
        TemporalInstant first,
        TemporalInstant second)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(registry);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(first);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(second);

        return Align(registry, policyKey, new[] { first, second });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Align a set of instants under a declared policy. The set is coincident only if
    /// every pair is; one provably separated pair separates the set, because instants
    /// that cannot all be the same moment are not aligned however close the rest are.
    /// </summary>
    public static TemporalAlignmentVerdict Align(
        TemporalAlignmentPolicyRegistry registry,
        string? policyKey,
        IReadOnlyList<TemporalInstant> instants)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(registry);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(instants);

        if (!registry.TryGetPolicy(policyKey, out var policy) || policy is null)
        {
            return Refuse(TemporalAlignmentCodes.PolicyNotDeclared);
        }

        if (instants.Count < 2 || instants.Any(i => i is null))
        {
            return Refuse(TemporalAlignmentCodes.InsufficientInstants);
        }

        // Aligning an event time against an arrival time is a category error, not a
        // close call. The roles were kept distinct upstream precisely so that this
        // comparison cannot be made by accident.
        if (instants.Select(i => i.Role).Distinct().Count() > 1)
        {
            return Refuse(TemporalAlignmentCodes.IncomparableTimeRoles);
        }

        var worst = new TemporalSeparation(TimeSpan.Zero, TimeSpan.Zero);
        var anySeparated = false;
        var anyIndeterminate = false;

        for (var i = 0; i < instants.Count - 1; i++)
        {
            for (var j = i + 1; j < instants.Count; j++)
            {
                var separation = Separation(instants[i], instants[j]);

                if (separation.Maximum > worst.Maximum) worst = separation;

                if (separation.Minimum > policy.Tolerance) anySeparated = true;
                else if (separation.Maximum > policy.Tolerance) anyIndeterminate = true;
            }
        }

        if (anySeparated) return Decide(TemporalAlignment.Separated, TemporalAlignmentCodes.Separated, worst);
        if (anyIndeterminate) return Decide(TemporalAlignment.Indeterminate, TemporalAlignmentCodes.Indeterminate, worst);

        return Decide(TemporalAlignment.Coincident, TemporalAlignmentCodes.Coincident, worst);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The range of separations two instants could have. Minimum is zero when their
    /// uncertainty intervals overlap: they could be the same moment.
    /// </summary>
    public static TemporalSeparation Separation(TemporalInstant first, TemporalInstant second)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(first);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(second);

        var gap = first.Instant - second.Instant;
        if (gap < TimeSpan.Zero) gap = gap.Negate();

        var combined = first.Uncertainty + second.Uncertainty;

        var minimum = gap - combined;
        if (minimum < TimeSpan.Zero) minimum = TimeSpan.Zero;

        return new TemporalSeparation(minimum, gap + combined);
    }

    private static TemporalAlignmentVerdict Decide(
        TemporalAlignment alignment,
        string code,
        TemporalSeparation separation) =>
        new(IsDecided: true,
            alignment,
            separation,
            code,
            // Indeterminate is a reported outcome, not a refusal: the evidence was
            // admissible, and what it supports is "cannot tell from this".
            TerminalState.Finding,
            ExclusionAttribution.None);

    private static TemporalAlignmentVerdict Refuse(string code) =>
        new(IsDecided: false,
            TemporalAlignment.Indeterminate,
            Separation: null,
            code,
            TerminalState.RefusedByGuard,
            ExclusionAttribution.Declaration);
}
'@
Write-AsciiFile -Path (Join-Path $CoreDir 'TemporalAlignmentKernel.cs') -Content $kernelCs
Write-Ok 'wrote TemporalAlignmentKernel.cs'

$testsCs = @'
// Temporal Alignment - deterministic acceptance.
//
// Backlog origin: T-217.
//
// The generic validation fixture supplies the two cases, and the source time authority
// supplies the instants. Exact bounds, so no verdict can pass by rounding luck:
//
//   overlapping pair (100 +/- 1s against 108 +/- 15min):
//       separation is between 0 and 23min 1s
//   disjoint pair    (100 +/- 1s against 140 +/- 15min):
//       separation is between 24min 59s and 55min 1s
//
// Those bounds decide every verdict below, and each case yields all three answers as
// the declared tolerance moves. A kernel that always returns the cautious answer fails
// here, and so does one that always decides.
using System;
using System.Linq;
using PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Kernel;
using Xunit;

namespace PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Tests.GenericValidation;

[Trait("BacklogTask", "T-217")]
public sealed class TemporalAlignmentKnownAnswerTests
{
    private const string PolicyKey = "POLICY-A";
    private const string MachineSource = "SOURCE-M";
    private const string ManualSource = "SOURCE-H";
    private const string EventSignal = "SIGNAL-1";
    private const string ArrivalSignal = "SIGNAL-2";

    private static readonly TimeSpan MachineUncertainty = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
    private static readonly TimeSpan ManualUncertainty = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15);

    private static TemporalAlignmentPolicyRegistry PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan tolerance)
    {
        var registry = new TemporalAlignmentPolicyRegistry();
        Assert.True(registry.TryDeclarePolicy(new TemporalAlignmentPolicy(PolicyKey, tolerance), out _));
        return registry;
    }

    private static TemporalInstant Instant(double atMinute, TimeSpan uncertainty, string source,
        TimeRole role = TimeRole.Effective, string signal = EventSignal) =>
        new(FrozenTestEpoch.AtMinute(atMinute), role, source, signal, uncertainty);

    private static TemporalInstant Machine(double atMinute) => Instant(atMinute, MachineUncertainty, MachineSource);
    private static TemporalInstant Manual(double atMinute) => Instant(atMinute, ManualUncertainty, ManualSource);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- fail closed

    [Fact]
    public void No_tolerance_is_assumed_including_zero()
    {
        var registry = new TemporalAlignmentPolicyRegistry();

        Assert.Equal(0, registry.PolicyCount);

        var verdict = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(registry, PolicyKey, Machine(100), Manual(108));

        Assert.False(verdict.IsDecided);
        Assert.Null(verdict.Separation);
        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignmentCodes.PolicyNotDeclared, verdict.Code);
        Assert.Equal(TerminalState.RefusedByGuard, verdict.Outcome);
        Assert.Equal(ExclusionAttribution.Declaration, verdict.Attribution);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_negative_tolerance_is_rejected_at_declaration()
    {
        var registry = new TemporalAlignmentPolicyRegistry();

        Assert.False(registry.TryDeclarePolicy(
            new TemporalAlignmentPolicy(PolicyKey, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(-1)), out var code));

        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignmentCodes.NegativeTolerance, code);
        Assert.Equal(0, registry.PolicyCount);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Fewer_than_two_instants_is_not_an_alignment_question()
    {
        var registry = PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan.Zero);

        var verdict = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(registry, PolicyKey, new[] { Machine(100) });

        Assert.False(verdict.IsDecided);
        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignmentCodes.InsufficientInstants, verdict.Code);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Instants_of_different_roles_are_a_category_error_not_a_close_call()
    {
        // The roles were kept distinct upstream precisely so an arrival stamp cannot be
        // compared against an event time by accident.
        var registry = PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan.FromHours(1));

        var effective = Machine(100);
        var ingestion = Instant(100, MachineUncertainty, MachineSource, TimeRole.Ingestion, ArrivalSignal);

        var verdict = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(registry, PolicyKey, effective, ingestion);

        Assert.False(verdict.IsDecided);
        Assert.Null(verdict.Separation);
        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignmentCodes.IncomparableTimeRoles, verdict.Code);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_refusal_never_carries_a_separation()
    {
        var registry = new TemporalAlignmentPolicyRegistry();

        var verdict = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(registry, "POLICY-NEVER-DECLARED", Machine(100), Manual(108));

        Assert.False(verdict.IsDecided);
        Assert.Null(verdict.Separation);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- separation bounds

    [Fact]
    public void Overlapping_uncertainty_gives_a_minimum_separation_of_zero()
    {
        var separation = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Separation(Machine(100), Manual(108));

        Assert.Equal(TimeSpan.Zero, separation.Minimum);
        Assert.Equal(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(23) + TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1), separation.Maximum);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Disjoint_uncertainty_gives_a_positive_minimum_separation()
    {
        var separation = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Separation(Machine(100), Manual(140));

        Assert.Equal(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(24) + TimeSpan.FromSeconds(59), separation.Minimum);
        Assert.Equal(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(55) + TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1), separation.Maximum);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Separation_is_symmetric()
    {
        var forward = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Separation(Machine(100), Manual(140));
        var backward = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Separation(Manual(140), Machine(100));

        Assert.Equal(forward, backward);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Two_exact_instants_at_the_same_moment_have_no_separation_at_all()
    {
        var exact = Instant(100, TimeSpan.Zero, MachineSource);
        var separation = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Separation(exact, exact);

        Assert.Equal(TimeSpan.Zero, separation.Minimum);
        Assert.Equal(TimeSpan.Zero, separation.Maximum);
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------- the three verdicts

    [Fact]
    public void Overlapping_uncertainty_under_zero_tolerance_is_indeterminate()
    {
        // The source time authority law, carried forward: uncertainty that overlaps
        // cannot be silently ordered, and cannot be silently aligned either.
        var verdict = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan.Zero), PolicyKey, Machine(100), Manual(108));

        Assert.True(verdict.IsDecided);
        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignment.Indeterminate, verdict.Alignment);
        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignmentCodes.Indeterminate, verdict.Code);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_tolerance_above_the_maximum_separation_decides_coincident()
    {
        // Maximum separation is 23min 1s, so 30 minutes settles it either way it falls.
        var verdict = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(
            PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30)), PolicyKey, Machine(100), Manual(108));

        Assert.True(verdict.IsDecided);
        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignment.Coincident, verdict.Alignment);
        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignmentCodes.Coincident, verdict.Code);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_tolerance_below_the_minimum_separation_decides_separated()
    {
        // Minimum separation is 24min 59s, so even the most generous reading of the
        // evidence puts these more than 5 minutes apart.
        var verdict = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(
            PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5)), PolicyKey, Machine(100), Manual(140));

        Assert.True(verdict.IsDecided);
        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignment.Separated, verdict.Alignment);
        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignmentCodes.Separated, verdict.Code);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_tolerance_inside_the_separation_bounds_is_indeterminate_even_for_the_disjoint_pair()
    {
        // 30 minutes sits between 24min 59s and 55min 1s. The evidence is compatible with
        // both answers, and saying so is the honest result.
        var verdict = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(
            PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30)), PolicyKey, Machine(100), Manual(140));

        Assert.True(verdict.IsDecided);
        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignment.Indeterminate, verdict.Alignment);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Each_fixture_pair_yields_all_three_verdicts_as_the_tolerance_moves()
    {
        // One pair, three answers. A kernel cannot pass by always deciding, and cannot
        // pass by always refusing to.
        var pair = new[] { Machine(100), Manual(140) };

        var separated = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5)), PolicyKey, pair);
        var indeterminate = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30)), PolicyKey, pair);
        var coincident = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(60)), PolicyKey, pair);

        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignment.Separated, separated.Alignment);
        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignment.Indeterminate, indeterminate.Alignment);
        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignment.Coincident, coincident.Alignment);

        Assert.Equal(3, new[] { separated.Alignment, indeterminate.Alignment, coincident.Alignment }.Distinct().Count());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Exact_instants_at_the_same_moment_are_coincident_even_at_zero_tolerance()
    {
        var exact = Instant(100, TimeSpan.Zero, MachineSource);
        var alsoExact = Instant(100, TimeSpan.Zero, ManualSource);

        var verdict = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan.Zero), PolicyKey, exact, alsoExact);

        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignment.Coincident, verdict.Alignment);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_tolerance_boundary_itself_counts_as_within_tolerance()
    {
        // Maximum separation is exactly 23min 1s. A tolerance of exactly that decides
        // coincident; one tick less does not.
        var maximum = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(23) + TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);

        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignment.Coincident,
            TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(PolicyRegistry(maximum), PolicyKey, Machine(100), Manual(108)).Alignment);

        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignment.Indeterminate,
            TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(PolicyRegistry(maximum - TimeSpan.FromTicks(1)), PolicyKey, Machine(100), Manual(108)).Alignment);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_decided_verdict_always_reports_its_separation_bounds()
    {
        var verdict = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(
            PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30)), PolicyKey, Machine(100), Manual(108));

        Assert.NotNull(verdict.Separation);
        Assert.True(verdict.Separation!.Minimum <= verdict.Separation.Maximum);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void An_indeterminate_verdict_is_a_finding_not_a_refusal()
    {
        // The evidence was admissible. What it supports is "cannot tell from this", which
        // is a result about the plant, not a gap in the declaration.
        var verdict = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan.Zero), PolicyKey, Machine(100), Manual(108));

        Assert.True(verdict.IsDecided);
        Assert.Equal(TerminalState.Finding, verdict.Outcome);
        Assert.Equal(ExclusionAttribution.None, verdict.Attribution);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ sets

    [Fact]
    public void A_set_is_coincident_only_when_every_pair_is()
    {
        var registry = PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30));

        var verdict = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(registry, PolicyKey,
            new[] { Machine(100), Manual(108), Machine(101) });

        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignment.Coincident, verdict.Alignment);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void One_provably_separated_pair_separates_the_whole_set()
    {
        // Instants that cannot all be the same moment are not aligned, however close the
        // rest of them are.
        var registry = PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5));

        var verdict = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(registry, PolicyKey,
            new[] { Machine(100), Machine(101), Manual(140) });

        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignment.Separated, verdict.Alignment);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void An_undecidable_pair_makes_the_set_indeterminate_rather_than_coincident()
    {
        var registry = PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(20));

        var verdict = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(registry, PolicyKey,
            new[] { Machine(100), Machine(101), Manual(108) });

        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignment.Indeterminate, verdict.Alignment);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_reported_bounds_belong_to_the_widest_pair_in_the_set()
    {
        var registry = PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan.FromHours(2));

        var verdict = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(registry, PolicyKey,
            new[] { Machine(100), Machine(101), Manual(140) });

        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignmentKernel.Separation(Machine(100), Manual(140)), verdict.Separation);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------- declaration invariants

    [Fact]
    public void An_identical_redeclaration_is_idempotent_and_a_conflicting_one_fails_closed()
    {
        var registry = PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5));

        Assert.True(registry.TryDeclarePolicy(new TemporalAlignmentPolicy(PolicyKey, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5)), out _));
        Assert.Equal(1, registry.PolicyCount);

        Assert.False(registry.TryDeclarePolicy(new TemporalAlignmentPolicy(PolicyKey, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(9)), out var code));
        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignmentCodes.ConflictingDeclaration, code);

        // The original tolerance stands: a later arrival does not win by arriving later.
        Assert.True(registry.TryGetPolicy(PolicyKey, out var stored));
        Assert.Equal(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5), stored!.Tolerance);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Policy_identity_uses_the_same_trim_only_normalisation_as_the_rest_of_the_kernel()
    {
        var registry = PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5));

        foreach (var variant in new[] { PolicyKey, "  " + PolicyKey, PolicyKey + "  " })
        {
            Assert.True(registry.TryGetPolicy(variant, out var policy));
            Assert.Equal(PolicyKey, policy!.PolicyKey);
        }

        Assert.Equal(1, registry.PolicyCount);

        // Case is identity, not noise.
        Assert.False(registry.TryGetPolicy(PolicyKey.ToLowerInvariant(), out _));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------- consumes the committed contract

    [Fact]
    public void Instants_resolved_by_the_source_time_authority_align_without_adaptation()
    {
        // End to end from the committed upstream contract: declare two signals, resolve
        // both, then align. Nothing is reconstructed by hand.
        var sources = new SourceTimeAuthorityRegistry();

        Assert.True(sources.TryDeclareSignal(new TimeSignalDeclaration(
            MachineSource, EventSignal, TimeRole.Effective, TimeOffsetOrigin.DeclaredFixedOffset,
            TimeSpan.Zero, string.Empty, MachineUncertainty, TimeSpan.Zero,
            TimeUncertaintyConvention.ResolutionIsHalfWidth), out _));

        Assert.True(sources.TryDeclareSignal(new TimeSignalDeclaration(
            ManualSource, EventSignal, TimeRole.Effective, TimeOffsetOrigin.DeclaredFixedOffset,
            TimeSpan.Zero, string.Empty, ManualUncertainty, TimeSpan.Zero,
            TimeUncertaintyConvention.ResolutionIsHalfWidth), out _));

        static RawSourceTime At(double minute) =>
            RawSourceTime.WithoutOffset(DateTime.SpecifyKind(FrozenTestEpoch.AtMinute(minute).UtcDateTime, DateTimeKind.Unspecified));

        var machine = SourceTimeAuthorityKernel.Resolve(sources, MachineSource, EventSignal, At(100)).Instant;
        var manual = SourceTimeAuthorityKernel.Resolve(sources, ManualSource, EventSignal, At(108)).Instant;

        Assert.NotNull(machine);
        Assert.NotNull(manual);

        var verdict = TemporalAlignmentKernel.Align(PolicyRegistry(TimeSpan.Zero), PolicyKey, machine!, manual!);

        Assert.True(verdict.IsDecided);
        Assert.Equal(TemporalAlignment.Indeterminate, verdict.Alignment);
        Assert.Equal(TimeSpan.Zero, verdict.Separation!.Minimum);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_declared_uncertainties_match_the_ones_the_fixture_already_carries()
    {
        var machineObservation = GenericProcessFixture.TemporalPairOverlapping
            .Single(o => o.Source == ObservationSourceKind.Machine);

        var manualObservation = GenericProcessFixture.TemporalPairOverlapping
            .Single(o => o.Source == ObservationSourceKind.Manual);

        Assert.Equal(machineObservation.ClockUncertainty, MachineUncertainty);
        Assert.Equal(manualObservation.ClockUncertainty, ManualUncertainty);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Alignment_reports_temporal_compatibility_and_nothing_about_what_it_means()
    {
        // This contract answers whether instants may be treated as the same moment. What
        // a disagreement implies about the plant belongs downstream.
        var verdicts = Enum.GetNames(typeof(TemporalAlignment));

        Assert.Equal(3, verdicts.Length);
        Assert.Contains("Indeterminate", verdicts);
        Assert.DoesNotContain(verdicts, v => v.IndexOf("Conflict", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0);
        Assert.DoesNotContain(verdicts, v => v.IndexOf("Misclassified", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0);
    }
}
'@
Write-AsciiFile -Path (Join-Path $FixtureDir 'TemporalAlignmentKnownAnswerTests.cs') -Content $testsCs
Write-Ok 'wrote TemporalAlignmentKnownAnswerTests.cs'

# ===========================================================================
# PHASE 4 - ON-DISK SELF-CHECK (positive facts about owned regions)
# ===========================================================================
Write-Step 'Phase 4 - on-disk self-check'

$contractsOnDisk = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $CoreDir 'TemporalAlignmentContracts.cs') -Raw
foreach ($must in @(
    'public enum TemporalAlignment',
    'public sealed record TemporalAlignmentPolicy',
    'public sealed record TemporalSeparation',
    'public sealed record TemporalAlignmentVerdict',
    'public static class TemporalAlignmentCodes',
    'public sealed class TemporalAlignmentPolicyRegistry')) {
    if ($contractsOnDisk.IndexOf($must, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal) -lt 0) { Stop-WithRollback "self-check: contracts file lacks $must" }
}
Write-Ok 'all declared public contract types are on disk'

$kernelOnDisk = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $CoreDir 'TemporalAlignmentKernel.cs') -Raw
foreach ($must in @('public static class TemporalAlignmentKernel', 'public static TemporalAlignmentVerdict Align', 'public static TemporalSeparation Separation')) {
    if ($kernelOnDisk.IndexOf($must, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal) -lt 0) { Stop-WithRollback "self-check: kernel lacks $must" }
}
Write-Ok 'kernel entry points are on disk'

$contractCode = [regex]::Replace($contractsOnDisk, '/\*[\s\S]*?\*/', '')
$contractCode = [regex]::Replace($contractCode, '(?m)^\s*//.*$', '')
$contractCode = [regex]::Replace($contractCode, '(?m)^\s*///.*$', '')

$kernelCode = [regex]::Replace($kernelOnDisk, '/\*[\s\S]*?\*/', '')
$kernelCode = [regex]::Replace($kernelCode, '(?m)^\s*//.*$', '')
$kernelCode = [regex]::Replace($kernelCode, '(?m)^\s*///.*$', '')

# Indeterminate must survive as a first-class verdict, or the upstream law that
# overlapping uncertainty cannot be silently resolved dies here.
foreach ($must in @('Indeterminate', 'Coincident', 'Separated')) {
    if ($contractCode.IndexOf($must, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal) -lt 0) {
        Stop-WithRollback "self-check: alignment verdict missing -> $must"
    }
}
Write-Ok 'three alignment verdicts including Indeterminate are on disk'

# Scope guard: this contract answers temporal compatibility only. Reconciliation
# vocabulary, causal language and persistence belong to other lanes.
foreach ($token in @('ConflictingEvidence', 'PartiallyAligned', 'LikelyMisclassified', 'RootCause', 'DbContext', 'Npgsql', 'Opc', 'Modbus')) {
    if ($contractCode -cmatch ('\b' + $token)) { Stop-WithRollback "self-check: out-of-scope vocabulary in the alignment contract -> $token" }
    if ($kernelCode -cmatch ('\b' + $token)) { Stop-WithRollback "self-check: out-of-scope vocabulary in the alignment kernel -> $token" }
}
Write-Ok 'scope held: temporal compatibility only, no reconciliation, causal or persistence vocabulary'

if ($contractCode.IndexOf('DeclaredKey.TryNormalise', [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal) -lt 0) {
    Stop-WithRollback 'self-check: the shared identity normalisation rule is not reused'
}
Write-Ok 'shared identity normalisation rule reused'

# ===========================================================================
# PHASE 5 - TARGETED TESTS
# ===========================================================================
Write-Step 'Phase 5 - targeted tests'

$grainRun = Invoke-Native -Exe 'dotnet' `
    -Arguments @('test', $TestProj, '--filter', 'BacklogTask=T-217', '--nologo') `
    -LogPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'temporal-alignment-tests.log')

if ($grainRun.ExitCode -ne 0) { Stop-WithRollback ("temporal alignment tests returned exit code " + $grainRun.ExitCode) }
if ($grainRun.Lines.Count -eq 0) { Stop-WithRollback 'empty test output is not a pass' }
Write-Ok 'temporal alignment tests GREEN'

# ===========================================================================
# PHASE 6 - ADJACENT GATES (nothing next door may break)
# ===========================================================================
Write-Step 'Phase 6 - adjacent gates'

$fixtureRun = Invoke-Native -Exe 'dotnet' `
    -Arguments @('test', $TestProj, '--filter', 'BacklogTask=T-208', '--nologo') `
    -LogPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'fixture-integrity.log') -Quiet

if ($fixtureRun.ExitCode -ne 0) { Stop-WithRollback ("the generic validation fixture went red (exit " + $fixtureRun.ExitCode + ")") }
Write-Ok 'generic validation fixture still GREEN'

# This contract adds product code to Analytics.Core, so the genericity gate is the
# proof that it introduced no new customer or industry identity. A new fingerprint
# here is a blocking failure, which is exactly what that gate is for.
$genericityRun = Invoke-Native -Exe 'dotnet' `
    -Arguments @('test', $ArchProj, '--filter', 'BacklogTask=T-206', '--nologo') `
    -LogPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'genericity-gate.log') -Quiet

if ($genericityRun.ExitCode -ne 0) {
    Stop-WithRollback ("the genericity gate went red (exit " + $genericityRun.ExitCode + "). This contract introduced a new violation fingerprint; see " + $genericityRun.LogPath)
}
Write-Ok 'genericity gate GREEN: zero new violation fingerprints from this contract'

# ===========================================================================
# PHASE 7 - FOREIGN-FILE DELTA GUARD
# ===========================================================================
Write-Step 'Phase 7 - foreign-file delta guard'

Push-Location $RepoRoot
try {
    $post = Invoke-Native -Exe 'git' -Arguments @('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all') `
        -LogPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'git-status-after.txt') -Quiet

    $foreignAfter = @($post.Lines | ForEach-Object { ($_ -replace '^..\s+', '') } | Where-Object { $Owned -notcontains $_ })
    $newForeign = @($foreignAfter | Where-Object { $ForeignDirtyBefore -notcontains $_ })
}
finally { Pop-Location }

if ($newForeign.Count -gt 0) { Stop-WithRollback ("this pack changed files it does not own: " + ($newForeign -join ', ')) }
Write-Ok 'foreign changed files: untouched (delta against the phase-1 baseline)'

# ===========================================================================
# EVIDENCE MANIFEST
# ===========================================================================
$manifest = @(
    'Task: T-217',
    'Release: M2',
    'Artifact: Temporal Alignment contract',
    ('Timestamp: ' + $Stamp),
    ('Branch/head: ' + ($branch.Lines -join '') + ' ' + ($head.Lines -join '')),
    'Temporal alignment tests: GREEN',
    'Generic validation fixture: GREEN',
    'Genericity gate: GREEN (no new violation fingerprints)',
    'Foreign files: untouched',
    'Staged: no',
    'Committed: no'
)
$manifest | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'manifest.txt') -Encoding ASCII

Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'APPLY PASS' -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host 'temporal alignment tests: GREEN'
Write-Host 'generic validation fixture: GREEN'
Write-Host 'genericity gate: GREEN (no new violation fingerprints)'
Write-Host 'owned files present: TemporalAlignmentContracts.cs, TemporalAlignmentKernel.cs, TemporalAlignmentKnownAnswerTests.cs'
Write-Host 'foreign changed files: untouched'
Write-Host 'not staged'
Write-Host ("evidence: " + $EvidenceDir)
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'Index check, then stage the exact three:'
Write-Host '  git diff --cached --name-only        # must be EMPTY before staging'
Write-Host '  git add Backend/PlantProcess.Analytics.Core/Kernel/Time/TemporalAlignmentContracts.cs Backend/PlantProcess.Analytics.Core/Kernel/Time/TemporalAlignmentKernel.cs Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Tests/GenericValidation/TemporalAlignmentKnownAnswerTests.cs'
Write-Host '  git diff --cached --name-only        # must equal exactly those three'
Write-Host '  git diff --cached --stat'

$Terminated = $true
exit 0

}
catch {
    if (-not $Terminated) {
        Write-Host ''
        Write-Bad 'APPLY FAILED'
        Write-Bad ("unhandled error: " + $_.Exception.Message)
        Write-Host ''
        Write-Host 'rollback executed:'

        $removed = 0
        foreach ($f in $Created) {
            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force; Write-Host ("  removed  " + $f); $removed++ }
        }
        if ($removed -eq 0) { Write-Host '  nothing had been created yet' }

        if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $CoreDir) -and -not (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $CoreDir -Force)) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $CoreDir -Force
        }

        Write-Host 'owned created files: removed'
        Write-Host 'foreign changed files: untouched'
        Write-Host 'repository returned to pre-pack state'
        Write-Host ("evidence: " + $EvidenceDir)
    }
    exit 1
}
