function Write-Head([string]$t) {
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
    Write-Host $t -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host ('=' * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
}
function Write-Ok  ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [OK]   $t" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Warn([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [WARN] $t" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Write-Bad ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] $t" -ForegroundColor Red }
function Write-Inf ([string]$t) { Write-Host "  [INFO] $t" -ForegroundColor Gray }

$script:Ev = ''
$script:Backup = ''
$script:Mutated = $false
$script:Written = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList

function Save-Text {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Text)
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if ($dir -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}

function Stop-Refuse {
    param([string]$Reason)
    Write-Head 'REFUSED - NOTHING WAS CHANGED'
    Write-Bad $Reason
    if ($script:Ev) { Write-Inf "evidence: $script:Ev" }
    exit 2
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------ file bytes ----

function Read-FileFacts {
    param([string]$Path)
    $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Path)
    $hasBom = ($bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and $bytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and $bytes[2] -eq 0xBF)
    if ($hasBom) { $text = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bytes, 3, $bytes.Length - 3) }
    else         { $text = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bytes) }
    $crlf = ([regex]::Matches($text, "`r`n")).Count
    $lf   = ([regex]::Matches($text, "`n")).Count - $crlf
    $eol  = 'LF'
    if ($crlf -ge $lf) { $eol = 'CRLF' }
    return @{ Path = $Path; Bom = $hasBom; Text = $text; Eol = $eol }
}

function Write-FileExact {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Text, [bool]$Bom, [string]$Eol)
    $normalised = $Text -replace "`r`n", "`n"
    if ($Eol -eq 'CRLF') { $normalised = $normalised -replace "`n", "`r`n" }
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if ($dir -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $normalised, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($Bom)))
}

function Show-LogTail {
    param([string]$Path, [int]$Count = 20)
    if (-not $Path) { return }
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) { Write-Inf "no log was produced at $Path"; return }
    Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Tail $Count | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
}

function New-TempDir {
    param([string]$Prefix)
    $base = $env:TEMP
    if (-not $base) { $base = $env:TMPDIR }
    if (-not $base) { $base = [System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath() }
    $dir = Join-Path $base ($Prefix + ([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')))
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null
    return $dir
}

function Get-Prop {
    param($Object, [string]$Name)
    if ($null -eq $Object) { return $null }
    if ($Object.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $Name) { return $Object.$Name }
    return $null
}

function Get-Sha256 {
    param([string]$Path)
    return (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ git ----

function Invoke-Git {
    param([string[]]$GitArgs)
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try {
        $raw = & git @GitArgs 2>&1
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
        $text = ($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) -join "`r`n"
    }
    finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
    return @{ Code = $code; Text = $text }
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------- rollback ----

function Invoke-Rollback {
    param([string]$Reason)
    Write-Head 'ROLLBACK'
    Write-Bad $Reason
    if (-not $script:Mutated) {
        Write-Ok 'nothing had been written yet'
        return
    }
    $restored = 0
    foreach ($rel in $script:Written) {
        $live = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull $rel
        $keep = Join-Path $script:Backup $rel
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $keep) {
            $dir = Split-Path -Parent $live
            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $keep -Destination $live -Force
            $restored++
        }
        elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath $live) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $live -Force
            $restored++
        }
    }
    Write-Ok "$restored path(s) returned to their pre-apply state"
    Write-Inf "backup kept at: $script:Backup"
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------- postgres ----

function Read-PgProfile {
    param([string]$RelativePath)
    $full = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull $RelativePath
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full)) { return $null }

    $kv = @{}
    foreach ($ln in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $full)) {
        if ($ln -match '^\s*#') { continue }
        if ($ln -match '^\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$') { $kv[$Matches[1]] = $Matches[2] }
    }

    $pg = @{ PgHost = ''; Port = '5432'; Database = ''; User = ''; Password = '' }
    foreach ($key in @('ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb', 'ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection')) {
        if (-not $kv.ContainsKey($key)) { continue }
        foreach ($part in ($kv[$key] -split ';')) {
            if ($part -notmatch '^\s*([A-Za-z ]+)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$') { continue }
            $n = $Matches[1].Trim().ToLowerInvariant()
            $v = $Matches[2]
            switch ($n) {
                'host'     { if (-not $pg.PgHost)   { $pg.PgHost = $v } }
                'server'   { if (-not $pg.PgHost)   { $pg.PgHost = $v } }
                'port'     { $pg.Port = $v }
                'database' { if (-not $pg.Database) { $pg.Database = $v } }
                'username' { if (-not $pg.User)     { $pg.User = $v } }
                'user id'  { if (-not $pg.User)     { $pg.User = $v } }
                'password' { if (-not $pg.Password) { $pg.Password = $v } }
            }
        }
    }
    foreach ($pair in @(@{K='PGHOST';F='PgHost'}, @{K='PGPORT';F='Port'}, @{K='PGDATABASE';F='Database'},
                        @{K='PGUSER';F='User'}, @{K='PGPASSWORD';F='Password'}, @{K='POSTGRES_HOST';F='PgHost'},
                        @{K='POSTGRES_PORT';F='Port'}, @{K='POSTGRES_DB';F='Database'},
                        @{K='POSTGRES_USER';F='User'}, @{K='POSTGRES_PASSWORD';F='Password'})) {
        if ($kv.ContainsKey($pair.K) -and -not $pg[$pair.F]) { $pg[$pair.F] = $kv[$pair.K] }
    }
    return $pg
}

function Assert-LocalProfile {
    param($Pg, [string]$Label)
    if ($null -eq $Pg) { Stop-Refuse "connection profile not found: $Label" }
    $missing = @()
    foreach ($f in @('PgHost', 'User', 'Password')) { if (-not $Pg[$f]) { $missing += $f } }
    if ($missing.Count -gt 0) {
        Stop-Refuse ("the profile $Label does not resolve: " + ($missing -join ', ') + ". No credential is embedded in this pack and none will be invented.")
    }
    if (@('localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1') -notcontains $Pg.PgHost.ToLowerInvariant()) {
        Stop-Refuse "refusing a non-local database host: $($Pg.PgHost)"
    }
}

function Invoke-PsqlFile {
    param($Pg, [string]$Database, [string]$SqlPath, [string]$LogPath, [switch]$Csv, [switch]$Tuples)
    $env:PGPASSWORD = $Pg.Password
    $psqlArgs = @('-v', 'ON_ERROR_STOP=1', '-h', $Pg.PgHost, '-p', $Pg.Port, '-U', $Pg.User, '-d', $Database, '-f', $SqlPath)
    if ($Csv)    { $psqlArgs = @('--csv') + $psqlArgs }
    if ($Tuples) { $psqlArgs = @('-A', '-F', '|', '-t') + $psqlArgs }
    $prev = $ErrorActionPreference
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try {
        $raw = & psql @psqlArgs 2>&1
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    }
    finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $prev }
    $lines = @($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString().TrimEnd() })
    if ($LogPath) { Save-Text -Path $LogPath -Text (($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n") }
    return @{ Code = $code; Lines = $lines }
}

function Invoke-PsqlText {
    param($Pg, [string]$Database, [string]$Sql, [string]$Name, [switch]$Tuples)
    $work = Join-Path $script:Ev 'sql'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $work)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $work -Force | Out-Null }
    $file = Join-Path $work ($Name + '.sql')
    Save-Text -Path $file -Text $Sql
    return (Invoke-PsqlFile -Pg $Pg -Database $Database -SqlPath $file -LogPath (Join-Path $work ($Name + '.log')) -Tuples:$Tuples)
}

function Get-Scalar {
    param($Pg, [string]$Database, [string]$Sql, [string]$Name)
    $r = Invoke-PsqlText -Pg $Pg -Database $Database -Sql $Sql -Name $Name -Tuples
    if ($r.Code -ne 0) { return $null }
    $vals = @($r.Lines | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
    if ($vals.Count -eq 0) { return '' }
    return $vals[0]
}

# =============================================================================
# PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT
# =============================================================================

Write-Head "PHASE 0 - PREFLIGHT   (mode: $Mode)"

if ($PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 5) { Write-Bad 'PowerShell 5.1 or later is required.'; exit 2 }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $RepoRoot)) { Write-Bad "repository not found: $RepoRoot"; exit 2 }

$needed = @('git', 'dotnet')

    if (-not (Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Bad "$c is not on PATH."; exit 2 }

Push-Location -LiteralPath $script:RepoRootFull
try {

$script:Ev = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Join-Path $EvidenceRoot 'ThreeSchemaTopologyConvergence') ((Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss') + '_' + $Mode))).TrimEnd('\')
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $script:Ev -Force | Out-Null

Write-Ok "repository : $script:RepoRootFull"
Write-Ok "evidence   : $script:Ev"

$head = (Invoke-Git @('rev-parse', 'HEAD'))
if ($head.Code -ne 0) { Stop-Refuse 'this is not a git working tree.' }
$headSha = $head.Text.Trim()
Write-Ok "HEAD       : $($headSha.Substring(0,12))"

$staged = Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')
$stagedFiles = @($staged.Text -split "`r`n" | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
if ($stagedFiles.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Bad 'the git index is not empty. Staging law: the index must be empty before this pack runs.'
    foreach ($f in ($stagedFiles | Select-Object -First 15)) { Write-Inf "  staged: $f" }
    exit 2
}
Write-Ok 'git index empty'

# ---- input 1: the frozen table assignment ----------------------------------

if (-not $AssignmentCsv) {
    $AssignmentCsv = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads\t087_static_assignment.csv'
}
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $AssignmentCsv)) {
    Stop-Refuse ("the frozen table assignment is not at $AssignmentCsv. " +
                 "It is the file the read-only scan already consumed on this machine. " +
                 "Pass -AssignmentCsv <path> if it lives elsewhere. No target schema will be inferred.")
}

$assignRows = @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $AssignmentCsv)
if ($assignRows.Count -eq 0) { Stop-Refuse 'the frozen table assignment is empty.' }

foreach ($col in @('old_schema', 'table', 'target_schema')) {
    if (-not ($assignRows[0].PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $col)) {
        Stop-Refuse "the frozen table assignment has no '$col' column; this is not the assignment the scan consumed."
    }
}

$GovernedSchemas = @('ppiq_meta', 'ppiq_plant', 'ppiq_staging')

$moves    = @{}   # 'old.table' -> 'target.table'
$tableTo  = @{}   # 'table'     -> 'target_schema'
$tableFrom= @{}   # 'table'     -> 'old_schema'
$staying  = 0
$badTarget = @()

foreach ($r in $assignRows) {
    $tbl = $r.table.Trim().ToLowerInvariant()
    $src = $r.old_schema.Trim().ToLowerInvariant()
    $tgt = $r.target_schema.Trim().ToLowerInvariant()
    if (-not $tbl) { continue }

    if ($tgt -eq $src) { $staying++; $tableTo[$tbl] = $tgt; $tableFrom[$tbl] = $src; continue }
    if ($GovernedSchemas -notcontains $tgt) { $badTarget += ("$src.$tbl -> $tgt"); continue }

    $moves["$src.$tbl"] = "$tgt.$tbl"
    $tableTo[$tbl]   = $tgt
    $tableFrom[$tbl] = $src
}

if ($badTarget.Count -gt 0) {
    foreach ($b in ($badTarget | Select-Object -First 10)) { Write-Inf "  ungoverned target: $b" }
    Stop-Refuse "$($badTarget.Count) assignment row(s) name a target schema outside the three governed schemas."
}

Write-Ok "$($assignRows.Count) assigned table(s); $($moves.Count) change schema; $staying stay where they are"

$spread = @{}
foreach ($s in $GovernedSchemas) { $spread[$s] = 0 }
foreach ($k in $moves.Keys) {
    $t = $moves[$k].Split('.')[0]
    $spread[$t] = $spread[$t] + 1
}
foreach ($s in $GovernedSchemas) { Write-Inf ("  {0,-14} {1} table(s) arrive" -f $s, $spread[$s]) }

# ---- input 2: the frozen patch ledger --------------------------------------

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $LedgerCsv)) {
    Stop-Refuse "the frozen patch ledger is not at $LedgerCsv"
}

$ledger = @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $LedgerCsv)
foreach ($col in @('file', 'line', 'old_reference', 'target_reference', 'owner', 'action')) {
    if (-not ($ledger[0].PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $col)) {
        Stop-Refuse "the patch ledger has no '$col' column; this is not the ledger the scan produced."
    }
}

if ($ledger.Count -ne $ExpectedLedgerRows) {
    Stop-Refuse ("the patch ledger holds $($ledger.Count) row(s); the frozen evidence declares $ExpectedLedgerRows. " +
                 "A different ledger is a different decision. Refusing.")
}
Write-Ok "patch ledger: $($ledger.Count) row(s), as frozen"

$qualify = @($ledger | Where-Object { $_.action -like 'qualify*' })
if ($qualify.Count -ne $ExpectedQualifyRows) {
    Stop-Refuse ("the ledger holds $($qualify.Count) qualify row(s); the frozen evidence declares $ExpectedQualifyRows.")
}
Write-Ok "qualify rows: $($qualify.Count), as frozen"

# ---- exclusions demanded by the ruling -------------------------------------

$exHistoricalEf  = @($qualify | Where-Object { $_.file -match '(?i)^Backend/PlantProcess\.Infrastructure/Migrations/' })
$exHistoricalSql = @($qualify | Where-Object { $_.file -match '(?i)^Backend/database/scripts/' })

$editable = @($qualify | Where-Object {
    $_.file -notmatch '(?i)^Backend/PlantProcess\.Infrastructure/Migrations/' -and
    $_.file -notmatch '(?i)^Backend/database/scripts/'
})

Write-Ok ("{0} historical EF migration row(s) excluded" -f $exHistoricalEf.Count)
Write-Ok ("{0} historical canonical SQL row(s) excluded" -f $exHistoricalSql.Count)
Write-Ok ("{0} current-source edit(s) remain" -f $editable.Count)

if ($editable.Count -eq 0) { Stop-Refuse 'after exclusions the ledger asks for no edit. That is not the frozen decision.' }

# every edit must have a known target schema
$unknownTarget = @()
foreach ($e in $editable) {
    $tgtSchema = $e.target_reference.Split('.')[0].ToLowerInvariant()
    if ($GovernedSchemas -notcontains $tgtSchema) { $unknownTarget += ("{0}:{1} -> {2}" -f $e.file, $e.line, $e.target_reference) }
}
if ($unknownTarget.Count -gt 0) {
    foreach ($u in ($unknownTarget | Select-Object -First 10)) { Write-Inf "  $u" }
    Stop-Refuse "$($unknownTarget.Count) ledger edit(s) target a schema outside the three governed schemas."
}
Write-Ok 'every edit has a governed target schema'

$editFiles = @($editable | Group-Object file | Sort-Object Name)
Write-Ok "$($editFiles.Count) file(s) carry an edit"

# =============================================================================
# PHASE 1 - THE HISTORICAL SET IS STILL INTACT
# =============================================================================

Write-Head 'PHASE 1 - HISTORICAL SET UNMUTATED'

$manifestRel  = 'Backend\database\canonical-migration-order.json'
$manifestPath = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull $manifestRel
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $manifestPath)) { Stop-Refuse 'the canonical migration authority manifest is missing.' }

$manifestFacts = Read-FileFacts -Path $manifestPath
$manifest = $manifestFacts.Text | ConvertFrom-Json

$drift = @()
foreach ($step in $manifest.canonicalPath) {
    $abs = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull ($step.path -replace '/', '\')
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $abs)) { $drift += ("missing: " + $step.path); continue }
    if ((Get-Sha256 -Path $abs) -ne $step.sha256) { $drift += ("changed: " + $step.path) }
}
foreach ($m in $manifest.efMigrationBaseline.migrations) {
    $abs = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull ('Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure\Migrations\' + $m.name + '.cs')
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $abs)) { $drift += ("missing EF migration: " + $m.name); continue }
    if ((Get-Sha256 -Path $abs) -ne $m.sha256) { $drift += ("changed EF migration: " + $m.name) }
}

if ($drift.Count -gt 0) {
    foreach ($d in ($drift | Select-Object -First 15)) { Write-Inf "  $d" }
    Stop-Refuse "$($drift.Count) historical artefact(s) already differ from the manifest. Convergence does not start on a drifted baseline."
}
Write-Ok ("{0} canonical script(s) and {1} EF migration(s) byte-identical to the manifest" -f @($manifest.canonicalPath).Count, @($manifest.efMigrationBaseline.migrations).Count)

# the views authority must be the single, last step on the path
$viewSteps = @($manifest.canonicalPath | Where-Object { $_.path -like 'Backend/database/views/*' })
if ($viewSteps.Count -ne 1) { Stop-Refuse "the manifest records $($viewSteps.Count) view step(s) on the path; this pack expects exactly one." }
$viewsRel = ($viewSteps[0].path -replace '/', '\')
$viewsPath = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull $viewsRel

$lastSchemaPosition = 0
foreach ($step in $manifest.canonicalPath) {
    if ($step.path -like 'Backend/database/views/*') { continue }
    if ($step.position -gt $lastSchemaPosition) { $lastSchemaPosition = $step.position }
}
if ($viewSteps[0].position -le $lastSchemaPosition) {
    Stop-Refuse 'the view authority does not currently apply last. The pack will not reorder a path it did not build.'
}
Write-Ok ("view authority is step {0}; last schema step is {1}" -f $viewSteps[0].position, $lastSchemaPosition)

# ---- constants used by every mode ------------------------------------------

$viewsRelGit = $viewSteps[0].path

$viewNames = @()
foreach ($v in @($manifest.declaredViews)) {
    $parts = $v.Split('.')
    if ($parts.Count -ne 2) { Stop-Refuse "a declared view is not schema-qualified: $v" }
    $viewNames += $parts[1].ToLowerInvariant()
}
if ($viewNames.Count -eq 0) { Stop-Refuse 'the manifest declares no read-model view.' }

$convRel     = 'Backend/database/topology/000_storage_topology_convergence.sql'
$canvasRel   = 'Backend/PlantProcess.Api/Endpoints/Prep/VisualMapperEndpoints.cs'
$twoStageRel = 'Backend/PlantProcess.Api/Endpoints/Admin/TwoStageImportEndpoints.cs'
$mapRel      = 'Backend/PlantProcess.Infrastructure/Persistence/Topology/StorageTopologyMap.cs'
$conRel      = 'Backend/PlantProcess.Infrastructure/Persistence/Topology/StorageTopologyConvention.cs'
$ctxRel      = 'Backend/PlantProcess.Infrastructure/Persistence/PlantProcessDbContext.cs'
$testRel     = 'Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests/StorageTopologyTests.cs'

$StableRoot = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $EvidenceRoot 'ThreeSchemaTopologyConvergence')).TrimEnd('\')
$OwnedFilesPath  = Join-Path $StableRoot 'owned-files.txt'
$CertifyStampPath = Join-Path $StableRoot 'certify-stamp.json'

# The path a build replays, in the order the manifest declares. In Verify and
# Apply this is the current path; in Certify it already carries the topology tier.
$newPathForReplay = @($manifest.canonicalPath | Sort-Object position | Select-Object -ExpandProperty path)

$script:MeasuredFreshTables = 0
$script:MeasuredDeclaredViewsMissing = 0

# =============================================================================
# PHASE 2 - POST-IMAGES IN MEMORY (no file is touched in this phase)
#
# Only Verify and Apply generate post-images. Certify and Close read a tree that
# already carries them, where the ledger anchors are gone by design.

$ledgerApplied = 0
$viewRefEdits  = 0
$canvasHits    = 0
$twoStageHits  = 0

if ($Mode -eq 'Verify' -or $Mode -eq 'Apply') {

Write-Head 'PHASE 2 - POST-IMAGES'

# postImages: relative path -> @{ Facts; Text; Reason }
$postImages = [ordered]@{}
$anchorFailures = @()
$editCounts = @{}

function Set-PostImage {
    param([string]$Rel, $Facts, [string]$Text, [string]$Reason)
    $script:postImages[$Rel] = @{ Facts = $Facts; Text = $Text; Reason = $Reason }
}

function Get-WorkingText {
    param([string]$Rel)
    if ($script:postImages.Contains($Rel)) { return $script:postImages[$Rel].Text }
    $abs = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull ($Rel -replace '/', '\')
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $abs)) { return $null }
    $facts = Read-FileFacts -Path $abs
    $script:postImages[$Rel] = @{ Facts = $facts; Text = $facts.Text; Reason = '' }
    return $facts.Text
}

# ---- 2a. ledger-driven re-qualification ------------------------------------

Write-Inf 'ledger-driven re-qualification'

foreach ($g in $editFiles) {
    $rel = $g.Name
    $abs = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull ($rel -replace '/', '\')
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $abs)) {
        $anchorFailures += ("{0} | file no longer exists | expected {1} edit(s)" -f $rel, $g.Count)
        continue
    }

    $text = Get-WorkingText -Rel $rel
    $applied = 0

    $byRef = @($g.Group | Group-Object old_reference)
    foreach ($ref in $byRef) {
        $old = $ref.Name
        $targets = @($ref.Group | Select-Object -ExpandProperty target_reference -Unique)
        if ($targets.Count -ne 1) {
            $anchorFailures += ("{0} | {1} | ambiguous: {2} different targets" -f $rel, $old, $targets.Count)
            continue
        }
        $new = $targets[0]
        $rx = [regex]('(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.])' + [regex]::Escape($old) + '(?![A-Za-z0-9_])')
        $actual = $rx.Matches($text).Count
        $expected = $ref.Count

        if ($actual -ne $expected) {
            $anchorFailures += ("{0} | {1} | expected {2} occurrence(s), found {3}" -f $rel, $old, $expected, $actual)
            continue
        }
        $text = $rx.Replace($text, $new)
        $applied += $actual
    }

    Set-PostImage -Rel $rel -Facts $script:postImages[$rel].Facts -Text $text -Reason 'ledger re-qualification'
    $editCounts[$rel] = $applied
}

foreach ($k in $editCounts.Keys) { $ledgerApplied += $editCounts[$k] }
Write-Ok ("{0} ledger edit(s) generated across {1} file(s)" -f $ledgerApplied, $editFiles.Count)

# ---- 2b. read-model view references ----------------------------------------
#
# The view authority itself carries no qualified reference, so the ledger has no
# row for it. Runtime code that names public.vw_* is found here instead, driven
# by the manifest's declared view list rather than by a guess.

Write-Inf 'declared read-model view references'

$sourceRoots = @('Backend\PlantProcess.Api', 'Backend\PlantProcess.Application', 'Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure', 'Backend\PlantProcess.Workers')
$viewRefFiles = @()

foreach ($root in $sourceRoots) {
    $dir = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull $root
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { continue }
    $cand = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Recurse -File -Include '*.cs', '*.json' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
              Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\(bin|obj)\\' -and $_.FullName -notmatch '\\Migrations\\' })
    foreach ($f in $cand) {
        $rel = $f.FullName.Substring($script:RepoRootFull.Length + 1).Replace('\', '/')
        $text = Get-WorkingText -Rel $rel
        if ($null -eq $text) { continue }
        $changed = $false
        foreach ($vn in $viewNames) {
            $rx = [regex]('(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.])public\.' + [regex]::Escape($vn) + '(?![A-Za-z0-9_])')
            $hits = $rx.Matches($text).Count
            if ($hits -eq 0) { continue }
            $text = $rx.Replace($text, ('ppiq_plant.' + $vn))
            $viewRefEdits += $hits
            $changed = $true
        }
        if ($changed) {
            Set-PostImage -Rel $rel -Facts $script:postImages[$rel].Facts -Text $text -Reason 'read-model view re-qualification'
            $viewRefFiles += $rel
        }
        elseif (-not $editCounts.ContainsKey($rel)) {
            $script:postImages.Remove($rel) | Out-Null
        }
    }
}
Write-Ok ("{0} declared-view reference(s) re-pointed across {1} file(s)" -f $viewRefEdits, @($viewRefFiles | Sort-Object -Unique).Count)

# ---- 2c. canvas staging schema ---------------------------------------------

Write-Inf 'canvas staging schema'

$canvasAbs = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull ($canvasRel -replace '/', '\')
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $canvasAbs)) { Stop-Refuse "the canvas endpoint is missing: $canvasRel" }

$canvasText = Get-WorkingText -Rel $canvasRel
$canvasRx = [regex]('cfg\["Prep:StagingSchema"\]\s*\?\?\s*"dump_store"')
$canvasHits = $canvasRx.Matches($canvasText).Count
if ($canvasHits -eq 0) {
    $anchorFailures += ("{0} | canvas staging fallback literal dump_store | expected at least 1 occurrence, found 0" -f $canvasRel)
}
else {
    $canvasText = $canvasRx.Replace($canvasText, 'cfg["Prep:StagingSchema"] ?? "ppiq_staging"')
    Set-PostImage -Rel $canvasRel -Facts $script:postImages[$canvasRel].Facts -Text $canvasText -Reason 'canvas fallback staging schema'
    Write-Ok "$canvasHits configuration-driven fallback(s) now default to ppiq_staging"
}

# ---- 2d. two-stage import summary literal (declared addition) --------------

$twoStageAbs = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull ($twoStageRel -replace '/', '\')
$twoStageHits = 0
if (-not $NoRegistryRealignment -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $twoStageAbs)) {
    $t = Get-WorkingText -Rel $twoStageRel
    $rx = [regex]("table_schema\s*=\s*'dump_store'")
    $twoStageHits = $rx.Matches($t).Count
    if ($twoStageHits -gt 0) {
        $t = $rx.Replace($t, "table_schema = 'ppiq_staging'")
        Set-PostImage -Rel $twoStageRel -Facts $script:postImages[$twoStageRel].Facts -Text $t -Reason 'staging literal repointed (declared addition)'
        Write-Warn "$twoStageHits hardcoded staging literal repointed - finding W1-STAGING-LITERAL-01 recorded"
    }
}

# ---- 2e. generated: storage topology map -----------------------------------

Write-Inf 'generated artefacts'

function Resolve-TargetSchema {
    param([string]$Table)
    $t = $Table.ToLowerInvariant()
    if (-not $tableTo.ContainsKey($t)) {
        Stop-Refuse ("the table '$t' is not present in the frozen assignment. " +
                     "This pack does not infer a schema for a table the ruling did not place.")
    }
    return $tableTo[$t]
}


$mapEntries = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
foreach ($t in ($tableTo.Keys | Sort-Object)) {
    $schema = $tableTo[$t]
    if ($GovernedSchemas -notcontains $schema) { continue }
    [void]$mapEntries.Add(('        { "' + $t + '", "' + $schema + '" },'))
}
if ($mapEntries.Count -eq 0) { Stop-Refuse 'the assignment places no table in a governed schema.' }

$mapHeader = @'
// <auto-generated>
//     Storage topology map.
//
//     One row per governed table: the relational table name, and the schema that
//     owns it. Generated from the frozen table assignment, which is the single
//     place a placement decision is made.
//
//     This file is the model half of one truth. The physical half is the terminal
//     convergence SQL, generated from the same assignment in the same run. Neither
//     half infers anything: a table absent from the assignment is refused, never
//     placed by name or prefix.
// </auto-generated>

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace PlantProcess.Infrastructure.Persistence.Topology;

public static class StorageTopologyMap
{
    public const string MetaSchema = "ppiq_meta";
    public const string PlantSchema = "ppiq_plant";
    public const string StagingSchema = "ppiq_staging";

    public static readonly IReadOnlyList<string> GovernedSchemas =
        new[] { MetaSchema, PlantSchema, StagingSchema };

    private static readonly Dictionary<string, string> Placements =
        new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal)
    {
'@

$mapFooter = @'
    };

    public static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> Placements_ => Placements;

    public static int Count => Placements.Count;

    public static bool TryGetSchema(string table, out string schema)
    {
        schema = null;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(table))
        {
            return false;
        }

        return Placements.TryGetValue(table, out schema);
    }
}
'@

$mapText = $mapHeader + "`r`n" + (($mapEntries.ToArray()) -join "`r`n") + "`r`n" + $mapFooter + "`r`n"
Set-PostImage -Rel $mapRel -Facts @{ Bom = $false; Eol = 'CRLF' } -Text $mapText -Reason 'generated storage topology map'

$conText = @'
// Storage topology convention.
//
// Runs after every IEntityTypeConfiguration has been applied, so the relational
// table name is already decided, and moves each mapped entity onto the schema the
// frozen assignment gives it. It contains no vocabulary and no prefix rule: a
// table the assignment does not name is left exactly where it was, and the
// topology gate fails the build rather than letting it drift silently.

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace PlantProcess.Infrastructure.Persistence.Topology;

public static class StorageTopologyConvention
{
    public static void Apply(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        foreach (var entityType in modelBuilder.Model.GetEntityTypes())
        {
            var table = entityType.GetTableName();

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(table))
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (!StorageTopologyMap.TryGetSchema(table, out var schema))
            {
                continue;
            }

            entityType.SetSchema(schema);
        }
    }
}
'@
Set-PostImage -Rel $conRel -Facts @{ Bom = $false; Eol = 'CRLF' } -Text ($conText + "`r`n") -Reason 'generated storage topology convention'

# ---- 2f. DbContext wiring --------------------------------------------------

$ctxAbs = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull ($ctxRel -replace '/', '\')
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ctxAbs)) { Stop-Refuse "the DbContext is missing: $ctxRel" }

$ctxText = Get-WorkingText -Rel $ctxRel

$usingAnchor = 'using PlantProcess.Infrastructure.Persistence'
$usingLine = 'using PlantProcess.Infrastructure.Persistence.Topology;'
if ($ctxText -notmatch [regex]::Escape($usingLine)) {
    $rxNs = [regex]('(?m)^namespace PlantProcess\.Infrastructure\.Persistence;')
    if ($rxNs.Matches($ctxText).Count -ne 1) {
        $anchorFailures += ("{0} | namespace PlantProcess.Infrastructure.Persistence; | expected 1 occurrence, found {1}" -f $ctxRel, $rxNs.Matches($ctxText).Count)
    }
    else {
        $ctxText = $rxNs.Replace($ctxText, ($usingLine + "`r`n`r`nnamespace PlantProcess.Infrastructure.Persistence;"), 1)
    }
}

$callAnchor = 'ApplySoftDeleteQueryFilters(modelBuilder);'
$rxCall = [regex]([regex]::Escape($callAnchor))
$callHits = $rxCall.Matches($ctxText).Count
if ($callHits -ne 1) {
    $anchorFailures += ("{0} | {1} | expected 1 occurrence, found {2}" -f $ctxRel, $callAnchor, $callHits)
}
elseif ($ctxText -notmatch [regex]::Escape('StorageTopologyConvention.Apply(modelBuilder);')) {
    $ctxText = $rxCall.Replace(
        $ctxText,
        ($callAnchor + "`r`n" +
         "`r`n" +
         "        // Placement is topology, not vocabulary: the frozen assignment decides,`r`n" +
         "        // and physical relocation is performed once by the terminal convergence SQL.`r`n" +
         "        StorageTopologyConvention.Apply(modelBuilder);"),
        1)
}
Set-PostImage -Rel $ctxRel -Facts $script:postImages[$ctxRel].Facts -Text $ctxText -Reason 'topology convention wired into the model'

# ---- 2g. terminal convergence SQL ------------------------------------------


$moveRows = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
foreach ($k in ($moves.Keys | Sort-Object)) {
    $src = $k.Split('.')[0]
    $tbl = $k.Substring($src.Length + 1)
    $tgt = $moves[$k].Split('.')[0]
    [void]$moveRows.Add(("            ('" + $src + "', '" + $tbl + "', '" + $tgt + "'),"))
}
$moveRowsText = (($moveRows.ToArray()) -join "`r`n")
$moveRowsText = $moveRowsText.Substring(0, $moveRowsText.Length - 1)

$convHeader = @'
-- ============================================================================
-- PlantProcess IQ - terminal storage topology convergence
--
-- The one place a product table physically changes schema. It runs after every
-- historical creator has run, so no historical script is edited and no historical
-- replay is disturbed: each script still creates what it always created, and this
-- file moves the result to where the topology says it belongs.
--
-- Existence-driven and idempotent by construction:
--     target present                 -> pass, nothing to do
--     source present, target absent  -> ALTER TABLE ... SET SCHEMA
--     neither present                -> pass, and nothing is created
--
-- ALTER TABLE ... SET SCHEMA relocates the table with its rows, indexes,
-- constraints and owned sequences. No row is copied and no foreign key is
-- dropped; cross-schema references stay valid because they are resolved by
-- object identity, not by name.
-- ============================================================================
\set ON_ERROR_STOP on

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS ppiq_meta;
COMMENT ON SCHEMA ppiq_meta IS 'App metadata: dashboards, widgets, jobs, pages, users, roles, license.';
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS ppiq_plant;
COMMENT ON SCHEMA ppiq_plant IS 'Customer plant data after staging transform; RLS per tenant.';
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS ppiq_staging;
COMMENT ON SCHEMA ppiq_staging IS 'Physical staging layer: raw customer shapes before mapping.';

DO $convergence$
DECLARE
    r          record;
    moved      integer := 0;
    already    integer := 0;
    absent     integer := 0;
BEGIN
    FOR r IN
        SELECT * FROM (VALUES
'@

$convFooterA = @'
        ) AS m(source_schema, table_name, target_schema)
    LOOP
        IF to_regclass(format('%I.%I', r.target_schema, r.table_name)) IS NOT NULL THEN
            already := already + 1;
            CONTINUE;
        END IF;

        IF to_regclass(format('%I.%I', r.source_schema, r.table_name)) IS NULL THEN
            absent := absent + 1;
            CONTINUE;
        END IF;

        EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %I.%I SET SCHEMA %I', r.source_schema, r.table_name, r.target_schema);
        moved := moved + 1;
    END LOOP;

    RAISE NOTICE 'storage topology convergence: % relocated, % already in place, % absent', moved, already, absent;
END
$convergence$;
'@

$registryBlock = @'
-- The staging registry points at a physical schema by name. The move above would
-- leave that pointer dangling, so it is realigned here, guarded on the column
-- actually existing and touching only rows that still name the retired schema.
DO $registry$
BEGIN
    IF to_regclass('ppiq_staging.source_table_dump_registry') IS NOT NULL
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
                   WHERE table_schema = 'ppiq_staging'
                     AND table_name = 'source_table_dump_registry'
                     AND column_name = 'dump_schema_name') THEN
        UPDATE ppiq_staging.source_table_dump_registry
           SET dump_schema_name = 'ppiq_staging'
         WHERE dump_schema_name = 'dump_store';
    ELSIF to_regclass('ppiq_meta.source_table_dump_registry') IS NOT NULL
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
                   WHERE table_schema = 'ppiq_meta'
                     AND table_name = 'source_table_dump_registry'
                     AND column_name = 'dump_schema_name') THEN
        UPDATE ppiq_meta.source_table_dump_registry
           SET dump_schema_name = 'ppiq_staging'
         WHERE dump_schema_name = 'dump_store';
    ELSIF to_regclass('public.source_table_dump_registry') IS NOT NULL
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
                   WHERE table_schema = 'public'
                     AND table_name = 'source_table_dump_registry'
                     AND column_name = 'dump_schema_name') THEN
        UPDATE public.source_table_dump_registry
           SET dump_schema_name = 'ppiq_staging'
         WHERE dump_schema_name = 'dump_store';
    END IF;
END
$registry$;
'@

$convFooterB = @'
-- Least-privilege grants follow the objects. The historical grant script runs
-- before this file and cannot see the new locations, so the same privileges are
-- restated here for the governed schemas, and the append-only rule on the audit
-- log is restated wherever the audit table now lives.
DO $grants$
DECLARE
    s          text;
    audit_ns   text;
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'plantprocess_app') THEN
        RAISE NOTICE 'plantprocess_app absent - skipping topology grants.';
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    FOREACH s IN ARRAY ARRAY['ppiq_meta', 'ppiq_plant', 'ppiq_staging'] LOOP
        EXECUTE format('GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA %I TO plantprocess_app', s);
        EXECUTE format('GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA %I TO plantprocess_app', s);
        EXECUTE format('GRANT USAGE, SELECT ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA %I TO plantprocess_app', s);
        EXECUTE format('ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA %I GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLES TO plantprocess_app', s);
        EXECUTE format('ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA %I GRANT USAGE, SELECT ON SEQUENCES TO plantprocess_app', s);
    END LOOP;

    SELECT n.nspname INTO audit_ns
      FROM pg_class c
      JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
     WHERE c.relname = 'audit_log_entries' AND c.relkind = 'r'
     LIMIT 1;

    IF audit_ns IS NOT NULL THEN
        EXECUTE format('GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON %I.audit_log_entries TO plantprocess_app', audit_ns);
        EXECUTE format('REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON %I.audit_log_entries FROM plantprocess_app', audit_ns);
    END IF;
END
$grants$;

SELECT 'storage topology convergence applied' AS status,
       current_database()                     AS database_name,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables
         WHERE table_schema = 'ppiq_meta'    AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE') AS meta_tables,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables
         WHERE table_schema = 'ppiq_plant'   AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE') AS plant_tables,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables
         WHERE table_schema = 'ppiq_staging' AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE') AS staging_tables;
'@

$convText = $convHeader + "`r`n" + $moveRowsText + "`r`n" + $convFooterA + "`r`n`r`n"
if (-not $NoRegistryRealignment) { $convText += $registryBlock + "`r`n`r`n" }
$convText += $convFooterB + "`r`n"

Set-PostImage -Rel $convRel -Facts @{ Bom = $false; Eol = 'CRLF' } -Text $convText -Reason 'generated terminal convergence SQL'
Write-Ok ("terminal convergence SQL generated for {0} relocation(s)" -f $moves.Count)

# ---- 2h. read-model view authority -----------------------------------------

$viewsFacts = Read-FileFacts -Path $viewsPath
$viewsShaNow = Get-Sha256 -Path $viewsPath
if ($viewsShaNow -ne $viewSteps[0].sha256) {
    Stop-Refuse "the read-model view authority already differs from the manifest hash; this pack rewrites a known file, not an unknown one."
}

$viewBaseTables = @('quality_events', 'material_units', 'risk_scores', 'data_quality_issues', 'correlation_results')
$viewSchema = @{}
foreach ($t in $viewBaseTables) { $viewSchema[$t] = (Resolve-TargetSchema -Table $t) }
foreach ($t in $viewBaseTables) { Write-Inf ("  view base table {0,-22} -> {1}" -f $t, $viewSchema[$t]) }

$viewDropLines = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
foreach ($vn in $viewNames) { [void]$viewDropLines.Add("DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.$vn;") }

$viewsTemplate = @'
-- Read-model views for BI export. Generic by construction: materials, process,
-- quality, risk, data quality and correlations, with no dashboard, widget or
-- industry vocabulary anywhere in them.
--
-- The views live in the plant schema and every base table is named with the
-- schema that owns it, so a view never depends on the caller's search_path.
--
-- The public copies are dropped rather than kept as compatibility shims. A
-- permanent public alias would make two names for one read model, and the older
-- name would quietly outlive the topology it belongs to.

__DROPS__

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW ppiq_plant.vw_dashboard_quality_overview AS
SELECT
    m.site_id,
    date_trunc('day', q.event_at_utc) AS event_day_utc,
    COUNT(*) AS quality_event_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE q.event_type = 'Defect' OR q.defect_catalog_id IS NOT NULL) AS defect_event_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT q.material_unit_id) AS affected_material_count
FROM __QUALITY_EVENTS__ q
JOIN __MATERIAL_UNITS__ m ON m.id = q.material_unit_id
WHERE q.is_deleted = false AND m.is_deleted = false
GROUP BY m.site_id, date_trunc('day', q.event_at_utc);

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW ppiq_plant.vw_dashboard_latest_risk_by_material AS
SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.material_unit_id, r.risk_type)
    r.material_unit_id,
    m.material_code,
    m.material_unit_type,
    m.product_family,
    m.grade_or_recipe,
    m.site_id,
    r.risk_type,
    r.score,
    r.risk_class,
    r.model_version,
    r.scored_at_utc,
    r.main_contributors_json
FROM __RISK_SCORES__ r
JOIN __MATERIAL_UNITS__ m ON m.id = r.material_unit_id
WHERE r.is_deleted = false AND m.is_deleted = false
ORDER BY r.material_unit_id, r.risk_type, r.scored_at_utc DESC;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW ppiq_plant.vw_dashboard_data_quality_summary AS
SELECT
    COALESCE(m.site_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) AS site_id,
    d.severity,
    d.issue_type,
    COUNT(*) AS issue_count
FROM __DATA_QUALITY_ISSUES__ d
LEFT JOIN __MATERIAL_UNITS__ m ON m.id = d.material_unit_id
WHERE d.is_deleted = false
GROUP BY COALESCE(m.site_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid), d.severity, d.issue_type;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW ppiq_plant.vw_dashboard_correlation_summary AS
SELECT
    correlation_type,
    subject_code,
    outcome_code,
    COUNT(*) AS calculation_count,
    AVG(score) AS average_score,
    MAX(calculated_at_utc) AS latest_calculated_at_utc
FROM __CORRELATION_RESULTS__
WHERE is_deleted = false
GROUP BY correlation_type, subject_code, outcome_code;
'@

$viewsText = $viewsTemplate
$viewsText = $viewsText.Replace('__DROPS__', (($viewDropLines.ToArray()) -join "`n"))
$viewsText = $viewsText.Replace('__QUALITY_EVENTS__',     ($viewSchema['quality_events']      + '.quality_events'))
$viewsText = $viewsText.Replace('__MATERIAL_UNITS__',     ($viewSchema['material_units']      + '.material_units'))
$viewsText = $viewsText.Replace('__RISK_SCORES__',        ($viewSchema['risk_scores']         + '.risk_scores'))
$viewsText = $viewsText.Replace('__DATA_QUALITY_ISSUES__',($viewSchema['data_quality_issues'] + '.data_quality_issues'))
$viewsText = $viewsText.Replace('__CORRELATION_RESULTS__',($viewSchema['correlation_results'] + '.correlation_results'))

Set-PostImage -Rel $viewsRelGit -Facts $viewsFacts -Text $viewsText -Reason 'read-model views moved to the plant schema'
Write-Ok 'read-model view authority regenerated'

# ---- 2i. topology architecture gate ----------------------------------------


$testText = @'
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using PlantProcess.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using PlantProcess.Infrastructure.Persistence.Topology;
using Xunit;

namespace PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests;

// Storage topology truth gate.
//
// Product storage is governed by three schemas. This holds the line in both
// halves at once: the relational model must place every mapped entity in a
// governed schema, and the physical convergence must be the only thing that
// moves a table, exactly once, without creating anything.
//
// SQL is read with literals and comments stripped first, so a file's own prose
// can neither satisfy nor violate a rule it merely describes.
[Trait("Gate", "StorageTopology")]
public sealed class StorageTopologyTests
{
    private const string ConvergenceRelativePath =
        "Backend/database/topology/000_storage_topology_convergence.sql";

    private const string ViewAuthorityRelativePath =
        "Backend/database/views/006_dashboard_dataset_views.sql";

    private static readonly string[] Governed = { "ppiq_meta", "ppiq_plant", "ppiq_staging" };

    [Fact]
    public void Every_mapped_entity_lives_in_a_governed_schema()
    {
        using var context = BuildContext();

        var stranded = new List<string>();

        foreach (var entityType in context.Model.GetEntityTypes())
        {
            var table = entityType.GetTableName();

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(table))
            {
                continue;
            }

            var schema = entityType.GetSchema();

            if (schema is null || !Governed.Contains(schema))
            {
                stranded.Add(entityType.ClrType.Name + " -> " + (schema ?? "public") + "." + table);
            }
        }

        Assert.True(
            stranded.Count == 0,
            "An entity is mapped outside the governed topology. Either the frozen assignment does not name its " +
            "table, or the entity has no explicit table name for the assignment to match:" +
            Environment.NewLine + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, stranded.Take(25)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_topology_map_places_tables_only_in_governed_schemas()
    {
        Assert.True(StorageTopologyMap.Count > 0, "The topology map is empty, so it governs nothing.");

        foreach (var placement in StorageTopologyMap.Placements_)
        {
            Assert.Contains(placement.Value, Governed);
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Convergence_relocates_and_never_creates()
    {
        var code = Strip(ReadRepositoryFile(ConvergenceRelativePath));

        Assert.Matches(new Regex(@"ALTER\s+TABLE.*SET\s+SCHEMA", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Singleline), code);

        Assert.DoesNotMatch(new Regex(@"\bCREATE\s+TABLE\b", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase), code);
        Assert.DoesNotMatch(new Regex(@"\bINSERT\s+INTO\b", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase), code);
        Assert.DoesNotMatch(new Regex(@"\bSELECT\s+INTO\b", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase), code);
        Assert.DoesNotMatch(new Regex(@"\bDROP\s+TABLE\b", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase), code);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Convergence_is_existence_driven()
    {
        var code = Strip(ReadRepositoryFile(ConvergenceRelativePath));

        Assert.Contains("to_regclass", code, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_read_model_views_leave_no_public_compatibility_alias()
    {
        var code = Strip(ReadRepositoryFile(ViewAuthorityRelativePath));

        Assert.DoesNotMatch(
            new Regex(@"CREATE\s+(OR\s+REPLACE\s+)?VIEW\s+public\.", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase),
            code);

        Assert.Matches(
            new Regex(@"CREATE\s+OR\s+REPLACE\s+VIEW\s+ppiq_plant\.", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase),
            code);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_canvas_staging_fallback_is_the_governed_staging_schema()
    {
        var code = ReadRepositoryFile("Backend/PlantProcess.Api/Endpoints/Prep/VisualMapperEndpoints.cs");

        Assert.DoesNotContain("\"dump_store\"", code, StringComparison.Ordinal);
        Assert.Contains("\"ppiq_staging\"", code, StringComparison.Ordinal);
    }

    private static PlantProcessDbContext BuildContext()
    {
        var options = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<PlantProcessDbContext>()
            .UseNpgsql("Host=localhost;Port=5432;Database=model_only;Username=model_only;Password=model_only")
            .UseSnakeCaseNamingConvention()
            .Options;

        return new PlantProcessDbContext(options);
    }

    private static string ReadRepositoryFile(string relative)
    {
        var full = Path.Combine(FindRepositoryRoot(), relative.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));

        Assert.True(File.Exists(full), "A governed artefact no longer exists: " + relative);

        return File.ReadAllText(full);
    }

    private static string Strip(string sql)
    {
        var withoutLiterals = Regex.Replace(sql, @"'(?:[^']|'')*'", "''");
        var withoutBlocks = Regex.Replace(withoutLiterals, @"/\*[\s\S]*?\*/", " ");
        return Regex.Replace(withoutBlocks, @"--[^\r\n]*", " ");
    }

    private static string FindRepositoryRoot()
    {
        var directory = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);

        while (directory is not null)
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, ".git")) ||
                Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, "Backend")))
            {
                return directory.FullName;
            }

            directory = directory.Parent;
        }

        throw new InvalidOperationException("Repository root not found from " + AppContext.BaseDirectory);
    }
}
'@
Set-PostImage -Rel $testRel -Facts @{ Bom = $false; Eol = 'CRLF' } -Text ($testText + "`r`n") -Reason 'generated topology architecture gate'

if ($anchorFailures.Count -gt 0) {

}
Write-Ok 'every anchor verified against the current repository'

$planLines = @()

Save-Text -Path (Join-Path $script:Ev 'planned_files.txt') -Text ((($planLines) -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
Write-Ok ("{0} file(s) in the post-image set" -f $script:postImages.Count)
