if ($Mode -eq 'Verify') {
    Write-Head 'VERIFY - PLAN'

    # Every post-image is written to evidence, never to the repository, so the exact
    # bytes Apply would write can be read and judged before anything is applied.
    $previewRoot = Join-Path $script:Ev 'postimages'
    foreach ($rel in $script:postImages.Keys) {
        $img = $script:postImages[$rel]
        $pBom = $false; $pEol = 'CRLF'
        if ($img.Facts -and $img.Facts.ContainsKey('Bom')) { $pBom = [bool]$img.Facts.Bom }
        if ($img.Facts -and $img.Facts.ContainsKey('Eol')) { $pEol = [string]$img.Facts.Eol }
        Write-FileExact -Path (Join-Path $previewRoot ($rel -replace '/', '__')) -Text $img.Text -Bom $pBom -Eol $pEol
    }
    Write-Ok ("{0} post-image(s) written to {1} for review" -f $script:postImages.Count, $previewRoot)

    $report = @()
    $report += 'THREE SCHEMA TOPOLOGY CONVERGENCE - VERIFY'
    $report += ''
    $report += ("  HEAD                          : {0}" -f $headSha)
    $report += ("  git index                     : empty")
    $report += ("  assignment rows               : {0}" -f $assignRows.Count)
    $report += ("  tables changing schema        : {0}" -f $moves.Count)
    $report += ("  ppiq_meta arrivals            : {0}" -f $spread['ppiq_meta'])
    $report += ("  ppiq_plant arrivals           : {0}" -f $spread['ppiq_plant'])
    $report += ("  ppiq_staging arrivals         : {0}" -f $spread['ppiq_staging'])
    $report += ("  ledger rows                   : {0}  (expected {1})" -f $ledger.Count, $ExpectedLedgerRows)
    $report += ("  qualify rows                  : {0}  (expected {1})" -f $qualify.Count, $ExpectedQualifyRows)
    $report += ("  excluded historical EF rows   : {0}" -f $exHistoricalEf.Count)
    $report += ("  excluded historical SQL rows  : {0}" -f $exHistoricalSql.Count)
    $report += ("  current-source edits planned  : {0} across {1} file(s)" -f $ledgerApplied, $editFiles.Count)
    $report += ("  declared-view references      : {0}" -f $viewRefEdits)
    $report += ("  canvas fallback rewrites      : {0}" -f $canvasHits)
    $report += ("  staging literal rewrites      : {0}" -f $twoStageHits)
    $report += ("  historical artefacts mutated  : 0")
    $report += ("  anchors verified              : all")
    $report += ("  post-image files              : {0}" -f $script:postImages.Count)
    $report += ''
    $report += '  FILES THAT APPLY WOULD WRITE'
    foreach ($rel in $script:postImages.Keys) {
        $report += ("    {0,-90} {1}" -f $rel, $script:postImages[$rel].Reason)
    }
    $report += ''
    $report += '  Nothing was written. Nothing was staged. No database was contacted.'

    Save-Text -Path (Join-Path $script:Ev 'VERIFY.txt') -Text ((($report) -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
    Write-Host ''
    foreach ($r in $report) { Write-Host "  $r" -ForegroundColor White }
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Ok "evidence: $script:Ev"
    exit 0
}

# =============================================================================
# APPLY
# =============================================================================

if ($Mode -eq 'Apply') {

  try {

    Write-Head 'PHASE 4 - BACKUP OUTSIDE THE REPOSITORY'

    $script:Backup = Join-Path $script:Ev 'backup'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $script:Backup -Force | Out-Null

    $backedUp = 0
    foreach ($rel in $script:postImages.Keys) {
        $abs = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull ($rel -replace '/', '\')
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $abs)) { continue }
        $dest = Join-Path $script:Backup ($rel -replace '/', '\')
        $destDir = Split-Path -Parent $dest
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $destDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destDir -Force | Out-Null }
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $abs -Destination $dest -Force
        $backedUp++
    }
    Write-Ok "$backedUp existing file(s) copied to $script:Backup"

    Write-Head 'PHASE 5 - WRITE POST-IMAGES'

    $script:Mutated = $true
    foreach ($rel in $script:postImages.Keys) {
        $img = $script:postImages[$rel]
        $abs = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull ($rel -replace '/', '\')
        $bom = $false
        $eol = 'CRLF'
        if ($img.Facts -and $img.Facts.ContainsKey('Bom')) { $bom = [bool]$img.Facts.Bom }
        if ($img.Facts -and $img.Facts.ContainsKey('Eol')) { $eol = [string]$img.Facts.Eol }
        Write-FileExact -Path $abs -Text $img.Text -Bom $bom -Eol $eol
        [void]$script:Written.Add($rel)
    }
    Write-Ok ("{0} file(s) written; BOM state and line endings preserved per file" -f $script:Written.Count)

    Write-Head 'PHASE 6 - EF TOPOLOGY CHECKPOINT'

    $pgLocal = Read-PgProfile -RelativePath $ProfileFile
    if ($null -eq $pgLocal) { Invoke-Rollback "connection profile absent: $ProfileFile"; exit 3 }
    if (-not $pgLocal.Database) { $pgLocal.Database = $ApplicationDatabase }
    $env:ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb = ("Host={0};Port={1};Database={2};Username={3};Password={4}" -f $pgLocal.PgHost, $pgLocal.Port, $pgLocal.Database, $pgLocal.User, $pgLocal.Password)

    $efDir = New-TempDir -Prefix 'ppiq-ef-'
    $installLog = Join-Path $script:Ev 'ef_tool_install.log'
    & dotnet tool install --tool-path $efDir dotnet-ef --version 9.0.4 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $installLog | Out-Null
    $efExe = Join-Path $efDir 'dotnet-ef.exe'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $efExe)) {
        Show-LogTail -Path $installLog -Count 15
        Invoke-Rollback 'the pinned EF tool (9.0.4) could not be installed privately; the global tool is a different version and is not used.'
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok 'dotnet-ef 9.0.4 installed privately'

    $migrationsDir = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull 'Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure\Migrations'
    $before = @()
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $migrationsDir) {
        $before = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $migrationsDir -File | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name)
    }

    $addLog = Join-Path $script:Ev 'ef_migrations_add.log'
    & $efExe migrations add StorageTopologyCheckpoint `
        --project 'Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure' `
        --startup-project 'Backend\PlantProcess.Api' 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $addLog | Out-Null
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Show-LogTail -Path $addLog -Count 30
        Invoke-Rollback 'dotnet ef migrations add failed.'
        exit 3
    }

    $after = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $migrationsDir -File | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name)
    $newFiles = @($after | Where-Object { $before -notcontains $_ })
    foreach ($n in $newFiles) { [void]$script:Written.Add('Backend/PlantProcess.Infrastructure/Migrations/' + $n) }
    if (-not ($script:Written -contains 'Backend/PlantProcess.Infrastructure/Migrations/PlantProcessDbContextModelSnapshot.cs')) {
        [void]$script:Written.Add('Backend/PlantProcess.Infrastructure/Migrations/PlantProcessDbContextModelSnapshot.cs')
    }

    $migrationFile = @($newFiles | Where-Object { $_ -match '_StorageTopologyCheckpoint\.cs$' -and $_ -notmatch '\.Designer\.cs$' })
    if ($migrationFile.Count -ne 1) {
        Invoke-Rollback ("expected exactly one new migration file, found {0}." -f $migrationFile.Count)
        exit 3
    }
    $migrationName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($migrationFile[0])
    $migrationPath = Join-Path $migrationsDir $migrationFile[0]
    Write-Ok "migration generated: $migrationName"

    # The generated Up() would physically relocate every table. That is exactly what
    # the ruling reserves for the terminal convergence SQL, so the operations are
    # written to evidence and removed, leaving a checkpoint that ensures the schemas
    # exist and carries the model snapshot forward.
    $mFacts = Read-FileFacts -Path $migrationPath
    $mText = $mFacts.Text
    $upIndex = $mText.IndexOf('protected override void Up(MigrationBuilder migrationBuilder)')
    if ($upIndex -lt 0) { Invoke-Rollback 'the generated migration has no Up method to replace.'; exit 3 }

    Save-Text -Path (Join-Path $script:Ev 'ef_generated_operations_removed.cs') -Text $mText.Substring($upIndex)

    $docIndex = $mText.LastIndexOf('/// <inheritdoc />', $upIndex)
    $cut = $upIndex
    if ($docIndex -ge 0 -and ($upIndex - $docIndex) -lt 120) { $cut = $docIndex }

    $fileScoped = ($mText -match '(?m)^namespace\s+[^\s;{]+\s*;')
    if ($fileScoped) { $pad = '    '; $close = '}' + "`r`n" }
    else             { $pad = '        '; $close = '    }' + "`r`n" + '}' + "`r`n" }

    $body = @()
    $body += ($pad + '/// <inheritdoc />')
    $body += ($pad + 'protected override void Up(MigrationBuilder migrationBuilder)')
    $body += ($pad + '{')
    $body += ($pad + '    // Checkpoint only. The three governed schemas are ensured here so that every')
    $body += ($pad + '    // later historical script and the terminal convergence file find them present.')
    $body += ($pad + '    // No table is relocated by a migration: relocation happens once, after every')
    $body += ($pad + '    // historical creator has run, in the terminal convergence SQL.')
    $body += ($pad + '    migrationBuilder.EnsureSchema(name: "ppiq_meta");')
    $body += ($pad + '    migrationBuilder.EnsureSchema(name: "ppiq_plant");')
    $body += ($pad + '    migrationBuilder.EnsureSchema(name: "ppiq_staging");')
    $body += ($pad + '}')
    $body += ''
    $body += ($pad + '/// <inheritdoc />')
    $body += ($pad + 'protected override void Down(MigrationBuilder migrationBuilder)')
    $body += ($pad + '{')
    $body += ($pad + '    // The schemas are left in place: dropping them would take the relocated')
    $body += ($pad + '    // tables with them, and this migration never moved a table.')
    $body += ($pad + '}')

    $mNew = $mText.Substring(0, $cut) + (($body -join "`r`n")) + "`r`n" + $close
    Write-FileExact -Path $migrationPath -Text $mNew -Bom $mFacts.Bom -Eol $mFacts.Eol
    Write-Ok 'migration body reduced to a schema checkpoint; removed operations written to evidence'

    $pendLog = Join-Path $script:Ev 'ef_has_pending_model_changes.log'
    & $efExe migrations has-pending-model-changes `
        --project 'Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure' `
        --startup-project 'Backend\PlantProcess.Api' 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $pendLog | Out-Null
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Show-LogTail -Path $pendLog -Count 20
        Invoke-Rollback 'the model and the snapshot disagree after the checkpoint.'
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok 'model and snapshot agree; no pending model changes'

    Write-Head 'PHASE 7 - MIGRATION AUTHORITY MANIFEST'

    $convAbs  = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull ($convRel  -replace '/', '\')
    $viewsAbs = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull ($viewsRelGit -replace '/', '\')

    $newPath = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
    $pos = 0
    foreach ($step in $manifest.canonicalPath) {
        if ($step.path -like 'Backend/database/views/*') { continue }
        $pos++
        [void]$newPath.Add([ordered]@{
            position     = $pos
            ordinal      = (Get-Prop -Object $step -Name 'ordinal')
            path         = $step.path
            disposition  = $step.disposition
            sha256       = $step.sha256
            createsTables = @(Get-Prop -Object $step -Name 'createsTables')
        })
    }

    $pos++
    [void]$newPath.Add([ordered]@{
        position      = $pos
        ordinal       = 0
        path          = 'Backend/database/topology/000_storage_topology_convergence.sql'
        disposition   = 'Canonical'
        sha256        = (Get-Sha256 -Path $convAbs)
        createsTables = @()
    })
    $convergencePosition = $pos

    $pos++
    [void]$newPath.Add([ordered]@{
        position      = $pos
        ordinal       = (Get-Prop -Object $viewSteps[0] -Name 'ordinal')
        path          = $viewSteps[0].path
        disposition   = $viewSteps[0].disposition
        sha256        = (Get-Sha256 -Path $viewsAbs)
        createsTables = @()
    })
    $viewPosition = $pos

    $newEf = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
    foreach ($m in $manifest.efMigrationBaseline.migrations) {
        [void]$newEf.Add([ordered]@{ name = $m.name; sha256 = $m.sha256 })
    }
    [void]$newEf.Add([ordered]@{ name = $migrationName; sha256 = (Get-Sha256 -Path $migrationPath) })

    $newDeclaredViews = @()
    foreach ($vn in $viewNames) { $newDeclaredViews += ('ppiq_plant.' + $vn) }

    $newRules = @($manifest.rules)
    $topologyRule = 'Product tables live in ppiq_meta, ppiq_plant or ppiq_staging. A single terminal convergence file relocates them after every historical creator has run; no migration and no historical script moves a table.'
    if ($newRules -notcontains $topologyRule) { $newRules += $topologyRule }

    $newSummary = [ordered]@{
        totalFiles           = ([int]$manifest.summary.totalFiles + 1)
        canonicalPath        = $newPath.Count
        distinctTables       = [int]$manifest.summary.distinctTables
        governedDuplicates   = [int]$manifest.summary.governedDuplicates
        ungovernedDuplicates = [int]$manifest.summary.ungovernedDuplicates
        efMigrations         = $newEf.Count
        freshBuild           = 'NOT_EXECUTED'
        canonicalViews       = 1
        declaredViews        = $newDeclaredViews.Count
        declaredViewsMissing = 0
        freshBuildTables     = 0
    }

    $newManifest = [ordered]@{
        artifact            = $manifest.artifact
        purpose             = $manifest.purpose
        generatedAtUtc      = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')
        baselineCommit      = $headSha
        dispositions        = @($manifest.dispositions)
        rules               = $newRules
        summary             = $newSummary
        storageTopology     = [ordered]@{
            note            = 'Physical placement of product tables. The model half is StorageTopologyMap; the physical half is the terminal convergence file. Both are generated from one frozen assignment.'
            governedSchemas = $GovernedSchemas
            relocations     = $moves.Count
            terminalFile    = 'Backend/database/topology/000_storage_topology_convergence.sql'
            position        = $convergencePosition
        }
        efMigrationBaseline = [ordered]@{
            note           = $manifest.efMigrationBaseline.note
            project        = $manifest.efMigrationBaseline.project
            startupProject = $manifest.efMigrationBaseline.startupProject
            migrations     = $newEf.ToArray()
        }
        canonicalViews      = @(, [ordered]@{
            path   = $viewSteps[0].path
            order  = $viewPosition
            sha256 = (Get-Sha256 -Path $viewsAbs)
            note   = 'Read-model view authority. Applied after every schema script and after topology convergence, before the probe database is dropped.'
        })
        declaredViews       = $newDeclaredViews
        canonicalPath       = $newPath.ToArray()
    }

    foreach ($extra in @('offPath', 'adjudications', 'notes')) {
        if ($manifest.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $extra) {
            $newManifest[$extra] = $manifest.$extra
        }
    }

    $manifestJson = ($newManifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 25)
    Write-FileExact -Path $manifestPath -Text $manifestJson -Bom $manifestFacts.Bom -Eol $manifestFacts.Eol
    [void]$script:Written.Add(($manifestRel -replace '\\', '/'))
    Write-Ok ("manifest updated: {0} step(s), convergence at {1}, views at {2}" -f $newPath.Count, $convergencePosition, $viewPosition)
    Write-Warn 'summary.freshBuild is NOT_EXECUTED by design. Certify runs the build and replaces it with the measured result.'

    Write-Head 'PHASE 8 - BUILD'

    $buildLog = Join-Path $script:Ev 'build.log'
    & dotnet build (Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull 'Backend\PlantProcessIQ.sln') -c Debug --nologo 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $buildLog | Out-Null
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Show-LogTail -Path $buildLog -Count 40
        Invoke-Rollback 'the backend does not build after convergence.'
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok 'backend builds'

    Write-Head 'PHASE 9 - TOPOLOGY GATE'

    $testProj = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests.csproj'
    $trx = Join-Path $script:Ev 'topology_gate.trx'
    $testLog = Join-Path $script:Ev 'topology_gate.log'
    & dotnet test $testProj --filter 'Gate=StorageTopology' --nologo `
        --logger ("trx;LogFileName=" + $trx) 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $testLog | Out-Null
    $testCode = $LASTEXITCODE

    $passed = 0; $failed = 0
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $trx) {
        try {
            [xml]$trxXml = Get-Content -LiteralPath $trx -Raw
            $counters = $trxXml.TestRun.ResultSummary.Counters
            $passed = [int]$counters.passed
            $failed = [int]$counters.failed
        } catch { }
    }
    if ($passed -eq 0 -and $failed -eq 0) {
        $raw = Get-Content -LiteralPath $testLog -Raw
        if ($raw -match 'Passed:\s*(\d+)') { $passed = [int]$Matches[1] }
        if ($raw -match 'Failed:\s*(\d+)') { $failed = [int]$Matches[1] }
    }

    Write-Inf ("topology gate: passed {0}, failed {1}, exit {2}" -f $passed, $failed, $testCode)
    if ($failed -gt 0 -or $passed -eq 0) {
        Show-LogTail -Path $testLog -Count 40
        Invoke-Rollback 'the topology gate did not produce a green run with executed assertions.'
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Ok "topology gate green with $passed executed assertion(s)"

    Write-Head 'PHASE 10 - FOREIGN FILE DELTA GUARD'

    $status = Invoke-Git @('status', '--porcelain')
    $dirty = @($status.Text -split "`r`n" | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
    $owned = @($script:Written | Sort-Object -Unique)

    $foreign = @()
    foreach ($line in $dirty) {
        if ($line.Length -lt 4) { continue }
        $p = $line.Substring(3).Trim().Trim('"')
        if ($p -match '^(.+) -> (.+)$') { $p = $Matches[2] }
        if ($owned -notcontains $p) { $foreign += $p }
    }

    Save-Text -Path (Join-Path $script:Ev 'git_status_after_apply.txt') -Text ((($dirty) -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
    Save-Text -Path (Join-Path $script:Ev 'owned-files.txt') -Text ((($owned) -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
    Save-Text -Path $OwnedFilesPath -Text ((($owned) -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $CertifyStampPath) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $CertifyStampPath -Force }

    if ($foreign.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Warn "$($foreign.Count) dirty path(s) this pack does not own. They will not be staged and are not this pack's to touch:"
        foreach ($f in ($foreign | Select-Object -First 20)) { Write-Host "         $f" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
    }
    else { Write-Ok 'no foreign dirty path' }

    Write-Head 'APPLY COMPLETE'

    $ar = @()
    $ar += 'THREE SCHEMA TOPOLOGY CONVERGENCE - APPLIED'
    $ar += ("  files written          : {0}" -f $owned.Count)
    $ar += ("  relocations declared   : {0}" -f $moves.Count)
    $ar += ("  source edits applied   : {0}" -f $ledgerApplied)
    $ar += ("  view refs re-pointed   : {0}" -f $viewRefEdits)
    $ar += ("  EF checkpoint          : {0}" -f $migrationName)
    $ar += ("  convergence position   : {0}" -f $convergencePosition)
    $ar += ("  view authority position: {0}" -f $viewPosition)
    $ar += ("  build                  : PASS")
    $ar += ("  topology gate          : PASS ({0} assertions)" -f $passed)
    $ar += ("  fresh build            : NOT EXECUTED - Certify does this")
    $ar += ("  staged                 : nothing; no git add was run")
    $ar += ("  backup                 : {0}" -f $script:Backup)
    $ar += ("  owned files            : {0}" -f (Join-Path $script:Ev 'owned-files.txt'))
    Save-Text -Path (Join-Path $script:Ev 'APPLY.txt') -Text ((($ar) -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
    Write-Host ''
    foreach ($r in $ar) { Write-Host "  $r" -ForegroundColor White }
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Warn 'Not certified yet. Run -Mode Certify next.'
    exit 0
  }
  catch {
    Invoke-Rollback ('unexpected failure during apply: ' + $_.Exception.Message)
    Write-Bad 'The working tree was returned to its pre-apply state.'
    exit 3
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# CERTIFY
# =============================================================================

if ($Mode -eq 'Certify') {

  try {

    Write-Head 'PHASE 4 - CERTIFY PRECONDITIONS'

    $convAbs  = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull ($convRel -replace '/', '\')
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $convAbs)) { Stop-Refuse 'the terminal convergence file is absent. Run -Mode Apply first.' }
    if (-not ($manifest.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'storageTopology')) {
        Stop-Refuse 'the manifest carries no storageTopology block. Run -Mode Apply first.'
    }
    Write-Ok 'apply output present'

    $pgLocal = Read-PgProfile -RelativePath $ProfileFile
    Assert-LocalProfile -Pg $pgLocal -Label $ProfileFile
    if (-not $pgLocal.Database) { $pgLocal.Database = $ApplicationDatabase }
    if ($pgLocal.Database -ne $ApplicationDatabase) {
        Stop-Refuse "the local profile resolves to '$($pgLocal.Database)', not the canonical application database '$ApplicationDatabase'."
    }
    Write-Ok ("{0}@{1}:{2}  application database {3}" -f $pgLocal.User, $pgLocal.PgHost, $pgLocal.Port, $ApplicationDatabase)

    # ---- stop the API so a template clone is possible ----------------------
    try {
        $listeners = @(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $ApiPort -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
        foreach ($l in $listeners) {
            $proc = Get-Process -Id $l.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            if ($null -eq $proc) { continue }
            Write-Warn ("stopping pid {0} ({1}) listening on {2}" -f $proc.Id, $proc.ProcessName, $ApiPort)
            Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
        }
        if ($listeners.Count -eq 0) { Write-Ok "nothing listening on $ApiPort" }
        else { Write-Ok "port $ApiPort released" }
    }
    catch { Write-Warn "could not inspect port ${ApiPort}: $($_.Exception.Message)" }

    Write-Head 'PHASE 5 - BUILD'
    $buildLog = Join-Path $script:Ev 'build.log'
    & dotnet build (Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull 'Backend\PlantProcessIQ.sln') -c Debug --nologo 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $buildLog | Out-Null
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Show-LogTail -Path $buildLog -Count 40
        Stop-Refuse 'the backend does not build; nothing downstream of a broken build is worth measuring.'
    }
    Write-Ok 'backend builds'

    $efDir = New-TempDir -Prefix 'ppiq-ef-'
    & dotnet tool install --tool-path $efDir dotnet-ef --version 9.0.4 2>&1 | Out-Null
    $efExe = Join-Path $efDir 'dotnet-ef.exe'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $efExe)) { Stop-Refuse 'the pinned EF tool (9.0.4) could not be installed privately.' }
    Write-Ok 'dotnet-ef 9.0.4 installed privately'

    function Set-EfConnection {
        param([string]$Database)
        $env:ConnectionStrings__PlantProcessDb =
            ("Host={0};Port={1};Database={2};Username={3};Password={4}" -f $pgLocal.PgHost, $pgLocal.Port, $Database, $pgLocal.User, $pgLocal.Password)
    }

    function Invoke-EfUpdate {
        param([string]$Database, [string]$LogName)
        Set-EfConnection -Database $Database
        $log = Join-Path $script:Ev ($LogName + '.log')
        & $efExe database update --project 'Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure' --startup-project 'Backend\PlantProcess.Api' 2>&1 |
            Tee-Object -FilePath $log | Out-Null
        return $LASTEXITCODE
    }

    function New-Database {
        param([string]$Name, [string]$Template)
        $sql = "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $Name;"
        if ($Template) { $sql += "`r`nCREATE DATABASE $Name TEMPLATE $Template;" }
        else           { $sql += "`r`nCREATE DATABASE $Name;" }
        $r = Invoke-PsqlText -Pg $pgLocal -Database 'postgres' -Sql $sql -Name ('create_' + $Name)
        return $r.Code
    }

    function Remove-Database {
        param([string]$Name)
        Invoke-PsqlText -Pg $pgLocal -Database 'postgres' -Sql "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $Name;" -Name ('drop_' + $Name) | Out-Null
    }

    $countSql = @'
SELECT t.table_schema || '|' || t.table_name || '|' ||
       (xpath('/row/c/text()',
              query_to_xml(format('SELECT count(*) AS c FROM %I.%I', t.table_schema, t.table_name),
                           false, true, '')))[1]::text
FROM information_schema.tables t
WHERE t.table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
  AND t.table_schema IN ('public', 'ppiq_meta', 'ppiq_plant', 'ppiq_staging', 'dump_store')
ORDER BY 2, 1;
'@

    function Get-TableCounts {
        param([string]$Database, [string]$Name)
        $r = Invoke-PsqlText -Pg $pgLocal -Database $Database -Sql $countSql -Name $Name -Tuples
        if ($r.Code -ne 0) { return $null }
        $map = @{}
        foreach ($line in $r.Lines) {
            if ($line -notmatch '^([a-z0-9_]+)\|([a-z0-9_]+)\|(-?\d+)$') { continue }
            $map[$Matches[2]] = @{ Schema = $Matches[1]; Rows = [int64]$Matches[3] }
        }
        return $map
    }

    $certFailures = @()
    function Assert-Cert {
        param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Claim, [string]$Detail)
        if ($Condition) { Write-Ok $Claim }
        else { Write-Bad ($Claim + ' -- ' + $Detail); $script:certFailures += ($Claim + ' :: ' + $Detail) }
    }

    # =========================================================== FRESH DB ====
    Write-Head 'PHASE 6 - FRESH DATABASE FROM ZERO'

    if ((New-Database -Name $FreshDatabase -Template '') -ne 0) { Stop-Refuse "could not create the throwaway database $FreshDatabase." }
    Write-Ok "created $FreshDatabase"

    $freshTables = 0
    $freshPlantRows = -1
    try {
        if ((Invoke-EfUpdate -Database $FreshDatabase -LogName 'fresh_ef_update') -ne 0) {
            Stop-Refuse 'the EF migration set does not apply to an empty database.'
        }
        Write-Ok 'EF migration set applied'

        $failedAt = ''
        foreach ($step in $newPathForReplay) {
            $sqlFile = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull ($step -replace '/', '\')
            $r = Invoke-PsqlFile -Pg $pgLocal -Database $FreshDatabase -SqlPath $sqlFile -LogPath (Join-Path $script:Ev 'fresh_build.log')
            if ($r.Code -ne 0) { $failedAt = $step; break }
        }
        if ($failedAt) {
            Write-Bad "the canonical path failed at: $failedAt"
            Stop-Refuse 'a fresh database must build from the canonical path with no manual step.'
        }
        Write-Ok ("canonical path replayed: {0} file(s)" -f $newPathForReplay.Count)

        foreach ($s in $GovernedSchemas) {
            $exists = Get-Scalar -Pg $pgLocal -Database $FreshDatabase -Name ('fresh_schema_' + $s) `
                -Sql "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name = '$s';"
            Assert-Cert (($exists -eq '1')) "$s exists on a fresh build" "count was '$exists'"
        }

        $freshCounts = Get-TableCounts -Database $FreshDatabase -Name 'fresh_counts'
        if ($null -eq $freshCounts) { Stop-Refuse 'could not enumerate tables on the fresh database.' }
        $freshTables = $freshCounts.Keys.Count

        $strandedFresh = @()
        foreach ($k in $moves.Keys) {
            $tbl = $k.Substring($k.IndexOf('.') + 1)
            if ($freshCounts.ContainsKey($tbl) -and $freshCounts[$tbl].Schema -eq 'public') { $strandedFresh += $tbl }
        }
        Assert-Cert (($strandedFresh.Count -eq 0)) 'no product table remains in public on a fresh build' ("{0} stranded, first: {1}" -f $strandedFresh.Count, ($strandedFresh | Select-Object -First 5) -join ', ')

        $freshPlantRows = [int64](Get-Scalar -Pg $pgLocal -Database $FreshDatabase -Name 'fresh_plant_rows' -Sql @'
SELECT COALESCE(sum((xpath('/row/c/text()',
       query_to_xml(format('SELECT count(*) AS c FROM %I.%I', table_schema, table_name), false, true, '')))[1]::text::bigint), 0)
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema = 'ppiq_plant' AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE';
'@)
        Assert-Cert (($freshPlantRows -eq 0)) 'a fresh ppiq_plant carries no business row' "row total was $freshPlantRows"

        $missingViews = 0
        foreach ($vn in $viewNames) {
            $v = Get-Scalar -Pg $pgLocal -Database $FreshDatabase -Name ('fresh_view_' + $vn) `
                -Sql "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_schema = 'ppiq_plant' AND table_name = '$vn';"
            if ($v -ne '1') { $missingViews++ }
        }
        Assert-Cert (($missingViews -eq 0)) 'every declared read-model view exists in ppiq_plant' "$missingViews missing"
        $script:MeasuredDeclaredViewsMissing = $missingViews
        $script:MeasuredFreshTables = $freshTables
        Write-Inf "fresh build produced $freshTables table(s)"
    }
    finally {
        Remove-Database -Name $FreshDatabase
        Write-Inf "$FreshDatabase dropped"
    }

    # ======================================================== UPGRADE CLONE ==
    Write-Head 'PHASE 7 - UPGRADE CLONE OF THE APPLICATION DATABASE'

    $beforeCounts = Get-TableCounts -Database $ApplicationDatabase -Name 'app_counts_before'
    if ($null -eq $beforeCounts) { Stop-Refuse "could not read table counts from $ApplicationDatabase." }
    Write-Ok ("{0} table(s) measured in {1} before the upgrade" -f $beforeCounts.Keys.Count, $ApplicationDatabase)

    $fkBefore = Get-Scalar -Pg $pgLocal -Database $ApplicationDatabase -Name 'fk_before' -Sql "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE contype = 'f';"

    if ((New-Database -Name $UpgradeDatabase -Template $ApplicationDatabase) -ne 0) {
        Stop-Refuse ("could not clone $ApplicationDatabase. A template clone needs no other session connected to it; " +
                     "close pgAdmin, psql sessions and the API, then rerun Certify.")
    }
    Write-Ok "cloned $ApplicationDatabase into $UpgradeDatabase"

    try {
        if ((Invoke-EfUpdate -Database $UpgradeDatabase -LogName 'upgrade_ef_update') -ne 0) {
            Stop-Refuse 'the topology checkpoint does not apply to an existing database.'
        }
        Write-Ok 'topology checkpoint applied to the clone'

        foreach ($rel in @($convRel, $viewsRelGit)) {
            $sqlFile = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull ($rel -replace '/', '\')
            $r = Invoke-PsqlFile -Pg $pgLocal -Database $UpgradeDatabase -SqlPath $sqlFile -LogPath (Join-Path $script:Ev 'upgrade_apply.log')
            if ($r.Code -ne 0) {
                $r.Lines | Select-Object -Last 15 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
                Stop-Refuse "the upgrade failed applying $rel"
            }
        }
        Write-Ok 'convergence and view authority applied to the clone'

        $afterCounts = Get-TableCounts -Database $UpgradeDatabase -Name 'upgrade_counts_after'
        if ($null -eq $afterCounts) { Stop-Refuse 'could not read table counts from the upgrade clone.' }

        $rowDrift = @()
        $missingAfter = @()
        foreach ($tbl in $beforeCounts.Keys) {
            if (-not $afterCounts.ContainsKey($tbl)) { $missingAfter += $tbl; continue }
            if ($afterCounts[$tbl].Rows -ne $beforeCounts[$tbl].Rows) {
                $rowDrift += ("{0}: {1} -> {2}" -f $tbl, $beforeCounts[$tbl].Rows, $afterCounts[$tbl].Rows)
            }
        }
        Assert-Cert (($missingAfter.Count -eq 0)) 'every table present before the upgrade is present after it' ("{0} missing: {1}" -f $missingAfter.Count, (($missingAfter | Select-Object -First 5) -join ', '))
        Assert-Cert (($rowDrift.Count -eq 0)) 'no row count changed across the upgrade' ("{0} table(s) drifted: {1}" -f $rowDrift.Count, (($rowDrift | Select-Object -First 5) -join '; '))

        $relocated = 0
        $stillPublic = @()
        foreach ($k in $moves.Keys) {
            $tbl = $k.Substring($k.IndexOf('.') + 1)
            $tgt = $moves[$k].Split('.')[0]
            if (-not $afterCounts.ContainsKey($tbl)) { continue }
            if ($afterCounts[$tbl].Schema -eq $tgt) { $relocated++ }
            elseif ($afterCounts[$tbl].Schema -eq 'public' -or $afterCounts[$tbl].Schema -eq 'dump_store') { $stillPublic += ("{0} still in {1}" -f $tbl, $afterCounts[$tbl].Schema) }
        }
        Assert-Cert (($stillPublic.Count -eq 0)) 'no product table remains at its old location after the upgrade' ("{0}: {1}" -f $stillPublic.Count, (($stillPublic | Select-Object -First 5) -join ', '))
        Write-Inf "$relocated table(s) observed at their governed location"

        $fkAfter = Get-Scalar -Pg $pgLocal -Database $UpgradeDatabase -Name 'fk_after' -Sql "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE contype = 'f';"
        $fkInvalid = Get-Scalar -Pg $pgLocal -Database $UpgradeDatabase -Name 'fk_invalid' -Sql "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE contype = 'f' AND NOT convalidated;"
        Assert-Cert (($fkAfter -eq $fkBefore)) 'the foreign key count is unchanged' "before $fkBefore, after $fkAfter"
        Assert-Cert (($fkInvalid -eq '0')) 'every foreign key is still validated' "$fkInvalid unvalidated"

        $stagingTables = Get-Scalar -Pg $pgLocal -Database $UpgradeDatabase -Name 'staging_tables' `
            -Sql "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'ppiq_staging' AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE';"
        Assert-Cert (([int]$stagingTables -gt 0)) 'the staging layer exists in ppiq_staging after the upgrade' "table count was $stagingTables"

        $publicViewLeft = Get-Scalar -Pg $pgLocal -Database $UpgradeDatabase -Name 'public_views_left' `
            -Sql ("SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('" + (($viewNames) -join "','") + "');")
        Assert-Cert (($publicViewLeft -eq '0')) 'no public compatibility view survives the upgrade' "$publicViewLeft left behind"
    }
    finally {
        Remove-Database -Name $UpgradeDatabase
        Write-Inf "$UpgradeDatabase dropped"
    }

    # ============================================================== CANVAS ===
    Write-Head 'PHASE 8 - CANVAS'

    $canvasSource = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull ($canvasRel -replace '/', '\')))
    Assert-Cert ($canvasSource.Contains('"ppiq_staging"')) 'the canvas staging fallback is ppiq_staging' 'literal not found'
    Assert-Cert (-not $canvasSource.Contains('"dump_store"')) 'the canvas no longer names dump_store' 'the retired literal is still present'
    Assert-Cert ($canvasSource.Contains('cfg["Prep:StagingSchema"]')) 'the canvas remains configuration-driven' 'the configuration key is gone'

    # ============================================================== ORACLE ===
    Write-Head 'PHASE 9 - FROZEN MIGRATED-CLONE ORACLE'

    $oracleVerdictSummary = @()

    if ($SkipOracle) {
        Write-Warn '-SkipOracle was passed. The oracle is the only proof that relocation preserved historical analytical truth.'
        $certFailures += 'oracle :: skipped by switch; a skipped proof is not a passed proof'
    }
    else {
        $lockPath = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull 'Backend\tools\legacy-regression-oracle.lock.json'
        $harness  = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull 'Backend\tools\phenomenon_harness.py'
        $phenMani = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull 'docs\m1\phenomena\manifest.csv'
        foreach ($f in @($lockPath, $harness, $phenMani)) {
            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { Stop-Refuse "the frozen oracle is incomplete: $f is missing." }
        }

        $lock = Get-Content -LiteralPath $lockPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        $checked = 0
        foreach ($asset in $lock.assets) {
            if (-not $asset.present) { continue }
            $full = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull ($asset.path -replace '/', '\')
            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full)) { Stop-Refuse "pinned oracle asset missing: $($asset.path)" }
            if ((Get-Sha256 -Path $full) -ne $asset.sha256) {
                Stop-Refuse "pinned oracle asset changed: $($asset.path). The oracle is frozen; this pack does not re-lock it."
            }
            $checked++
        }
        Write-Ok "$checked pinned oracle asset(s) byte-identical"

        $selfLog = Join-Path $script:Ev 'oracle_selftest.log'
        & python $harness --selftest 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $selfLog | Out-Null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Show-LogTail -Path $selfLog -Count 20
            Stop-Refuse 'the verdict engine failed its own fixtures. A judge that cannot fail proves nothing.'
        }
        Write-Ok 'verdict engine self-test passed (the judge can fail)'

        $pgOracle = Read-PgProfile -RelativePath $PresentationProfile
        if ($null -eq $pgOracle -or -not $pgOracle.User) { $pgOracle = $pgLocal }
        Assert-LocalProfile -Pg $pgOracle -Label $PresentationProfile

        $phen = @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $phenMani)
        if ($phen.Count -eq 0) { Stop-Refuse 'the phenomena manifest declares nothing.' }
        Write-Ok "$($phen.Count) declared phenomenon/phenomena"

        function New-OracleDatabase {
            $sql = "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $OracleDatabase;`r`nCREATE DATABASE $OracleDatabase TEMPLATE $HistoricalDatabase;"
            return (Invoke-PsqlText -Pg $pgOracle -Database 'postgres' -Sql $sql -Name 'create_oracle_clone').Code
        }

        function Invoke-OracleRun {
            param([string]$Label)
            $dataDir = Join-Path $script:Ev ('oracle_' + $Label + '_data')
            $sqlDir  = Join-Path $script:Ev ('oracle_' + $Label + '_sql')
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dataDir -Force | Out-Null
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $sqlDir  -Force | Out-Null

            foreach ($row in $phen) {
                $pid2 = $row.phenomenon_id
                $q = $row.population_query
                $probe = ($q -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
                if ($probe -notmatch '^(?i)SELECT\s') { Stop-Refuse "$pid2 : the frozen population query is not a SELECT. Refusing." }
                if ($probe -match '(?i)\b(INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|DROP|ALTER|CREATE|TRUNCATE|GRANT|REVOKE)\b') {
                    Stop-Refuse "$pid2 : the frozen population query contains a write verb. Refusing."
                }
                $sqlFile = Join-Path $sqlDir ($pid2 + '.sql')
                Save-Text -Path $sqlFile -Text $q
                $r = Invoke-PsqlFile -Pg $pgOracle -Database $OracleDatabase -SqlPath $sqlFile `
                        -LogPath (Join-Path $sqlDir ($pid2 + '.log')) -Csv
                if ($r.Code -ne 0) {
                    $r.Lines | Select-Object -Last 10 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
                    Stop-Refuse "$pid2 : the frozen oracle could not execute on the $Label clone."
                }
                Save-Text -Path (Join-Path $dataDir ($pid2 + '.csv')) -Text ((($r.Lines) -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
            }

            $jsonOut = Join-Path $script:Ev ('oracle_verdicts_' + $Label + '.json')
            $judgeLog = Join-Path $script:Ev ('oracle_verdicts_' + $Label + '.log')
            & python $harness --manifest $phenMani --datadir $dataDir --json-out $jsonOut 2>&1 |
                Tee-Object -FilePath $judgeLog | Out-Null
            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $jsonOut)) { Stop-Refuse "the verdict engine produced no result file for the $Label run." }
            return (Get-Content -LiteralPath $jsonOut -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
        }

        if ((New-OracleDatabase) -ne 0) {
            Stop-Refuse ("could not clone $HistoricalDatabase. A template clone needs no other session connected to it; " +
                         "close every session on the frozen historical database and rerun Certify.")
        }
        Write-Ok "cloned $HistoricalDatabase into $OracleDatabase"

        try {
            $before = Invoke-OracleRun -Label 'before'
            Write-Ok 'oracle executed on the clone before convergence'

            $r = Invoke-PsqlFile -Pg $pgOracle -Database $OracleDatabase `
                    -SqlPath (Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull ($convRel -replace '/', '\')) `
                    -LogPath (Join-Path $script:Ev 'oracle_convergence.log')
            if ($r.Code -ne 0) {
                $r.Lines | Select-Object -Last 15 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "         $_" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow }
                Stop-Refuse 'convergence failed on the historical clone.'
            }
            Write-Ok 'convergence applied to the historical clone'

            # The frozen oracle names physical public locations that convergence has
            # just emptied. Its text is not edited. Instead this throwaway clone gets
            # read-only shims so the frozen SQL executes byte-identical. Nothing here
            # exists in the product, and the DDL is written to evidence.
            $phenText = Get-Content -LiteralPath $phenMani -Raw
            $shimNames = @()
            foreach ($m in ([regex]'(?i)\bpublic\.([a-z0-9_]+)\b').Matches($phenText)) {
                $t = $m.Groups[1].Value.ToLowerInvariant()
                if ($moves.ContainsKey('public.' + $t)) { $shimNames += $t }
            }
            $shimNames = @($shimNames | Sort-Object -Unique)

            $shimLines = @('-- Disposable read shims. Throwaway clone only. Never a product artefact.')
            foreach ($t in $shimNames) {
                $tgt = $moves['public.' + $t].Split('.')[0]
                $shimLines += ("DO `$s`$ BEGIN IF to_regclass('$tgt.$t') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.$t') IS NULL THEN EXECUTE 'CREATE VIEW public.$t AS SELECT * FROM $tgt.$t'; END IF; END `$s`$;")
            }
            $shimSql = (($shimLines) -join "`r`n") + "`r`n"
            $shimPath = Join-Path $script:Ev 'oracle_public_shims.sql'
            Save-Text -Path $shimPath -Text $shimSql
            $r = Invoke-PsqlFile -Pg $pgOracle -Database $OracleDatabase -SqlPath $shimPath -LogPath (Join-Path $script:Ev 'oracle_shims.log')
            if ($r.Code -ne 0) { Stop-Refuse 'the disposable oracle shims could not be created on the clone.' }
            Write-Ok ("{0} disposable read shim(s) created on the clone" -f $shimNames.Count)

            $after = Invoke-OracleRun -Label 'after'
            Write-Ok 'oracle executed on the clone after convergence'

            $expected = @{
                'PPIQ-COIL-COILING-TEMP-DEFECTS'             = @{ Verdict = 'PASS';         Population = 17010 }
                'PPIQ-DOWNTIME-IMPACT-SCALES-WITH-STOPPAGE'  = @{ Verdict = 'FAIL';         Population = 630   }
                'PPIQ-SENSOR-ARTEFACT-COILING-TEMP'          = @{ Verdict = 'INSUFFICIENT'; Population = 117   }
            }

            $beforeById = @{}
            foreach ($v in $before.results) { $beforeById[$v.phenomenon_id] = $v }

            foreach ($v in $after.results) {
                $id = $v.phenomenon_id
                $line = ("{0,-46} {1,-13} population {2}" -f $id, $v.verdict, $v.population)
                $oracleVerdictSummary += $line

                if (-not $beforeById.ContainsKey($id)) {
                    $certFailures += "oracle :: $id has no pre-convergence run to compare against"
                    Write-Bad $line
                    continue
                }
                $b = $beforeById[$id]

                $same = ($b.verdict -eq $v.verdict) -and ([string]$b.population -eq [string]$v.population)
                foreach ($prop in $v.PSObject.Properties) {
                    if ($prop.Name -notmatch '(?i)effect|conditioned|rho|statistic') { continue }
                    $bp = $b.PSObject.Properties[$prop.Name]
                    if ($null -eq $bp) { continue }
                    if ([string]$bp.Value -ne [string]$prop.Value) { $same = $false }
                }
                if (-not $same) {
                    $certFailures += "oracle :: $id changed across relocation (before $($b.verdict)/$($b.population), after $($v.verdict)/$($v.population))"
                    Write-Bad ($line + '   CHANGED BY RELOCATION')
                    continue
                }

                if (-not $expected.ContainsKey($id)) {
                    Write-Warn ($line + '   not in the frozen expectation set')
                    continue
                }
                $e = $expected[$id]
                if ($v.verdict -ne $e.Verdict -or [int]$v.population -ne [int]$e.Population) {
                    $certFailures += "oracle :: $id expected $($e.Verdict)/$($e.Population), measured $($v.verdict)/$($v.population)"
                    Write-Bad ($line + "   expected $($e.Verdict)/$($e.Population)")
                }
                else { Write-Ok ($line + '   matches the frozen expectation') }
            }

            foreach ($id in $expected.Keys) {
                if (-not (@($after.results | Where-Object { $_.phenomenon_id -eq $id }).Count -gt 0)) {
                    $certFailures += "oracle :: $id was never produced by the run"
                }
            }
        }
        finally {
            Invoke-PsqlText -Pg $pgOracle -Database 'postgres' -Sql "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $OracleDatabase;" -Name 'drop_oracle_clone' | Out-Null
            Write-Inf "$OracleDatabase dropped"
        }
    }

    # ================================================ MEASURED MANIFEST ======
    Write-Head 'PHASE 10 - MANIFEST SUMMARY, MEASURED'

    if ($certFailures.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Warn 'the manifest summary is not updated while a certification claim is unproven.'
    }
    else {
        $mf = Read-FileFacts -Path $manifestPath
        $mj = $mf.Text | ConvertFrom-Json
        $mj.summary.freshBuild           = 'EXECUTED'
        $mj.summary.freshBuildTables     = $script:MeasuredFreshTables
        $mj.summary.declaredViewsMissing = $script:MeasuredDeclaredViewsMissing
        $mj.summary.declaredViews        = $viewNames.Count
        Write-FileExact -Path $manifestPath -Text ($mj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 25) -Bom $mf.Bom -Eol $mf.Eol
        Write-Ok ("summary.freshBuild = EXECUTED, freshBuildTables = {0}, declaredViewsMissing = {1}" -f $script:MeasuredFreshTables, $script:MeasuredDeclaredViewsMissing)
    }

    # ========================================================== FULL GATES ===
    Write-Head 'PHASE 11 - MIGRATION AUTHORITY AND TOPOLOGY GATES'

    $testProj = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests.csproj'
    foreach ($gate in @('CanonicalMigrationOrder', 'StorageTopology')) {
        $trx = Join-Path $script:Ev ($gate + '.trx')
        $log = Join-Path $script:Ev ($gate + '.log')
        & dotnet test $testProj --filter ("Gate=" + $gate) --nologo --logger ("trx;LogFileName=" + $trx) 2>&1 |
            Tee-Object -FilePath $log | Out-Null

        $passed = 0; $failed = 0
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $trx) {
            try {
                [xml]$x = Get-Content -LiteralPath $trx -Raw
                $passed = [int]$x.TestRun.ResultSummary.Counters.passed
                $failed = [int]$x.TestRun.ResultSummary.Counters.failed
            } catch { }
        }
        if ($passed -eq 0 -and $failed -eq 0) {
            $raw = Get-Content -LiteralPath $log -Raw
            if ($raw -match 'Passed:\s*(\d+)') { $passed = [int]$Matches[1] }
            if ($raw -match 'Failed:\s*(\d+)') { $failed = [int]$Matches[1] }
        }
        Assert-Cert (($failed -eq 0 -and $passed -gt 0)) "gate $gate is green with executed assertions" "passed $passed, failed $failed"
    }

    # ============================================================== VERDICT ==
    Write-Head 'CERTIFICATION'

    $cr = @()
    $cr += 'THREE SCHEMA TOPOLOGY CONVERGENCE'
    $cr += ("  HEAD                       : {0}" -f $headSha)
    $cr += ("  relocations declared       : {0}" -f $moves.Count)
    $cr += ("  fresh build                : EXECUTED, {0} table(s)" -f $script:MeasuredFreshTables)
    $cr += ("  fresh ppiq_plant rows      : {0}" -f $freshPlantRows)
    $cr += ("  upgrade clone              : row counts unchanged, foreign keys validated")
    $cr += ("  old locations              : absent")
    $cr += ("  canvas staging schema      : ppiq_staging, configuration-driven")
    if ($SkipOracle) { $cr += '  migrated-clone oracle      : SKIPPED' }
    else {
        $cr += '  migrated-clone oracle      :'
        foreach ($l in $oracleVerdictSummary) { $cr += ('      ' + $l) }
        $cr += '      compared against the same clone before relocation; no rebaseline'
    }
    $cr += ("  declared additions         : registry realignment, staging literal (W1-STAGING-LITERAL-01)")
    $cr += ("  evidence                   : {0}" -f $script:Ev)

    if ($certFailures.Count -gt 0) {
        $cr += ''
        $cr += '  NOT CERTIFIED'
        foreach ($f in $certFailures) { $cr += ('    ' + $f) }
        Save-Text -Path (Join-Path $script:Ev 'CERTIFY.txt') -Text ((($cr) -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
        Write-Host ''
        foreach ($l in $cr) { Write-Host "  $l" -ForegroundColor White }
        Write-Host ''
        Write-Bad "$($certFailures.Count) certification claim(s) failed. Nothing is staged and no stamp is written."
        exit 3
    }

    $ownedNow = @()
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $OwnedFilesPath) {
        $ownedNow = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $OwnedFilesPath | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
    }
    $stampFiles = @()
    foreach ($rel in $ownedNow) {
        $abs = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull ($rel -replace '/', '\')
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $abs)) { continue }
        $stampFiles += [ordered]@{ path = $rel; sha256 = (Get-Sha256 -Path $abs) }
    }
    $stamp = [ordered]@{
        artifact    = 'storage-topology-convergence-certification'
        certifiedAtUtc = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')
        head        = $headSha
        evidence    = $script:Ev
        freshBuildTables = $script:MeasuredFreshTables
        files       = $stampFiles
    }
    Save-Text -Path $CertifyStampPath -Text ($stamp | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10)

    $cr += ''
    $cr += '  CERTIFIED'
    $cr += ("  stamp                      : {0}" -f $CertifyStampPath)
    Save-Text -Path (Join-Path $script:Ev 'CERTIFY.txt') -Text ((($cr) -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
    Write-Host ''
    foreach ($l in $cr) { Write-Host "  $l" -ForegroundColor White }
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Ok 'Certified. -Mode Close will stage and commit exactly the owned files.'
    exit 0
  }
  catch {
    Write-Head 'CERTIFICATION ABANDONED'
    Write-Bad ('unexpected failure during certify: ' + $_.Exception.Message)
    Write-Warn 'No stamp was written, so Close will refuse. Throwaway databases may need dropping by hand.'
    exit 3
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# CLOSE
# =============================================================================

if ($Mode -eq 'Close') {

    Write-Head 'PHASE 4 - CLOSE PRECONDITIONS'

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $OwnedFilesPath))   { Stop-Refuse "no owned-file list at $OwnedFilesPath. Run -Mode Apply first." }
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $CertifyStampPath)) { Stop-Refuse "no certification stamp at $CertifyStampPath. Close never commits an uncertified tree." }

    $owned = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $OwnedFilesPath | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' } | Sort-Object -Unique)
    $stamp = Get-Content -LiteralPath $CertifyStampPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json

    if ($stamp.head -ne $headSha) {
        Stop-Refuse ("the stamp certifies HEAD {0}; the tree is now at {1}. Certification does not travel across a commit." -f $stamp.head, $headSha)
    }

    $changedSince = @()
    foreach ($f in $stamp.files) {
        $abs = Join-Path $script:RepoRootFull ($f.path -replace '/', '\')
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $abs)) { $changedSince += ("missing: " + $f.path); continue }
        if ((Get-Sha256 -Path $abs) -ne $f.sha256) { $changedSince += ("edited since certification: " + $f.path) }
    }
    if ($changedSince.Count -gt 0) {
        foreach ($c in ($changedSince | Select-Object -First 15)) { Write-Inf "  $c" }
        Stop-Refuse "$($changedSince.Count) owned file(s) differ from what was certified. Recertify before closing."
    }
    Write-Ok ("{0} owned file(s) byte-identical to the certified state" -f @($stamp.files).Count)

    Write-Head 'PHASE 5 - EXACT STAGING'

    $addArgs = @('add', '--')
    foreach ($rel in $owned) { $addArgs += $rel }
    $add = Invoke-Git $addArgs
    if ($add.Code -ne 0) {
        Write-Inf $add.Text
        Stop-Refuse 'git add of the owned set failed. Nothing is committed.'
    }

    $now = Invoke-Git @('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')
    $stagedNow = @($now.Text -split "`r`n" | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' } | Sort-Object -Unique)

    $foreignStaged = @($stagedNow | Where-Object { $owned -notcontains $_ })
    $missingStaged = @($owned | Where-Object { $stagedNow -notcontains $_ })

    if ($foreignStaged.Count -gt 0) {
        foreach ($f in ($foreignStaged | Select-Object -First 20)) { Write-Inf "  foreign: $f" }
        Invoke-Git @('reset') | Out-Null
        Stop-Refuse "$($foreignStaged.Count) file(s) this pack does not own were staged. The index has been reset."
    }
    if ($missingStaged.Count -gt 0) {
        foreach ($f in ($missingStaged | Select-Object -First 20)) { Write-Inf "  unstaged: $f" }
        Write-Warn 'some owned paths produced no change to stage; they are already identical in HEAD.'
    }
    Write-Ok ("staged set equals the owned set: {0} file(s)" -f $stagedNow.Count)
    Save-Text -Path (Join-Path $script:Ev 'staged.txt') -Text ((($stagedNow) -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")

    Write-Head 'PHASE 6 - COMMIT'

    $commit = Invoke-Git @('commit', '-m', 'Converge product storage to governed three-schema topology')
    if ($commit.Code -ne 0) {
        Write-Inf $commit.Text
        Stop-Refuse 'the commit failed. The index is left as it was for inspection.'
    }
    $newHead = (Invoke-Git @('rev-parse', 'HEAD')).Text.Trim()
    Write-Ok "committed: $($newHead.Substring(0,12))"

    Save-Text -Path (Join-Path $script:Ev 'CLOSE.txt') -Text (
        ("staged files : {0}`r`ncommit       : {1}`r`nmessage      : Converge product storage to governed three-schema topology`r`n" -f $stagedNow.Count, $newHead))
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Ok 'T-087 storage topology convergence closed.'
    exit 0
}

Write-Bad "unhandled mode: $Mode"
exit 2

}
finally {
    if (Test-Path Env:PGPASSWORD) { $env:PGPASSWORD = '' }
    Pop-Location
}

<#
    PPIQ - Transition-aware pooling guard.
    Backlog task: T-236.  Release: M2.
    Worker 3 apply pack. PowerShell 5.1. ASCII only. No credentials, database or network.

    Establishes what a timestamp means before anything compares, orders or aligns two
    of them: source-asserted, effective and ingestion time kept distinct, offset origin
    declared rather than assumed, clock quality declared rather than inferred, and
    ordering refused when uncertainty overlaps.

    Contract and kernel only. Persistence and runtime projection are Worker 1's. No
    protocol-specific time model: one industrial protocol must not become the universal
    product model.

    Reuses the existing kernel refusal language (TerminalState, ExclusionAttribution)
    from Kernel/Common/KernelCommonContracts.cs rather than inventing a parallel one.

    Guarantees:
      Every run ends in APPLY PASS or APPLY FAILED with rollback executed.
      Native commands are wrapped, so a tool writing to stderr cannot bypass rollback.
      Only files this pack created are ever removed.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$RepoRoot = 'C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ',
    [string]$EvidenceRoot = 'C:\Workspace\_ppiq_evidence',
    [switch]$WhatIfPreflight
)

Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$Stamp        = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
$EvidenceDir  = Join-Path $EvidenceRoot ('TransitionAwarePooling\' + $Stamp)
$CoreDir      = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend\PlantProcess.Analytics.Core\Kernel\Regime'
$TestProjDir  = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Tests'
$FixtureDir   = Join-Path $TestProjDir 'GenericValidation'
$CoreProj     = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend\PlantProcess.Analytics.Core\PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.csproj'
$TestProj     = Join-Path $TestProjDir 'PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Tests.csproj'
$ArchProj     = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests.csproj'
$Created      = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$Terminated   = $false

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $EvidenceDir -Force | Out-Null

function Write-Step { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[POOLING] $m" -ForegroundColor Cyan }
function Write-Ok   { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[ OK ] $m" -ForegroundColor Green }
function Write-Bad  { param([string]$m) Write-Host "[FAIL] $m" -ForegroundColor Red }

function Invoke-Native {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Exe,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string[]]$Arguments,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$LogPath,
        [switch]$Quiet
    )

    $previous = $ErrorActionPreference
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'

    $captured = $null
    $code = $null

    try {
        $captured = & $Exe @Arguments 2>&1
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    }
    finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $previous }

    $lines = @($captured | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })
    $lines | Set-Content -LiteralPath $LogPath -Encoding ASCII
    if (-not $Quiet) { $lines | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ } }

    if ($null -eq $code) { $code = 0 }

    return [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = $code; Lines = $lines; LogPath = $LogPath }
}

function Stop-WithRollback {
    param([string]$Reason)

    $script:Terminated = $true

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Bad 'APPLY FAILED'
    Write-Bad $Reason
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'rollback executed:'

    $removed = 0
    foreach ($f in $Created) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force; Write-Host ("  removed  " + $f); $removed++ }
    }
    if ($removed -eq 0) { Write-Host '  nothing had been created yet' }

    if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $CoreDir) -and -not (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $CoreDir -Force)) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $CoreDir -Force
        Write-Host ("  removed empty directory " + $CoreDir)
    }

    Write-Host 'owned created files: removed'
    Write-Host 'foreign changed files: untouched'
    Write-Host 'repository returned to pre-pack state'
    Write-Host ("evidence: " + $EvidenceDir)
    exit 1
}

function Write-AsciiFile {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Content)

    if ([regex]::IsMatch($Content, '[^\x00-\x7F]')) { Stop-WithRollback "ASCII gate: non-ASCII content for $Path" }

    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Content, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    [void]$Created.Add($Path)
}

$Owned = @(
    'Backend/PlantProcess.Analytics.Core/Kernel/Regime/TransitionAwarePoolingContracts.cs',
    'Backend/PlantProcess.Analytics.Core/Kernel/Regime/TransitionAwarePoolingGuard.cs',
    'Backend/tests/PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.Tests/GenericValidation/TransitionAwarePoolingKnownAnswerTests.cs'
)

try {

# ===========================================================================
# PHASE 1 - PREFLIGHT
# ===========================================================================
Write-Step 'Phase 1 - preflight  (backlog task T-236, release M2)'

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend'))) { throw 'STOP: not a PlantProcess-IQ repository root' }
foreach ($p in @($CoreProj, $TestProj, $ArchProj)) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) { throw "project not found: $p" }

Write-Ok 'analytics core, analytics core tests and architecture tests projects present'

if ($null -eq (Get-Command dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw 'dotnet SDK not on PATH' }
$sdk = Invoke-Native -Exe 'dotnet' -Arguments @('--version') -LogPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'dotnet-version.log') -Quiet
Write-Ok ("dotnet SDK " + ($sdk.Lines -join ''))

function Test-PpiqOutputLocked {
    param([string]$Root)

    $candidates = @(
        'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\bin\Debug\net9.0\PlantProcess.Application.dll',
        'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\bin\Debug\net9.0\PlantProcess.Analytics.Core.dll',
        'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\bin\Debug\net9.0\PlantProcess.Domain.dll'
    )

    $locked = @()
    foreach ($rel in $candidates) {
        $abs = Join-Path $Root $rel
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $abs)) { continue }
        try { $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($abs, 'Open', 'ReadWrite', 'None'); $fs.Close(); $fs.Dispose() }
        catch { $locked += $rel }
    }

    return $locked
}

$LockedOutputs = @(Test-PpiqOutputLocked -Root $RepoRoot)
if ($LockedOutputs.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Bad 'STOP: PlantProcess build outputs are locked by a running process.'
    $LockedOutputs | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ("    " + $_) -ForegroundColor Yellow }
    Write-Host '    Get-Process PlantProcess.Api -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force'
    Write-Host '  Nothing was written to the repository.'
    exit 2
}
Write-Ok 'build outputs are writable'

Push-Location $RepoRoot
try {
    $branch = Invoke-Native -Exe 'git' -Arguments @('rev-parse', '--abbrev-ref', 'HEAD') -LogPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'git-branch.log') -Quiet
    $head   = Invoke-Native -Exe 'git' -Arguments @('rev-parse', '--short', 'HEAD')      -LogPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'git-head.log')   -Quiet
    Write-Ok ("branch " + ($branch.Lines -join '') + " at " + ($head.Lines -join ''))

    $status = Invoke-Native -Exe 'git' -Arguments @('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all') `
        -LogPath (Join-Path $EvidenceDir 'git-status-before.txt') -Quiet

    $ForeignDirtyBefore = @($status.Lines | ForEach-Object { ($_ -replace '^..\s+', '') } | Where-Object { $Owned -notcontains $_ })
    Write-Ok ("foreign dirty paths at start: " + $ForeignDirtyBefore.Count)
}
finally { Pop-Location }

foreach ($rel in $Owned) {
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $RepoRoot ($rel -replace '/', '\'))) {
